original: upakramādibhirnirṇītatātparyakasya bhedāgamasya yajamānaprastara ityādyāgamasya pratītārthāprāmāṇyaprasaṃgena bhede prāmāṇyāyogāt| upakramādibhirnirṇītatātparyasyāgamasya bhede prāmāṇyaṃ vācyaṃ| tathā ca śāstreṇopakramādyanusaṃdhānarūpavicārapravṛttau nirṇītatātparyeṇa vedena bhedasiddhiḥ|

original: tatsiddhau jīvabhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃdhigdhatvāpattyā śāstreṇa pravṛttiriti| jīvātmakatve ca sprakāśatvena nityasiddhatvānna viṣayatvaṃ| nāpi paraprayojanaṃ| paraprayojanaṃ bhavatsvargādyabhyudayo vā mokṣo vā syāt| nādyaḥ| laghūpāyena tatsiddheḥ| nā pi mokṣaḥ| jijñāsānaṃtaraṃ mokṣānupalaṃbhāt| astu vā jīvavyatiriktaṃ brahma|
analyzed: tad siddhau jīva bhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃdhigdha tva āpattyā śāstreṇa pravṛttiḥ iti jīva ātmaka tve ca nitya siddha tvāt na viṣaya tvam na api para prayojanam para prayojanam bhavat svarga ādi abhyudayaḥ vā mokṣaḥ vā syāt na ādyaḥ laghu upāyena tad siddheḥ mokṣaḥ jijñāsā anaṃtaram mokṣa anupalaṃbhāt astu vā jīva vyatiriktam brahma

original: tathā'pi nāparokṣadvārā vicārasya taddhetutvaṃ| sākṣātkṛtabrahmaṇāmapi vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ tadanupalaṃbhāt| viṣayaprayojanābhāvāt| atha śabdoktādhikāriviśeṣāsaṃbhavena brahmajijñāsāyāmadhikārī na vidyate| ata eva na saṃbaṃdho'pīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha ||

original: athāto brahmajijñāseti || asyārthaḥ || atha adhyayanaśamadamādirūpādhikārasaṃpattyanaṃtaraṃ| ataḥ svajanyajñānajanyamokṣākhyaphalayuktatvāt| guṇapūrṇasya brahmaṇo viṣṇoḥ jijñāsā śravaṇādirūpo vicāraḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atha atas brahma jijñāsā iti asya arthaḥ atha adhyayana śama dama ādi rūpa adhikāra saṃpatti anaṃtaram atas sva janya jñāna janya mokṣa ākhya phala yukta tvāt guṇa pūrṇasya brahmaṇaḥ viṣṇoḥ jijñāsā śravaṇa ādi rūpaḥ vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca kartavyaiva brahmajijñāsā| saprayojanatvāt| na ca nirviṣayatvena satpratipakṣatā| jīvabhinnasya brahmaṇa eva viṣayatvasaṃbhavena nirviṣayatvāsiddheḥ| na ca bhede mānābhāvaḥ| tadvijijñāsasveti śrutisiddhapūrṇatvasyaiva mānatvāt| na ca jaḍe'sādhāraṇyaṃ| jīvāsaṃbhāvitaguṇapūrṇatvasyaiva hetutvena vivakṣitatvāt| na cānumānasya kāmagāmitvaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca kartavyā eva brahma jijñāsā sa prayojana tvāt na ca nirviṣaya tvena sat pratipakṣa tā jīva bhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ eva viṣaya tva saṃbhavena nirviṣaya tva asiddheḥ na ca bhede māna abhāvaḥ tat vijijñāsasva iti śruti siddha pūrṇa tvasya eva māna tvāt na ca jaḍe sādhāraṇyam jīva asaṃbhāvita guṇa pūrṇa tvasya eva hetu tvena vivakṣita tvāt na ca anumānasya kāma gāmi tvam asti iti vacana anumānasya kāma gāmi tvam asti iti vacana anumānasya kāma gā

original: bhinno'ciṃtya iti śrutimūlatvāt| na copakramādyanusaṃdhānarūpavicārapravṛttau bhinno'ciṃtya ityādyāgamānāṃ bhede tātparyanirṇayaḥ| tasminsati prakṛtānumānasya pramāṇatvena jīvabhannaviṣayatvasiddhiḥ| tatsiddhau ca vicārapravṛttirityanyonyāśraya iti vācyaṃ| tātparyasaṃdehe satyeva vicārāpekṣaṇāt|
analyzed: bhinna uciṃtyaḥ iti śruti mūla tvāt na ca upakrama ādi anusaṃdhāna rūpa vicāra pravṛttau bhinna uciṃtyaḥ ityādi āgamānām bhede tātparya nirṇayaḥ tasmin sati prakṛta anumānasya pramāṇa tvena jīva bhanna viṣaya tva siddhiḥ tad siddhau ca vicāra pravṛttiḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ iti vācyam tātparya saṃdehe sati eva vicāra apekṣaṇāt

original: anyathopakramādīnāmapi svārthe tātparyanirṇayāyopakramādyaṃtaramanveṣaṇīyaṃ syādityanavasthā| tathā ca jīvabhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃdigdhatvena na nirviṣayatvena satpratipakṣaḥ| vyāpyasya prayojanasya sadbhāvena vyāpakasyādhikāriṇo'pi siddheḥ| na tadabhāvenāpi satpratipakṣaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā upakrama ādīnām api svārthe tātparya nirṇayāya upakrama ādi aṃtaram anveṣaṇīyam syāt iti anavasthā tathā ca jīva bhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃdigdha tvena na nirviṣaya tvena sat pratipakṣaḥ vyāpyasya prayojanasya sadbhāvena vyāpakasya adhikāriṇaḥ api siddheḥ na tad abhāvena api sat pratipakṣaḥ

original: nanu sākṣātkṛta brahmaṇāmapi vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ mokṣānupalaṃbhena satprayojanatvamasiddhamiti cenna| anupalaṃbhaḥ kiṃ pratyakṣeṇa| uta pratyakṣamātreṇa| nādyaḥ| paramāṇvādīnāmapyabhāvaprasaṃgāt| dvitīye'pi vartamānakāle sattvānupalaṃbhaḥ| uta kadā'pi| nādyaḥ| jyotiṣṭomādyanuṣṭhānabhāvaprasaṃgāt| nātyaḥ|
analyzed: nanu sākṣātkṛta brahmaṇām api vasiṣṭha ādīnām mokṣa anupalaṃbhena sat prayojana tvam asiddham iti ced na anupalaṃbhaḥ kim pratyakṣeṇa uta pratyakṣa mātreṇa na ādyaḥ paramāṇu ādīnām api abhāva prasaṃgāt dvitīye api vartamāna kāle sattva anupalaṃbhaḥ uta kadāpi na ādyaḥ jyotiṣṭoma ādi anuṣṭhāna bhāva prasaṃgāt na ātyaḥ

original: brahmapralayānaṃtaraṃ vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ mokṣopalaṃbhaśravaṇāt| ata eva saṃbaṃdhābhāvaśca parāstaḥ| tadabhāvenāpi satpratipakṣaḥ| tasmādvicāraḥ kartavya eveti śāstramāraṃbhaṇīyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: brahma pralaya anantaram vasiṣṭha ādīnām mokṣa upalaṃbha śravaṇāt atas eva saṃbaṃdha abhāvaḥ ca parāstaḥ tad abhāvena api sat pratipakṣaḥ tasmāt vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ eva iti śāstram āraṃbhaṇīyam iti siddham

original: || iti jijñāsādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: || janmādyasya yataḥ || ||
analyzed: janma ādyasya yatas

original: nanu jīvedaṃ brahma na viṣṇuḥ| jīvaprāpakarūḍhisadbhāvāt| na ca viṣṇuprāpakayogasadbhāvādviṣṇureva brahma yogādrūḍhermukhyatvādbādhakaṃ vinā mukhyārthatyāgāyogāt| na ca jijñāsyatvameva bādhakaṃ| jijñāsāpadasya jñānecchāvācakatvena vicārārthakatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu jīva idam brahma na viṣṇuḥ jīva prāpaka rūḍhi sadbhāvāt na ca viṣṇu prāpaka yoga sadbhāvāt viṣṇuḥ eva brahma yogāt rūḍheḥ mukhya tvāt bādhakam vinā mukhya artha tyāga ayogāt na ca jijñāsyatvam eva bādhakam jijñāsā padasya jñāna icchā vācaka tvena vicāra arthaka tva abhāvāt

original: tataśca jīvasya brahmapada mukhyārthatvādasya brahmaṇojīvatve siddhe tasya ca svaprakāśatvena saṃdigdhasyāvicāryatvātprakṛtānuguṇameva jijñāsāpadena lakṣaṇīyamiti jijñāsāyā avihitatvānna brahmajijñāsā saṃbhavatīti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati|
analyzed: tatas ca jīvasya brahma pada mukhya artha tvāt asya brahmaṇaḥ jīva tve siddhe tasya ca sva prakāśa tvena saṃdigdhasya avicārya tvāt prakṛta anuguṇam eva jijñāsā padena lakṣaṇīyam iti jijñāsāyāḥ avihita tvāt na brahma jijñāsā saṃbhavati iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || janmādyasya yata iti || asyārthaḥ || asya pramitajīvajaḍātmakaprapaṃcasya| yataḥ yasmāt| janmādi sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraniyamanajñānājñānabaṃdhamokṣarūpāṣṭakaṃ| bhavatīti śrutaṃ tadeva brahma nānyadityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: janma ādyasya yatas iti asya arthaḥ asya pramita jīva jaḍa ātmaka prapaṃcasya yatas yasmāt janma ādi sṛṣṭi sthiti saṃhāra niyamana jñāna ajñāna baṃdha mokṣa rūpa aṣṭakam bhavati iti śrutam tat eva brahma na anyat iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca brahmaśabdasya viṣṇau yogarūḍhatvādviṣṇurevedaṃ brahma| brahmaśabdasya jīve rūḍhatve'pi rūḍhamātrādvidvadrūḍheḥ prābalyena nirṇayopapatteḥ| astu vā jīva evarūḍhistathā'pi yatoveti pūrvavākyoktakāraṇatvapālakatvasaṃhārakatvamuktaprāpyatvānāmayogaprasaṃgena mukhyārthasyāpi tyājyatvāt| na ca teṣāṃ jīve saṃbhavaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca brahma śabdasya viṣṇau yoga rūḍha tvāt viṣṇuḥ eva idam brahma brahma śabdasya jīve rūḍha tve pi rūḍha mātrāt vidvat rūḍheḥ prābalyena nirṇaya upapatteḥ astu vā jīve eva rūḍhiḥ tathā api yatas vā iti pūrva vākya ukta kāraṇatva pālakatva saṃhārakatva mukta prāpyatvānām ayoga prasaṃgena mukhya arthasya api tyājya tvāt na ca teṣām jīve saṃbhavaḥ

original: ya utridhā tvityādinā teṣāṃ viṣṇvaikaniṣṭhatvasya siddhatvājjijñāsāśabdo vicāre rūḍhaḥ| yadi vā lākṣaṇikaḥ| ubhayathā'pyātmā vā're iti śrutisamākhyānādvicāra eveti tadvirodhena na jī'votra vivakṣitaḥ| tataśca jīvātiriktasya brāhmaṇaḥ prāguktaṃ jijñāsyatvaṃ siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: yaḥ tu ityādinā teṣām viṣṇu aika niṣṭhatvasya siddhatvāt jijñāsā śabdaḥ vicāre rūḍhaḥ yadi vā lākṣaṇikaḥ ubhayathā api ātmā vāre iti śruti samākhyānāt vicāraḥ eva iti tad virodhena na vivakṣitaḥ tatas ca jīva atiriktasya brāhmaṇaḥ prāguktam jijñāsyatvam siddham

original: || iti janmādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti janma adhikaraṇam

original: atra pūrvoktajagajjanmādikāraṇatvarūpabrahmalakṣaṇasya rudrādiṣvativyāptiparihārāya jagatkāraṇe pramāṇamucyate|
analyzed: atra pūrva ukta jagat janma ādikāraṇatva rūpa brahma lakṣaṇasya rudra ādiṣu ativyāpti parihārāya jagat kāraṇe pramāṇam ucyate

original: || śāstrayonitvāt || ||
analyzed: śāstra yoni tvāt

original: nanu rudrāderātmāśrayaprasaṃgena rudrādikāraṇatvāyogānnātivyāptiḥ| siddhāṃtyabhimatalakṣaṇasya tatrābhāvāt siddhāṃtyanabhimatarudravyatiriktajagatkāraṇatvopapādanenātivyāptidānasyānucitatvāt| kiṃca sūtrakārābhimataṃ viṣṇujanyabaṃdhādiyogitvaṃ rudrādāvaṃgīkriyate na vā| ādye na tasya kāraṇatvasaṃbhavaḥ| baddhasya devadattāditulyatvāt|
analyzed: nanu rudra ādeḥ ātma āśraya prasaṃgena rudra ādi kāraṇatva ayogāt na ativyāptiḥ siddhāṃti abhimata lakṣaṇasya tatra abhāvāt siddhāṃti anabhimata rudra vyatirikta jagat kāraṇatva upapādanena ativyāpti dānasya anucita tvāt kiṃca sūtrakāra abhimatam viṣṇu janya baṃdha ādi yogitvam rudra ādau aṃgīkriyate na vā ādye na tasya kāraṇatva saṃbhavaḥ baddhasya devadatta ādi tulya tvāt

original: dvitīye'saṃbhava eva vaktavyaḥ| siddhāṃtyabhimatasya rudrājaganniṣṭhajñānābaṃdhādikartṛtvasya viṣṇāvabhāvāditi cet| syādayaṃ doṣaḥ| yadi sūtrakṛdabhimatalakṣaṇasyātivyāptirucyeta| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāma mayo veti śrutyukta lakṣaṇasyaiva| naca rudrādiniṣṭhabaṃdhādi kāraṇatvaṃ śrutyabhipretaṃ| rudrasya viṣṇusamānatvena baṃdhājñānādiśūnyatvāt|
analyzed: dvitīye saṃbhavaḥ eva vaktavyaḥ siddhāṃti abhimatasya viṣṇau abhāvāt iti ced syāt ayam doṣaḥ yadi sūtrakṛt abhimata lakṣaṇasya ativyāptiḥ ucyeta na ca evam kim nāma mayaḥ vā iti śruti ukta lakṣaṇasya eva na ca rudra ādi niṣṭha baṃdha ādi kāraṇatvam śruti abhipretam rudrasya viṣṇu samāna tvena baṃdha ajñāna ādi śūnyatvāt

original: avidyamānarudrādiniṣṭhabaṃdhādikartṛtvasya śrutyarthatve ghaṭasya baṃdhādikartṛtvamapi śrutyarthaḥ syāt| tataśca mahadākartṛtvameva śrutyarthaḥ| na sūtrakāroktaḥ| tasya rudrādāvanumānena siddhatvādityativyāptireva| ata eva na chalaprasaṃgo'pi| pramāṇaṃ tu śivo jagatkartā tadicchutve sati tatkartṛviṣṇusamānatvāt| iti mānaṃ|
analyzed: avidyamāna rudra ādi niṣṭha baṃdha ādi kartṛ tvasya śruti artha tve ghaṭasya baṃdha ādi kartṛ tvam api śruti arthaḥ syāt tatas ca mahat ākartṛ tvam eva śruti arthaḥ na sūtrakāra uktaḥ tasya rudra ādau anumānena siddhatvāt iti ativyāptiḥ eva atas eva na chala prasaṃgaḥ upi pramāṇam tu śivaḥ jagat kartā tad icchu tve sati tad kartṛ viṣṇu samānatvāt iti mānam

original: asya ca sakalalokasiddhatvena nāsidhyādikṣudropadrabaḥ| tataśca tadvijijñāsasveti vākye rudrādigrahaṇe bādhakābhāvāt| rūḍhisadbhāvācca| ato rudra eva vivakṣito na viṣṇuriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: asya ca sakala loka siddha tvena na asidhya ādi kṣudra upadrabaḥ tatas ca tat vijijñāsasva iti vākye rudra ādi grahaṇe bādhaka abhāvāt rūḍhi sadbhāvāt ca atas rudraḥ eva vivakṣitaḥ na viṣṇuḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || śastrayonitvāditi || asyārthaḥ || śivo jagatkartā tadicchutve sati tatkartṛviṣṇusamānatvādityādyanumānairna rudrāderjagatkāraṇatvaṃ kalpyaṃ| kutaḥ| śāstrayonitvāt| śāstraṃ ṛgādirūpaṃ| yoniḥ jñaptikāraṇaṃ yasya tacchāstrayonitvaṃ| tasmājjagatkāraṇaṃ brahma| śāstrekasamadhigamyatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: śastra yoni tvāt iti asya arthaḥ śivaḥ jagat kartā tad icchu tve sati tad kartṛ viṣṇu samāna tvāt ityādi anumānaiḥ na rudra ādeḥ jagat kāraṇatvam kalpyam kutas śāstra yoni tvāt śāstram ṛk ādi rūpam yoniḥ jñapti kāraṇam yasya tat śāstra yoni tvam tasmāt jagat kāraṇam brahma śāstra eka samadhigamya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca viṣṇoreva jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na rudrādīnāṃ| rudrādibaṃdhakāraṇatvāderudrādāvasaṃbhavāt| na ca rudrādikāraṇatvādi na yato veti śrutyartha iti vācyaṃ| imānītyanenotpattyādimattayā pramāṇapramitasarvapadārthagrahaṇāt| rudrasya cotpattyādimattayā pramāṇapramitatvāt| astu vā mahadādikartṛtvameva yato veti śrutyarthaḥ|

original: || || chaṃdobhidhānānneti cenna tathā cetorpaṇanigadāttatāhi darśanamiti || asyārthaḥ || chaṃdobhidhānāt| nanu chaṃdogaśrutisthagāyatrīpadena caturviṃśatyakṣarātmakachaṃdasaḥ pratipādanādgāyatrīśabdavācyo viṣṇurneti cenna| kutaḥ| tathā hi darśanaṃ| hi yasmāt| tathā gānatrāṇakartṛtvanimittena|

original: || evaṃca gānatrāṇakartṛtvaliṃgāt| naca liṃgasya niravakāśatvāyogena śrutibādhāyogaḥ| gāyatrīśruteḥ paurāṇikarūḍhyā śrutyuktayogena ca tatra mukhyatvāt| svabhāveti vacanāṅgāyatryā bhagavadadhīnatvāt| gāyatrīśabdavācyoviṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||

original: || evaṃca chāṃdogye saiṣāṃ catuṣpadetivākyena gāyatrīnāmakasya bhagavataḥ prāguktagāyatrībhūtavāk‌pṛthivīśarīrahṛdayalakṣaṇaṣaḍ‌vidhatvamanūdyāṃśacatuṣṭayarūpavattvarūpaṃ catuṣpādatvaṃ vidhāya svoktārtha eva puruṣasūktamaṃtraḥ samākhyārūpatvenodāhṛtaḥ| bhagavataścatuṣpādatvaṃ ṛṅ‌matreṇa spaṣṭamānukūlyenoktaṃ|

original: evaṃ ca sa eṣo'surityatra duṣṭanirasanādasutvena prakṛṣṭānaṃdarūpatvātprāṇatvena devānāṃ jñānādyaiśvaryapradatvādasurāṇāmajñānādyaiśvaryahetutvācca bhūtyabhūtitvena ca tā vā etā ityatra sarvavedoktatvena tadayaṃ prāṇa ityatra deharathitvena taṃ devāḥ prāmayaṃta ityatra sarvadevatopāsyatvena coktatvāt|

analyzed: na ca pūrvapakṣi liṃgasya niravakāśa tvena api prābalyam iti atra sarva devatā upāsya tvena ca ukta tvāt na ca pūrvapakṣi liṃgasya niravakāśa tvena api prābalyam prāṇaiḥ saha gaṇita tvasya aṃtaryāmi niṣṭha tā saṃbhavāt prābalye pi eka prakāreṇa prabalāt pūrvapakṣi liṃgāt prakāra dvayena api prabalasya saiddhāṃtika liṃgasya ādhikyena nirṇaya upapatteḥ

analyzed: na vaktuḥ ātma upadeśāt iti ced adhyātma saṃbaṃdha bhūmā hi asmin iti asya arthaḥ dvitīyā arthe ṣaṣṭhī vaktuḥ bṛhatīsahasra vaktāram viśvāmitram prati iṃdreṇa ātma upadeśāt ātmanaḥ svasya prāṇatayā upadeśāt iṃdraḥ eva ayam prāṇaḥ na viṣṇuḥ iti ced na iti śeṣaḥ tasya āvṛttiḥ anugamāt iti anuvartate tathā ca prāk ukta anugama hetoḥ na iṃdraḥ prāṇaḥ

original: tathā sati upadeśavirodha ityapi na| kutaḥ| yasyāt asminprakaraṇe bhagavataḥ adhyātmasaṃbaṃdhabhūmā iṃdraviśvāmitrādirūpabahudehasaṃbaṃdhaḥ ukto'sti| tasmādityarthaḥ || yadvā || hi yasmāt| asmin iṃdre| adhyātmasaṃbaṃdhabhūmā| adhi adhikasya| ātmanaḥ| saṃbaṃdhasya āveśasya| bhūmā bāhulyaṃ vidyate| tasmādityarthaḥ ||

original: || || na ca smārtamataddharmābhilāpāditi || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye| smārta kāpilasmṛtyuktaṃ| pradhānaṃ jīvaśca aṃtaryāmī na| kutaḥ| ataddharmābhilāpāt taddharmāṇāṃ pradhānajīvadharmāṇāṃ triguṇatvasaṃsāritvādīnāṃ| anabhilāpāt anuktatvādityarthaḥ ||

original: || || śārīraścobhaye'pi hi bhedenainamadhīyata iti || āsyārthaḥ || co naño'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| ubhaye mādhyaṃdināḥ kāṇvāśca| ātmanoṃ'taraṃ vijñānādaṃtara iti| enaṃ jīvaṃ| aṃtaryāmiṇaḥ sakāśāt| bhedena bhinnatvena| adhīyate paṭhaṃti| tasmācchārīro jīvaśca nāṃtaryāmītyarthaḥ ||

original: nanu yattadadreśyami tyuktādṛśyatvādiguṇako na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu jaḍaprakṛtiḥ| akṣarātsaṃbhavatīheti araśabdaśravaṇāt| na cākṣaraśabdo viṣṇāvapi sāvakāśaḥ| tatparataḥ parābhidhānāt| na ca viṣṇoḥ paro'sti| pṛthivyādidṛṣṭāṃtenopādānatayā jagatkāraṇatvābhidhānācca| citprakṛterevaitadadṛśyatvādikaṃ| tasyāmakṣaraśabdasya kūṭastha iti smṛtisiddhatvāt|
analyzed: nanu yat tat adreśyam iti ukta adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu jaḍa prakṛtiḥ akṣarāt saṃbhavati iha iti ara śabda śravaṇāt na ca akṣara śabdaḥ viṣṇau api sa avakāśaḥ tad paratas para abhidhānāt na ca viṣṇoḥ paraḥ asti pṛthivyādi dṛṣṭāṃtena upādānatayā jagat kāraṇatva abhidhānāt ca cit prakṛteḥ eva etat adṛśya tva ādikam tasyām akṣara śabdasya kūṭasthaḥ iti smṛti siddha tvāt

original: vikāritvena jagatkāraṇatvavacanaṃ vikārābhimānitvādyujyate| aśrarātparata ityetadapi parato'kṣarāditi sāmānādhikaraṇyenopapadyate| hiraṇyagarbhasya vetadadṛśyatvādikaṃ| sabrahmavidyāmityādi brahmaśabdāt| rudrasya vaitadadṛśyatvādikaṃ| kartāramīśami tīśaśabdaśravaṇāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: vikāri tvena jagat kāraṇatva vacanam vikāra abhimāni tvāt yujyate aśrarāt paratas iti etat api paratas ukṣarāt iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena upapadyate hiraṇyagarbhasya vā etat adṛśya tva ādikam sa brahma vidyām ityādi brahma śabdāt rudrasya vā etat adṛśya tva ādikam kartāram īśam iti īśa śabda śravaṇāt iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || adṛśyatvādiguṇako dharmokteriti || asyārthaḥ || adṛśyatvādiguṇakaḥ yattadadraśyamiti śrutyuktādṛśyatvādidharmaviśiṣṭākṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureva| na prakṛtyādiḥ| kutaḥ| dharmokte ṛgādiparavidyāviṣayatvarūpaviṣṇudharmasya yayeti śrutyuktatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ dharma ukteḥ iti asya arthaḥ adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ yat tat adraśyam iti śruti ukta adṛśya tva ādi dharma viśiṣṭa akṣara śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na prakṛti ādiḥ kutas dharma ukte ṛk ādi para vidyā viṣaya tva rūpa viṣṇu dharmasya yayā iti śruti ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcātha parāyaye tyadṛśyatvādiguṇakasya paravidyāviṣayatvābhidhānādadṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca atha ti adṛśya tva ādi guṇakasya paravidyā viṣaya tva abhidhānāt adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ ca netarau || ||
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa bheda vyapadeśābhyām ca na itarau

original: nanu viṣṇuprāpakaparavidyāviṣayatvavajjaḍaprakṛtiviriṃcarudraprāpakānāmapi bhāvātta evādṛśatvādiguṇakāḥ kiṃ na syurityato viśeṣayuktyā parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu viṣṇu prāpaka para vidyā viṣaya tva vat jaḍa prakṛti viriṃca rudra prāpakānām api bhāvāt te eva ādṛśatva ādi guṇakāḥ kim na syuḥ iti atas viśeṣa yuktyā parākurvat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ ca netarāviti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye itarau prakṛtidvayaṃ viriṃcarudrau ca| nādṛśyatvādiguṇakau| kutaḥ| viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ pratijñādvaye krameṇaikakaihetvanvayaḥ| yaḥ sarvajña iti sārvajñyādiviśeṣaṇāt| tasmādetaditi adṛśyatvādiguṇakākṣarādviriṃcarudrayerbhedokteścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa bheda vyapadeśābhyām ca na itarau iti asya arthaḥ caḥ samuccaye itarau prakṛti dvayam viriṃca rudrau ca na adṛśya tva ādi guṇakau kutas viśeṣaṇa bheda vyapadeśābhyām pratijñā dvaye krameṇa eka kai hetu anvayaḥ yaḥ sarvajñaḥ iti sārvajñya ādi viśeṣaṇāt tasmāt etat iti adṛśya tva ādi guṇaka akṣarāt viriṃca rudra yeḥ bheda ukteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca jaḍaprakṛtitvavirodhisārvajñyādiviśeṣaṇasya tasmādetaditi viriṃcatvavirodhi juṣṭaṃ yadāpaśyatyanyamiti rudratvavirodhibhedavyapadeśasya cābhāvenāsaṃbhavāt| na ca parataḥparābhidhānānna viṣṇuriti vācyaṃ| aparaṃ tvakṣaramiti tryakṣarābhidhānena parato madhyamākṣarātparatvasaṃbhavenāvirodhādadṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jaḍa prakṛti tva virodhi sārvajñya ādi viśeṣaṇasya tasmāt etat iti viriṃca tva virodhi juṣṭam yadā apaśyati anyam iti rudra tva virodhi bheda vyapadeśasya ca abhāvena asaṃbhavāt na ca paratas para abhidhānāt na viṣṇuḥ iti vācyam aparam tu akṣaram iti tri akṣara abhidhānena paratas madhyama akṣarāt paratva saṃbhavena avirodhāt adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || || rūpopanyāsācca || ||
analyzed: rūpa upanyāsāt ca

original: yutkyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorevādṛśyatvādiguṇakatvaṃ sādhayatsūtramavatārayati ||
analyzed: yutki aṃtareṇa viṣṇoḥ eva adṛśya tva ādi guṇaka tvam sādhayat sūtram avatārayati

original: || || rūpopanyāsācceti || asyārthaḥ || yadā paśyaḥpaśyata iti viṣṇvasādhāraṇasvarṇarūpa pratipādanāccādṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: rūpa upanyāsāt ca iti asya arthaḥ yadā paśyaḥ paśyataḥ iti viṣṇu asādhāraṇa svarṇa rūpa pratipādanāt ca adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca viṣṇvasādhāraṇarukmarūpapratipādanāt| eko nārāyaṇa ityatra śuklādirūpāṇāṃ manuṣyādau miśrīkaraṇasyoktatvādadṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca viṣṇu asādhāraṇa rukma rūpa pratipādanāt ekaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ iti atra śukla ādi rūpāṇām manuṣya ādau miśrīkaraṇasya ukta tvāt adṛśya tva ādi guṇakaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || iti adṛśyatvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti adṛśya tva adhikaraṇam

original: atra pācakatvādyanekaliṃgasamanvayasidhyarthaṃ brahmaṇi vaiśvānaranāmasamanvayaḥ kriyate ||
analyzed: atra pācaka tva ādi aneka liṃga samanvaya sidhi artham brahmaṇi vaiśvānara nāma samanvayaḥ kriyate

original: || vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāt || ||
analyzed: vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇa śabda viśeṣāt

original: nanu nāyaṃ vaiśvānaro viṣṇuḥ| sādhakaśūnyatvāt| sarvagatatvaliṃgasyānyavaprasiddhavaiśvānaraśrutyā bādhitatvāt| na ca liṃgasya niravakāśatvena tena śrutibādhaḥ| śruterapi| niravakāśatvāt| vaisvānaraśruternibādhasādhakaśūnyatvenāgniviṣṇvoḥ sādhāraṇanyena cānyaniścāyakatvābhāvāt| ato vaiśvānaro na viṣṇuriti prāpte sūtramā ||
analyzed: nanu na ayam vaiśvānaraḥ viṣṇuḥ sādhaka śūnyatvāt sarvagata tva liṃgasya bādhita tvāt na ca liṃgasya niravakāśa tvena tena śruti bādhaḥ śruteḥ api niravakāśa tvāt vaisvānara śruteḥ ca anya niścāyaka tva abhāvāt atas vaiśvānaraḥ na viṣṇuḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāditi || arayārthaḥ || vaiśvānaraḥ yastvetamityādi vākyagatavaiśvānarādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureva natvagniḥ| kutaḥ| sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāt| agniviṣṇvoḥ sādhāraṇasya vaiśvānaraśabdasya ātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramiti śrutāvātmaśabdena viśeṣitatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇa śabda viśeṣāt iti arayā arthaḥ vaiśvānaraḥ yaḥ tu etam ityādi vākya gata vaiśvānara ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na tu agniḥ kutas sādhāraṇa śabda viśeṣāt agni viṣṇvoḥ sādhāraṇasya vaiśvānara śabdasya ātmānam vaiśvānaram iti śrutau ātma śabdena viśeṣita tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca sādhāraṇasyāpi vaiśvānaraśabdasya viṣṇvaikaniṣṭhatayā śrutyādisiddhenātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramityātmaśabdaviśeṣitatvādviṣṇuparatvasaṃbhavāt| prasiddhyāderanyathopapannatvena nirṇayakāraṇābhāvācchabdaviśeṣādātmaśabdādvaiśvānaro viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sādhāraṇasya api vaiśvānara śabdasya viṣṇu aika niṣṭhatayā śruti ādi siddhena ātmānam vaiśvānaram iti ātma śabda viśeṣita tvāt viṣṇu paratva saṃbhavāt prasiddhi ādeḥ anyathā upapanna tvena nirṇaya kāraṇa abhāvāt śabda viśeṣāt ātma śabdāt vaiśvānaraḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || || smaryamāṇamanumānaṃ syāditi || ||
analyzed: smaryamāṇam anumānam syāt iti

original: || || smaryamāṇamanumānaṃ syāditīti || asyārthaḥ || iti smaryamāṇaṃ ahaṃ vaiśvānarobhūtve tyuktaṃ viṣṇorvaiśvānaratvaṃ| anumānaṃ vaiśvānaravidyāyāḥ gītoktabhagavatparatvasyānumāpakaṃ| syāt bhavedityarthaḥ ||

analyzed: evam ca gītā smṛteḥ vaiśvānara vidyā samāna ukti rūpatvāt asyāḥ tad samākhyānāt nirṇayaka tvena vaiśvānaraḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || śabdādibhyoṃ'taḥ pratiṣṭhānānneti cenna tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśādasaṃbhavātpuruṣavidhamapi cainamadhīyate || ||
analyzed: śabda ādibhyaḥ antar pratiṣṭhānāt na iti ced na tathā dṛṣṭi upadeśāt asaṃbhavāt puruṣavidham api ca enam adhīyate

original: nanu vaiśvānaramṛta ajātamagnimī tyagniśabdasya vaiśvānare tadhdutaṃ bhavati| hṛdayaṃ gārhapatya ityāgniliṃgasya yenedamannaṃ pacyata ityādinā pācakatvenāṃtaḥ pratiṣṭhānasya ca śravamāt| eteṣāṃ viṣṇāvanavakāśāt| ityādinā vaiśvānarasya viṣṇutvamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu ajātam agnim iti agni śabdasya vaiśvānare tat hdutam bhavati hṛdayam gārhapatyaḥ iti āgni liṃgasya yena idam annam pacyate ityādinā pācaka tvena aṃtar pratiṣṭhānasya ca śravamāt eteṣām viṣṇau anavakāśāt ityādinā vaiśvānarasya viṣṇu tvam ākṣipya samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || || sabhdādibhyoṃ'taḥpratiṣṭhānānneti cenna tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśādasaṃbhavātpuruṣavidhamapi cainamadhīyata iti || asyārthaḥ || yuktisamuccaye ca śabdaḥ| śabdādibhyaḥ agniśabda homādhikaraṇatvaliṃgādityarthaḥ| aṃtaḥpratiṣṭhānāt pācakatvena śarīrāṃtarāvasthānācca| vaiśvānaro na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu agnireveti cenna| kutaḥ| tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśāt|
analyzed: sabhda ādibhyaḥ aṃtar pratiṣṭhānāt na iti ced na tathā dṛṣṭi upadeśāt asaṃbhavāt puruṣavidham api ca enam adhīyate iti asya arthaḥ yukti samuccaye ca śabdaḥ śabda ādibhyaḥ agni śabda homa adhikaraṇa tva liṃgāt iti arthaḥ aṃtar pratiṣṭhānāt pācaka tvena śarīra aṃtara avasthānāt ca vaiśvānaraḥ na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu agniḥ eva iti ced na kutas tathā dṛṣṭi upadeśāt

original: agnyādināmaliṃgakarmavattvena dṛṣṭyupadeśāt upāsanopadeśādityarthaḥ| tathā ca agnyādiśrutiliṃgānāṃ viṣṇau sāvakāśatvānna tadvirodha iti bhāvaḥ| kiṃcātroktātmatvabrahmatvādīnāṃ agnyādāvasaṃbhavācca vaiśvānaro viṣṇureva| api ca yataḥ chaṃdogāḥ enaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ| puruṣavidhaṃ puruṣasūktapratipādyanārāyaṇamānaguṇakameva| adhīyate abhidadhati|
analyzed: agni ādi nāma liṃga karmavattvena dṛṣṭi upadeśāt upāsana upadeśāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca agni ādi śruti liṃgānām viṣṇau sāvakāśa tvāt na tad virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kiṃca atra ukta ātmatva brahma tva ādīnām agni ādau asaṃbhavāt ca vaiśvānaraḥ viṣṇuḥ eva api ca yatas chaṃdogāḥ enam vaiśvānaram puruṣavidham puruṣasūkta pratipādya nārāyaṇa māna guṇakam eva adhīyate abhidadhati

original: ato'pi viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ| ca śabdena puruṣasūktasya viṣṇuparatvaṃ bahupramāṇasiddhamiti sūcayati ||
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ eva iti arthaḥ ca śabdena puruṣasūktasya viṣṇu paratvam bahu pramāṇa siddham iti sūcayati

original: || evaṃca sarvanāmā sarvakarmetyādinā mahopaniṣadi tattannāmaliṃgatvena dṛṣṭyupadeśāt| ko na ātmā kiṃ brahmoti viṣṇerevāraṃbhāt| caṃdramā manaso jāta ityādīnā vaiśvānarasya tadvidhatvābhidhānācca| tataśca vaiśvānaro viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sarva nāmā sarva karmā ityādinā mahā upaniṣadi tad tad nāma liṃga tvena dṛṣṭi upadeśāt kaḥ naḥ ātmā kim brahma uti viṣṇeḥ eva āraṃbhāt caṃdramāḥ manasaḥ jātaḥ ityādīnām vaiśvānarasya tadvidha tva abhidhānāt ca tatas ca vaiśvānaraḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || ataeva na devatā bhūtaṃca || ||
analyzed: atas eva na devatā bhūtam ca

original: nanu vaiśvānaraśabdasya tejasi bhūte'gnidevatāyāṃ ca prasiddhatvādatrāpyasau tatparaḥ syāditi prāpte tannirāsāya sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu vaiśvānara śabdasya tejasi bhūta igni devatāyām ca prasiddha tvāt atra api asau tatparaḥ syāt iti prāpte tad nirāsāya sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || ata eva na devatā bhūtaṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || devatā agnyādirūpā| bhūtaṃ tadabhimanyamānatejobhūtaṃ ca| vaiśvānaraśabda vācyaṃ na| kutaḥ| ataeva niravakāśātmaśabdādi heterevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atas eva na devatā bhūtam ca iti asya arthaḥ devatā agni ādi rūpāḥ bhūtam tad abhimanyamāna tejaḥ bhūtam ca vaiśvānara śabda vācyam na kutas ataeva niravakāśa ātma śabda ādi heteḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca niravakāśātmaśabdaśravaṇādvaiśvānaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca niravakāśa ātma śabda śravaṇāt vaiśvānara śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || sākṣādapyavirodhaṃ jaiminiḥ || ||
analyzed: sākṣāt api avirodham jaiminiḥ

original: nanu loke vede cāgnyādipadānāmīśādanyatra vyavahāraprasiddhidarśanāt| tasya ca kāraṇāṃtarābhāvāttadanyathā'nupapattyā'nyeṣāṃ vācyatvamaṃgīkāryaṃ| anyathā tadvirodhaḥ syāditi prāpte tannirāsāya sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: nanu loke vede ca agni ādi padānām īśāt anyatra vyavahāra prasiddhi darśanāt tasya ca kāraṇa aṃtara abhāvāt tad anyathā anupapattyā anyeṣām vācyatvam aṃgīkāryam anyathā tad virodhaḥ syāt iti prāpte tad nirāsāya sūtram vyācaṣṭe

original: || || sākṣādapyāvirodhaṃ jaiminiriti || asyārthaḥ || sākṣāt mukhyavṛttyā| api brahmaṇo'gnyādiśabdavācyatve'pi| avirodhaṃ ajñānādinimittāṃtareṇa agnyādau tattacchabdavirodhābhāvaṃ| jaiminirācāryo vaktītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sākṣāt api āvirodham jaiminiḥ iti asya arthaḥ sākṣāt mukhya vṛttyā api brahmaṇā agni ādi śabda vācyatve pi avirodham ajñāna ādi nimitta aṃtareṇa agni ādau tad tad śabda virodha abhāvam jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ vakti iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃcāgnyādiśabdānāṃ brahmavadagnyādyavācitvepyagnyādijñānārthamabhijñairanyatra vyavahārāt| anabhijñaistu paramamukhyārthabhagavadajñānādeva mukhyārthe'gnyādāveva prayogeṇa prasidhyupapatteragnyādiśabdā viṣṇuvācakāḥ| na ca jaiminyādimatānāṃ vyāsamatena parasparaṃ virodhaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca agni ādi śabdānām brahma vat agni ādi avāci tve pi agni ādi jñāna artham abhijñaiḥ anyatra vyavahārāt anabhijñaiḥ tu parama mukhya artha bhagavat ajñānāt eva mukhya arthe agni ādau eva prayogeṇa prasidhi upapatteḥ agni ādi śabdāḥ viṣṇu vācakāḥ na ca jaimini ādi matānām vyāsa matena parasparam virodhaḥ

original: || || abhivyakterityāśmarathya iti || asyārthaḥ || abhivyakteḥ agnyādiṣu brahmopāstau kṛtāyāṃ teṣu brahmaṇo'bhivyakteḥ| tannimitto'gnyādisūktaniyama iti āśmarathyācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ ||

original: || evaṃcāgnyādisūktairupāsakānāmagnyādau ca bhagavadabhivyaktyā sūktaniyamasaṃbhavādagnyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ| tataścāśmarathyācāryamatenāvirodha iti siddhaṃ ||

original: || anusmṛterbādariḥ || ||

original: || || anusmṛterbādaririti || asyārthaḥ || anusmṛteḥ tattasūktādyupāsakairagnyādiṣveva brahmaṇo'nusmṛteḥ anusaṃdhānāddhetoḥ| agnyādisūktavyavastheti bādarirvaktītyarthaḥ ||

original: || evaṃcāgnyādisūktairupāsakānāmagnyādau viṣṇoḥ smartavyatvātsūktaniyamasaṃbhavādagnyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ| tathāca badarātmajasya śukācāryasya matasyāvirodha iti sthitaṃ ||

original: || || saṃpatteriti jaiministathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| taṃ yatheti hi prasiddhāśrutiḥ tathā darśayati yathā jaiminimataṃ tathā pratipādayati| tasmājjaiminiḥ svoktyanukūlaśrutyanusārema saṃpatteḥ agnyādisūktopāsakānāmagnyādiprāptihetoḥ| tadvivakṣayā sūktādiniyama iti āhetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃpatteḥ iti jaiminiḥ tathā hi darśayati iti asya arthaḥ hi yasmāt tam yathā iti hi prasiddha śrutiḥ tathā darśayati yathā jaimini matam tathā pratipādayati tasmāt jaiminiḥ sva ukti anukūla śruti anusārā ima saṃpatteḥ agni ādi sūkta upāsakānām agni ādi prāpti hetoḥ tad vivakṣayā sūkta ādi niyamaḥ iti āha iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃcāgnyādisūktādiṣu mukhyataḥ para brahmaṇa eva pratipādyatve'pi sūktādiniyamo yujyate| bhagavadupāsakānāmagnyādiprāptirbhavati| ato laukikavyavahārāvirodha iti jaiminirmanyate| ataḥ sūktaniyamo'bhyupagaṃtavya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca agni ādi sūkta ādiṣu mukhyatas para brahmaṇaḥ eva pratipādya tve pi sūkta ādi niyamaḥ yujyate bhagavat upāsakānām agni ādi prāptiḥ bhavati atas laukika vyavahāra avirodhaḥ iti jaiminiḥ manyate atas sūkta niyamaḥ abhyupagaṃtavyaḥ iti siddham

original: || āmanaṃti cainamasmin || ||

original: || || āmanaṃti cainamasminniti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ śaṃkānivartakaḥ| yasmāt enaṃ viṣṇuṃ| agnyādau āmanaṃti tatsthatayā yo'gnau tiṣṭhanni tyādyāḥ śrutayaḥ pratipādayaṃti| tasmātkathamagnyādiṣu viṣṇūpāstyā'gnyādi prāptirbhavatīti śaṃkā nivṛttā| kutaḥ| agnyādipadena tatsthabhagavatprāpterevābhipretatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: āmanaṃti ca enam asmin iti asya arthaḥ caḥ śaṃkā nivartakaḥ yasmāt enam viṣṇum agni ādau āmanaṃti tad stha tayā tiṣṭhan ityādyāḥ śrutayaḥ pratipādayaṃti tasmāt katham agni ādiṣu viṣṇu upāstyā agni ādi prāptiḥ bhavati iti śaṃkā nivṛttā kutas agni ādi padena tad stha bhagavat prāpteḥ eva abhipreta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca tattatsūktopāsakānāmagnyādipadena tadaṃtargataviṣṇuprāptervivakṣitatvāt| viṣṇūpāsakasyāgnyādiprāptyukterayogāt| na ca viṣṇoragnyādyaṃtargatatvāsiddhiḥ| yo'gnau tiṣṭhannityādiśruteḥ| ato'gnyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca tad tad sūkta upāsakānām agni ādi padena tad aṃtargata viṣṇu prāpteḥ vivakṣita tvāt viṣṇu upāsakasya agni ādi prāpti ukteḥ ayogāt na ca viṣṇoḥ agni ādi aṃtargata tva asiddhiḥ yaḥ ugnau tiṣṭhan ityādi śruteḥ atas agni ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || || dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ svaśabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ yasminniti vākyoktasvarga bhūmyādi sarvāśrayo viṣṇureva| na tvanyaḥ| kutaḥ| svaśabdāt sveti śabdaḥ svaśabdaḥ svaśabdagṛhīta brahmavācakātmaśabdādityarthaḥ ||

original: || evaṃca tamevaikamātmānamityātmaśabdādviṣṇordyubhvādyāyatanatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca tam eva ekam ātmānam iti ātma śabdāt viṣṇoḥ dyubhvā ādi āyatana tvam iti siddham

original: || muktopasṛpyavyapadeśāt || ||
analyzed: mukta upasṛpya vyapadeśāt

original: nanu viṣṇau mukhyo'pyātmaśabdo'rā iva rathanābhāvityatra bahudhājāyamānatvarūpajīvaliṃgāt| tasya jīvavādeva prāṇitvasiddheḥ| tataśca jīva eva dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||

original: || || muktopasṛpyavyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || dyubhvādhyāyatanatvaṃ na viṣṇoranyasya| kiṃtu viṣṇoreva| kutaḥ| muktopasṛpyavyapadeśāt| bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ| dyubhvādyāyatanasya vastuno'mṛtasyaiṣaseturiti muktaprāpyatvavacanāttasya cānyatrāyogādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: mukta upasṛpya vyapadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ dyu bhvā ādhi āyatana tvam na viṣṇoḥ anyasya kiṃtu viṣṇoḥ eva kutas mukta upasṛpya vyapadeśāt bhāva pradhānaḥ yam dyu bhvā ādi āyatanasya vastunā umṛtasya eṣa setuḥ iti mukta prāpya tva vacanāt tasya ca anyatra ayogāt iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃcāmṛtasyaiṣaseturbrahmavidāpnoti paramityādiṣu muktaprāpyatvavacanādviṣṇordyubhvādyāyatanatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca amṛtasya eṣa setuḥ brahma vidā āpnoti param ityādiṣu mukta prāpya tva vacanāt viṣṇoḥ dyubhvā ādi āyatana tvam iti siddham

original: || nānumānamatacchabdāt || ||

original: nanu viṣṇuprāpakavat rudraprakṛtyorapi prāpakasadbhāvāttayordyubhvādyāyatanatvaṃ syāditi prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||

original: || || nānumānamatacchabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || anumānaṃ anumānamiti vā| manumānasiddhaprāmāṇyayutapāśupatādyāgamaiḥ sarvāśrayatayā kalpitaṃ| rudrapradhānādikaṃ dyubhvādyāyatanaṃva| kṛtaḥ| atacchabdāt bhasmadharogratvāditacchutiliṃgādyabhāvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na anumānam atacchabdāt iti asya arthaḥ anumānam anumānam iti vā manumāna siddha prāmāṇya yuta pāśupata ādi āgamaiḥ sarva āśraya tayā kalpitam rudra pradhāna ādikam dyubhva ādi āyatanam vai kṛtaḥ atacchabdāt bhasma dharā ugra tva ādi tad śuti liṃga ādi abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca rudrādiśabdānāṃ sāvakāśatvena prāṇānāmityādivākyasya rudraparavānirṇayenāsādhakatvāt| niravakāśānāṃ ca bhasmadharogrādi śabdānāmabhāvāt| tataśca viṣṇordyubhvādyāyatanavamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || prāṇabhṛcca || ||

original: nanu sa eṣa ityatra jāyamānatvarūpajīvaliṃgaśravaṇātprāṇitvasiddheśca jīvasāmānyasya vāyunā vai gautamasūtreṇāyaṃ loka iti viṣayabhūtalokādhāratvasya vāyuniṣṭhatvena śravaṇādvāyorvā dyubhvādyāyatanatvaṃ syāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu saḥ eṣaḥ iti atra jāyamāna tva rūpa jīva liṃga śravaṇāt prāṇi tva siddheḥ ca jīva sāmānyasya vāyunā vai gautamasūtreṇa ayam lokaḥ iti viṣaya bhūta loka ādhāra tvasya vāyu niṣṭha tvena śravaṇāt vāyoḥ vā dyu bhvā ādi āyatana tvam syāt iti prāpte sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || prāṇabhṛcceti || jīvo'pyata eva dyubhvādyāyatana ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prāṇabhṛt ca iti jīvaḥ upyate eva dyubhva ādi āyatane iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca prāguktasāvakāśasādhakasadbhāve'pi niravakāśātmaśabdābhāvādeva tatprāpakatvenābhimatasya bahudhā janmāderajāyamāna iti śruterviṣṇāveva saṃbhavācca na jīvasya vāyorvā dyubhvādyāyatanatvamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || bhedavyapadeśāt || ||

original: nanu jīvaliṃgasya kiṃ viṣṇutvapratipādanāyāsena jīvasyaiva dyubhvādyāyatanatve viṣṇostallābhasaṃbhavāt| na coktahetuvirodhaḥ| jīveśābhedābhiprāyeṇa jīve'pyātmaśabdādyuktisaṃbhavājjīva eva dyubhvādyāyatanatvena pratipādyo bhavediti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu jīva liṃgasya kim viṣṇu tva pratipādana āyāsena jīvasya eva dyu bhu ādi āyatana tve viṣṇoḥ tad lābha saṃbhavāt na ca ukta hetu virodhaḥ jīva īśa abheda abhiprāyeṇa jīve pi ātma śabda ādi ukti saṃbhavāt jīvaḥ eva dyu bhu ādi āyatana tvena pratipādyaḥ bhavet iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || bhedavyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || anyamīśamiti jīveśayorbhedokterna tayoraikyamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bheda vyapadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ anyam īśam iti jīva īśayoḥ bheda ukteḥ na tayoḥ aikyam iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca juṣṭhaṃ yadā paśyatītyatra darśanakartṛtvena prakṛtajīvasyeśapadokteśvarādbhedokte rviṣṇureva dyubhvādyāyatanatvena pratipādya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca juṣṭham yadā paśyati iti atra darśana kartṛ tvena prakṛta jīvasya īśa pada ukta īśvarāt bheda ukteḥ rviṣṇuḥ eva dyubhvā ādi āyatana tvena pratipādyaḥ iti siddham

original: || || prakaraṇāt || ||

original: || || prakaraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || anyamityāderviṣṇuprakaraṇatvāt| atra jīvasya viṣṇubheda evocyate| na tvanyasmādbheda ityarthaḥ ||

original: || evaṃca dvevidyaityasya paravidyāviṣayavastuno'trādhītatvena viṣṇuprakaraṇatvātparamātmana eva bhedavyapadeśāvagaterviṣṇureva dyubhvādyāyatana iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca dve vidyā ityasya paravidyā viṣaya vastunā ūtra adhīta tvena viṣṇu prakaraṇa tvāt paramātmanaḥ eva bheda vyapadeśa avagateḥ viṣṇuḥ eva dyubhva ādi āyatanaḥ iti siddham

analyzed: evam na kevalam juṣṭam iti bheda śruteḥ jīva īśa bhedaḥ utra prakaraṇe vivakṣitaḥ iti jñāyate kiṃtu liṃgāt api iti āha sūtrakṛt

original: || || sthityadanābhyāṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || īśajīvayordvāsuparṇe tyādivākyoktaṃ karmaphalānupajīvanastititadupajīvanarūpahetubhyāṃ ca na tayoraikyaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sthiti adanābhyām ca iti asya arthaḥ īśa jīvayoḥ dvāsuparṇe tyādi vākya uktam karma phala anupajīvana stiti tad upajīvana rūpa hetubhyām ca na tayoḥ aikyam vācyam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bhūmākhyaḥ prāṇo bhavet| prāṇo veti prāṇasyottamatvamuktvā taduttamamanukatvā bhūmna āmnātatvāt| utkrāṃta prāṇān śūlenetyanenoktramaṇaliṃgaśravaṇāt| na cedaṃ liṃge viṣṇāvavakāśamarhati| sarvagatatvāt| prāṇaśabdasya vāyuvācyatvāt| tataścānaṃdamayo'pi sa eveti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati ||

original: || || bhūmā saṃprasādādadhyupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhūmā yo vai bhūmeti śrutau bhūmaśabdoktapūrṇo| viṣṇureva| kutaḥ| saṃprasādāt bhūmnastatsukhamityanena saṃprasādaśabditapūrṇasukharūpatvābhidhānāt| kiṃca adhyupadeśāt nāmāderapi tadupari nāmādidevatottamatvena bhūm‌no'bhidānāccetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: bhūmā saṃprasādāt adhyupadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ bhūmā yaḥ vai bhūmā iti śrutau bhūma śabda ukta pūrṇaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva kutas saṃprasādāt bhūmnaḥ tat sukham iti anena saṃprasāda śabdita pūrṇa sukha rūpatva abhidhānāt kiṃca adhyupadeśāt nāma ādeḥ api tad upari nāma ādi devatā uttamatvena bhūmnaḥ abhidānāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca viṣṇurevāyaṃ bhūmā| pūrṇasūkhatvāt| tasya cānyatra niravakāśatvāt| kiṃcāsya bhūmnaḥ sarveṣāmuparyupadeśaḥ śrūyate| na cāsyānyatrāvakāśaḥ| na copakrame prāṇaśabdaśravaṇena kathamasau viṣṇuriti vācyaṃ| prāṇaśabdenāpi viṣṇoruktatvāt| na cotkramaṇādi liṃgavirodhaḥ| tamutkraṃtamitiśrutisiddhatvena tasya viṣṇāveva mukhyatvāt|
analyzed: evaṃca viṣṇuḥ eva ayam bhūmā pūrṇa sūkha tvāt tasya ca anyatra niravakāśa tvāt kiṃca asya bhūmnaḥ sarveṣām upari upadeśaḥ śrūyate na ca asya anyatra avakāśaḥ na ca upakrame prāṇa śabda śravaṇena katham asau viṣṇuḥ iti vācyam prāṇa śabdena api viṣṇoḥ ukta tvāt na ca utkramaṇa ādi liṃga virodhaḥ tam utkraṃtam iti śruti siddha tvena tasya viṣṇau eva mukhya tvāt

original: athavā'yaṃ prāṇo vāyureva| tathā'pi na tasya bhūmatvaprāptiḥ| eṣa tu vetyādinā sūcita praśnādyadhyāhāreṇa prāṇādviṣṇorbhūyastvamuktvā bhūmna āmnānāt| sarveṣāṃ nāmādīnāmupari viṣṇoḥ sarvottama tvenābhidhānāt| bhūmā viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: athavā ayam prāṇaḥ vāyuḥ eva tathā api na tasya bhūma tva prāptiḥ eṣa tu vā ityādinā sūcita praśna ādi adhyāhāreṇa prāṇāt viṣṇoḥ bhūyastvam uktvā bhūmnaḥ āmnānāt sarveṣām nāma ādīnām upari viṣṇoḥ sarva uttama tvena abhidhānāt bhūmā viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || dharmopapatteśca || ||
analyzed: dharma upapatteḥ ca

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorbhūmatvapratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa viṣṇoḥ bhūma tva pratipādayat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || dharmopapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || sa evādhastādityādinā bhūmni sarvagatatvādidharmaśravaṇāt| tasya ca viṣṇorevopapatteḥ| viṣṇureva bhūmetyarthaḥ ||

original: || evaṃca prāṇapadena vāyyaṃtargatasya viṣṇorabhidhānāt| ātmana ākāśaityatra saṃbhūtapadena bhūtasya tadabhimānidehasya svarūpotpattyabhidhāne'pi tadabhimānino hareśca dehasaṃbaṃdhaprādurbhāvayoścābhidhānavat bhūmā vāva prāṇādityanena svarūpottamatvasya bhūmno'bhidhāne'pi
analyzed: evam ca prāṇa padena vāyi aṃtargatasya viṣṇoḥ abhidhānāt ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ iti atra saṃbhūta padena bhūtasya tad abhimāni dehasya svarūpa utpatti abhidhāne api tad abhimāninaḥ hareḥ ca deha saṃbaṃdha prādurbhāvayoḥ ca abhidhāna vat bhūmā vāva prāṇāt iti anena svarūpa uttama tvasya bhūmnaḥ abhidhāne api

original: vāyvaṃtargatādrūpātprasādonmukhatvarūpottamatvaviśiṣṭabhūmābhidhānasaṃbhavena praśnaprativacanasahiṣṇutvasaṃbhavāt| kiṃca sa evādhastādityādinā bhūmni sarvagatatvādayo dharmāḥ śrūyaṃte| naite'nyatrāvakāśā labhaṃte| tataśca niravakāśebhyaḥ sarvagatatvādibhyo bhūmā viṣṇureveti tasyaivānaṃdamayatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: vāyu aṃtargatāt rūpāt prasāda unmukha tva rūpa uttama tva viśiṣṭa bhūma abhidhāna saṃbhavena praśna prativacana sahiṣṇu tva saṃbhavāt kiṃca saḥ eva adhastāt ityādinā bhūmni sarvagata tva ādayaḥ dharmāḥ śrūyaṃte na etena atra avakāśāḥ labhaṃte tatas ca niravakāśebhyaḥ sarvagata tva ādibhyaḥ bhūmā viṣṇuḥ eva iti tasya eva ānaṃda maya tvam iti siddham

original: || iti bhūmādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti bhūma adhikaraṇam

original: atrākṣara nāmasamanvayaḥ kriyate|
analyzed: atra akṣara nāma samanvayaḥ kriyate

original: || akṣaramaṃbarāṃtadhṛteḥ || ||
analyzed: akṣaram aṃbara aṃta dhṛteḥ

original: nanvetadakṣaraṃ madhyamaṃ śrītatvameva| adṛṣṭamiti śruteḥ | ahaṃ somamityādinā taddharmatvenāvagatacaṃdrasūryādyādhāratvasya sūryācaṃdramasāvityādinā'kṣarapratīteśca| na ca śrītatvaliṃgatayā prasiddhacaṃdrasūryādyādhāratvabalādyadyakṣaraṃ śrītatvamucyate| tarhi viṣṇuliṃgatayā prasiddhādṛśyatvādibalādviṣṇureva kiṃ na syāditi vācyaṃ|
analyzed: nanu etat akṣaram madhyamam śrīta tvam eva adṛṣṭam iti śruteḥ aham somam ityādinā tad dharma tvena avagata caṃdra sūrya ādi ādhāra tvasya sūryācaṃdramasau ityādinā akṣara pratīteḥ ca na ca śrīta tva liṃgatayā prasiddha caṃdra sūrya ādi ādhāra tva balāt yadi akṣaram śrīta tvam ucyate tarhi viṣṇu liṃgatayā prasiddha adṛśya tva ādi balāt viṣṇuḥ eva kim na syāt iti vācyam

original: adṛśyatvādīnāṃ yettvakṣaramanirdeśyami tyādinā sāvakāśatvāt| na cākṣaraśruteradṛśyatvādiliṃgānāṃ ca madhyamottamākṣarayoḥ sāmye'tra madhyamamevocyata iti nirbedhe ko heturiti vācyaṃ| na tadaśnāti kiṃcanetyakṣarasyānaśanokteḥ| tacca viṣṇorviruddhaṃ| attā carācara grahaṇādityuktatvāt| na ca madhyamākṣarasyānaśanāṃgīkāre virodhī'sti|
analyzed: adṛśya tva ādīnām ye tu akṣaram anirdeśyam ityādinā sāvakāśa tvāt na ca akṣara śruteḥ adṛśya tva ādi liṃgānām ca madhyama uttama akṣarayoḥ sāmī etra madhyamam eva ucyate iti nirbedhe kaḥ hetuḥ iti vācyam na tat aśnāti kiṃcana iti akṣarasya anaśana ukteḥ tat ca viṣṇoḥ viruddham attā carācara grahaṇāt iti ukta tvāt na ca madhyama akṣarasya anaśana aṃgīkāre

original: ata etadakṣaraṃ madhyamaṃ śrītatvameveti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: atas etat akṣaram madhyamam śrīta tvam eva iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || akṣaramaṃbarāṃtadhṛteriti || asyārthaḥ || akṣaraṃ tadvā etadityakṣaraśabdavācyaṃ brahmaiva| na citprakṛtiḥ| kutaḥ aṃbarāntadhṛteḥ| sminnakṣare etasminkhalvakṣara iti ākāśāṃtapadārthadhārakatvaśravaṇādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: akṣaram ambara aṃta dhṛteḥ iti asya arthaḥ akṣaram tat vai etat iti akṣara śabda vācyam brahmā eva na cit prakṛtiḥ kutas aṃbara anta dhṛteḥ smin akṣare etasmin khalu akṣare iti ākāśa aṃta padārtha dhāraka tva śravaṇāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcākāśa eva tadotaṃca protaṃcetyākāśākhyaprakṛteḥ sarvādhāratvamuktvā etasminkhalvakṣara ityādinā'kṣarasya tadādhāratvaśravaṇādakṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ākāśaḥ eva tadā ūtam ca protam ca iti ākāśa ākhya prakṛteḥ sarva ādhāra tvam uktvā etasmin khalu akṣare ityādinā akṣarasya tad ādhāra tva śravaṇāt akṣara śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || sā ca praśāsanāt || ||

analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa viṣṇoḥ eva akṣara tvam pratipādayat sūtram vyācaṣṭe

original: || || sā ca praśāsanāditi || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| sā aṃbarāṃtadhṛtiḥ| praśāsanāt viṣṇorājñamātrādeva bhavatīti etasya veti śrutā uktā| ato'pi brahmaivākṣara śabdavācyaṃ| na cetanaprakṛtirityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sā ca praśāsanāt iti asya arthaḥ caḥ yatas sā aṃbara aṃta dhṛtiḥ praśāsanāt viṣṇoḥ ājña mātrāt eva bhavati iti etasya vā iti śrutā uktā atas api brahma eva akṣara śabda vācyam na cetana prakṛtiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcākṣarasyājñāmātreṇa sarvādhāratvaśravaṇāt| saptārdhagarbheti śruteḥ| ato'kṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca akṣarasya ājñā mātreṇa sarva ādhāra tva śravaṇāt sapta ardha garbhā iti śruteḥ atas ukṣara śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || anyabhāvavyāvṛtteśca || ||
analyzed: anya bhāva vyāvṛtteḥ ca

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorakṣatvaṃ pratipādayatsūtramāha ||

original: || || anyabhāvavyāvṛtteśceti || asyārthaḥ || anyabhāvānāṃ viṣṇvanyavastusvabhāvānāṃ sthūlatvādīnāṃ| asthūlamanaṇviti śrutāvakṣare vyāvṛterabhāvasya kathanācca brahmaivākṣaramityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anya bhāva vyāvṛtteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ anya bhāvānām viṣṇu anya vastu svabhāvānām sthūla tva ādīnām asthūlam anaṇu iti śrutau akṣare vyāvṛteḥ abhāvasya kathanāt ca brahma eva akṣaram iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāsthūlamityādinā'nyavastusvabhāvānāṃ sthaulyādīnāṃ vyāvṛttyabhidhānādakṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca asthūlam ityādinā anya vastu svabhāvānām sthaulya ādīnām vyāvṛtti abhidhānāt akṣara śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || iti akṣarādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti akṣara adhikaraṇam

original: trānekaprakaraṇātmakaṃ `sadeva' ityādisthānaṃ samanvīyate|

original: || īkṣatikarmavyapadeśaśātsaḥ || ||
analyzed: īkṣati karma vyapadeśa śātsaḥ

original: nanu sat pradhānameva bhavet| na viṣṇuḥ| sato bahu syāmiti bahudhābhāvākhyavikāritvaśravaṇāt| na ca vikārītvaṃ paramātmani saṃbhavati| avikāraḥ sadā śuddha ityādinā tasyāvikāritvāt| tataśca pradhānameva saditi tasyaiva jagatkartṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu sat pradhānam eva bhavet na viṣṇuḥ sataḥ bahu syām iti bahudhābhāva ākhya vikāri tva śravaṇāt na ca vikārī tvam paramātmani saṃbhavati avikāraḥ sadā śuddhaḥ ityādinā tasya avikāri tvāt tatas ca pradhānam eva sat iti tasya eva jagat kartṛ tvam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || īkṣatikarmavyapadeśātsa iti|| asyārthaḥ || sadevetyādi prakaraṇasthitasadādiśabdavācyaḥ viṣṇureva na pradhānaṃ| kutaḥ| īkṣatikarmavyapadeśāt tadaikṣateti cetananiṣṭhaikṣateti śabdopalakṣitadarśanākhyakriyābhidhānādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: īkṣati karma vyapadeśāt saḥ iti asya arthaḥ sat eva ityādi prakaraṇa sthita sat ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na pradhānam kutas īkṣati karma vyapadeśāt tadā aikṣata iti cetana niṣṭhā aikṣata iti śabda upalakṣita darśana ākhya kriyā abhidhānāt iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca tadaikṣateti īkṣatyākhyavyāpāraśravaṇāttena prekṣāpūrvakāritvalābhāt| īkṣaṇasyācetane pradhāne kathamapyayogāt| mābhūttarhyacetanā prakṛtiḥ| cetanā prakṛtiḥ kiṃ na syāditi cet| cetanaprakṛteḥ strītvena svātaṃtryeṇa sarjakatvāyogāt| na ca bahubhāvākhyapradhānaliṃgaśravaṇena sa na viṣṇuriti vācyaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca tat aikṣata iti īkṣati ākhya vyāpāra śravaṇāt tena prekṣā pūrva kāri tva lābhāt īkṣaṇasya acetane pradhāne katham api ayogāt mā abhūt tarhi acetanā prakṛtiḥ cetanā prakṛtiḥ kim na syāt iti ced cetana prakṛteḥ strītvena svātaṃtryeṇa sarjaka tva ayogāt na ca bahu bhāva ākhya pradhāna liṃga śravaṇena sa na viṣṇuḥ iti vācyam

original: ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyata ityāvikārasyāpi bahubhāvaśravaṇena tasya sāvakāśatvāt| saditi viṣṇurevoktastasyaiva sraṣṭatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: ajāyamānaḥ bahudhā vijāyate iti ā vikārasya api bahu bhāva śravaṇena tasya sāvakāśa tvāt sat iti viṣṇuḥ eva uktaḥ tasya eva sraṣṭatvam iti siddham

original: || iti sadadhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: atra sarvādhāratayā'nveṣṭavyatayā ca sākṣādvā vyavadhānena vā sāmānyato hṛtpadmasthatvaliṃgasya brahmāṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate|

original: || dahara uttarebhyaḥ || ||
analyzed: daharaḥ uttarebhyaḥ

original: nanvākāśa eva hṛpadmastho bhavet| daharo'sminniti padmasthe daharākāśasthitiśravaṇāt| tasyāṃte suṣiramitivyākhyānācca| ākāśaśabdena yadi suṣiramevābhimataṃ tasmiṃśca yadaṃtariti hṛtpadmasthākāśagataḥ sarvādhāratayocyeta tarhi vākyānvayānupapatteḥ| tathāhi|

original: || virodhaḥ karmaṇīti cennānekapratipatterdarśanāt || ||
analyzed: virodhaḥ karmaṇi iti ced na aneka pratipatteḥ darśanāt

original: nanu yaddevānāṃ sādivināśitvamiti dvitīyakalpamaṃgīkṛtya vedavidyādhikārakathanaṃ tadayuktaṃ| devānāṃ sādivināśitve tataḥ pūrvaṃ devatā'bhāvena pūrvakalpe pravṛttakarmaṇyuddeśābhāvādvaiyarthyākhyavirodhāpatterityākṣipya samādadhatsūṃtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu yat devānām sādivināśi tvam iti dvitīya kalpam aṃgīkṛtya veda vidyā adhikāra kathanam tat ayuktam devānām sādivināśi tve tatas pūrvam devatā bhāvena pūrva kalpe pravṛtta karmaṇi uddeśa abhāvāt vaiyarthya ākhya virodha āpatteḥ iti ākṣipya samādadhat sūṃtram paṭhati

original: || || virodhaḥ karmaṇīti cennānekapratipatterdarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || devadīnāṃ sāditve karmaṇi pūrvakalpe pravṛttayajñādikarmaṇi viṣaye| virodhaḥ uddeśyābhāvanimittavaiyarthyākhyavirodhaḥ syāditi cenna| kutaḥ| anekapratipatteḥ| anekeṣāṃ yogyamanupyāṇāṃ| devatāpadaprāpterdaśanāt yatra pūrva iti śrutāvuktatvādityārthaḥ ||
analyzed: virodhaḥ karmaṇi iti ced na aneka pratipatteḥ darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ devadīnām sādi tve karmaṇi pūrva kalpe pravṛtta yajña ādi karmaṇi viṣaye virodhaḥ uddeśya abhāva nimitta vaiyarthya ākhya virodhaḥ syāt iti ced na kutas aneka pratipatteḥ anekeṣām yogya manupyāṇām devatā pada prāpteḥ daśanāt yatra pūrve iti śrutau ukta tvāt ityārthaḥ

original: evaṃca teṣāṃ pravāhato'nādinityatvenaitaddevānāmabhāve'pi devatāṃtarasadbhāvāt| teha nākamiti śrutau ekaikagaṇaśo'naṃtānāṃ devatvādiyogyamanuṣyāṇāṃ vidyākarmabhyāṃ pūrva pūrva devatāpadaprāpterdarśanāt| tataśca vaiyarthyākhyavirodhābhāva iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca teṣām pravāhataḥ ūna ādi nitya tvena etat devānām abhāve pi devatā aṃtara sadbhāvāt tāḥ iha nākam iti śrutau ekaika gaṇaśas ūnaṃtānām deva tva ādi yogya manuṣyāṇām vidyā karmabhyām devatā pada prāpteḥ darśanāt tatas ca vaiyarthya ākhya virodha abhāvaḥ iti siddham

original: || śabda iti cennātaḥprabhavātpratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ || ||
analyzed: śabdaḥ iti ced na atas prabhavāt pratyakṣa anumānābhyām

original: nanu vedānityatve prāmāṇyāyogena nityatvaṃ tādaṃgīkāryaṃ| vācā virūpeti śruteḥ| tadvācyā devā yadyanityāstārhi pūrvadevatāparityāgenānyadevatāvācakatvamagyupeyaṃ| na caitaddhaṭate| vākyasyārthena svābhāvikasaṃbaṃdhāt| na hi kimapi vākyaṃ kaṃcitkālaṃ kaṃcidarthaṃ pratipādya tamapahāya kālaṃtare'rthāṃtaraṃ pratipādayatīti bhāvikasaṃbaṃdhāt|
analyzed: nanu veda anitya tve prāmāṇya ayogena nitya tvam vācā virūpā iti śruteḥ tad vācyāḥ devāḥ yadi anityāḥ tārhi pūrva devatā parityāgena anya devatā vācaka tvam agyupeyam na ca etat haṭate vākyasya arthena svābhāvika saṃbaṃdhāt na hi kim api vākyam kaṃcid kālam kaṃcid artham pratipādya tam apahāya kālaṃtara irthāṃtaram pratipādayati iti bhāvika saṃbaṃdhāt

original: na hi kimapi vākyaṃ kaṃcitkālaṃ kaṃcidarthaṃ pratipādya tamapahāya kālāṃtare'rthāṃtaraṃ pratipādayatīti dṛṣṭacaraṃ yena vede'pi tathā syāt| vade tathātvamaṃgīkurvāṇena vedasyārthena sagbandhaḥ kālpanika ityaṃgīkāryaḥ| tathā kālpanikasambandhasyāprāmāṇyaprayojakatvādvedāprāmāṇyaṃ|
analyzed: na hi kim api vākyam kaṃcid kālam kaṃcid artham pratipādya tam apahāya kāla aṃtara īrthāṃtaram pratipādayati iti dṛṣṭacaram yena vede api tathā syāt vade tathātvam aṃgīkurvāṇena vedasya arthena sagbandhaḥ kālpanikaḥ iti aṃgīkāryaḥ tathā kālpanika sambandhasya aprāmāṇya prayojaka tvāt veda aprāmāṇyam

original: kālpanikasambandhasya prāmāṇyaprayojakatve'pi vedaprāmāṇyaṃ na ghaṭate| prāmāṇikatvena pūrvadevatāpravāhaniyame'pi pramāṇābhāvenottarakalpeṣvapi devatāpravāhaniyamābhāvena kālpanikasambandhasyāpyabhāvādityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: kālpanika sambandhasya prāmāṇya prayojaka tve api veda prāmāṇyam na ghaṭate prāmāṇika tvena pūrva devatā pravāha niyame pi pramāṇa abhāvena uttara kalpeṣu api devatā pravāha niyama abhāvena kālpanika sambandhasya api abhāvāt iti ākṣipya samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || || śabda iti cennātaḥ prabhavāpratyakṣānumānābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || virodha iti vartate| devānāmādyantavattve śabde vede| aprāṇyākhyavirodhaḥ syāt| nityatvena śrutisiddhavedavācāṃ kadācidvācyahīnatvāditi bhāvaḥ| iti cenna| ataḥ dhātā yatheti vedavākyāt| tathā pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ| mahatāṃ pratyakṣāt| devānāṃ pravāhataḥ utpattisādhakaliṃgācca|
analyzed: śabdaḥ iti ced na atas prabhava apratyakṣa anumānābhyām iti asya arthaḥ virodhaḥ iti vartate devānām ādi antavat tve śabde vede aprāṇi ākhya virodhaḥ syāt nitya tvena śruti siddha veda vācām kadācid vācya hīna tvāt iti bhāvaḥ iti ced na atas dhātā yathā iti veda vākyāt tathā pratyakṣa anumānābhyām mahatām pratyakṣāt devānām pravāhataḥ utpatti sādhaka liṃgāt ca

original: prabhavāt| pratikalpaṃ niyamena prabhavaśabditotpattyavagamāccoktaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: prabhavāt pratikalpam niyamena prabhava śabdita utpatti avagamāt ca uktam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca sūryācaṃdramasāviti śruteḥ| mahatāṃ pratyakṣāt| uttaraka'lpaḥ devavān apralayakālatvādityanumānasya ca bhāvāt| na ca saṃbaṃdhasya kālpanikatvānna prāmāṇyaprayojakatvamiti vācyaṃ| anyānyadevatāsaṃbaṃdhasyānādinidhaneti prāmāṇyasiddhatvenākālpanikatvāt| tathā ca vaiyarbhyākhyavirodhābhāva iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sūryācaṃdramasau iti śruteḥ mahatām pratyakṣāt uttara kalpaḥ devavān apralaya kāla tvāt iti anumānasya ca bhāvāt na ca saṃbaṃdhasya kālpanika tvāt na prāmāṇya prayojaka tvam iti vācyam anya anya devatā saṃbaṃdhasya anādinidhanā iti prāmāṇya siddha tvena akālpanika tvāt tathā ca vaiyarbhya ākhya virodha abhāvaḥ iti siddham

original: || || ata eva ca nityatvaṃ || ||
analyzed: atas eva ca nitya tvam

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa devapravāhasya nityatāṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati
analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa deva pravāhasya nitya tām sādhayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || ata eva ca nityatvamiti || asyārthaḥ || ata eva pūrvapakṣyuktavedanityatvādeva| tadanyathā'nupapattyā'pi tadvācyadevatāpravāhasya nityavaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atas eva ca nitya tvam iti asya arthaḥ atas eva pūrvapakṣi ukta veda nitya tvāt eva tad anyathā anupapattyā api tad vācya devatā pravāhasya nitya vam sidhyati iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca pareṇābhihitavedanityatvasyānyatā'nupapattyaiva devatāpravāhanityatvasya siddhatvāt| vācyasya nityatvābhāve evaṃ rūpāyā vāco nityatvaṃ nopapadyate| utpattivināśitvātsvarūpanityatvāyogena teṣāṃ pravāharūpeṇaiva nityatvaṃ siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca pareṇa abhihita veda nitya tvasya anya tā anupapattyā eva devatā pravāha nitya tvasya siddha tvāt vācyasya nitya tva abhāve evam rūpāyāḥ vācaḥ nitya tvam nā upapadyate utpatti vināśi tvāt svarūpa nitya tva ayogena teṣām pravāha rūpeṇa eva nitya tvam siddham

original: || samānanāmarūpatvāccāvṛttāvapyavirodho darśanātsmṛteśca || ||
analyzed: samāna nāma rūpa tvāt ca avṛttau api avirodhaḥ darśanāt smṛteḥ ca

original: nanu devatāpravāhasya nityatve'pi vedaprāmāṇyasyānupapadyamānatvaṃ bhavet| pūrvakalpamuktānāmuttarakalpe punarāvartananve mukterapunarāvṛttitvāt| tadanyeṣāṃ punarāvartanatve dharmibhūtadevānityatvahetukaṃ virodhābhāve'pi nāmarūpādidharmavaicitryakṛtavirodhāpatteḥ| vācakavedasya pratikalpaṃ pāṭhabhedābhāvenaikavidhatvāt|
analyzed: nanu devatā pravāhasya nitya tve api veda prāmāṇyasya anupapadyamāna tvam bhavet pūrva kalpa muktānām uttara kalpe punarāvartana nve mukteḥ apunarāvṛtti tvāt tad anyeṣām punarāvartana tve dharmi bhūta deva anitya tva hetukam virodha abhāve api nāma rūpa ādi dharma vaicitrya kṛta virodha āpatteḥ vācaka vedasya pratikalpam pāṭha bheda abhāvena ekavidha tvāt

original: vācyadevānāṃ ca nānāvidhanāmarūpavattvāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: vācya devānām ca nānāvidha nāma rūpavat tvāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || samānanāmarūpatvāccāvṛttāvapyavirodho darśanātsmṛteścaṃti || asyārthaḥ || ā vṛttāvapi pūrvakalpe muktānāṃ devānāṃ punaḥ svapadeṣu asattve'pi| avirodhaḥ tatpratipādakaikavidhavedāprāmāṇyākhyavirodho nāsti| kutaḥ| samānanāmarūpatvāt etatkalpotpannānāmapi devānāṃ prācīnatulyanāmarūpatvāt|
analyzed: samāna nāma rūpa tvāt ca avṛttau api avirodhaḥ darśanāt smṛteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ vṛttau api pūrva kalpe muktānām devānām punar sva padeṣu asattve api avirodhaḥ tad pratipādaka ekavidha veda aprāmāṇya ākhya virodhaḥ na asti kutas samāna nāma rūpa tvāt etad kalpa utpannānām api devānām prācīna tulya nāma rūpa tvāt

original: tathā ca pratipādyasyāpyekavidhatvāt na tadbodhakavedāprāmāṇyamiti bhāvaḥ ekavidhatvameva kuta ityata uktaṃ| darśanātsmṛteśceti| yathā pūrvamiti śruteḥ| anādinidhaneti smṛteścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā ca pratipādyasya api ekavidha tvāt na tad bodhaka veda aprāmāṇyam iti bhāvaḥ ekavidha tvam eva kutas iti atas uktam darśanāt smṛteḥ ca iti yathā pūrvam iti śruteḥ anādinidhanā iti smṛteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃceṃdrādidevatānāṃ vede yādṛśe nāmarūpe pratipādyete tayoreva kalpāṃtare jāyamānānāṃ devānābhabhyupagamāt| tatprāmāṇikatve yathā pūrvamiti śruteranādinidhaneti smṛteśca sadbhāvāt| tathā ca vedāprāmāṇyākhyavirodhābhāva iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca iṃdra ādi devatānām vede yādṛśe nāma rūpe pratipādyete tayoḥ eva kalpa aṃtare jāyamānānām tad prāmāṇika tve yathā pūrvam iti śruteḥ anādinidhanā iti smṛteḥ ca sadbhāvāt tathā ca veda aprāmāṇya ākhya virodha abhāvaḥ iti siddham

original: || madhvādiṣvasaṃbhavādanadhikāraṃ jaiminiḥ || ||
analyzed: madhu ādiṣu asaṃbhavāt anadhikāram jaiminiḥ

original: nanu na devānāṃ vedavidyādhikāro yuktaḥ| vedavidyā mukhyaphalārthāstaditaraphalārdhāśceti| dvividhāḥ| mokṣetaraphalā api brahmakarmabhedānmadhuvidyā'gniṣṭomavidyā ceti dvividhāḥ| tatra tāvanna devānāṃ mokṣetaraphalakadvividhavidyāsvikāro yujyate|
analyzed: nanu na devānām veda vidyā adhikāraḥ yuktaḥ veda vidyāḥ mukhya phala arthāḥ tad itara phala ardhāḥ ca iti dvividhāḥ mokṣa itara phalāḥ api brahma karma bhedāt madhu vidyā agniṣṭoma vidyā ca iti dvividhāḥ tatra tāvat na devānām mokṣa itara phalaka dvividha vidyā svikāraḥ yujyate

original: tatsādhyānāṃ mokṣetaraphalānāṃ madhye keṣāṃcidyogyānāṃ prāptatvenāyogyānāṃ ca prāptumaśakyatvenārthitvābhāvāditi jaiminimatāvalaṃbena vedavidyādhikāratvasya sāmānyaniṣeprāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: tad sādhyānām mokṣa itara phalānām madhye keṣāṃcid yogyānām prāptatvena ayogyānām ca prāptum aśakya tvena arthi tva abhāvāt iti jaimini mata avalaṃbena veda vidyā adhikāra tvasya sūtram āha

original: || || madhvādiṣvasaṃbhavādanadhikāraṃ jaiminiriti || madhvādiṣu asauvā''dityo deva madhvi tyādyuktaṃ madhvādividyāsu| anadhikāraṃ devānāmadhikārābhāvaṃ| jaiminirācāryo manyate kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt teṣāmarthitvatatpadayogyatvādyayogādityrathaḥ ||
analyzed: madhu ādiṣu asaṃbhavāt anadhikāram jaiminiḥ iti madhu ādiṣu asau ādityaḥ deva madhu ityādi uktam madhu ādi vidyāsu anadhikāram devānām adhikāra abhāvam jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate kutas asaṃbhavāt teṣām arthi tva tad pada yogya tva ādya yogāt iti rathaḥ

original: evaṃca kakṣadvayamadhye prathame tathā dvitīyasya prathame'saṃbhavāt| dvitīyasya dvitīye'rthitvābhāvāccādhikārasya niṣedhānnatvadhikāramātrasya niṣedhāt| jaiminyācāryamatāvirodha iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca kakṣa dvaya madhye prathame tathā dvitīyasya prathame saṃbhavāt dvitīyasya dvitīye ṛthi tva abhāvāt ca adhikārasya niṣedhāt na tu adhikāra mātrasya niṣedhāt jaimini ācārya mata avirodhaḥ iti siddham

original: || jyotiṣi bhāvācca || ||
analyzed: jyotiṣi bhāvāt ca

original: nanu māstumokṣetaraphalavidyāsvadhikāro devānāṃ| tathā'pi satyaṃ jñānityādimokṣārthavidyāsvadhikāro bhaviṣyati| tatrārthitvasaṃbhavādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu māstu mokṣa itara phala vidyāsu adhikāraḥ devānām tathā api satyam jñāni ityādi mokṣa artha vidyāsu adhikāraḥ bhaviṣyati tatra arthi tva saṃbhavāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || jyotiṣi bhāvācceti || asyārthaḥ || jyotiṣi devānāṃ jñāne| bhāvāt sarvavastūnāṃ viṣāṃtayatarbhūtatvāt siddhajñānānāṃ devānāṃ na jñānārthatā yujyata iti na mokṣavidyāsvadhikāra ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: jyotiṣi bhāvāt ca iti asya arthaḥ jyotiṣi devānām jñāne bhāvāt sarva vastūnām siddha jñānānām devānām na jñāna artha tā yujyate iti na mokṣa vidyāsu adhikāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca devānāṃ sārvajñyena sarvabrahmakarmavidyāsādhyajñānānāṃ niyamena prāptatvenāta eva vedadraṣṭṛtvāt| tataśca teṣāmubhayavidyāsādhyajñāne'rthitāyā asaṃbhavāt| tasmājjaiminimatāvirodha iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca devānām sārvajñyena sarva brahma karma vidyā sādhya jñānānām niyamena prāptatvena atas eva veda draṣṭṛ tvāt tatas ca teṣām ubhaya vidyā sādhya jñāna īrthitāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt tasmāt jaimini mata avirodhaḥ iti siddham

original: || bhāvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo'sti hi || ||
analyzed: bhāvam tu bādarāyaṇaḥ usti hi

original: evaṃ devairmokṣetarayogyaphalānāṃ prāptatvāt| ayogyānāṃ prāptumaśakyatvāt| mokṣasyāpi brahmajñānitvenārthato labdhatvāt| arthitvābhāvena teṣāṃ kāsvapi vidyāsvadhikārābhāvena jaiminimatāvalaṃbinā samarthite punaradhikāraṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam devaiḥ mokṣa itara yogya phalānām prāpta tvāt ayogyānām prāptum aśakya tvāt mokṣasya api brahma jñāni tvena arthataḥ labdha tvāt arthi tva abhāvena teṣām kāsu api vidyāsu adhikāra abhāvena jaimini mata avalaṃbinā samarthite punar adhikāram samarthayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || bhāvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo'sti hīti || asyārthaḥ || bādarāyaṇastu| hi yasmāt| devānāmapyasti vidyāsādhyapūrvaprakāśaviśeṣo mokṣaphale'tiśayaścāsti| tasmādbhāvaṃ devānāmadhikārasadbhāvaṃ manyata ityarthaḥ| jaiminimataṃ tu devānāṃ prāptajñānaphalārthamanadhikārābhiprāyamityavadheyaṃ ||
analyzed: bhāvam tu bādarāyaṇaḥ usti hi iti asya arthaḥ bādarāyaṇaḥ tu hi yasmāt devānām api asti vidyā sādhya pūrva prakāśa viśeṣaḥ mokṣa phala itiśayaḥ ca asti tasmāt bhāvam devānām adhikāra sadbhāvam manyate iti arthaḥ jaimini matam tu devānām prāpta jñāna phala artham anadhikāra abhiprāyam iti avadheyam

original: evaṃca yadyapi devāḥ prāptapadā brahmajñānitvātsiddhamokṣatadiraphalāḥ prāptumaśakyāyogyaphalāśca| tathā'pi prāptapadānāmapi devānāṃ madhvādividyāsūktopāsanā kramakaraṇābhyāṃ phalaviśeṣabhāvena svasvayogyaraya jñānamātreṇāsādhyasya mokṣaphale'tiśasya bhāvena siddherarthitvasaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: evam ca yadi api devāḥ prāpta padāḥ brahma jñāni tvāt siddha mokṣa tadis aphalāḥ prāptum aśakya ayogya phalāḥ ca tathā api prāpta padānām api devānām madhu ādi vidyā sūkta upāsanā krama karaṇābhyām phala viśeṣa bhāvena sva sva yogya raya jñāna mātreṇa asādhyasya mokṣa phala itiśasya bhāvena siddheḥ arthi tva saṃbhavāt

original: mokṣaphala ānaṃdātiśayarūpavidyāphalasya bhāvena jñānārthamapyadhikārasaṃbhavāt| yāvatsevāpara iti skāṃdavacanāt| bhagavadvyatiriktānāṃ nirupacaritasārvajñyābhāvena vidyāvicāreṇa jñānalābhasaṃbhavāt| jaiminimatasya devānāṃ prāptaphalārthamanadhikārābhiprāyeṇāviruddhatvāt|
analyzed: mokṣa phale ānaṃda atiśaya rūpa vidyā phalasya bhāvena jñāna artham api adhikāra saṃbhavāt yāvat sevā paraḥ iti skāṃda vacanāt bhagavat vyatiriktānām nirupacarita sārvajñya abhāvena vidyā vicāreṇa jñāna lābha saṃbhavāt jaimini matasya devānām prāpta phala artham anadhikāra abhiprāyeṇa aviruddha tvāt

original: evaṃ bhagavatā bādāyaṇena devānāṃ madhvādyaśeṣāvidyāsvadhikārābhāvasyoktatvāt| tataśca sarvadevopāsyatvaṃ viṣṇoryuktamiti siddhaṃ ||

analyzed: kṣatriya tva avagateḥ ca uttaratra caitra rathena liṃgāt iti asya arthaḥ caḥ liṃga aṃtara samuccaye uttaratra ayam aśvatarī rathaḥ iti uttara vākye śrutena iti śeṣaḥ caitra rathena citra śabdāt aśvatarī yukta ratha saṃbaṃdhi tva rūpeṇa liṃgāt liṃgena ca jñāpakena ca asya kṣatriya tva avagateḥ ca kṣatriya tva jñānāt na pautrāyaṇam śūdraḥ iti arthaḥ

analyzed: evam ca pautrāyaṇasya śūdra tve pramāṇa abhāvāt śūdra śabdena saṃbodhanasya aprāmāṇyāt na ca śūdra śabdena saṃbodhanam eva tatra pramāṇam śoka ādravaṇa yogena tatra śūdra śabdasya pravṛtta tvena tasya rūḍhi labhya varṇa āvaraka tva asādhaka tvāt kiṃca na asau pautrāyaṇaḥ śūdraḥ mahatām kṣatriya tva anubhavāt

original: anyeṣāmayamaśvatarīratha iti caitrarathena liṃgena tatra kṣatriyatvāvagateśca| tataśca śūdrasya vedānadhikāratvaṃ siddhaṃ ||

original: || || saṃskāraparāmarśāttadabhāvābhilāpācceti || asyārthaḥ || sādhyasamuccaye ca śabdaḥ| saṃskāraparāmarśāt aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīta| tamadhyāpayīteti tacchabdena upanayanākhyasaṃskārayuktasya vacanāt| tadāvābhilāpāt śūdrasya nāgnirna yajña iti saṃskārābhāvābhidhānāt| na tasya vedādyadhikāra ityarthaḥ ||

original: tasyaivetyatra paramātmajyotiṣṭvamuktvā katama ātmeti praśne jyotiṣāmnājjyotirviṣṇuriti| tathā sati paramātmana udayāstamayādiśūnyatvena sadā sadbhāvāt| ādityenaivāyamityādyavadhāraṇaṃ na syāt| atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃ jyotirbhavatītyasyaivārthasya pratyabhijñānācca| tasmādidaṃ jyotirjīva eveti prācīnabrahmatvopādanamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: tasya eva iti atra paramātma jyotiṣṭvam uktvā katamaḥ ātmā iti praśne jyotiṣā āmnāt jyotiḥ viṣṇuḥ iti tathā sati paramātmanaḥ udaya astamaya ādi śūnyatvena sadā sadbhāvāt ādityena eva ayam ityādi avadhāraṇam na syāt atra ayam puruṣaḥ svayam jyotiḥ bhavati iti asya eva arthasya pratyabhijñānāt ca tasmāt idam jyotiḥ jīvaḥ eva iti prācīna brahma tva upādanam ayuktam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || jyotirdarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || yo'yamaṃtarjotiriti jyotiḥ śabdāvācyo viṣṇureva| na jīvaḥ| kutaḥ| darśanāt viṣṇureva jyotiriti śruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: jyotiḥ darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ yaḥ yam antar jotiḥ iti jyotiḥ śabda avācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na jīvaḥ kutas darśanāt viṣṇuḥ eva jyotiḥ iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: || evaṃca viṣṇurevedaṃ jyotiḥ| jyotiḥśruterviṣṇvaikavācitvāt| mukhyārthāsaṃbhava evāmukhyārthasya grāhyatvāt| na ca viṣṇupakṣa ubhayalokasaṃcaraṇānupapatteramukhye'pi jīvarūpo'rtho grāhyaḥ| tasyāpi prājñenātmaneti tasminpramāṇasiddhatvena mukhyārthagrahaṇe bādhakābhāvāt| na cemaṃ lokamityādyuktaliṃgavirodhaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca viṣṇuḥ eva idam jyotiḥ jyotiḥ śruteḥ viṣṇu a eka vāci tvāt mukhya artha asaṃbhavaḥ eva amukhya arthasya grāhya tvāt na ca viṣṇu pakṣe ubhaya loka saṃcaraṇa anupapatteḥ amukhye api jīva rūpaḥ ūrthaḥ grāhyaḥ tasya api prājñena ātmanā iti tasmin pramāṇa siddha tvena mukhya artha grahaṇe bādhaka abhāvāt na ca imam lokam ityādi ukta liṃga virodhaḥ

original: aṃtarṇī taṇic‌tvena teṣāmapi sāvakāśatvopapatteḥ| na cādityādijyotiṣṭ‌vavirodhaḥ| tasya jīvatvāṃgīkārāt| na ca tasyaiva svayaṃ jyotiṣṭ‌vābhidhānena jīvasya prasiddhatvena praśnāyogyatayā jyotiṣṭ‌vānabhidhānāt| na cāvadhāraṇānupapattiḥ| tasya brāhmajyotiḥṣu tasya prādhānyajñāpanārthatvāt| anyavyāvartakatvasya vāgādisatvenāyogāt|
analyzed: aṃtarṇī taṇic tvena teṣām api sāvakāśa tva upapatteḥ na ca āditya ādi jyotiṣṭva virodhaḥ tasya jīva tva aṃgīkārāt na ca tasya eva svayam jyotiṣṭva abhidhānena jīvasya prasiddhatvena praśna ayogyatayā jyotiṣṭva anabhidhānāt na ca avadhāraṇa anupapattiḥ tasya brāhmajyotiḥṣu tasya prādhānya jñāpana arthatvāt anya vyāvartaka tvasya vāc ādi satvena ayogāt

original: viśiṣyabhagavato jyotiṣṭ‌vavacanaṃ tu svāpe jyotiraṃtarābhāvābhiprāyeṇeti draṣṭavyaṃ| tasmādidaṃ jyotirviṣṇuriti jyotiścaraṇābhidhānāditi prāgvyutpāditaviṣṇutvaṃ na bādhitamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: viśiṣya bhagavataḥ jyotiṣṭva vacanam tu svāpe jyotiḥ aṃtara abhāva abhiprāyeṇa iti draṣṭavyam tasmāt idam jyotiḥ viṣṇuḥ iti jyotiścaraṇa abhidhānāt iti prāc vyutpādita viṣṇu tvam na bādhitam iti siddham

original: || iti jyotiradhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti jyotiḥ adhikaraṇam

original: atrobhayatraprasiddhamākāśanāma brahmaṇi samanvīyate|
analyzed: atra ubhayatra prasiddham ākāśa nāma brahmaṇi samanvīyate

original: || ākāśo'rthāṃtaratvādivyapadeśāt || ||
analyzed: ākāśaḥ ūrdhva aṃtara tva ādi vyapadeśāt

original: nanvayamākāśo vai nāme tyatrākāśaḥ prasiddhākāśa eva syāt| tcachabdasyākāśe rūḍhatvāt| viṣṇau ca yaugiktvāt| yogasya rūḍherbalaktvāt| prasiddhākāśaparityāgena sarvādhāratvaliṃgena viṣṇugrahaṇe vai nāmetyuktanipātadvayavirodhasadbhāvāt| nāmarūpanirvāhakatvāmātrasyākāśapakṣe prasiddhatvānnipātavirodhasāgyābhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu ayam ākāśaḥ vai nāma iti atra ākāśaḥ prasiddha ākāśaḥ eva syāt tcac śabdasya ākāśe rūḍha tvāt viṣṇau ca yaugika tvāt yogasya rūḍheḥ balak tvāt prasiddha ākāśa parityāgena sarva ādhāra tva liṃgena viṣṇu grahaṇe vai nāma iti ukta nipāta dvaya virodha sadbhāvāt nāma rūpa nirvāhaka tva a mātrasya ākāśa pakṣe prasiddha tvāt nipāta virodha sāgya abhāvāt

original: viṣṇupakṣe viṣṇustannirvāhakatvaṃ ceti dvayamapyaprasiddhaṃ || ākāśapakṣe tu tannirvāhakatvamātramaprasiddhamiti vaiṣamyāt| nāmarūpanirvāhakatvaliṃgaṃ tvākāśasyopādānatvātsaṃbhāvitaṃ na tu viṣṇoriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: viṣṇu pakṣe viṣṇuḥ tad nirvāhaka tvam ca iti dvayam api aprasiddham ākāśa pakṣe tu tad nirvāhaka tva mātram aprasiddham iti vaiṣamyāt nāma rūpa nirvāhaka tva liṃgam tu ākāśasya upādāna tvāt saṃbhāvitam na tu viṣṇoḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || ākāśo'rthāṃtaratvādivyapadeśāditi || ākāśo havai nāmeti śrutyuktākāśeo viṣṇureva| natvavyākṛtākāśaḥ| kutaḥ| arthāṃtaratvādivyapadeśāt te yadaṃtareti vākye viṣṇornāmarūparāhityākhyāvilakṣaṇārthatvasyādiśabdagṛhītabrahmatvāmṛtatvayośca uktatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ākāśaḥ ūrtha antara tva ādi vyapadeśāt iti ākāśaḥ havai nāma iti śruti ukta ākāśaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na tu avyākṛta ākāśaḥ kutas artha aṃtara tva ādi vyapadeśāt te yat aṃtarā iti vākye viṣṇoḥ nāma rūpa rāhitya ākhyā vilakṣaṇa arthatvasya ādi śabda gṛhīta brahma tva amṛta tvayoḥ ca uktatvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcoktahetudvayasadbhāvāt| anāmarūpatvasya tallakṣaṇatvenāvarṇamiti śrutisiddhatvāt eko dādhāretyaprasiddhatvābhāvena nipātadvayāvirodhāt| lokaprasitdhyapekṣayā śrutiprasiddheḥ prābalyena tasyā eva grāhyatvāt| pratyutākāśasya nāmarūpatvenākāśagrahaṇa eva virodhaḥ| tataścākāśo| viṣṇureveti tasyaiva sarvādhāratvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ukta hetu dvaya sadbhāvāt anāma rūpa tvasya tad lakṣaṇa tvena avarṇam iti śruti siddha tvāt ekaḥ dādhāra iti aprasiddha tva abhāvena nipāta dvaya avirodhāt loka prasitdhi apekṣayā śruti prasiddheḥ prābalyena tasyāḥ eva grāhya tvāt pratyuta ākāśasya nāma rūpa tvena ākāśa grahaṇe eva virodhaḥ tatas ca ākāśaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti tasya eva sarva ādhāra tvam iti siddham

original: || iti ākāśādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti ākāśa adhikaraṇam

original: atra svapnādidraṣṭṛtvaliṃgaṃ brahmaṇi samanvīyate|
analyzed: atra svapna ādi draṣṭṛ tva liṃgam brahmaṇi samanvīyate

original: || suṣuptyukrāṃtyorebhedena || ||
analyzed: suṣupti ukrāntyoḥ e bhedena

original: nanvayaṃ svapnādidraṣṭā jīvo bhavet| tasya tasminprasiddhatvāt| jīveśayorabhedena jīve'pyamukhyāsaṃgatvaliṃgasyāsaṃbhavāt| aśarīrasya viṣṇoḥ svapnādidraṣṭṛtvāyogāt| kāraṇagatasya kārye saṃbhave'pi kāryagatasya kāraṇe'yogāt| jīveśābhedasya viśeṣaṇadvayasāmānādhikaraṇyānyathā'nupapattyaiva siddheḥ|
analyzed: nanu ayam svapna ādi draṣṭā jīvaḥ bhavet tasya tasmin prasiddha tvāt jīva īśayoḥ abhedena jīve pi amukhya asaṃga tva liṃgasya asaṃbhavāt aśarīrasya viṣṇoḥ svapna ādi draṣṭṛ tva ayogāt kāraṇa gatasya kārye saṃbhave api kārya gatasya kāraṇe yogāt jīva īśa abhedasya viśeṣaṇa dvaya sāmānādhikaraṇya anyathā anupapattyā eva siddheḥ

original: rājāsādhāraṇadharmasyāpi kośasyāmātyagatatvavadīśāsādhāraṇadharmasyāsaṃgatvasya śrutibalājjīvagatatvasaṃbhavāt| iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: rāja asādhāraṇa dharmasya api kośasya amātya gata tva vat īśa asādhāraṇa dharmasya asaṃga tvasya śruti balāt jīva gata tva saṃbhavāt iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || suṣuptyutkrāṃtyorbhedeneti || asyārthaḥ || sa yattatra kiṃcitpaśyatīti śrutyuktasvapnādidraṣṭā paramātmaiva| na jīvaḥ| kutaḥ| asaṃgo hyaṃ puruṣa ityuktāsaṃgatvaliṃgāditi heturbahirevādhyāhāryaḥ| nanvīśvarābhedena jīve'pyasaṃgatvoktiḥ saṃbhavatrītyata uktaṃ| suṣuptyetyādi|
analyzed: suṣupti utkrāṃtyoḥ bhedena iti asya arthaḥ sa yat tatra kiṃcid paśyati iti śruti ukta svapna ādi draṣṭā paramātmā eva na jīvaḥ kutas asaṃgaḥ hi am puruṣaḥ iti ukta asaṃga tva liṃgāt iti hetuḥ bahis eva adhyāhāryaḥ nanu īśvara abhedena jīva ipi asaṃga tva uktiḥ saṃbhavatrī iti atas uktam suṣuptyā ityādi

original: tathā ca suṣuptyuktrāṃtyoḥ prājñenātmanā saṃpariṣvaktaṃ iti prājñenātmanā'nvārūḍha iti ca suṣuptyuktrāṃtaprakaraṇayoḥ| bhedena jīveśayorbhinnatvenokteḥ| na tayoraikyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā ca suṣupti uktrāṃtyoḥ prājñena ātmanā saṃpariṣvaktam iti prājñena ātmanā anvārūḍhaḥ iti ca suṣupti uktrāṃta prakaraṇayoḥ bhedena jīva īśayoḥ bhinna tvena ukteḥ na tayoḥ aikyam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāsaṃgatvaliṃgāt tadviṣṇorevopapadyate| na tu jīvasya| baddhatvāt| suṣuptyutkrāṃtaprakaraṇayorbhedābhidhānena jīveśayorabhedābhāvāt| ato guṇaguṇibhāvāpannāsaṃgatvaliṃgādviṣṇureva svapnādidraṣṭā| asaṃgatvamapīśamātraniṣṭhaṃ| tataścāsaṃgo hyayaṃ puruṣa iti vākyamapīśaparameveti pramāmābhāvāt| rājadhanavadasaṃgatvaṃ nānyaniṣṭhamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca asaṃgatva liṃgāt tat viṣṇoḥ eva upapadyate na tu jīvasya baddha tvāt suṣupti utkrāṃta prakaraṇayoḥ bheda abhidhānena jīva īśayoḥ abheda abhāvāt atas guṇa guṇibhāva āpanna asaṃgatva liṃgāt viṣṇuḥ eva svapna ādi draṣṭā asaṃga tvam api īśa mātra niṣṭham tatas ca asaṃgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti vākyam api īśa param eva iti pramā mābhāvāt rāja dhana vat asaṃgatvam na anya niṣṭham iti siddham

original: || iti suṣuptyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti suṣupti adhikaraṇam

original: atra brāhmaṇanāma brahmāṇi samanvīyate|
analyzed: atra brāhmaṇa nāma brahmāṇi samanvīyate

original: || patyādiśabdebhyaḥ || ||
analyzed: pati ādi śabdebhyaḥ

original: nanvayaṃ brāhmaṇo viriṃcobhavet| asminbahuśo'jaśabdaśravaṇāt| na cājatvayogenājaḥ śabdo viṣṇau sāvakāśa iti vācyaṃ| brāhmaṇaśabdasahapaṭhitasyājaśabdasya viṣṇāvanavakāśāt| na cātmajaśabdena sahapāṭhādajaśabdo viṣṇau sāvakāśa iti vācyaṃ| ātmaśabdasyātmā viriṃca ityādinā viriṃce'ṣi pravṛtteḥ|
analyzed: nanu ayam brāhmaṇaḥ viriṃcaḥ bhavet asmin bahuśas oja śabda śravaṇāt na ca aja tva yogena ajaḥ śabdaḥ viṣṇau sa avakāśaḥ iti vācyam brāhmaṇa śabda saha paṭhitasya aja śabdasya viṣṇau anavakāśāt na ca ātmaja śabdena saha pāṭhāt aja śabdaḥ viṣṇau sa avakāśaḥ iti vācyam ātma śabdasya ātmā viriṃcaḥ ityādinā pravṛtteḥ

original: na cāsaṃgatvaliṃgānavakāśānna viriṃco brāhmaṇa iti vācyaṃ| viṣṇuviriṃcayorabhedenāsaṃgatvaliṃgasya tasminsaṃbhavāt| tathā ca brāhmaṇo viriṃca iti prāguktanityamahimatvaṃ viṣṇoranupapannamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: na ca asaṃga tva liṃga anavakāśāt na viriṃcaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ iti vācyam viṣṇu viriṃcayoḥ abhedena asaṃga tva liṃgasya tasmin saṃbhavāt tathā ca brāhmaṇaḥ viriṃcaḥ iti prāc ukta nitya mahima tvam viṣṇoḥ anupapannam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || patyādiśabdebhya iti || eṣanityo mahimā bāhmaṇasyeti śrutyuktabrāhmaṇo viṣṇureva| na viriṃcaḥ| kutaḥ| patyādiśabdebhyaḥ| sarvasyādhipatirityādisarvādhipatyādivāci śrutibhya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pati ādi śabdebhyaḥ iti eṣa nityaḥ mahimā bāhmaṇasya iti śruti ukta brāhmaṇaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na viriṃcaḥ kutas pati ādi śabdebhyaḥ sarvasya adhipatiḥ ityādi sarva adhipati ādi vāci śrutibhyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutiṣu patyādiśabdasadbhāvāt| na ca viṣṇorbrāhmaṇatve'jaśabdavirodhaḥ| aja śabdasya na jāyata iti yogenopapatteḥ| brāhmaṇaśabdasya brāhmaṇā vedena bhaṇyata iti yogenopapattyā'jaśabdāpahārābhāvāt| na cābhedātpatitvāderviriṃce'pi saṃbhavaḥ| tadabhede mānābhāvāt| brāhmaṇājaśabdayoruktarītyā'nyathopapatteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śrutiṣu pati ādi śabda sadbhāvāt na ca viṣṇoḥ brāhmaṇa tva ija śabda virodhaḥ aja śabdasya na jāyate iti yogena upapatteḥ brāhmaṇa śabdasya brāhmaṇāḥ vedena bhaṇyate iti yogena upapattyā aja śabda apahāra abhāvāt na ca abhedāt pati tva ādeḥ saṃbhavaḥ tad abhede māna abhāvāt brāhmaṇa aja śabdayoḥ ukta rītyā anyathā upapatteḥ

original: tata ete vyajāyaṃteti bhedaśrutibāhulyena tayorabhede mānābhāvāt| tataśca viṣṇurevāyaṃ brāhmaṇo nityamahimādiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ete vyajāyaṃta iti bheda śruti bāhulyena tayoḥ abhede māna abhāvāt tatas ca viṣṇuḥ eva ayam brāhmaṇaḥ nitya mahima ādiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti brāhmaṇādhikaraṇaṃ ||

analyzed: iti prathama adhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ

original: || śrīḥ ||
analyzed: śrīḥ

original: || hariḥ ||
analyzed: hariḥ

original: || atha prathamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ ||

analyzed: śruti liṃgābhiḥ anyatra eva prasiddhānām api śabdānām sāmastyena viśeṣa hetubhiḥ viṣṇau eva pravṛttiḥ pradarśyate smin pāde

analyzed: ānumānikam api ekeṣām iti ced na śarīra rūpaka vinyasta gṛhīteḥ darśayati ca

original: nanu pradhānādyevāvyaktādiśabdavācyaṃ| tacchabdānāṃ pradhānādāveva prasiddhatvāt| na ca teṣāṃ viṣṇāvapi sāvakāśatvaṃ| tatrāvyaktasya puruṣāvaratvaśravaṇāt| viṣṇośca na tatsamābhyadhikaśca dṛśyata iti pramāṇavirodhena tadayogāt| mahadādikaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇajanyaṃ kāryatvāt| ghaṭavadityādisāṃkhyopanyastānumānasiddhatvāt|
