original: || || prāṇādayo vākyaśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhagavadrūpatvenoktāḥ paṃcajanāstu prāṇādeḥ| prāṇādayaḥ dvitīyānirdiṣṭaprāṇacakṣuḥśrotrānnamanobhidhāḥ jñeyāḥ| kutaḥ| vākyaśeṣāt te ca bhagavadrūpaviśeṣā eva| kutaḥ| viṣṇoranyatrāsaṃbhāvita prāṇa prāmapadatvādipratipādakaṃ| prāṇasya prāṇami tyādivākyaśeṣādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prāṇa ādayaḥ vākya śeṣāt iti asya arthaḥ bhagavat rūpa tvena uktāḥ paṃcajanāḥ tu prāṇa ādeḥ prāṇa ādayaḥ dvitīyā nirdiṣṭa prāṇa cakṣuḥ śrotra anna manaḥ abhidhāḥ jñeyāḥ kutas vākya śeṣāt te ca bhagavat rūpa viśeṣāḥ eva kutas viṣṇoḥ anyatra asaṃbhāvita prāṇa prāma pada tva ādi pratipādakam prāṇasya prāṇam ityādi vākya śeṣāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca sa u prāṇasyeti vākyaśyeṣe prāṇādināṃ prāṇapadatvokteḥ| tasya ca viṣṇuliṃgatvāt| tasmātpaṃcajanādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca saḥ u prāṇasya iti vākya śyeṣe prāṇa ādinām prāṇa pada tva ukteḥ tasya ca viṣṇu liṃga tvāt tasmāt paṃcajana ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || jyotiṣaikeṣāmasatyanne || ||
analyzed: jyotiṣā ekeṣām asati anne

original: nanu na paṃcajanādiśabdavācyo viṣṇuḥ| māṃdhyadinavākyaśeṣoktānāṃ prāṇādiprāṇatvādipradānāṃ viṣṇutve'pi kāṇvānāṃ vākyaśeṣe caturṇāmevoktatvena tasya tadgatayasminniti pūrvavākyato bhinnārthatvāt| atrāpi vākyaśeṣasya yasminnityato bhinnārthatvāvaśyaṃbhāvāt| ekasyaivādhārādheyabhāvābhāvāt| ataḥ paṃcajanānāṃ viṣṇutvābhāvāditi prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu na paṃcajana ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ māṃdhyadina vākyaśeṣa uktānām prāṇa ādi prāṇatva ādi pradānām viṣṇu tve pi kāṇvānām vākyaśeṣe caturṇām eva ukta tvena tasya tad gata yasmin iti pūrva vākyataḥ bhinna artha tvāt atra api vākyaśeṣasya yasmin ityataḥ bhinna artha tva avaśyaṃbhāvāt ekasya eva ādhāra ādheya bhāva abhāvāt atas paṃcajanānām viṣṇu tva abhāvāt iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || jyotiṣaikeṣāmasatyanna iti || asyārthaḥ || ekeṣāṃ kāṇvādīnāṃ| śākhāyāṃ| anne annākhyabhagavadrūpe| asati anukte'pi| jyotiṣā tadākhyabhagavadrūpeṇa paṃcatvasaṃkhyāpūrtirjñātavyetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: jyotiṣā ekeṣām asati anne iti asya arthaḥ ekeṣām kāṇva ādīnām śākhāyām anne anna ākhya bhagavat rūpe asati anukte api jyotiṣā tad ākhya bhagavat rūpeṇa paṃcatva saṃkhyā pūrtiḥ jñātavyā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāsminvākyaśeṣe annasyānnamitirūpe kathite satyapi taddevā jyotiṣāṃ jyotiriti kiṃciddūroktena paṃcatvasaṃbhavena bhinnaviṣayatvābhāvāt| ato bahutvasaṃkhyā viśiṣṭavāciśabdavācyo'pi harireveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca asmin vākya śeṣe annasya annam iti rūpe kathite sati api tat devāḥ jyotiṣām jyotiḥ iti kiṃcid dūra uktena paṃcatva saṃbhavena bhinna viṣaya tva abhāvāt atas bahutva saṃkhyā viśiṣṭa vāci śabda vācyaḥ api hariḥ eva iti siddham

original: || iti na saṃkhyopasaṃgrahādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na saṃkhyā upasaṃgraha adhikaraṇam

original: atrāvāṃtarakāraṇavācyākāśādiśabdasamanvayaḥ brahmaṇi kriyate|
analyzed: atra avāṃtara kāraṇa vācya ākāśa ādi śabda samanvayaḥ brahmaṇi kriyate

original: || kāraṇatvena cākāśādiṣu yathāvyapadiṣṭokteḥ || ||
analyzed: kāraṇa tvena ca ākāśa ādiṣu yathā vyapadiṣṭa ukteḥ

original: nanvākāśādiśabdavācyo na viṣṇuḥ| teṣāmātmādikāryatvaśravaṇāt| na ca paramātmanastatsaṃbhavati| na jāyateti śruteḥ| kiṃca loke tāvadbhinnayoreva kāryakāraṇabhāvopalabdho natvabhinnayorityātmākāśayorabhinnatvena tathābhāvo viruddhaḥ| na cākāśādisaṃbhavasya tadadhīnatvena saṃbhūtaśabdopapattiriti vācyaṃ| sutotpattau janake jātaśabdaprayogādarśanāt|
analyzed: nanu ākāśa ādi śabda vācyaḥ na viṣṇuḥ teṣām ātma ādi kāryatva śravaṇāt na ca paramātmanaḥ tat saṃbhavati na jāyata iti śruteḥ kiṃca loke tāvat bhinnayoḥ eva kārya kāraṇa bhāva upalabdhaḥ na tu abhinnayoḥ iti ātma ākāśayoḥ abhinna tvena tathābhāvaḥ viruddhaḥ na ca ākāśa ādi saṃbhavasya tad adhīna tvena saṃbhūta śabda upapattiḥ iti vācyam suta utpattau janake jāta śabda prayoga adarśanāt

original: ākāśagatarūpasyānyagatasaṃbhavaniyāmakatve ātmaśabdasyānupayogāt| ātmana ityasyānanvayaṃ syāt| tasmādātmaśabdoditasyaiva mukhyakāraṇasya viṣṇutvaṃ natvavāṃtarakāraṇānāmākāśādīnāmiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: ākāśa gata rūpasya anya gata saṃbhava niyāmaka tve ātma śabdasya anupayogāt ātmanaḥ iti asya ananvayam syāt tasmāt ātma śabda uditasya eva mukhya kāraṇasya viṣṇu tvam na tu avāṃtara kāraṇānām ākāśa ādīnām iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || kāraṇatvena cākāśādiṣu yathāvyapadiṣṭokteriti || asyārthaḥ || ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ ākāśadvāyurityādau kāryatve sati kāraṇatvarūpāvāṃtarakāraṇavācakākāśādiśabdairākāśādiṣu sthito viṣṇureva| kāraṇatvena ca śabdātkāryatvena cocyate| na bhūtaṃ| kutaḥ| yathāvyapadiṣṭokteḥ|
analyzed: kāraṇa tvena ca ākāśa ādiṣu yathā vyapadiṣṭa ukteḥ iti asya arthaḥ ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ ākāśāt vāyuḥ ityādau kārya tve sati kāraṇa tva rūpa avāntara kāraṇa vācaka ākāśa ādi śabdaiḥ ākāśa ādiṣu sthitaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva kāraṇa tvena ca śabdāt kārya tvena ca ucyate na bhūtam kutas yathā vyapadiṣṭa ukteḥ

original: sa yo'to'śruta ityādau viṣṇuḥ yathā yādṛśenāviditatvādirūpeṇa vyapadiṣṭaḥ uktaḥ| tadrūpayuktasyaivākāśādiṣu yamākāśo na vede tyādivākyenoktatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sa yā uta śrutaḥ ityādau viṣṇuḥ yathā yādṛśena avidita tva ādi rūpeṇa vyapadiṣṭaḥ uktaḥ tad rūpa yuktasya eva ākāśa ādiṣu yam ākāśaḥ na vede tyādi vākyena uktatvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca kāryatve sati kāraṇatvābhidhāyakākāśaḥ saṃbhūta ityādiśrutibhāgagatākāśādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureva| nāmāni sarvāṇīti śruteḥ| ākāśādyutpattāvākāśāṃtargatatvena bhagavato'bhivyaktyā kāryatvasya vāyvādirūpābhivyaktihetutvena kāraṇatvopapattyā kāryakāraṇabhāvāvirodhāt| tathā cāvāṃtarakāraṇākāśādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca kārya tve sati kāraṇatva abhidhāyaka ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ ityādi śruti bhāga gata ākāśa ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva nāmāni sarvāṇi iti śruteḥ ākāśa ādi utpattau ākāśa aṃtargata tvena bhagavataḥ abhivyaktyā kārya tvasya vāyu ādi rūpa abhivyakti hetu tvena kāraṇa tva upapattyā kārya kāraṇa bhāva avirodhāt tathā ca avāṃtara kāraṇa ākāśa ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || iti ākāśādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti ākāśa adhikaraṇam

original: atra viṣṇau prakārāṃtareṇa pūvoktasarvaśabdasamanvayāsaṃbhavamāśaṃkya parihriyate|
analyzed: atra viṣṇau prakāra aṃtareṇa pūva ukta sarva śabda samanvaya asaṃbhavam āśaṃkya parihriyate

original: || samākarṣāt || ||
analyzed: samākarṣāt

original: nanvathā'pi bhagavataḥ sarvaśabdavācyatvaṃ na saṃbhavati| sarvaśabdānāṃ mukhyatastasyaikavācitve tato'nyatra jagati śabdaprayogarūpo vā hānādirūpo vā vyavahārābhāvāpātena tallopaprasaṃgāt| tasya cāniṣṭatvāt| paramātmaiva mukhyataḥ sarvaśabdavācya ityavadhāraṇānupapatteriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu atha api bhagavataḥ sarva śabda vācyatvam na saṃbhavati sarva śabdānām mukhyatas tasya eka vāci tve tatonyatra jagati śabda prayoga rūpaḥ vā hāna ādi rūpaḥ vā vyavahāra abhāva āpātena tad lopa prasaṃgāt tasya ca aniṣṭa tvāt paramātmā eva mukhyatas sarva śabda vācyaḥ iti avadhāraṇa anupapatteḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || samākarṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || svato mukhyavṛttyā paramātmavācinaḥ śabdān| tataḥ samākṛṣyānyatravācakatvaśaktyaṃgīkārāt| nānyatra vyavahāralopaprasaṃga| ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: samākarṣāt iti asya arthaḥ svatas mukhya vṛttyā paramātma vācinaḥ śabdān tatas samākṛṣya anyatra vācaka tva śakti aṃgīkārāt na anyatra vyavahāra lopa prasaṃgaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca mukhyataḥ paramātmavācakānāṃ śabdānāmanyatra vyavahārārthaṃ samākṛṣya parameśvareṇa saṃketitatvena sarvavyavahāropapatteḥ| parasya vācakā iti smṛteḥ| tathā ca sakalaśabdaparamamukhyārthatvaṃ hareriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca mukhyatas paramātma vācakānām śabdānām anyatra vyavahāra artham samākṛṣya parameśvareṇa saṃketita tvena sarva vyavahāra upapatteḥ parasya vācakāḥ iti smṛteḥ tathā ca sakala śabda parama mukhya artha tvam hareḥ iti siddham

original: || jagadvācitvāt || ||
analyzed: jagat vāci tvāt

original: nanu yadi paramātmani śabdā mukhyā anyatrāmukhyāstarhi tasminneva prasitdhyā bhāvyaṃ| kathamanyatra prasiddhiḥ tathā ca prasitdhyanyathā'nupapattyā'nyasyaiva mukhyavācyatvaṃ kalpyamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu yadi paramātmani śabdāḥ mukhyāḥ anyatra amukhyāḥ tarhi tasmin eva prasitdhyā bhāvyam katham anyatra prasiddhiḥ tathā ca prasitdhi anyathā anupapattyā anyasya eva mukhya vācyatvam kalpyam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || jagadvācitvāditi || asyārthaḥ || lokavyavahārācchabdānāṃ jagadvācitvajñānātteṣāṃ tatra prasiddhiryuktetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: jagat vāci tvāt iti asya arthaḥ lokavyavahārāt śabdānām jagat vāci tva jñānāt teṣām tatra prasiddhiḥ yuktā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca lokasya bahirmukhatvena jagatyeva vyavahārācchabdānāṃ tatra vyutpattyā prasiddhiḥ| paramātmani tu vyutpattyabhāvena prasitdhyabhāvopapatteḥ| tasmātsarvaśabdamukhyavācyatvaṃ viṣṇoriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca lokasya bahirmukha tvena jagati eva vyavahārāt śabdānām tatra vyutpattyā prasiddhiḥ paramātmani tu vyutpatti abhāvena prasitdhi abhāva upapatteḥ tasmāt sarva śabda mukhya vācya tvam viṣṇoḥ iti siddham

original: || jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṃgāditicedvyākhyātaṃ || ||
analyzed: jīva mukhya prāṇa liṃgāt iti ced vyākhyātam

original: nanvastu pravṛttinimittasvāmitvātparamātmano mukhyataḥ śabdavācyatvaṃ| tathā'pi tasyaiva kiṃtu jīvamukhyaprāṇayorapi| tayoḥ sarvasvāmitvasyāsya yadaikāṃ śākhāmiti vāyunā hi sarve lokā ityādiśrutisiddhatvādityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu astu pravṛtti nimitta svāmi tvāt paramātmanaḥ mukhyatas śabda vācyatvam tathā api tasya eva kiṃtu jīva mukhya prāṇayoḥ api tayoḥ sarva svāmi tvasya asya yadā ekām śākhām iti vāyunā hi sarve lokāḥ ityādi śruti siddha tvāt iti ākṣipya samādadhat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || jīvamukhyaprāmaliṃgāditi cedvyākhyātamiti || asyārthaḥ || asya yadaikāṃ śākhāṃ jīvo jahātīti vāyunā hi lokā nenīyaṃta iti vākye ca jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṃgāt jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṃgayoḥ śravaṇāt| tayorapi tattacchabdamukhyavācyatā syāditi cenna| kutaḥ| yasmāttdvākyajātaṃ tattadaṃtaryāmiparatayā vyākṛtaṃ| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: jīva mukhya prāma liṃgāt iti ced vyākhyātam iti asya arthaḥ asya yadā ekām śākhām jīvaḥ jahāti iti vāyunā hi lokāḥ nenīyaṃte iti vākye ca jīva mukhya prāṇa liṃgāt jīva mukhya prāṇa liṃgayoḥ śravaṇāt tayoḥ api tad tad śabda mukhya vācya tā syāt iti ced na kutas yasmāt ttd vākya jātam tat tat aṃtaryāmi para tayā vyākṛtam tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca śrutīnāṃ tadaṃtargatabhagavadviṣayatayopāsātraividhyāditi vyākhyānādviṣṇoreva mukhyataḥ śabdārthatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca śrutīnām tad aṃtargata bhagavat viṣaya tayā upāsā traividhyāt iti vyākhyānāt viṣṇoḥ eva mukhyatas śabda artha tvam iti siddham

original: || anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ praśnavyākhyānābhyāmapi caivameke || ||
analyzed: anya artham tu jaiminiḥ praśna vyākhyānābhyām api ca evam eke

original: nanu yattāvaduktaṃ samākarṣeṇa vācyatvādekasya mukhyavācyatvamanyasya svatovācyatvātparamamukhyavācyatvamiti taduktaṃ| vedasya kāmyaphalārthamapravṛttatvena samākarṣe prayojanābhāvāt| ekasya vācyatvameva netyanyasya viṣṇormukhyata eva vācyatvaṃ bhavenna tu paramamukhyato vācyatvamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu yat tāvat uktam samākarṣeṇa vācya tvāt ekasya mukhya vācya tvam anyasya svatas vācya tvāt parama mukhya vācya tvam iti tat uktam vedasya kāmya phala artham apravṛtta tvena samākarṣe prayojana abhāvāt ekasya vācya tvam eva na iti anyasya viṣṇoḥ mukhyatas eva vācya tvam bhavet na tu parama mukhyatas vācya tvam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ praśnavyākhyānābhyāmapi caivameva iti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| etena viṣṇoranyatra śabdān samākṛṣya karmādipratipādanamapi yuktameva| kutaḥ| yasmāt anyārthaṃ paramātmajñānārthameva| tatkuta iti cet| praśnavyākhyānābhyāṃ śvetaketupraśnāt yathā saumyetyuddākavacanācceti jaiminirācāryo manyate|
analyzed: anya artham tu jaiminiḥ praśna vyākhyānābhyām api ca evam eva iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ eva arthe etena viṣṇoḥ anyatra śabdān samākṛṣya karma ādi pratipādanam api yuktam eva kutas yasmāt anya artham paramātma jñāna artham eva tat kutas iti ced praśna vyākhyānābhyām śvetaketu praśnāt yathā saumya iti uddāka vacanāt ca iti jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate

original: kiṃca eke śākhinaḥ spaṣṭaṃyastaṃ na vedeti anyajñānasya paramātmajñānārthatāṃ paṭhaṃti| tasmādapītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: kiṃca eke śākhinaḥ spaṣṭam yaḥ tam na veda iti anya jñānasya paramātma jñāna arthatām paṭhaṃti tasmāt api iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva vedaḥ samākarṣeṇa karmadikaṃ vadatīti| karmādijñānasya gavatjñānārthatvaṃ kuta iti ceta sarvamidamiti vijñātasyāpyasya phalaṃ kasminvijñāte bhavati| etatjñānamātrasyāphalatvāditi śaunakapraśne sarvamaparavidyayā vijñātaṃ bhavati| vijñātaṃ ca paravidyāviṣayaparamātmajñānena saphalaṃ bhavatītyaṃgiraso vyākhyānāt|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva vedaḥ samākarṣeṇa karma dikam vadati iti karma ādi jñānasya gavat jñāna artha tvam kutas iti ceta sarvam idam iti vijñātasya api asya phalam kasmin vijñāte bhavati etat jñāna mātrasya aphala tvāt iti śaunakapraśne sarvam apara vidyayā vijñātam bhavati vijñātam ca para vidyā viṣaya paramātma jñānena saphalam bhavati iti aṃgirasaḥ vyākhyānāt

original: api caivameka śākhino yastannavedetyādinā paṭhaṃti| ato karmādijñānasya bhagavatjñānārthatvamiti jaiminirācāryo manyate| tataśca viṣṇoḥ paramamukhyavācyatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: api ca evam eka śākhinaḥ yaḥ tat na veda ityādinā paṭhaṃti karma ādi jñānasya bhagavat jñāna artha tvam iti jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate tatas ca viṣṇoḥ parama mukhya vācya tvam iti siddham

original: || vākyānvayāt || ||
analyzed: vākya anvayāt

original: nanu na paramātmajñānārthaṃ karmādikaṃ vedena vaktavyaṃ| anyadanuktvā vedena paramātmamātrakathane'pi tatjñānasaṃbhavāt| na ca vyutpattyunupapattiḥ| jyotiṣṭomādiśabdānāṃ viṣṇaurūḍherabhāvāt| yogasyaca jyotiṣṭhomeneti padāvayavānāmapyanyaparatvānabhyupagame'yogāditi vācyaṃ| khaṃḍapadamātrasyānyavācakatvābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: nanu na paramātma jñāna artham karma ādikam vedena vaktavyam anyat an uktvā vedena paramātma mātra kathane pi tad jñāna saṃbhavāt na ca vyutpatti unupapattiḥ jyotiṣṭoma ādi śabdānām viṣṇau rūḍheḥ abhāvāt yogasya ca jyotiṣṭhomena iti pada avayavānām api anya paratva anabhyupagame yogāt iti vācyam khaṃḍa pada mātrasya anya vācaka tva abhyupagamāt

original: tathā cānyakathane prayojanābhāvānna tatra samākarṣo yukta iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: tathā ca anya kathane prayojana abhāvāt na tatra samākarṣaḥ yuktaḥ iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || vākyānvayāditi || asyārthaḥ || brahmaṇi vākyasamanvayamavekṣya vedena karmādikamapi pratipādanīyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vākya anvayāt iti asya arthaḥ brahmaṇi vākya samanvayam avekṣya vedena karma ādikam api pratipādanīyam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na kevalaṃ paramātmani śruteḥ padasamanvayo vivakṣitaḥ kiṃ tarhi vākyasamanvayo'pi| na cāsāvanyatra samākarṣābhāve sitdhyatīti samākarṣo vaktavya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca na kevalam paramātmani śruteḥ pada samanvayaḥ vivakṣitaḥ kim tarhi vākya samanvayaḥ api na ca asau anyatra samākarṣa abhāve sitdhyati iti samākarṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti siddham

original: || pratijñāsiddherliṃgamāśmarathyaḥ || ||
analyzed: pratijñā siddheḥ liṃgam āśmarathyaḥ

original: nanu paramātmajñānārthaṃ karmādikamucyata ityuktaṃ| tatkena prakāreṇetyākāṃkṣāyāṃ sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu paramātma jñāna artham karma ādikam ucyate iti uktam tat kena prakāreṇa iti ākāṃkṣāyām sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || pratijñāsiddherliṃgamāśmarathya iti || vedena karmādipratipādanaṃ| yataḥprati jñāsirddherliṃgaṃ jñānameva mokṣahetuḥ nānyadityevaṃrūpāyāḥ nānyaḥ paṃthā iti pratijñātārthasiddheḥ sādhakaṃ| atastadupayogitvena tatpratipādanaṃ yuktamityāśmarathyācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pratijñā siddheḥ liṃgam āśmarathyaḥ iti vedena karma ādi pratipādanam yatas prati jñā sirddheḥ liṃgam jñānam eva mokṣa hetuḥ na anyat iti evaṃrūpāyāḥ na anyaḥ paṃthāḥ iti pratijñāta artha siddheḥ sādhakam atas tad upayogi tvena tad pratipādanam yuktam iti āśmarathya ācāryaḥ manyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nānyaḥ paṃthā iti brahmajñānena mokṣaḥ pratijñātaḥ| tatsitdhyarthaṃ karmādikaṃ saparikaraṃ nirūpya tasyānityaduḥkhaśiraskaphalakatvamucyate| evaṃ karmādikamanityaphalakatvena nānya iti siddhamityevaṃrūpeṇa karmavacanasyopayoga ityāśmarathyācāryo manyate| tathā ca bhagavatjñānārthaṃ karmādikamucyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca na anyaḥ paṃthāḥ iti brahma jñānena mokṣaḥ pratijñātaḥ tad sitdhi artham karma ādikam sa parikaram nirūpya tasya anitya duḥkha śiraska phalaka tvam ucyate evam karma ādikam anitya phalaka tvena na anyaḥ iti siddham iti evaṃrūpeṇa karma vacanasya upayogaḥ iti āśmarathi ācāryaḥ manyate tathā ca bhagavat jñāna artham karma ādikam ucyate iti siddham

original: || utkramiṣyata evaṃ bhāvādityauḍulomiḥ || ||
analyzed: utkramiṣyate evam bhāvāt iti auḍulomiḥ

original: prakārāṃtareṇa karmādivacanasya bhagavatjñānopayogaṃ pradarśayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: prakāra aṃtareṇa karma ādi vacanasya bhagavat jñāna upayogam pradarśayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || ukramiṣyata evaṃ bhāvādityauḍulomiriti || asyārthaḥ || ukramiṣyataḥ jñānānmokṣamicchato'dhikāriṇaḥ| evaṃ jñānasādhanatayā| bhāvāt karmāderapyanuṣṭhayetvānmokṣārthajñānasādhanatvena vedena karmādipratipādanaṃ yuktamevetyauḍulomirācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ukramiṣyataḥ evam bhāvāt iti auḍulomiḥ iti asya arthaḥ ukramiṣyataḥ jñānāt mokṣam icchataḥ adhikāriṇaḥ evam jñāna sādhanatayā bhāvāt karma ādeḥ api mokṣa artha jñāna sādhanatvena vedena karma ādi pratipādanam yuktam eva iti auḍulomiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca saṃsārādutkramaṇecchormumukṣorjñānasyeva karmādarepyaṃtaḥkaraṇaśuddhidvārā mokṣasādhanabhagavatjñānasādhanatvena nimittena saṃpādyatvādvedānāṃ karmādivācitvamāvaśyakamityauḍulomirācāryo manyate| na ca karmādeḥ phalaśrutivirodhaḥ| tasyāḥ karmaṇi rucijananārthatvāt| tathā coktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca saṃsārāt utkramaṇa icchoḥ mumukṣoḥ jñānasya iva karma ādare pi aṃtaḥkaraṇa śuddhi dvārā mokṣa sādhana bhagavat jñāna sādhana tvena nimittena saṃpādya tvāt vedānām karma ādi vāci tvam āvaśyakam iti auḍulomiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate na ca karma ādeḥ phala śruti virodhaḥ tasyāḥ karmaṇi ruci janana artha tvāt tathā ca uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || avasthiteriti kāśakṛtsnaḥ || ||
analyzed: avasthiteḥ iti kāśakṛtsnaḥ

original: prakārāṃtareṇa karmādivacanasya brahmajñānopayogitvaṃ pradarśayatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: prakāra aṃtareṇa karma ādi vacanasya brahma jñāna upayogi tvam pradarśayat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || avasthiteriti kāśakṛtsna iti || asyārthaḥ || sarvādhāre bhagavati karmādīnāṃ avasthiteḥ avasthānāt| bhagavataḥ karmādyādhāratvajñānāyādheyabhūtakarmādisvarūpaṃ vedena pratipādyata iti kāśakṛtsnācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ| anekādhikārikatvānmatānāṃ na virodha iti dhyeyaṃ ||
analyzed: avasthiteḥ iti kāśakṛtsnaḥ iti asya arthaḥ sarva ādhāre bhagavati karma ādīnām avasthiteḥ avasthānāt bhagavataḥ karma ādi ādhāra tva jñānāya ādheya bhūta karma ādi svarūpam vedena pratipādyate iti kāśakṛtsna ācāryaḥ manyate iti arthaḥ aneka ādhikārika tvāt matānām na virodhaḥ iti dhyeyam

original: evaṃcaiva seturvidhāraṇaṃ ityādau paramātmanyavasthityukteḥ| tasyāśca sarvādhāratvena jñātavyamiti jñānārthatvāt| asya cādheyajñānaṃ vinā'yogāttadarthaṃ vedena karmādikamucyata iti sākṣādeva kathaṃ brahmajñātavyamiti jñānyapekṣitasvetarasarvādhāratvarūpaprakārasamarpakatvena vedānāṃ karmādijagadvācitvamanyārthaṃ paramātmajñānārthamiti
analyzed: evam ca eva setuḥ vidhāraṇam ityādau paramātmani avasthiti ukteḥ tasyāḥ ca sarva ādhāra tvena jñātavyam iti jñāna artha tvāt asya ca ādheya jñānam vinā ayogāt tad artham vedena karma ādikam ucyate iti sākṣāt eva katham brahma jñātavyam iti jñāni apekṣita sva itara sarva ādhāra tva rūpa prakāra samarpaka tvena vedānām karma ādi jagat vācitvam anya artham paramātma jñāna artham iti

original: kāśakṛtsnācāryo manyate| tathā ca bhagavajjñānārthaṃ vaidikaśabdānāmanyatra samākarṣeṇa vyavahāropapatteryuktaṃ hareḥ sakalaśabdaparamamukhyārthatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: kāśakṛtsna ācāryaḥ manyate tathā ca bhagavat jñāna artham vaidika śabdānām anyatra samākarṣeṇa vyavahāra upapatteḥ yuktam hareḥ sakala śabda parama mukhya artha tvam iti siddham

original: || iti samākarṣādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti samākarṣa adhikaraṇam

original: atra strīśabdānāṃ brahmāṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate|
analyzed: atra strī śabdānām brahmāṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate

original: || prakṛtiśca pratijñādṛṣṭāṃtānuparodhāt || ||
analyzed: prakṛtiḥ ca pratijñā dṛṣṭāṃta an uparodhāt

original: nanu na prakṛtyādiśabdavācyo hariḥ| strīliṃgaśabdavācyatāvyāpakastrītvābhāvāt| nainamiti strītvaniṣedhāt| na ca napuṃsakaśabdavṛttivastrīśabdavṛttiḥ kiṃ na syāditi vācyaṃ| tatkalpanā'yogāt| atha strībhūtasyāpi strīniyāmakatvāttacchabdavācyateti cinna| vaśīkṛtabhārye bhartari tacchabdavācyatvaprasaṃgāt|
analyzed: nanu na prakṛti ādi śabda vācyaḥ hariḥ strī liṃga śabda vācyatā vyāpaka strī tva abhāvāt na enam iti strītva niṣedhāt na ca napuṃsaka śabda vṛtti vat strī śabda vṛttiḥ kim na syāt iti vācyam tad kalpanā yogāt atha strī bhūtasya api strī niyāmaka tvāt tad śabda vācya tā iti cit na vaśīkṛta bhārye bhartari tad śabda vācya tva prasaṃgāt

original: ataḥ prakṛtyādiśabdānāṃ paramātmavācitvābhāvena samanvayasūtramanupapannamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: atas prakṛti ādi śabdānām paramātma vāci tva abhāvena samanvaya sūtram anupapannam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || prakṛtiśca pratijñādṛṣṭāṃtānuparodhāditi || asyārthaḥ || īśvaro na kevalaṃ pulliṃgābhidheyaḥ| kiṃtu prakṛtiḥ| saiṣā prakṛtītyādyuktaprakṛtyādistrīliṃgaśabdavācyaśca bhavati| kutaḥ| evaṃ satyeva pratijñādṛṣṭāṃtānuparodhāt haṃtaitamiti pratijñāyāḥ yatheti nadīsamudradṛṣṭāṃtasya cānuparodhāt avirodhāt| anyathā tadvirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prakṛtiḥ ca pratijñā dṛṣṭāṃta anuparodhāt iti asya arthaḥ īśvaraḥ na kevalam pulliṃga abhidheyaḥ kiṃtu prakṛtiḥ sā eṣā prakṛti ityādi ukta prakṛti ādi strī liṃga śabda vācyaḥ ca bhavati kutas evam satī eva pratijñā dṛṣṭāṃta anuparodhāt haṃta etam iti pratijñāyāḥ yathā iti nadī samudra dṛṣṭāṃtasya ca anuparodhāt avirodhāt anyathā tad virodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca harireva prakṛtyādiśabdavācyaḥ| haṃtaitameva puruṣamiti śrutau viṣṇau sarvaśabdavācyatvaṃ pratijñāya tatraiva nadīsamudradraṣṭāṃtābhidhānāt| anyathā pratijñādṛṣṭāṃtoparodhaḥ syāt| ataḥ prakṛtyādiśabdavācyo harireveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca hariḥ eva prakṛti ādi śabda vācyaḥ haṃta etam eva puruṣam iti śrutau viṣṇau sarva śabda vācya tvam pratijñāya tatra eva nadī samudra draṣṭāṃta abhidhānāt anyathā pratijñā dṛṣṭāṃta uparodhaḥ syāt atas prakṛti ādi śabda vācyaḥ hariḥ eva iti siddham

original: || abhidhyopadeśācca || ||
analyzed: abhidhyā upadeśāt ca

original: evaṃ sāmānyapramāṇena prakṛtyādiśabdavācyatāṃ hareḥ pratipādyedānīmaśeṣastrīśabdopalakṣakaprakṛtiśabdavācyatva eva viśiṣyapramāṇaṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: evam sāmānya pramāṇena prakṛti ādi śabda vācyatām hareḥ pratipādya idānīm aśeṣa strī śabda upalakṣaka prakṛti śabda vācyatve eva viśiṣya pramāṇam pratipādayat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || abhidhyopadeśācceti || asyārthaḥ || abhidhyāyāḥ īśvarerchāyāḥ| upadeśāt māyāṃtviti śrutau prakṛtiśabdavācyatvokteśca icchā'bhinneśvarasyāpi tacchabdavācyatvāccetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: abhidhyā upadeśāt ca iti asya arthaḥ abhidhyāyāḥ īśvara irchāyāḥ upadeśāt māyām tu iti śrutau prakṛti śabda vācya tva ukteḥ ca icchā bhinna īśvarasya api tad śabda vācya tvāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhagavadabhinnecchāyā māyāṃtu prakṛtimiti śrutau prakṛtirvāsanetyevamiti smṛtau ca prakṛtiśabdavācyatvābhidhānāt| so'bhidhyāsa iti smṛteśca| ato na kevalaṃ parvoktasāmānyahetoḥ kiṃ tu prakṛtiśabdavācyecchātmakatvokteśca prakṛtirbrahmaiveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca bhagavat abhinna icchāyāḥ māyām tu prakṛtim iti śrutau prakṛtiḥ vāsanā iti evam iti smṛtau ca prakṛti śabda vācya tva abhidhānāt iti smṛteḥ ca atas na kevalam parva ukta sāmānya hetoḥ kim tu prakṛti śabda vācya icchā ātmaka tva ukteḥ ca prakṛtiḥ brahma eva iti siddham

original: || sākṣāccobhayāmnānāt || ||
analyzed: sākṣāt ca ubhaya āmnānāt

original: nanvathā'pi viṣṇoricchādvārā prakṛtiśabdavācyatve'pi na sākṣāttacchabdavācyatvaṃ| pramāṇābhāvāt| nāmānīti śruteḥ saṃkocasaṃbhavāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu atha api viṣṇoḥ icchā dvārā prakṛti śabda vācyatve pi na sākṣāt tad śabda vācyatvam pramāṇa abhāvāt nāmāni iti śruteḥ saṃkoca saṃbhavāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || sākṣāccobhayāmnānāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| sākṣāt dvāramaṃtareṇaiva| ubhayāmnānāt eṣa stryaiṣa puruṣa iti vākyena prakṛtipuruṣobhayaśabdavācyatvābhidhānāt| īśvarasya prakṛtyādiśabdavācyatvamāvaśyakamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sākṣāt ca ubhaya āmnānāt iti asya arthaḥ sākṣāt dvāram aṃtareṇa eva ubhaya āmnānāt eṣa stryā eṣa puruṣaḥ iti vākyena prakṛti puruṣa ubhaya śabda vācya tva abhidhānāt īśvarasya prakṛti ādi śabda vācya tvam āvaśyakam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutau bhagavataḥ prakṛtipuruṣatvābhidhānenaitacchrutyaivārthādicchādvāramaṃtarāpi prakṛtiśaṃbdavācyatvalābhāt| anyathā puruṣaśabdavācyatvamapi na syādaviśeṣāt| tataśca prakṛtyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śrutau bhagavataḥ prakṛti puruṣa tva abhidhānena etad śrutyā eva arthāt icchā dvāram aṃtarā api prakṛti śaṃbda vācyatva lābhāt anyathā puruṣa śabda vācyatvam api na syāt aviśeṣāt tatas ca prakṛti ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || ātmakṛteḥ pariṇāmāt || ||
analyzed: ātma kṛteḥ pariṇāmāt

original: nanu yadyapi bhagavataḥ prakṛtiśabdavācyatvaṃ śrutyoktaṃ| prāpte na tadyuktaṃ| tatra tasya pravṛttau nimittābhāvāt| siddhāṃtibhiḥ saṃketamātratvasyānabhyupagatatvāditi prāpte pariharatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu yadi api bhagavataḥ prakṛti śabda vācyatvam śrutyā uktam prāpte na tat yuktam tatra tasya pravṛttau nimitta abhāvāt siddhāṃtibhiḥ saṃketa mātra tvasya anabhyupagata tvāt iti prāpte pariharat sūtram āha

original: || ātmakṛteḥ pariṇāmāditi || asyārthaḥ || prakṛtipariṇāmaṃ vidhāya tatpreraṇāya ātmakṛteḥ tvasya bahudhākaraṇāt prakṛtiśabdavācyo viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ātma kṛteḥ pariṇāmāt iti asya arthaḥ prakṛti pariṇāmam vidhāya tad preraṇāya ātma kṛteḥ tvasya bahudhā karaṇāt prakṛti śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prakṛṣṭākṛtiriti yogasaṃbhavena nimittābhāvāsiddheḥ| prakṛteḥ svataḥ pariṇāmasāmarthyābhāvāttatra sthitvā tāṃ pariṇamya mahadādiniyākatvenātmano bahudhākaraṇāt| atha heṣa ātmeti śruteḥ| avikāro'pi parama iti smṛteśca| tataḥ prakṛtyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prakṛṣṭa ākṛtiḥ iti yoga saṃbhavena nimitta abhāva asiddheḥ prakṛteḥ svatas pariṇāma sāmarthya abhāvāt tatra sthitvā tām pariṇamya mahat ādi niyāka tvena ātmanaḥ bahudhā karaṇāt atha ha iṣaḥ ātmā iti śruteḥ avikāraḥ api paramaḥ iti smṛteḥ ca tatas prakṛti ādi śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti siddham

original: || yoniśca hi gīyate || ||
analyzed: yoniḥ ca hi gīyate

original: nanu paramātmanaḥ strītve'pi prakṛtiśabdavācyatvābhidhāyakapramāṇasadbhāve'pi strīśabdavācyatvaṃ na yuktaṃ| tasyāvyavadhānena sūtikartṛtvavācitvaniyamāt| na ca paramātmanastadasti| vyāpakābhāveca vyāpyāyogāt| prakṛtiśabdavācyatābhidhāyakavākyasya mṛdavrīvīdityādivākyavatkathaṃcinne yatvāditi prāpte pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu paramātmanaḥ strī tve pi prakṛti śabda vācyatva abhidhāyaka pramāṇa sadbhāve pi strī śabda vācyatvam na yuktam tasya avyavadhānena sūti kartṛ tva vāci tva niyamāt na ca paramātmanaḥ tat asti vyāpaka abhāve ca vyāpya ayogāt prakṛti śabda vācyatā abhidhāyaka vākyasya prāpte pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || yoniśca hi gīyata iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| īśvaraḥ yad‌bhūtayonimiti śrutyā yoniḥ svadehādevāpatyotpādakaśca| gīyate pratipādyate tasmātprakṛtyādistrīliṃgaśabdavācya ityarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃca vyavadhāneniti smṛteḥ| yonitvasyāpi śrutisiddhatvena vyāpakābhāvāsiddheḥ| tataśca viṣṇurevāśeṣastrīśabdavācya ityupapannaṃ samanvayasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||

original: nanu śrutyādeḥ svataḥ prāmāṇyavādinā'pi doṣadarśane'prāmāṇasyāvaśyaṃ grāhyatvāt| vede'pi svoktaphalādarśanāddoṣādaprāmāṇyameva vaktavyamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu śruti ādeḥ svatas prāmāṇya vādinā api doṣa darśane prāmāṇasya avaśyam grāhya tvāt vede pi sva ukta phala adarśanāt doṣāt aprāmāṇyam eva vaktavyam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || dṛśyatetviti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo viśeṣārthe| yataḥ tatphalayogyādhikāriviśeṣāṇāṃ śrutyādyuktaṃ phalaṃ dṛsyate upalabhyate| ato nāprāmāṇyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: dṛśyate tu iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ viśeṣa arthe yatas tad phala yogya adhikāri viśeṣāṇām śruti ādi uktam phalam upalabhyate atas na aprāmāṇyam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcādhikāriṇāṃ phalopalaṃbhena phalānupalaṃbhasya kartṛvaiguṇayādinopapatteḥ| phalavisaṃvādasyānyathāsiddhatvāt| avāṣṇavasmṛtīnāṃ pāśupatādīnāmanupalabhyamānaphalasādhanatvasyoktatvena prāmāṇyabhāvasya niścitatvāt| vedaprāmāṇyasya yuktivirodhābhāvena tena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ hareryuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca adhikāriṇām phala upalaṃbhena phala anupalaṃbhasya kartṛ vaiguṇayā ādinā upapatteḥ phala visaṃvādasya anyathā siddha tvāt avāṣṇava smṛtīnām pāśupata ādīnām anupalabhyamāna phala sādhanatvasya ukta tvena prāmāṇya bhāvasya niścita tvāt veda prāmāṇyasya yukti virodha abhāvena tena jagat kāraṇatvam hareḥ yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti na vilakṣaṇatvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na vilakṣaṇa tva adhikaraṇam

original: atra viṣṇorjagatkartṛtvapratipādakavedaprāmāṇyarūpoktārthe dṛḍhayuktyavirodha ucyate|
analyzed: atra viṣṇoḥ jagatkartṛtva pratipādaka veda prāmāṇya rūpa ukta arthe dṛḍha yukti avirodhaḥ ucyate

original: || abhimānivyapadeśastuviśeṣānugatibhyāṃ || ||
analyzed: abhimāni vyapadeśaḥ tu viśeṣa anugatibhyām

original: nanu na vedaḥ pramāṇaṃ| mṛdavravī dityādinā'mihitamṛdādiktṛtvādermanna vadati jaḍatvādityādiyuktiviruddhatvāt| vedaikadeśasyāprāmāṇye vedaprāmāṇyasādhakasyāpauruṣeyatvasya tatraiva vyabhicārādāmāsatvenāsādhakatvāt| yuktyavirodhāya śruteranyārthakalpanā'yogāt| abhimānidevataikadeśe sati vigrahavattve upalabhaprasaṃgāt| vigrahābhāve vacanādyayogāt|
analyzed: nanu na vedaḥ pramāṇam mṛd avravīt ityādinā amihita mṛd ādiktṛ tva ādeḥ mat na vadati jaḍa tvāt ityādi yukti viruddha tvāt veda eka deśasya aprāmāṇye veda prāmāṇya sādhakasya apauruṣeya tvasya tatra eva vyabhicārāt āmāsa tvena asādhaka tvāt yukti avirodhāya śruteḥ anya artha kalpanā yogāt abhimāni devatā eka deśe sati vigrahavattve upalabha prasaṃgāt vigraha abhāve vacana ādya yogāt

original: devatā'yogāt| tadrahitadeśavaddeśāṃtaropapattau tadvaiyarbhyaprasaṃgāt| devatāsadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt| śruteraviśvananīyatvāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: devatā yogāt tad rahita deśa vat deśa aṃtara upapattau tad vaiyarbhya prasaṃgāt devatā sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt śruteḥ aviśvananīya tvāt iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || abhimānivyapadeśastu viśeṣānugatibhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| abhimānivyapadeśaḥ mṛdabravīdityādau abhimāninaḥ cetanasyaiva vyapadeśaḥ uktiḥ| na tvacetanasya| kutaḥ| mṛnna vaktrī jaḍatvāditi yuktiviruddhatvāt| tathā ca na vedāprāmāṇyaṃ|
analyzed: abhimāni vyapadeśaḥ tu viśeṣa anugatibhyām iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ avadhāraṇe abhimāni vyapadeśaḥ mṛd abravīt ityādau abhimāninaḥ cetanasya eva vyapadeśaḥ uktiḥ na tu acetanasya kutas mṛd na vaktrī jaḍa tvāt iti yukti viruddha tvāt tathā ca na veda aprāmāṇyam

original: nanvabhimāninaḥ videhatvāyogena sadehatve tasyādarśanamanyavastvadhiṣṭhānena vaktṛtvamanekābhimanyamānādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃcetyādikaṃ videhatvāyogena sadehatve tasyādarśanamanyavasyavastvadhiṣṭhānena vaktṛtvamanekābhimanyamānādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃcetyādikaṃ kathaṃ yujyata ityata uktaṃ| viśeṣetyādi| viśeṣaḥ sāmarthyaṃ| anugatiḥ sarvābhimanyamānavyāptiḥ|
analyzed: nanu abhimāninaḥ videha tva ayogena sa deha tve tasya adarśanam anya vastu adhiṣṭhānena vaktṛ tvam aneka abhimanyamāna adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam ca iti ādikam videha tva ayogena sa deha tve tasya adarśanam anya vasya vastu adhiṣṭhānena vaktṛ tvam aneka abhimanyamāna adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam ca iti ādikam katham yujyate iti atas uktam viśeṣa ityādi viśeṣaḥ sāmarthyam anugatiḥ sarva abhimanyamāna vyāptiḥ

original: tābhyāṃ sarvaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tābhyām sarvam yujyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca mṛdabracīditi vedasyābhimānidevatāparatvena yuktyavirodhāt| śruteranyārthakatpane pratītārthādapi mukhyārthalābhena sāvakāśatvāt| śruteryuktibādhābhāvāt| abhimanyamānavyāpīrnānāṃ vigrahavatīnāṃ ca devatānāṃ sadbhāvāt| mahatāmupalabdhiprasaṃge iṣṭāpattiḥ| pramāṇaprasiddhatvāt| ajñānāṃ tvadṛṣṭiyogyatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca mṛd abracīt iti vedasya abhimāni devatā paratvena yukti avirodhāt śruteḥ anya artha katpane pratīta arthāt api mukhya artha lābhena sāvakāśa tvāt śruteḥ yukti bādhā abhāvāt vigrahavatīnām ca devatānām sadbhāvāt mahatām upalabdhi prasaṃge iṣṭa āpattiḥ pramāṇa prasiddha tvāt ajñānām tu adṛṣṭi yogya tvāt

original: devatāsadbhāve mahatāṃ pratyakṣasyaiva pramāṇatvāt| tataśca vedaprāmāṇye yuktyavirodhattena bhagavato jagatkāraṇatvasādhanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: devatā sadbhāve mahatām pratyakṣasya eva pramāṇa tvāt tatas ca veda prāmāṇye yukti avirodha tena bhagavataḥ jagat kāraṇatva sādhanam yuktam iti siddham

original: || dṛśyate ca || ||
analyzed: dṛśyate ca

original: nanvaprāmāṇikadevatātatsāmarthyakalpanāpekṣayā vedāprāmāṇyakatpanaṃ varaṃ| lāghavāt| vastvaṃtaramadhiṣṭhāya sthitānāṃ tāsāṃ va vanādīnāmayuktatvāt| sāmarthyaviśeṣe pramāṇābhāvāt| vedaprāmāṇyasya vipratipannatvāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu aprāmāṇika devatā tad sāmarthya kalpana apekṣayā veda aprāmāṇya katpanam varam lāghavāt vastu aṃtaram adhiṣṭhāya sthitānām tāsām vana ādīnām ayukta tvāt sāmarthya viśeṣe pramāṇa abhāvāt veda prāmāṇyasya vipratipanna tvāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || dṛśyate ceti || asyārthaḥ || abhimānidevatāyāṃ sāmarthyaṃ yogibhiḥ upalabhyate ca ato'pi nādarśanavirodha ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: dṛśyate ca iti asya arthaḥ abhimāni devatāyām sāmarthyam yogibhiḥ upalabhyate ca atas api na adarśana virodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca sāmarthyaviśeṣasadbhāvena vacanānāmupapatteḥ| viśeṣe mahaddarśanasya pramāṇātvāt| pṛthivyādyabhimāninya iti smṛteḥ| ato yuktyavirodhādvedena bhagavajjagatkartṛtvasādhanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sāmarthya viśeṣa sadbhāvena vacanānām upapatteḥ viśeṣe mahat darśanasya pṛthivī ādi abhimāninyaḥ iti smṛteḥ atas yukti avirodhāt vedena bhagavat jagat kartṛ tva sādhanam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti abhimānyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti abhimāni adhikaraṇam

original: atra brahmaṇo jagatkartṛtve śrutyupasarjanaprāgabhāvakartṛkatvasādhakayuktivirodho nirasyate|
analyzed: atra brahmaṇaḥ jagat kartṛ tve śruti upasarjana prāgabhāva kartṛkatva sādhaka yukti virodhaḥ nirasyate

original: || asaditi cenna pratiṣedhamātratvāt || ||
analyzed: asat iti ced na pratiṣedha mātra tvāt

original: nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca yato vetyādiśrutiḥ pramāṇamiti vācyaṃ| brahma na jagatkāraṇaṃ| tatpūrvamasattvāt| yadyayataḥ pūrvaṃ nāsti na tasya kāraṇamiti yuktiviruddhatvena śruteḥ pratītārthe prāmāṇyāyogāt| na cāsiddho hetuḥ| asadevedamagra iti śrutisiddhatvāt|
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam pramāṇa abhāvāt na ca yatas vā ityādi śrutiḥ pramāṇam iti vācyam brahma na jagat kāraṇam tat pūrvam asattvāt yadi ayataḥ pūrvam na asti na tasya kāraṇam iti yukti viruddha tvena śruteḥ pratīta arthe prāmāṇya ayogāt na ca asiddhaḥ hetuḥ asat eva idam agre iti śruti siddha tvāt

original: na ca brahmaṇo'kāraṇatve niṣkāraṇaṃ jagadāpadyata iti vācyaṃ| asataḥ sadajāyateti śrutibalenābhāvasyaiva kāraṇatvena grāhyatvāt| na ca brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatva ivābhāvasya kāraṇatvāṃgīkāre yuktivirodho'sti| pratyutābha vasya jagatkāraṇatve pralayakālīnaṃ kāraṇamasadbhavitumarhati vastutvātkāryavadityanumānaṃ cāsti|
analyzed: na ca brahmaṇaḥ ukāraṇa tve niṣkāraṇam jagat āpadyate iti vācyam asataḥ sat ajāyata iti śruti balena abhāvasya eva kāraṇa tvena grāhya tvāt na ca brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇa tve iva abhāvasya kāraṇa tva aṃgīkāre yukti virodhaḥ usti pratyuta ābhavasya jagat kāraṇa tve pralaya kālīnam kāraṇam asat bhavitum arhati vastu tvāt kārya vat iti anumānam ca asti

original: ato'bhāvasyaiva jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na brahmaṇa ityayuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte nirākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: atobhāvasya eva jagat kāraṇatvam na brahmaṇaḥ iti ayuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti prāpte nirākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || asaditi cenna pratiṣedhamātratvāditi || asyārthaḥ || asat viśvaprāgabhāva eva| jagatkartṛ neśvara iti cenna| kutaḥ| pratiṣedhamātratvāt abhāvadharmātmatāmaṃtareṇa svarūpata eva niṣedhabuddhiviṣayatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: asat iti ced na pratiṣedha mātra tvāt iti asya arthaḥ asat viśva prāgabhāvaḥ eva jagat kartṛ na īśvaraḥ iti ced na kutas pratiṣedha mātra tvāt abhāva dharma ātmatām aṃtareṇa svarūpataḥ eva niṣedha buddhi viṣaya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ na tvasataḥ| tasya kāraṇaṃ neti kāraṇatāpratiṣedhabuddhiviṣayatvāt| ato yuktvayāderābhāsakatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam na tu asataḥ tasya kāraṇam na iti kāraṇatā pratiṣedha buddhi viṣaya tvāt atas yuktvayā ādeḥ ābhāsaka tvena avirodhaka tvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || apītau tadvatprasaṃgādasamaṃjasaṃ || ||
analyzed: apītau tadvat prasaṃgāt asamaṃjasam

original: nanu yaduktaṃ pratiṣedhamātratvāditi yuktiviradhānnāsataḥ kāraṇatvamiti na tadyuktaṃ| yuktiviruddhasyāpi śrutibalātkasyacidabhāvasya kartṛtvābhyupagame bādhakābhāvāt| na caivaṃ ghaṭaprāgabhavadīnāmapi kartṛtvaprasaṃga iti vācyaṃ|
analyzed: nanu yat uktam pratiṣedha mātra tvāt iti yukti viradhāt na asataḥ kāraṇatvam iti na tat yuktam yukti viruddhasya api śruti balāt kasyacid abhāvasya kartṛ tva abhyupagame bādhaka abhāvāt na ca evam ghaṭa prāgabhava dīnām api kartṛ tva prasaṃgaḥ iti vācyam

original: bhāveṣu kasyacitkartṛtvaṃ kasyacidakartṛtvamiti vailakṣaṇyavadabhāveṣvapi ghaṭaprāgabhāvaderakartṛtvaṃ viśvaprāgabhāvatsya cāsadevetyādi śrutibalākartṛtvamiti vailakṣaṇyopapatteriti prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: bhāveṣu kasyacid kartṛ tvam kasyacid akartṛ tvam iti vailakṣaṇya vat abhāveṣu api ghaṭa prāgabhāva deḥ akartṛ tvam ca asat eva ityādi śruti bala akartṛ tvam iti vailakṣaṇya upapatteḥ iti prāpte samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || || apītau tadvatprasaṃgādasamaṃjasamiti || asyārthaḥ || apītau pralaye| tadvatprasaṃgāt āsanmātratvaprasaṃgāt| asatkartṛtvaṃ| asamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: apītau tadvat prasaṃgāt asamaṃjasam iti asya arthaḥ apītau pralaye tadvat prasaṃgāt āsat mātra tva prasaṃgāt asat kartṛ tvam asamaṃjasam ayuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca pralaye sarvasya bhāvamātrasyāsatve'sanmātrāvaśeṣaḥ syāt| kāryanāśe kāraṇamātrāvaseṣaniyamāt| tathā ca kālo'pi na syādityatiprasaṃgasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca pralaye sarvasya bhāva mātrasya asatve sat mātra avaśeṣaḥ syāt kārya nāśe kāraṇa mātra avaseṣa niyamāt tathā ca kālaḥ api na syāt iti atiprasaṃgasya vaktum śakya tvāt atas virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || na tu dṛṣṭāṃtabhāvāt || ||
analyzed: na tu dṛṣṭāṃta bhāvāt

original: nanvasmābhirapi pralaye'sanmātrāvaśeṣasyābhilaṣitatvānnāniṣṭāpādanametadityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu asmābhiḥ api pralaye sat mātra avaśeṣasya abhilaṣita tvāt na aniṣṭa āpādanam etat iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || na tu dṛṣṭāṃtabhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| pralaye sarvāsatvaṃ na yujyate| kutaḥ| tadā sarvapadārthasattva eva dṛṣṭāṃtasya bhāvāt| sadbhāvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na tu dṛṣṭāṃta bhāvāt iti asya arthaḥ tuśabdaḥ avadhāraṇe pralaye sarva asattvam na yujyate kutas tadā sarva padārtha sattve eva dṛṣṭāṃtasya bhāvāt sadbhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca vipratipannotpattiḥ sato bhavitumarhati utpattimattvāt| ghaṭotpattivat vimato vināśaḥ saśeṣaḥ| vināśatvāt ghaṭanāśavat| ityanumānābhyāṃ pralayakālagatasya sattvasidhyā tadanaṃgīkārasya prāmāṇikahānarūpatvenāniṣṭāpādanarūpatvāt| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca vipratipanna utpattiḥ sataḥ bhavitum arhati utpattimat tvāt ghaṭa utpatti vat vimataḥ vināśaḥ saśeṣaḥ vināśa tvāt ghaṭa nāśa vat iti anumānābhyām pralaya kāla gatasya sattva sidhyā tad anaṃgīkārasya prāmāṇika hāna rūpa tvena aniṣṭa āpādana rūpa tvāt atas virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || svapakṣadoṣācca || ||
analyzed: sva pakṣa doṣāt ca

original: na kevalaṃ prāmāṇikaparityāgaprāptyā pralaye sarvāsatvamaniṣṭamapi tvaprāmāṇikatvāccetyarthapratipādaka sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: na kevalam prāmāṇika parityāga prāptyā pralaye sarva asatvam aniṣṭam api tu aprāmāṇika tvāt ca iti artha pratipādaka sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || svapakṣadoṣācceti || asyārthaḥ || svapakṣe pralaye sarvāsattvapakṣe| doṣāt dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvākhyadoṣācca na tatpakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sva pakṣa doṣāt ca iti asya arthaḥ sva pakṣe pralaye sarva asattva pakṣe doṣāt dṛṣṭāṃta abhāva ākhya doṣāt ca na tad pakṣaḥ yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca pralaye sarvāsattvamaprāmāṇikaṃ| tathāhi| pralaye sthitānāṃ kālādināmasattvaṃ kiṃ pratyakṣavedyaṃ| utāgamavedyaṃ| āhosvidanumānavedyaṃ| nādyaḥ| asannikṛṣṭatvāt| na dvitīyaḥ| tadabhāvāt| nāpi tṛtīyaḥ| dṛṣṭāṃtādyabhāvāt| tathā ca pralaye sarvāsattvapakṣasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadabhyupagamasyāniṣṭatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca pralaye sarva asattvam aprāmāṇikam tathā hi pralaye sthitānām kāla ādīnām asattvam kim pratyakṣa vedyam uta āgama vedyam āhosvit anumāna vedyam na ādyaḥ asat nikṛṣṭa tvāt na dvitīyaḥ tad abhāvāt na api tṛtīyaḥ dṛṣṭāṃta ādi abhāvāt tathā ca pralaye sarva asattva pakṣasya aprāmāṇika tvena tad abhyupagamasya aniṣṭa tvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || tarkāpratiṣṭhānādapyanyathānumeyamiti cedevamapyanirmokṣaprasaṃgaḥ || ||
analyzed: tarka apratiṣṭhānāt api anyathā anumeyam iti ced evam api anirmokṣa prasaṃgaḥ

original: nanvayaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ siddhāṃtaścānupapannaḥ| etāvāneva tarka iti pratiṣṭhāpakapramāṇābhāvenoktādanyathā'pyanumātuṃ śakyatvāditi sadasatoḥ kāraṇatvasādhanabādhanetyākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu ayam pūrvapakṣaḥ siddhāṃtaḥ ca anupapannaḥ etāvān eva tarkaḥ iti pratiṣṭhāpaka pramāṇa abhāvena uktāt anyathā api anumātum śakya tvāt iti sat asatoḥ kāraṇatva sādhana bādhanā iti ākṣipya samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || || tarkāpratiṣṭhānādapyanyathānumeyamiti cedevamapyanirmokṣaprasaṃga iti || asyārthaḥ tarkāpratiṣṭhānāt| dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvādirūpatarkasya apratiṣṭhānāt avyavasthitatvāt| anyathā'pi siddhāṃtyuktiprakāradanyarūpeṇāpi| pratitarkeṇānumeyaṃ sādhanīyaṃ iti cet| neti śeṣaḥ| kutaḥ| evamapi evaṃ sati tarkamātrasyāprāmāṇye sati|
analyzed: tarka apratiṣṭhānāt api anyathā anumeyam iti ced evam api anirmokṣa prasaṃgaḥ iti asya arthaḥ tarka apratiṣṭhānāt dṛṣṭāṃta abhāva ādi rūpa tarkasya apratiṣṭhānāt avyavasthita tvāt anyathā api pratitarkeṇa anumeyam sādhanīyam iti ced na iti śeṣaḥ kutas evam api evam sati tarka mātrasya aprāmāṇye sati

original: anirmokṣaprasaṃgaḥ sarvasiddhātibhiḥ svasvaśāstraprayojanatvenāṃgīkṛtasyāpi mokṣasyāpi lopaprasaṃgaḥ| kutaḥ| tasya vipratipannaṃ prati anumānenaiva sādhanīyatayā tasyāpyevamaprāmāṇyoktisaṃbhavādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anirmokṣa prasaṃgaḥ sarva siddhātibhiḥ sva sva śāstra prayojana tvena aṃgīkṛtasya api mokṣasya api lopa prasaṃgaḥ kutas tasya vipratipannam prati anumānena eva sādhanīya tayā tasya api evam aprāmāṇya ukti saṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcātra vaktavyaṃ| kiṃ prāmāṇikaṃ tarkasiddhaṃ pratitarkeṇa dūṣayituṃ śakyaṃ| utāprāmāṇikaṃ| dvitīyastvabhimataḥ| ādyo'pi kimevaṃ vādino mate mokṣo'sti na veti| neti pakṣe'vāditvenopekṣaṇīyatvāt| siddhāṃtyabhimataprameyāvighātaka iti satkāraṇatvādikaṃ yathāsthitameva| ādye yadi tarko'prāmāṇaṃ syāttarhi mokṣa eva na sidhyet| tatsādhanopāyābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca atra vaktavyam kim prāmāṇikam tarka siddham pratitarkeṇa dūṣayitum śakyam uta aprāmāṇikam dvitīyaḥ tu abhimataḥ ādyaḥ api kim evam vādinaḥ mate mokṣaḥ usti na vā iti na iti pakṣevādi tvena upekṣaṇīya tvāt siddhāṃti abhimata prameya avighātakaḥ iti satkāraṇa tva ādikam yathāsthitam eva ādye yadi tarka uprāmāṇam syāt tarhi mokṣaḥ eva na sidhyet tad sādhana upāya abhāvāt

original: na cāgamena tatsiddhiḥ| mokṣamanabhyupagacchatā tatprāmāṇyānaṃgīkārāt| sadakāraṇatvāsatkāraṇatvasādhakatarkayoraprāmāṇikatvāttābhyāṃ niṣedhāyogāt| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca āgamena tad siddhiḥ mokṣam anabhyupagacchatā tad prāmāṇya anaṃgīkārāt sat akāraṇa tva asat kāraṇatva sādhaka tarkayoḥ aprāmāṇika tvāt tābhyām niṣedha ayogāt atas virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || etena śiṣṭā aparigrahā api vyākhyātāḥ || ||
analyzed: etena śiṣṭāḥ aparigrahāḥ api vyākhyātāḥ

original: nanu māstvasacchabditābhāvatattvaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ| tathā'pi na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvasaṃbhavaḥ| vipratipannaṃ jaganniṣkāraṇakaṃ, acetanakāraṇakaṃ, jīvakāraṇakaṃ, vā kāryatvāt kūlapatanadadhyādivaditi niṣkāraṇatvādisādhakayuktivirodhāt| na ca nirmūlayukterasādhakatvamiti vācyaṃ| akasmāditi śrutimūlatvādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu mā astu asat śabdita abhāva tattvam jagataḥ kāraṇam tathā api na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatva saṃbhavaḥ vipratipannam jagat niṣkāraṇakam acetana kāraṇakam jīva kāraṇakam vā kārya tvāt kūla patana dadhi ādi vat iti niṣkāraṇa tva ādi sādhaka yukti virodhāt na ca nirmūla yukteḥ asādhaka tvam iti vācyam akasmāt iti śruti mūla tvāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || etana śiṣṭā aparigrahā api vyākhyātā iti || asyārthaḥ || etena svaparapakṣayoḥ dṛṣṭāṃtabhāvābhāvākhyahetunā| aparigrahāḥ vedaparigrahaśūnyāḥ tadviruddhāśca| śiṣṭāḥ avaśiṣṭāḥ jīvakālasvabhāvakartṛtvapakṣā api| vyākhyātāḥ pratyākhyātā dūṣitāṃ ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: etana śiṣṭāḥ aparigrahāḥ api vyākhyātāḥ iti asya arthaḥ etena sva para pakṣayoḥ dṛṣṭāṃta bhāva abhāva ākhya hetunā aparigrahāḥ veda parigraha śūnyāḥ tad viruddhāḥ ca śiṣṭāḥ avaśiṣṭāḥ jīva kāla svabhāva kartṛ tva pakṣāḥ api vyākhyātāḥ pratyākhyātāḥ dūṣitāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dṛṣṭāṃtabhāvenābhāvena ca vedaviruddhānāmakāraṇatvācetanakartṛkatvamāyibrahmakartṛkatvakālasvabhāvakāraṇatva siddhāṃtānāṃ nirastatvāt| akasmāddhīdaṃ, pradhānādidamutpannaṃ, jīvādbhavaṃti bhūtāni, ityādiśrutīnāṃ viṣṇuparatvāt| ato yuktyāderābhāsatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca dṛṣṭāṃta bhāvena abhāvena ca veda viruddhānām akāraṇa tva acetana kartṛkatva māyi brahma kartṛkatva kāla svabhāva kāraṇatva siddhāṃtānām nirasta tvāt akasmāt hi idam pradhānāt idam utpannam jīvāt bhavaṃti bhūtāni ityādi śrutīnām viṣṇu paratvāt atas yukti ādeḥ ābhāsa tvena avirodhāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || iti asadadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti asat adhikaraṇam

original: atra bahuśrutisiddhatvena prabalayā dṛḍhayuktyā virodhaḥ parihriyate ||
analyzed: atra bahu śruti siddha tvena prabalayā dṛḍha yuktyā virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || bhotkrāpatteravibhāgaścetsyāllokavat || ||
analyzed: bhotkrā āpatteḥ avibhāgaḥ ced syāt loka vat

original: nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvādi yuktaṃ| tasya jīvābhinnatvāt| na hi jīvābhinnasya kartṛtvādyupapadyate| tasya jīvābhedaḥ kuta iti cet| pare'vyaye sarva ekībhavaṃtīti śruteḥ| ato jīvābhinnatvādīśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvādyanupapannamiti na lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatva ādi yuktam tasya jīva abhinna tvāt na hi jīva abhinnasya kartṛ tva ādi upapadyate tasya jīva abhedaḥ kutas iti ced parevyaye sarve ekībhavanti iti śruteḥ atas jīva abhinna tvāt īśvarasya jagat kāraṇatva ādi anupapannam iti na lakṣaṇa sūtram yuktam iti prāpte sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || bhoktrāpatteravibhāgaścetyāllokavaditi || asyārthaḥ || bhoktrāpatteḥ yasmādbhoktuḥ jīvasya pare'vyaye ekībhavaṃtīti vākye brahmabhāvāpatteḥ śravaṇāt| tayoravibhāgaḥ bhedābhāvaḥ| tasmādalpajīvābhinnabrahṇaḥ jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na yuktamiti cet| netiśeṣaḥ| kutaḥ|
analyzed: bhoktṛ āpatteḥ avibhāgaḥ cetyāt loka vat iti asya arthaḥ bhoktṛ āpatteḥ yasmāt bhoktuḥ jīvasya ekībhavanti iti vākye brahma bhāva āpattyāḥ śravaṇāt tayoḥ avibhāgaḥ bheda abhāvaḥ tasmāt alpa jīva abhinna brahṇaḥ jagat kāraṇatvam na yuktam iti ced na iti śeṣaḥ kutas

original: yataḥ lokavat yathā loke jale jalāṃtarasyaikībhāvoktistathā'trāpi sthānaikyādyālaṃbanena jīveśayoḥ ekībhavaṃtītyaikyoktiḥ syāt upacaritā bhavet| ato nokta doṣa ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yatas loka vat yathā loke jale jala aṃtarasya aikībhāva uktiḥ tathā atra api sthāna aikya ādi ālaṃbanena jīva īśayoḥ ekībhavanti iti aikya uktiḥ syāt upacaritā bhavet atas na ukta doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jīveśvarayorabhedābhāvānneśvarasya viruddhaṃ jagatkāraṇatvādikaṃ| na ca pare'vyaye sarva iti śruteḥ kathamaikyābhāva iti| niraṃjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaitīti saṃnahitavākyavirodhena śrutestatra tātparyābhāvāt| kā gatistarhyabhedaśruteriti cet| sthānaikyādyālaṃbanatvena jalaikībhāvāṃktivadupacaritatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca jīva īśvarayoḥ abheda abhāvāt na īśvarasya viruddham jagat kāraṇatva ādikam na ca parevyaye sarve iti śruteḥ katham aikya abhāvaḥ iti niraṃjanaḥ paramam sāmyam upaiti iti saṃnahita vākya virodhena śruteḥ tatra tātparya abhāvāt kā gatiḥ tarhi abheda śruteḥ iti ced sthāna aikya ādi ālaṃbana tvena jala ekībhāva aṃkti vat upacarita tva upapatteḥ

original: na ca mukteśvarayorbhedasamarthanasya phalādhyāyasaṃgatatvena naitatsūtrārtha iti| asyādhikaraṇasya phalādhyāyasaṃgatatve'pi na hyanyasyetyuktavirodhaparihārātmake pādeṃ'tarbhūtatvenātrāsyādhikaraṇasya viśeṣitatvāt| ato viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatve yuktivirodhābhāvenopapannaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca mukta īśvarayoḥ bheda samarthanasya phala adhyāya saṃgata tvena na etat sūtra arthaḥ iti asya adhikaraṇasya phala adhyāya saṃgata tve pi na hi anyasya iti ukta virodha parihāra ātmake viśeṣita tvāt atas viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatve yukti virodha abhāvena upapannam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || iti bhotkradhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti

original: atra viṣṇorjagatkartṛtve bahuyuktivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra viṣṇoḥ jagatkartṛ tve bahu yukti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || tadananyatvamāraṃbhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ || ||
analyzed: tad ananya tvam āraṃbhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ

original: nanu vipratipannāsṛṣṭiḥ svataṃtrabahusādhanasāpekṣā| sṛṣṭitvāt| ghaṭādisṛṣṭivat| tathā ceśvaraḥ svataṃtrasādhanasāpekṣyaiva sṛṣṭyādikarteti na tasya jagajjanmādikāraṇatvena sarvaguṇapūrṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu vipratipannā a sṛṣṭiḥ svataṃtra bahu sādhana sāpekṣā sṛṣṭi tvāt ghaṭa ādi sṛṣṭi vat tathā ca īśvaraḥ svataṃtra sādhana sāpekṣya eva sṛṣṭi ādi kartā iti na tasya jagat janma ādi kāraṇa tvena sarva guṇa pūrṇa tva siddhiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || tadananyatvamāraṃbhaṇaśabdādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || tadananyatvaṃ tasya svataṃtrakāraṇasya brahmābhinnatvaṃ vācyaṃ| kutaḥ| āraṃbhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ| āraṃbhaṇe phalopalakṣitakiṃsvidārsādityadhiṣṭhānādyākṣepavākyāt svātaṃtryādiyuktibhiścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tad ananyatvam āraṃbhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ tad ananyatvam tasya svataṃtra kāraṇasya brahma abhinna tvam vācyam kutas āraṃbhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ āraṃbhaṇe svātaṃtrya ādi yuktibhiḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nānumānabaleneśvarasṛṣṭeḥ svataṃtrabahusādhanasādhyatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyaṃ| kiṃ svidasīditi śrutyeśvaraḥ svataṃtrasādhanavidhuraḥ sādhanāṃtaramapahāya sraṣṭuṃ śaktatvāt| vyatirekeṇa kulālavat| tatheśvaraḥ svataṃtrasādhanaśūnyaḥ| svecchayopāttasādhanatvāt| yaḥ svataṃtrasādhanaśūnyo nāsau svecchayopāttasādhanaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca na anumāna balena īśvara sṛṣṭeḥ svataṃtra bahu sādhana sādhya tvam vaktum śakyam kim svid asīt iti śrutyā īśvaraḥ svataṃtra sādhana vidhuraḥ sādhana aṃtaram apahāya sraṣṭum śakta tvāt vyatirekeṇa kulāla vat tathā īśvaraḥ svataṃtra sādhana śūnyaḥ sva icchayā upātta sādhana tvāt yaḥ svataṃtra sādhana śūnyaḥ na asau sva icchayā upātta sādhanaḥ

original: kiṃtu vipakṣe kāryānutpattibhayopāttasādhanaḥ| yathā kulālastateśvaraḥ svataṃtrasādhanarahitaḥ sādhanasattāpradatvāt| vyatirekeṇa kulālavadityādiyuktimiśca viruddhatvāt| ato bhagavataḥ svātaṃtryeṇa sarvakartṛtve virodhagaṃdhābhāvādyuktaṃ tasya sarvaguṇapūrṇatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: kiṃtu vipakṣe kārya anutpatti bhaya upātta sādhanaḥ yathā kulālaḥ tata īśvaraḥ svataṃtra sādhana rahitaḥ sādhana sattā pradatvāt vyatirekeṇa kulāla vat ityādi yuktimiḥ ca viruddha tvāt atas bhagavataḥ svātaṃtryeṇa sarva kartṛ tve virodha gaṃdha abhāvāt yuktam tasya sarva guṇa pūrṇa tvam iti siddham

original: || bhāve copalabdheḥ || ||
analyzed: bhāve ca upalabdheḥ

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa svataṃtrasādhanaṃ pratikṣipatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa svataṃtra sādhanam pratikṣipat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || bhāve copalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ īśvarānyasvataṃtrasādhanasya| bhāve sattve| upalabdheḥ darśanasya| prasaṃga iti śeṣaḥ| ato'pi nāstyanayatsvataṃtrasādhanamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: bhāve ca upalabdheḥ iti asya arthaḥ yatas īśvara anya svataṃtra sādhanasya bhāve sattve upalabdheḥ darśanasya prasaṃgaḥ iti śeṣaḥ atas api na asti anayat svataṃtra sādhanam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yadīśvarātiriktaṃ svataṃtrasādhanaṃ syāttarhi vedādipramāṇairupalabhyeta| na copalabhyate| tasmānnāstīti bādhakatarkasadbhāvāt| nanu pramāṇānupalabdhamapi vastu kiṃ na syāditi cet| paṃcabhirvedairanuktamapi vastu nāsti| kutaḥ| pramāṇamātrāsiddhamastītyanuktaṃ paṃcabhiriti vacanāt| ato virodhābhāvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yadi īśvara atiriktam svataṃtra sādhanam syāt tarhi veda ādi pramāṇaiḥ upalabhyeta na ca upalabhyate tasmāt na asti iti bādhaka tarka sadbhāvāt nanu pramāṇa anupalabdham api vastu kim na syāt iti ced paṃcabhiḥ vedaiḥ anuktam api vastu nā asti kutas pramāṇa mātra asiddham asti iti anuktam paṃcabhiḥ iti vacanāt atas virodha abhāvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || sattvāccāvarasya || ||
analyzed: sattvāt ca avarasya

original: nanvad‌bhyaḥ saṃbhūta iti śrutau prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi yuge yuga iti smṛtau ca bhagavaditaraprakṛtyabādisvataṃtrasādhanasattvapratītestadanupalabdheriṣṭāpādanamiti prāpte sūtramavatārayati ||
analyzed: nanu adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ iti śrutau prakṛtim svām avaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi yuge yuge iti smṛtau ca bhagavat itara prakṛti ap ādi svataṃtra sādhana sattva pratīteḥ tad anupalabdheḥ iṣṭa āpādanam iti prāpte sūtram avatārayati

original: || || sattvāccāvarasyeti || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| avarasya asvataṃtrasāghanasya| sattvādeva adūbhyaḥ saṃbhūta iti vākyaṃ tatparaṃ bhavatīti na tadvirodha ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sattvāt ca avarasya iti asya arthaḥ avarasya asvataṃtra sāghanasya sattvāt eva saṃbhūtaḥ iti vākyam tad param bhavati iti na tad virodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāvarasyaiva sādhanasya sattvādeva śrutestadviṣayatvāt| tataśca yasyopalabdhirāpādyate na tasyopalabdhiḥ| yaccopalabhyate na tatsvataṃtrasādhanamitīṣṭāpādanābhāvāt| na cāsyāṃ śrutau sādhanāmātraṃ pratīyate na tu tasya bhagavadadhīnatvaṃ tacca lokānusārātsvataṃtrameva kiṃ na syāditi vācyaṃ| kāla āsīditi śruteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca avarasya eva sādhanasya sattvāt eva śruteḥ tad viṣayatvāt tatas ca yasya upalabdhiḥ āpādyate na tasya upalabdhiḥ yat ca upalabhyate na tat svataṃtra sādhanam iti iṣṭa āpādana abhāvāt na ca asyām śrutau sādhanā mātram pratīyate na tu tasya bhagavat adhīna tvam tat ca loka anusārāt svataṃtram eva kim na syāt iti vācyam kāle āsīt iti śruteḥ

original: prāgabhāvenotpattau siddhāyāṃ satyāṃ tadutpādakasyānyasyābhāvāddharereva jagatkartṛtvasya siddheḥ| tasmādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: prāgabhāvena utpattau siddhāyām satyām tad utpādakasya anyasya abhāvāt hareḥ eva jagat kartṛ tvasya siddheḥ tasmāt yuktam jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || asadvyapadeśānneti cenna dharmāṃtareṇa vākyaśeṣāt || ||
analyzed: asat vyapadeśāt na iti ced na dharma aṃtareṇa vākyaśeṣāt

original: || || devādivadapi loka iti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ bhūteśvarasyāpi devādivat adarśanaṃ yujyate| kathametadityata uktaṃ| loka iti| loke jagati piśācādīnāmapi adṛśyatvādiśaktirdṛṣṭā sarveśvarasya tu kiṃ vācyamityarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃca devādivadaṃtardhānaśaktyā pratyakṣeṇānupalabhyamānatvepyāgamenopalabhyamānatvāt| na ceśvarasya devādivadaṃtardhānaśaktimattvaṃ yuktaṃ| tasyā upāsanāsādhyatveneśvare tadabhāvāditi cet| tarhi piśācādīnāmapi tannasyāt| upāsanābhāvāt| atha pramāṇasiddhāṃ'tardhānaśaktiḥ piśācādīnāṃ hātumaśakyatvena kāraṇāṃtaraṃ kalpyate syāt| upāsanābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca deva ādi vat aṃtardhāna śaktyā pratyakṣeṇa anupalabhyamāna tve pi āgamena upalabhyamāna tvāt na ca īśvarasya deva ādi vat aṃtardhāna śaktimat tvam yuktam tasyāḥ upāsanā sādhya tvena īśvare tad abhāvāt iti ced tarhi piśāca ādīnām api tat na syāt upāsanā abhāvāt atha pramāṇa siddha aṃtardhāna śaktiḥ piśāca ādīnām hātum aśakya tvena kāraṇa aṃtaram kalpyate syāt upāsanā abhāvāt

original: atha pramāṇasiddhāṃ'tardhānaśaktiḥ piśācādīnāṃ hātumaśakyatvena kāraṇāṃrataṃ kalpyate tarhi yattadadreśyamiti pramāṇasiddhā sā na hātuṃ śakyeti nityā sā kalpyatāṃ| na yuktiyogāditi vacanena śrutismṛtirūpavākyānāṃ yuktilakṣaṇopāyātkvacidapi viṣaye'pramāṇatvenāsādhakatvena vā nirākaraṇāyogāt|
analyzed: atha pramāṇa siddha aṃtardhāna śaktiḥ piśāca ādīnām hātum aśakya tvena kāraṇa aṃratam kalpyate tarhi yat tat adreśyam iti pramāṇa siddhā sā na hātum śakyā iti nityā sā kalpyatām na yukti yogāt iti vacanena śruti smṛti rūpa vākyānām yukti lakṣaṇa upāyāt kvacid api viṣaye pramāṇa tvena asādhaka tvena vā nirākaraṇa ayogāt

original: teṣāṃ virodhe tāsāṃ yuktīnāmekavākyānusāriṇīnāmevārthasādhakatvaṃ natu śuṣkayuktīnāṃ| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: teṣām virodhe tāsām yuktīnām eka vākya anusāriṇīnām eva artha sādhaka tvam na tu śuṣka yuktīnām atas virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || kṛtsna prasaktirniravayavatvaśabdakopo vā || ||

original: || || kṛtsnaprasaktirniravayavatvaśabdakopo veti || asyārthaḥ || vā śabdaḥ pakṣabhedena doṣāpādanasūcakaḥ| jīvasya svataḥ kartṛtve sarvakārtsnyena pravartane cāṃgīkṛte kṛtsnaprasaktiḥ tṛṇādānādi sarvakāryeṣvapi sarvasāmarthyaprasaktiḥ prasaṃgaḥ|
analyzed: kṛtsna prasaktiḥ niravayava tva śabda kopaḥ vā iti asya arthaḥ vā śabdaḥ pakṣa bhedena doṣa āpādana sūcakaḥ jīvasya svatas kartṛ tve sarva kārtsnyena pravartane ca aṃgīkṛte kṛtsna prasaktiḥ tṛṇa ādāna ādi sarva kāryeṣu api sarva sāmarthya prasaktiḥ prasaṃgaḥ

original: tatparihārāya ekadeśena pravṛtyabhyupagame ca niravayavatvaśabdakopaḥ nityo niravayava iti śrutivirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tad parihārāya eka deśena pravṛti abhyupagame ca niravayava tva śabda kopaḥ nityaḥ niravayavaḥ iti śruti virodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jīvasya svataṃtrakartṛtve sa samāstyena sarvasvakāryakarteti kvacidaṃśena| ādye yadi jīvaḥ sāmastyena sarvasvakāryakartā syātsāmastyena tṛṇādānādāvapi kartā syāditi tarkavirodhaḥ| dvitīye yadi jīrvo'śena svakāryakartā syāttarhi niravayavapratipādakaśrutyaprāmāṇyaṃ syāditi tarkavirodhaḥ|
analyzed: evaṃca jīvasya svataṃtra kartṛ tve sa sarva sva kārya kartā iti kvacid aṃśena ādye yadi jīvaḥ sāmastyena sarva sva kārya kartā syāt sāmastyena tṛṇa ādāna ādau api kartā syāt iti tarka virodhaḥ dvitīye yadi sva kārya kartā syāt tarhi niravayava pratipādaka śruti aprāmāṇyam syāt iti tarka virodhaḥ

original: tathā ca kartatvaṃ sāmastyenāṃśena pravṛttirvyāpyamiti jīvasya svātaṃtryāṃgīkāre vyāpakībhūtapravṛtyayogātkartṛtvameva na syāditisvātaṃtryaṃ tyājyaṃ| nanu najīvasya svataḥ kartṛtve'pi doṣāvakāśaḥ| tasyopādhikṛtāṃśavattvena kṛtsnaprasaktyayogāt| svābhāvikāṃśābhāvena śrutivirodhābhāvāditi cet| kiṃ jīvaḥ sarvopyupahitastadaṃśo veti praṣṭavyaṃ ||

original: nādyaḥ| sarvajīvasyopahitatve sarvasya grastatvenāṃśasyopādhikatvāyogāt| dvitīye nopādhikatvaṃ| upādhisaṃbaṃdhātprāgapyaṃśasya vaktavyatvāt| tasyāpyupādhyaṃtarakṛtatve'navasthānāt| nanu jīvasya kartṛtvaṃ yuktiviruddhatvādavicāraramaṇīyā'vidyānimittamastviti cenna| avidyānimittatvasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| yaddhi yuktyā viruddhateti pramāṇiviruddhatvācca|

original: nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa jagatkartatvaṃ yuktaṃ| yadīśvaraḥ kartā syāttarhi kārtsnenāṃśena vā pravṛttimāṃtsyāt| na ca tadīśvare saṃbhavatīti tarkabādhitatvāt| na cāyaṃ doṣaḥ| jīvakartṛtvāṃgīkāra eva neśvarakartṛtvāṃgīkāra iti vācyaṃ| doṣanirāsopayuktāyāḥ prakārāṃtareṇa pravṛtterīśvare'bhāvāt| anyathājīve'pi sa doṣo na syāt|

original: || || śrutestu śabdamūlatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || īśvarakartṛtvapakṣe tu kṛtsnaprasaktirityādinā jīvakartṛtvapakṣoktayuktivirodhadoṣo nāsti| kutaḥ| śrutestu yo'sau viruddha iti śrutereva| nanvetāvatā kathaṃ yuktivirodha śāṃtirityata uktaṃ| śabdamūlatvāditi| īśvarataddharmāṇāṃ śabdaikapramāṇavattve yuktyaviṣayatvāt| na tatra yuktivirodhaḥ pravartate|
analyzed: śruteḥ tu śabda mūla tvāt iti asya arthaḥ īśvara kartṛ tva pakṣe tu kṛtsna prasaktiḥ ityādinā jīva kartṛ tva pakṣa ukta yukti virodha doṣaḥ na asti kutas śruteḥ tu yaḥ asau viruddhaḥ iti śruteḥ eva nanu etāvatā katham yukti virodha śāṃtiḥ iti atas uktam śabda mūla tvāt iti īśvara tad dharmāṇām śabda eka pramāṇavat tve yukti aviṣaya tvāt na tatra yukti virodhaḥ pravartate

original: jīve tu na tathā| tasya pramāṇāṃtareṇāpi gamyatvādityarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃca neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtve yuktivirodhaḥ| virodhayukterdharmigrāhakāgamopajīvyatvena tadbodhana yukterevāpramāṇyāt| kiṃceśvarasyāciṃtyāśaktiyuktatvāttadvalenāṃśatvepyaṃśakāryakāritopapannā| yo'sau viruddha iti śrutau lokaviruddhadharmāṇāmīśvare'viruddhatayā'vasthānatvokteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca na īśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛ tve yukti virodhaḥ virodha yukteḥ dharmi grāhaka āgama upajīvya tvena tad bodhana yukteḥ eva apramāṇyāt kiṃca īśvarasya aciṃtya aśakti yuktatvāt tad valena aṃśa tve pi aṃśa kārya kāri tā upapannā yaḥ asau viruddhaḥ iti śrutau loka viruddha dharmāṇām īśvare viruddha tayā avasthāna tva ukteḥ

original: yuktivirodhaparihāropayoginaḥ śabdaikasamādhigamyatvasyeśvare sattvādaviśeṣāsiddheḥ| śuṣkānumayā''gamoktaprameyasya niṣedhāyogāt| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: yukti virodha parihāra upayoginaḥ śabda eka samādhi gamya tvasya īśvare sattvāt aviśeṣa asiddheḥ śuṣka anumaya āgama ukta prameyasya niṣedha ayogāt atas virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || || ātmani evaṃ vicitrāśca hīti || asyārthaḥ || ādyaśca śabdo'vadhāraṇe| dvitīyaḥ samuccaye| hi śabdaḥ prasiddhau| tathāca hi śabdāt ātmani īśvara eva| evaṃ sakalayuktivirodhanirāsakāḥ vicitrāḥ aciṃtyāḥ vicitraśaktiriti śrutiprasiddhāḥ śaktayaḥ saṃti na jīve| tasmācca jīvapakṣa eva yuktivirodhaḥ neśvarapakṣa ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ātmani evam vicitrāḥ ca hi iti asya arthaḥ ādyaḥ ca śabdaḥ avadhāraṇe dvitīyaḥ samuccaye hi śabdaḥ prasiddhau tathā ca hi śabdāt ātmani īśvare eva evam sakala yukti virodha nirāsakāḥ vicitrāḥ aciṃtyāḥ vicitra śaktiḥ iti śruti prasiddhāḥ śaktayaḥ saṃti na jīve tasmāt ca jīva pakṣe eva yukti virodhaḥ na īśvara pakṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca vicitraśaktīnamīśvara eva satvādanyeṣāṃ tadabhāvāt| eko vaśīti śruteḥ| śaktervicitratvaṃ tu bhinnāvayavaśūnyānāṃ jīvānāmīsvarasya caikadeśena pravṛttyādirūpādhaṭitavicitrakāryakāritvamiti vivekāt| ato yuktivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca īśvaraḥ eva satvāt anyeṣām tad abhāvāt ekaḥ vaśī iti śruteḥ śakteḥ vicitra tvam tu bhinna avayava śūnyānām jīvānām īsvarasya ca eka deśena pravṛtti ādi rūpa a dhaṭita vicitra kārya kāri tvam iti vivekāt atas yukti virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham
