analyzed: sva pakṣa doṣāt ca

original: nanu viṣṇoḥ śabdamūlatvena vicitraśaktitvena ca yuktivirodhasyādoṣatvavajīve'pi tathā bhavet| cetanatvādiliṃgena yuktivirodhasyāvirodhatāsādhanasaṃbhavāditi prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu viṣṇoḥ śabda mūla tvena vicitra śakti tvena ca tathā bhavet cetana tva ādi liṃgena yukti virodhasya avirodha tā sādhana saṃbhavāt iti prāpte samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || || svapakṣadoṣācceti || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| tathāca ye doṣā iti śrutau jīvapakṣe yuktivirodhasya doṣasyaivokteḥ nāsāvadoṣatāṃ netavyaḥ| kiṃtu īśvarapakṣa eva adoṣatāṃ netavya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sva pakṣa doṣāt ca iti asya arthaḥ tathā ca ye doṣāḥ iti śrutau jīva pakṣe yukti virodhasya doṣasya eva ukteḥ na asau adoṣatām netavyaḥ kiṃtu īśvara pakṣaḥ eva adoṣatām netavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jīvasyāpi svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ vaktumaśakyaṃ| tasya doṣitvenaṃ kalpakābhāvena taddoṣasyādoṣatayā netumaśakyatvāt| atha yaḥ saḥ doṣa iti śruteḥ| kṛtsnaprasaktyādiyuktivirodhasya jīvapakṣe doṣasyaivoktatvāt| jīveśayoḥ sadoṣatvanirdoṣatvavacanavirodhākhyadoṣasadbhāvāt| tataśca virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jīvasya api svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛ tvam vaktum aśakyam tasya doṣi tvena kalpaka abhāvena tad doṣasya adoṣatayā netum aśakya tvāt atha yaḥ saḥ doṣaḥ iti śruteḥ kṛtsna prasakti ādi yukti virodhasya jīva pakṣe doṣasya eva ukta tvāt jīva īśayoḥ sa doṣatva nirdoṣatva vacana virodha ākhya doṣa sadbhāvāt tatas ca virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || sarvopetā ta taddarśanāt || ||
analyzed: sarva upetā tad tad darśanāt

original: nanu vicitraśaktibalānneśvare virodha iti yuktaṃ| sā śaktiryadviṣayiṇī na bhavati yadā ca naśyati tadā tatra doṣāvaśaṃbhāvaniyamānna tayā tatparihāro yukta ityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu vicitra śakti balāt na īśvare virodhaḥ iti yuktam sā śaktiḥ yad viṣayiṇī na bhavati yadā ca naśyati tadā tatra doṣa avaśaṃbhāva niyamāt na tayā tad parihāraḥ yuktaḥ iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || sarvopetā ca taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ paramātmākhyadevatā na kevalaṃ sāmānyato vicitraśaktimatī kiṃtu sarvopetā sarvaviṣayasārvakālikaśaktimatī ca| kutaḥ| taddarśanāt sarvairyukteti tathā śruteḥ| ato neśvare yuktivirodhaḥ śaṃkanīya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sarva upetā ca tad darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ yatas paramātma ākhya devatā na kevalam sāmānyatas vicitra śaktimatī kiṃtu sarva upetā sarva viṣaya sārvakālika śaktimatī ca kutas tad darśanāt sarvaiḥ yuktā iti tathā śruteḥ atas na īśvare yukti virodhaḥ śaṃkanīyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃceśasya sadā sarvaviṣaye vicitraktitvāt| sarvairyuktā śaktibhiriti śrutau paramātmaśaktiḥ sarvadā sarvaviṣayiṇī sarvakālā ceti tasya sarvaśaktimattvenoktatvāttathā śaktyā yuktivirodhaparihāraucityāt| ato yuktivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca īśasya sadā sarva viṣaye vicitra kti tvāt sarvaiḥ yuktā śaktibhiḥ iti śrutau paramātma śaktiḥ sarvadā sarva viṣayiṇī sarva kālā ca iti tasya sarva śaktimat tvena ukta tvāt tathā śaktyāḥ yukti virodha parihāra aucityāt atas yukti virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || vikaraṇatvānneti cettaduktaṃ || ||
analyzed: vikaraṇa tvāt na iti ced tat uktam

original: nanvathāpi vikaraṇatvānneśvarasya jagatkartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| api ca sarvopeteti sūtra eva vicitrāśeṣaśaktivalena nikhilavirodhānāṃ parihṛtatvācchaṃkānavakāśātprakṛtasūtravaiyarthyamityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu atha api vikaraṇa tvāt na īśvarasya jagatkartṛ tvam yuktam api ca sarvopetā iti sūtre eva vicitra aśeṣa śakti valena nikhila virodhānām parihṛta tvāt śaṃkā anavakāśāt prakṛta sūtra vaiyarthyam iti ākṣipya samādadhat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || vikaraṇatvānneti cettaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || netyāvartate| virakaṇatvāt apāṇipādamiti śrutyā īśvarasya hastādīṃdriyaśūnyatvāvagamāt| neticet īśvarasya kartṛtvaṃ na yuktamiti cenna| kutaḥ| yasmāt taduktaṃ| tasminna tasyetyādyāgamena tatkaraṇarāhityasya prākṛteṃdriyaviṣayatvamuktaṃ| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vikaraṇa tvāt na iti ced tat uktam iti asya arthaḥ na iti āvartate virakaṇa tvāt apāṇi pādam iti śrutyā īśvarasya hasta ādi iṃdriya śūnyatva avagamāt na iti ced īśvarasya kartṛ tvam na yuktam iti ced na kutas yasmāt tat uktam tasmin na tasya ityādi āgamena tad karaṇa rāhityasya prākṛta iṃdriya viṣayatvam uktam tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāpāṇipāda iti śrutau pāṇyādirahitasyāpi harergrahakādikamuktvā na tasyā kāryamityādinā pāṇyādirahitatvasya prākṛtaviṣayatvena sarvottamatvena paramaśaktitvena copapāditatvāt| paroktahetoraprayojakatvādasiddheśca|
analyzed: evam ca apāṇi pādaḥ iti śrutau pāṇi ādi rahitasya api hareḥ grahaka ādikam uktvā na kāryam ityādinā pāṇi ādi rahita tvasya prākṛta viṣaya tvena sarva uttama tvena paramaśakti tvena ca upapādita tvāt para ukta hetoḥ aprayojaka tvāt asiddheḥ ca

original: api ca sādhāraṇyena sarvavirodhānāṃ parihāre kṛte'pi viśeṣato'syaiva codyasya parihārānukūlayuktibodhanecchayā punaḥ śaṃkāyā darśitatvena sūtravaiyarthyābhāvāt| ato viṣṇorjagatkatṛtve yuktivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: api ca sādhāraṇyena sarva virodhānām parihāre kṛte api viśeṣataḥ usya eva codyasya parihāra anukūla yukti bodhana icchayā punar śaṃkāyāḥ darśita tvena sūtra vaiyarthya abhāvāt atas viṣṇoḥ jagat katṛ tve yukti virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || iti śrutestu śabdamūlatvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti śruteḥ tu śabda mūla tva adhikaraṇam

original: atreśvarasya jagatkartṛtve niṣphalattvādiyuktivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra īśvarasya jagatkartṛ tve niṣphalat tva ādi yukti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || na prayojanavakttvāt || ||
analyzed: na prayojana vat tvāt

original: nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarvasarjakatvādi yuktaṃ| atra kiṃ viṣṇuḥ prayojanoddeśena sṛṣṭhyādikaṃ karotītyucyate tadanuddeśeneti vā| ādye'pūrṇatvāt| dvitīye pravṛtterevāyogena sarvakartṛtvasya sutarāmayogāt| vidhāṃtarasya cābhāve'nupapannameva sarvakartṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarva sarjaka tva ādi yuktam atra kim viṣṇuḥ prayojana uddeśena sṛṣṭhi ādikam karoti iti ucyate tad anuddeśena iti vā ādye pūrṇa tvāt dvitīye pravṛtteḥ eva ayogena sarva kartṛ tvasya sutarām ayogāt vidha aṃtarasya ca abhāvena upapannam eva sarva kartṛ tvam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || na prayojanavatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || īśvarasya sṛṣṭyādau pravṛttirna svaprayojanoddeśena| kutaḥ| prayojanavatvāt pūrṇānaṃdatvena prāptaprāptavyatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na prayojanavat tvāt iti asya arthaḥ īśvarasya sṛṣṭi ādau pravṛttiḥ na sva prayojana uddeśena kutas prayojanavatvāt pūrṇa ānaṃda tvena prāpta prāptavya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvakartṛtvaṃ| tasya pūrṇānaṃdatvena prāptaprāptavyatayā phaloddeśena pravṛttyanaṃgīkārāt| athaiṣa eva parameti śruteḥ| tathā cāptakāmatvena dayāsādhyaphalābhāvena paraprayojanārthamapi tasya sṛṣṭyādipravṛttyayogāt| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ sarva kartṛ tvam tasya pūrṇānaṃda tvena prāpta prāptavya tayā phala uddeśena pravṛtti anaṃgīkārāt atha eṣaḥ eva paramā iti śruteḥ tathā ca āpta kāma tvena dayā sādhya phala abhāvena para prayojana artham api tasya sṛṣṭi ādi pravṛtti ayogāt atas virodha abhāvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || lokavattu līlākaivalyaṃ || ||
analyzed: loka vat tu līlā kaivalyam

original: nanuneśvaraḥ phalānuddeśena pravṛttimān cetanatvāt yajñadattavadityupapattivirodhātkathamaśvirasya phalānuddeśena pravṛttirityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu nā īśvaraḥ phala anuddeśena pravṛttimān cetana tvāt yajñadatta vat iti upapatti virodhāt katham aśviḥ asya phala anuddeśena pravṛttiḥ iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || lokavattu līlākaivalyamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| lokavat loke mattādipravṛttiriveśvarapravṛtteḥ| līlākaivalyaṃ kevalalīlārūpatvameva na svaprayojanoddeśyatvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: loka vat tu līlā kaivalyam iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ eva arthe loka vat loke matta ādi pravṛttiḥ iva īśvara pravṛtteḥ līlā kaivalyam kevala līlā rūpatvam eva na sva prayojana uddeśya tvam iti arthaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ phalānuddeśena pravṛtteranupapattiriti cenna| lokavallīlayaiva pravṛttyupapatteḥ| na hi līlā prayojanāṃtarāya bhavati| mattasya nṛttagānādilīlāyāḥ prayojanābhāve'pi darśanāt| pūrvapakṣyuktānumānasyonmattādau vyabhicārāt| vyākhyānādikāle hastacālanādāviva prayojanavattvarāhityāt| īśvarapravṛtterlokānugrahārthatvāṃgīkārāt|
analyzed: nanu evam phala anuddeśena pravṛtteḥ anupapattiḥ iti ced na loka vat līlayā eva pravṛtti upapatteḥ na hi līlā prayojana aṃtarāya bhavati mattasya nṛtta gāna ādi līlāyāḥ prayojana abhāve pi darśanāt pūrvapakṣi ukta anumānasya unmatta ādau vyabhicārāt vyākhyāna ādi kāle hasta cālana ādau iva prayojanavat tva rāhityāt īśvara pravṛtteḥ loka anugraha artha tva aṃgīkārāt

original: ato virodhābhāvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas virodha abhāvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || iti na prayojanādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na prayojana adhikaraṇam

original: atra pūrvokta paraprayojanarūpaphalaviṣayayuktivirodhaḥ parihriyate ||
analyzed: atra pūrvokta para prayojana rūpa phala viṣaya yukti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāttathā hi darśayati || ||
analyzed: vaiṣamya nairghṛṇye na sāpekṣa tvāt tathā hi darśayati

original: nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarvakartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| vaiṣamyādidoṣavattvāt| atra pṛṣṭavyaṃ| īśvaraḥ suranaratiryagādinānāyoniṣu prāṇino janayitvā teṣāṃ vibhāgena yatsukhaduḥkhe dadati tatkiṃ teṣāṃ karmānusāreṇa| uta tannairapekṣyeṇa| ādye'svātaṃtryāpātāt| niyamena karmasāpekṣasyāsvātaṃtryaniyamāt| dvitīyetu vaiṣamyanaighṛṇye prāpnutaḥ|
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarva kartṛ tvam yuktam vaiṣamya ādi doṣavat tvāt atra pṛṣṭavyam īśvaraḥ sura nara tiryak ādi nānā yoniṣu prāṇinaḥ janayitvā teṣām vibhāgena yat sukha duḥkhe dadati tat kim teṣām karma anusāreṇa uta tad nairapekṣyeṇa ādye svātaṃtrya āpātāt niyamena karma sāpekṣasya asvātaṃtrya niyamāt dvitīye tu vaiṣamya naighṛṇye prāpnutaḥ

original: nirnimitta vibhāgena sukhaduḥkhadātṛtvāt| kiṃca neśvarasya kartṛtve mānaṃ| mānatvenābhimatasya vedasya jyotiṣṭomādipratipādakavedavadamānatvāt| jyotiṣṭomādivedāmānatvaṃ tu sukhaduḥkhasādhanatvena taduktānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ nairapekṣyeṇaiveśvareṇa sukhādipradatvāsiddhaṃ| ato hareḥ sarvakartṛtvāyogānna lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nirnimitta vibhāgena sukha duḥkha dātṛ tvāt kiṃca na īśvarasya kartṛ tve mānam māna tvena abhimatasya vedasya jyotiṣṭoma ādi pratipādaka veda vat amānatvāt jyotiṣṭoma ādi veda amānatvam tu sukha duḥkha sādhanatvena tad uktānām dharma ādīnām nairapekṣyeṇa eva īśvareṇa sukha ādi pradatva asiddham atas hareḥ sarva kartṛ tva ayogān na lakṣaṇa sūtram iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāttathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || svātaṃtryasidhyarthamīśvarasya jīvebhyaḥ phaladāne karmāpekṣāṃgīkāre nirnimittaṃ vaiṣamyeṇa phaladātustasya vaiṣamyanairdhṛṇye viṣamatvānirdayatve ye prasakte te nastaḥ| kutaḥ| sāpekṣatvāt īśvarasya karmāpekṣāvattvābhyupagamāt| tatkutaḥ|
analyzed: vaiṣamya nairghṛṇye na sāpekṣa tvāt tathā hi darśayati iti asya arthaḥ svātaṃtrya sidhi artham īśvarasya jīvebhyaḥ phala dāne karma apekṣā aṃgīkāre nirnimittam vaiṣamyeṇa phala dātuḥ tasya vaiṣamya nairdhṛṇye viṣama tva anirdaya tve ye prasakte te naḥ tasmāt kutas sāpekṣa tvāt īśvarasya karma apekṣāvat tva abhyupagamāt tat kutas

original: hi yasmāt puṇyena puṇyamiti śrutiḥ tathā darśayati pratipādayati| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: hi yasmāt puṇyena puṇyam iti śrutiḥ tathā darśayati pratipādayati tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatsraṣṭṛtvādikaṃ| tattatkarmānusāreṇa phaladātṛtvāṃgīkāreṇa veṣamyanairghṛṇyābhāvāt| ato lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ jagatsraṣṭṛ tva ādikam tad tad karma anusāreṇa phala dātṛ tva aṃgīkāreṇa veṣamya nairghṛṇya abhāvāt atas lakṣaṇa sūtram yuktam iti siddham

original: || na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāt || ||
analyzed: na karma avibhāgāt iti ced na anādi tvāt

original: nanvapekṣayā karmaṇo'bhāvānna tadapekṣayā vaiṣamyādidoṣaparihāraḥ saṃbhavati| na cāsti pūrvakarmeti vācyaṃ| eṣa hyeveti śrutau tasyāpi bhagavadadhīnatvaśravaṇāt| svakāritāpekṣayā phaladāne vaiṣamyāderanistārāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu apekṣayā karmaṇaḥ bhāvāt na tad apekṣayā vaiṣamya ādi doṣa parihāraḥ saṃbhavati na ca asti pūrva karma iti vācyam eṣa hi eva iti śrutau tasya api bhagavat adhīna tva śravaṇāt sva kāritā apekṣayā phala dāne vaiṣamya ādeḥ anistārāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāditi || asyārthaḥ || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyādidoṣaparihārāya īśenāpekṣaṇīyaṃ yatkarma tannāstīti viśiṣṭaniṣedhaḥ| kutaḥ| avibhāgāt tasya karmaṇaḥ asvataṃtra vastubhyaḥ avibhaktatvāt| asvataṃtratvāditi yāvat| tathā ca svādhīna karmāpekṣayā vaiṣamyāderaparihāra iti cenna| kutaḥ|
analyzed: na karma avibhāgāt iti ced na anādi tvāt iti asya arthaḥ vaiṣamya nairghṛṇya ādi doṣa parihārāya īśena apekṣaṇīyam yat karma tat na asti iti viśiṣṭa niṣedhaḥ kutas avibhāgāt tasya karmaṇaḥ asvataṃtra vastubhyaḥ avibhakta tvāt asvataṃtra tvāt iti yāvat tathā ca svādhīna karma apekṣayā vaiṣamya ādeḥ aparihāraḥ iti ced na kutas

original: anāditvāt karmaparaṃparāyāḥ anāditvādityarthaḥ| tathā ceśvaraḥ pūrvapūrvamapekṣyottarottarakarma jīvena kārayatītyaṃgīkāreṇa karmaṇaḥ apekṣaṇayitvāpatteḥ noktadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: anādi tvāt karma paraṃparāyāḥ anādi tvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca īśvaraḥ pūrva pūrvam apekṣya uttara uttara karma jīvena kārayati iti aṃgīkāreṇa karmaṇaḥ na ukta doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca bhavedayaṃ doṣaḥ| yadi pūrvatanaṃ karmeśvareṇa nirapekṣeṇa kāritaṃ syāt| na caivaṃ| kiṃ tarhi prācīnakarmānusāreṇa kāritaṃ| yatraiva paryavasānaṃ tadārabhya doṣa iti karmaparaṃparāyā anāditvāt| puṇyapāpādikamiti vacanāt| ato virodhābhāvenoktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca bhavet ayam doṣaḥ yadi pūrvatanam karma īśvareṇa nirapekṣeṇa kāritam syāt na ca evam kim tarhi prācīna karma anusāreṇa kāritam yatra eva paryavasānam tat ārabhya doṣaḥ iti karma paraṃparāyāḥ anādi tvāt puṇya pāpa ādikam iti vacanāt atas virodha abhāvena uktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || upapadyatecāpyupalabhyate ca || ||
analyzed: upapadyate ca api upalabhyate ca

original: nanvathā'pi neśvarasya karmāpekṣayā phaladātṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| asvātaṃtryaprasaṃgādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati|
analyzed: nanu atha api na īśvarasya karma apekṣayā phala dātṛ tvam yuktam asvātaṃtrya prasaṃgāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || upapadyate cāpyupalabhyate ceti || asyārthaḥ || īśvarasya karmāpekṣāyāmapyupapadyate svātaṃtryaṃ yujyata eva| karmaṇaḥ svādhīnatvāt| nanu punaḥ svādhīnakarmasāpekṣatvakṛtavaiṣamyāpāta ityata uktaṃ| upalabhyate ceti| sa kārayediti śrutyā tādṛśavaiṣamyaṃ adoṣatvena jñāyate cetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: upapadyate ca api upalabhyate ca iti asya arthaḥ īśvarasya karma apekṣāyām api upapadyate svātaṃtryam yujyate eva karmaṇaḥ svādhīna tvāt nanu punar svādhīna karma sāpekṣa tva kṛta vaiṣamya āpātaḥ iti atas uktam upalabhyate ca iti sa kārayet iti śrutyā tādṛśa vaiṣamyam adoṣa tvena jñāyate ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcopapadyate khalvīśvarasya karmasāpekṣatve'pi svātaṃtryaṃ| svādhīnasāpekṣāyāḥ svātaṃtryāvirodhitvāt| na ca tathā sati punarvaiṣamyādikaṃ syādita vācyaṃ| iṣṭatvāt| vaiṣamyamiti vacanāt| ato hareḥ sarvakartṛtve virodhābhāvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca upapadyate khalu īśvarasya karma sāpekṣa tve pi svātaṃtryam svādhīna sāpekṣāyāḥ svātaṃtrya avirodhi tvāt na ca tathā sati punar vaiṣamya ādikam vācyam iṣṭa tvāt vaiṣamyam iti vacanāt atas hareḥ sarva kartṛ tve virodha abhāvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || iti vaiṣamyanairghaṇyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vaiṣamya nairghaṇya adhikaraṇam

original: atra viṣṇoḥ sarvagumapūrtau sarvadoṣarāhitye ca yuktyavirodha ucyate|
analyzed: atra viṣṇoḥ sarva guma pūrtau sarva doṣa rāhitye ca yukti avirodhaḥ ucyate

original: || sarvadharmopapatteśca || ||
analyzed: sarva dharma upapatteḥ ca

original: nanu na viṣṇuḥ sarvaguṇapūrṇaḥ| cetanatvāt| anyathā devadattādīnāmapi tathātvaṃ syāt| sarveṣāṃ yuktivirodhānāṃ parihṛtatvenottarasūtraveyarbhyācceti prāpte pariharatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇuḥ sarva guṇa pūrṇaḥ cetanatvāt anyathā devadatta ādīnām api tathātvam syāt sarveṣām yukti virodhānām parihṛta tvena uttarasūtra veyarbhyāt ca iti prāpte pariharat sūtram āha

original: || || sarvadharmopapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || guṇadoṣābhāvavattvarūpāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ upapatteḥ svātaṃtryādinā brahmaṇi yuktatvācca na tasya guṇapūrṇatve yuktivirodhaḥ śaṃkanīya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sarva dharma upapatteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ guṇa doṣa abhāvavat tva rūpāṇām sarveṣām dharmāṇām upapatteḥ svātaṃtrya ādinā brahmaṇi yuktatvāt ca na tasya guṇa pūrṇa tve yukti virodhaḥ śaṃkanīyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvaguṇapūrmatvaṃ| svātaṃtryāt| guṇāḥ śrutā iti śruteśca| pūrvādhikaraṇeṣu tasya pratyekamekaikaguṇaviṣaye doṣābhāve ca virodhaṃ parihṛtya samarthanaṃ kṛtaṃ| sarvaguṇapūrṇatvaviṣaye ca prāptayuktivirodhaparihāreṇa ca tatprakaraṇasyātra samāpitatvātsūtravaiyarthyābhāvāt| cenatvahetoraprayojakatvācchrutiviruddhatvācca|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ sarva guṇa pūrma tvam svātaṃtryāt guṇāḥ śrutāḥ iti śruteḥ ca pūrva adhikaraṇeṣu tasya pratyekam ekaika guṇa viṣaye doṣa abhāve ca virodham parihṛtya samarthanam kṛtam sarva guṇa pūrṇa tva viṣaye ca prāpta yukti virodha parihāreṇa ca tad prakaraṇasya atra samāpita tvāt sūtra vaiyarthya abhāvāt cenatva hetoḥ aprayojaka tvāt śruti viruddha tvāt ca

original: tatca viṣṇoḥ sarvaguṇapūrṇatve virodhābhāvenoktaṃ sarvamupapannamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tat ca viṣṇoḥ sarva guṇa pūrṇa tve virodha abhāvena uktam sarvam upapannam iti siddham

original: || iti sarvadharmopapattyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti sarva dharma upapatti adhikaraṇam

original: || iti dvitīyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: iti dvitīya adhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ

original: || śrīḥ ||
analyzed: śrīḥ

original: || hariḥ ||
analyzed: hariḥ

original: || atha dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: atha dvitīya adhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

original: itareṣāṃ cānupalabdheriti naye sāmānyato nirākṛtasamayānāṃ viśeṣato nirākaraṇaṃ kriyate'sminpāde ||
analyzed: itareṣām ca anupalabdheḥ iti naye sāmānyatas nirākṛta samayānām viśeṣataḥ nirākaraṇam kriyate ismin pāde

original: atrācetanapravṛttimataṃ nirākriyate|
analyzed: atra acetana pravṛtti matam nirākriyate

original: || racanānupapatteśca nānumānaṃ || ||
analyzed: racanā anupapatteḥ ca na anumānam

original: nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| sāṃkhyasamaye mahadādikaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇajanyaṃ| kāryatvāt| ghaṭavadityanumānena prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvaṃ prasādhya tasyā ananyādhīnatayā kāryonmukhatvābhidhānāt| ataḥ prakṛterevānanyādhīnatayā'śeṣakāryonmukhatvena neśvarakartṛtvaṃ cāstīti na jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha|
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam sāṃkhya samaye mahat ādikam sva sadṛśa kāraṇa janyam kārya tvāt ghaṭa vat iti anumānena prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvam prasādhya tasyāḥ ananya adhīna tayā kārya unmukha tva abhidhānāt atas prakṛteḥ eva ananya adhīna tayā aśeṣa kārya unmukha tvena na īśvara kartṛ tvam ca asti iti na jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam iti prāpte parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || racanānupapatteśca nānumānamiti || asyārthaḥ || anumīyata ityanumānaṃ| sāṃkhyānumānakalpitaṃ| pradhānaṃ na jagatkartṛ| kutaḥ racanānupapatteḥ| pradhānasya jaḍatvena svataḥ pravṛttyanupapatteḥ| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛtau pramāṇābhāvāccetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: racanā anupapatteḥ ca na anumānam iti asya arthaḥ anumīyate iti anumānam sāṃkhya anumāna kalpitam pradhānam na jagat kartṛ kutas racanā anupapatteḥ pradhānasya jaḍa tvena svatas pravṛtti anupapatteḥ acetanasya svatas pravṛtau pramāṇa abhāvāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ jagatkartṛtvaṃ| kāryaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇavadityanumānena kāraṇatayā parikalpitasya pradhānasyācetanatvena svataḥ kāryonmukhatvāyogāt| pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttyabhāve'cetanatvākhyahetusūcanādasiddheḥ parihṛtatvāt| tadviruddhopapattereva tadabhāvasādhakatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ jagatkartṛ tvam kāryam sva sadṛśa kāraṇa vat iti anumānena kāraṇatayā parikalpitasya pradhānasya acetana tvena svatas kārya unmukha tva ayogāt pradhānasya svatas pravṛtti abhāve cetana tva ākhya hetu sūcanāt asiddheḥ parihṛta tvāt tad viruddha upapatteḥ eva tad abhāva sādhaka tvāt

original: prāguktānumānasya kāraṇatvamātrasādhakatvena svataḥ kāryonmukhatvāsādhakatvāt| pramāṇāṃtarasya cābhāvāt| ato nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadvirodhābhāvādyuktaṃ janmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: prāgukta anumānasya kāraṇatva mātra sādhaka tvena svatas kārya unmukhatva asādhaka tvāt pramāṇa aṃtarasya ca abhāvāt atas nirīśvara sāṃkhya matasya aprāmāṇika tvena tad virodha abhāvāt yuktam janma ādi kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || pravṛtteśca || ||
analyzed: pravṛtteḥ ca

original: evaṃ pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttikartṛtve'cetanatvasvataḥpravṛttiśūnyatvapramāṇābhāvairnirākṛtya yuktyaṃtareṇāpi tannirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam pradhānasya svatas pravṛtti kartṛ tva icetana tva svatas pravṛtti śūnyatva pramāṇa abhāvaiḥ nirākṛtya yukti aṃtareṇa api tat nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || pravṛtteśceti || asyārthaḥ || ahaṃ karomīti cetanasyaiva pravṛtterdarśanācca na pradhānaṃ jagatkartṛ ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pravṛtteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ aham karomi iti cetanasya eva pravṛtteḥ darśanāt ca na pradhānam jagat kartṛ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca kulālāderghaṭādisṛṣṭau vyāpārasyāhaṃ karomītyanabhavasiddhatvāt| kiṃca paṭādisṛṣṭeścetanecchānusāritvadarśanena mahadādisṛṣṭerapi tathā'bhyupagaṃtavyatvāt| mahadādisṛṣṭiścetanecchānusāriṇī sṛṣṭitvāddhaṭasṛṣṭivaditi mānāṃtaravirodhāt| cetanasya pravṛttiḥ kriyā| sā ca kṛtiṃ vinā nopapannā| sā ca necchāṃ vinā|
analyzed: evam ca kulāla ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi sṛṣṭau vyāpārasya aham karomi iti anabhava siddha tvāt kiṃca paṭa ādi sṛṣṭeḥ cetana icchā anusāri tva darśanena mahat ādi sṛṣṭeḥ api tathā abhyupagaṃtavya tvāt mahat ādi sṛṣṭiḥ cetana icchā anusāriṇī sṛṣṭi tvāt dhaṭa sṛṣṭi vat iti māna aṃtara virodhāt cetanasya pravṛttiḥ kriyā sā ca kṛtim vinā na upapannā sā ca na icchām vinā

original: sā ca na jñānaṃ vineti pravṛttyādikāryāṇāṃ svasvakāraṇāvinā bhūtatvena pravṛttyā icchāpūrvakatvasādhanasaṃbhavāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: sā ca na jñānam vinā iti pravṛtti ādi kāryāṇām sva sva kāraṇa a vinā bhūtatvena pravṛttyā icchā pūrvakatva sādhana saṃbhavāt atas jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti siddham

original: || payoṃ'buvaccettatrāpi || ||
analyzed: payaḥ uṃbu vat ced tatra api

original: nanvacetanayorapi payoṃ'bunoḥ svataḥ pravṛttirddṛśyate| atastatraivācetatvahetorvyabhicārāt| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛttau ca sa eva dṛṣṭāṃto bhaviṣyatīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu acetanayoḥ api payaḥ uṃbunoḥ svatas pravṛttiḥ ddṛśyate atas tatra eva aceta tva hetoḥ vyabhicārāt acetanasya svatas pravṛttau ca saḥ eva dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ bhaviṣyati iti prāpte parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || payoṃ'buvaccettatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || api śabdaścetanapravṛttyākarṣaṇārthaḥ| payoṃ'buvat yathā'cetanayoḥ payoṃ'bunoḥ pravṛttirdṛṣṭā tathā pradhānasyāpyastviti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ| tatrāpi payoṃ'bvādāvapi aṃtataḥ īśvarādeva pravṛttiḥ| na svataḥ pravṛttirityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: payaḥ uṃbu vat ced tatra api iti asya arthaḥ api śabdaḥ cetana pravṛtti ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ payaḥ uṃbu vat yathā acetanayoḥ payaḥ uṃbunoḥ pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā tathā pradhānasya api astu iti ced na kutas yatas tatra api payaḥ uṃbu ādau api aṃtatas īśvarāt eva pravṛttiḥ na svatas pravṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcaitasya vā'kṣarasya praśāsana iti śrutyā tatrāpīśvaranimittapravṛttisadbhāvāvagamāt tathā ca pūrvavādyuktapratyanumānadṛṣṭāṃte payoṃ'bvādau siddhāṃtyabhimatasādhyasyaiva satvānna tadanumānasya satpratipakṣatā na vā vyabhicāraḥ| ato janmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane iti śrutyā tatra api īśvara nimitta pravṛtti sadbhāva avagamāt tathā ca pūrvavādi ukta pratyanumāna dṛṣṭāṃte payoṃbu ādau siddhāṃti abhimata sādhyasya eva satvāt na tad anumānasya satpratipakṣatā na vā vyabhicāraḥ atas janma ādi kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti siddham

original: || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāt || ||
analyzed: vyatireka anavasthiteḥ ca anapekṣa tvāt

original: nanu śrutisāmarthyena payoṃ'bunoḥ pravṛtterīśvaradhīnatayā tatra vyabhicārābhāve'pyayaskāṃtaśilādirūpācetanāṃtasya pravṛttau siddhāyāṃ bhaviṣyati tatra vyabhicāraḥ| setsyati ca pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttau sādhyāyāmayaskāṃtādikmeva nidarśanaṃ| udāharaṇaniyamasyānāśrayaṇīyatvādityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu śruti sāmarthyena payaḥ uṃbunoḥ pravṛtteḥ īśvara dhīna tayā tatra vyabhicāra abhāve pi ayaskāṃta śilā ādi rūpa acetana aṃtasya pravṛttau siddhāyām bhaviṣyati tatra vyabhicāraḥ setsyati ca pradhānasya svatas pravṛttau sādhyāyām ayaskāṃta ādikm eva nidarśanam udāharaṇa niyamasya anāśrayaṇīya tvāt iti āśaṃkām apākurvat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || vyatirekānavasthiteḥ na ṛta iti śrutyā īśvaravyatirekeṇa kasyāpi karmaṇaḥ asattvāvagamāt| tata evācetanasyaiva svataḥ pravṛttiriti nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| ataḥ evānapekṣatvātsadbhiranādaraṇīyatvānna tadvirodho viṣṇukartṛtvasyetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vyatireka anavasthiteḥ ca anapekṣa tvāt iti asya arthaḥ vyatireka anavasthiteḥ na ṛte iti śrutyāḥ īśvara vyatirekeṇa kasya api karmaṇaḥ asattva avagamāt tatas eva acetanasya eva svatas pravṛttiḥ iti nirīśvara sāṃkhya matasya aprāmāṇika tvāt atas eva anapekṣa tvāt sadbhiḥ anādaraṇīya tvāt na tad virodhaḥ viṣṇu kartṛ tvasya iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na ṛte tvatkriyata iti śrutyā sarvasyāpīśvarādhīnatvāvagamāt| īśvaravyatirekeṇa taṃ vinā kasyāpi karmaṇo'navasthitiśruteracetanatvahetoḥ kutrāpi vyabhicārābhāvāt| pūrvavādyuktānumāne dṛṣṭāṃtālābhāt| sāṃkhyaparikalpitānumānasyāprāmāṇikatvena pramāṇaviruddhatvena ca mahājanaparigṛhītatvābhāvānnānumānaparikalpitaṃ pradhānaṃ jagatkartṛ|
analyzed: evam ca na ṛte tvat kriyate iti śrutyā sarvasya api īśvara adhīnatva avagamāt īśvara vyatirekeṇa tam vinā kasya api karmaṇaḥ navasthiti śruteḥ acetana tva hetoḥ kutra api vyabhicāra abhāvāt pūrvavādi ukta anumāne dṛṣṭāṃta alābhāt sāṃkhya parikalpita anumānasya aprāmāṇika tvena pramāṇa viruddha tvena ca mahājana parigṛhīta tva abhāvāt na anumāna parikalpitam pradhānam jagat kartṛ

original: ato nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadvirodhābhāvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas nirīśvara sāṃkhya matasya aprāmāṇika tvena tad virodha abhāvāt yuktam jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || iti racanānupapattyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti racanā anupapattyā adhikaraṇam

original: || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivat || ||
analyzed: anyatra abhāvāt ca na tṛṇa ādi vat

original: nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| parameśvarānugṛhītapradhānādeva| parjanyānugṛhīta pṛthivyā aṃkurotpattivajjagadutpattisaṃbhavāt| ato neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na īśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛ tvam yuktam parameśvara anugṛhīta pradhānāt eva parjanya anugṛhīta pṛthivyāḥ aṃkura utpatti vat jagat utpatti saṃbhavāt atas na īśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || tṛṇādivat yathā pṛthivījanyatṛṇādikārye parjanyaṃ sahakārimātraṃ tathā prakṛtijanyamahadādikārye'pīśvaraḥ anugrāhakaḥ| na svataṃtra iti seśvarasāṃkhyapakṣo'pi na| kutaḥ| anyatrābhāvāt| īśvarādanyatra tatpreraṇāṃ vinā jagato'bhāvādīśvarasya prakṛtisattādipradatvāccetyerthaḥ ||
analyzed: anyatra abhāvāt ca na tṛṇa ādi vat iti asya arthaḥ tṛṇa ādi vat yathā pṛthivī janya tṛṇa ādi kārye parjanyam sahakāri mātram tathā prakṛti janya mahat ādi kārye pi īśvaraḥ anugrāhakaḥ na svataṃtraḥ iti seśvara sāṃkhya pakṣaḥ api na kutas anyatra abhāvāt īśvarāt anyatra tad preraṇām vinā jagataḥ bhāvāt īśvarasya prakṛti sattā ādi prada tvāt ca iti īrthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| svātaṃtryeṇa tatpreraṇāmaṃtareṇa kasyāpi vastuno'bhāvāt| mūlakāraṇabhūtāyāḥ prakṛterapi tadadhīnasattākatvācca| ataḥ seśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam svātaṃtryeṇa tad preraṇām aṃtareṇa kasya api vastunaḥ bhāvāt mūlakāraṇa bhūtāyāḥ prakṛteḥ api tad adhīna sattāka tvāt ca atas seśvara sāṃkhya matasya aprāmāṇika tvena avirodhaka tvāt yuktam jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || iti anyatrābhāvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti anyatra abhāva adhikaraṇam

original: nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| aṃtareṇāpīśvaraṃ pūrvasmātpūrvasmāduttarottarotpattisaṃbhavāt| caitanyotpatterapi madirotpattivatsvabhāvadevopapatteḥ| na ca śrutyādibādhaḥ| tasyā apramāṇyāt| na ca tasyā aprāmāṇye dharmādyasiddhiprasaṃgaḥ| atīṃdriyavastuno'bhāveneṣṭatvāt|
analyzed: nanu nā īśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛ tvam yuktam aṃtareṇa api īśvaram pūrvasmāt pūrvasmāt uttarottara utpatti saṃbhavāt caitanya utpatteḥ api madirā utpatti vat svabhāva deva upapatteḥ na ca śruti ādi bādhaḥ tasyāḥ apramāṇyāt na ca tasyāḥ aprāmāṇye dharma ādi asiddhi prasaṃgaḥ atīṃdriya vastunaḥ ubhāvena iṣṭatvāt

original: ata iśvarābhāvānneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati|
analyzed: atas iśvara abhāvāt na īśvarasya jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || netyanuvartate| anabhyupagame'pi cārvākaiḥ svaśāstrasya siddhāṃtatvānabhyupagame siddhamasmadiṣṭaṃ| abhyupagame'pi arthābhāvāt| siddhāṃtatvavyāpakayoḥ arthaśabditaviṣayaprayojanayoḥ asattvāṃgīkārāt svavyāghātaḥ syāditi na tatpakṣo'pi yukta ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: abhyupagame api artha abhāvāt iti asya arthaḥ na iti anuvartate anabhyupagame pi cārvākaiḥ sva śāstrasya siddhāṃta tva anabhyupagame siddham asmad iṣṭam abhyupagame api artha abhāvāt siddhāṃta tva vyāpakayoḥ artha śabdita viṣaya prayojanayoḥ asattva aṃgīkārāt sva vyāghātaḥ syāt iti na tad pakṣaḥ api yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| cārvākasamayasya viṣayaprayojanādiśūnyatvenāpramāṇatvena virodhābhāvāt| tathāhi| na tāvattatsamayasyātīṃdriyo viṣayaḥ| tadabhāvāt| nāpyaiṃdriyakaṃ| tasya pratyakṣasiddhatvena śāstrānapekṣaṇāt| nāpi svargāpavargādi śrotṛphalaṃ| tadalābhāt| nāpi dṛṣṭaṃ dhanādi| tasya kṛṣyādilaghūpāyasādhyatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam cārvāka samayasya viṣaya prayojana ādi śūnyatvena apramāṇa tvena virodha abhāvāt tathā hi na tāvat tad samayasya atīṃdriyaḥ viṣayaḥ tad abhāvāt na api aiṃdriyakam tasya pratyakṣa siddha tvena śāstra anapekṣaṇāt nā api svarga apavarga ādi śrotṛ phalam tad alābhāt nā api dṛṣṭam dhana ādi tasya kṛṣi ādi laghu upāya sādhya tvāt

original: nāpi praṇetuḥ prayojanaṃ| na ca dharmādyabhāvapratipādanadvārā lokopakāraḥ prayojanamiti vācyaṃ| dharmādyabhāvajñāne parasparahiṃsādinā'pakārasyaiva prāpteḥ| nāpyupakāraḥ svataḥ prayojanaṃ| sukhaduḥkhāvāptihānirūpatvābhāvāt| na vā tenāpi kiṃcitsādhyaṃ prayojanaṃ| evaṃ vidhe'dhikārī dūrotsāritaḥ|
analyzed: nā api praṇetuḥ prayojanam na ca dharma ādi abhāva pratipādana dvārā loka upakāraḥ prayojanam iti vācyam dharma ādi abhāva jñāne paraspara hiṃsā ādinā apakārasya eva prāpteḥ nā api upakāraḥ svatas prayojanam sukha duḥkha avāpti hāni rūpa tva abhāvāt na vā tena api kiṃcid sādhyam prayojanam evam vidhedhi kārī dūra utsāritaḥ

original: tadabhāvādeva saṃbaṃdho'pi ataścārvākasamayasyāprāmāṇikatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tad abhāvāt eva saṃbaṃdhaḥ api atas cārvāka samayasya aprāmāṇika tvāt yuktam lakṣaṇasūtram iti siddham

original: || iti abhyupagamādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: || puruṣāśmavaditi cettatrāpi || ||

original: nanu na harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| cetanopasarjanaśarīrasyāśmānayanādikartṛtvadarśanena puruṣopasarjanapradhānenaiva jagadutpattisaṃbhavāt| pradhānaṃ cetanasaṃnidhānātsvataḥ pravṛttimat acetanatvāt śarīravaditi mānasadbhāvāt| ata īśvarasyaivābhāvājjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ tasyaivetyetad‌dūrotsāritamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na hareḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam cetanā upasarjana śarīrasya aśma ānayana ādi kartṛ tva darśanena puruṣa upasarjana pradhānena eva jagat utpatti saṃbhavāt pradhānam cetana saṃnidhānāt svatas pravṛttimat acetana tvāt śarīra vat iti māna sadbhāvāt atas īśvarasya eva abhāvāt jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam tasya eva iti etat dūra utsāritam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || puruṣāśmavaditi cettatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣāśmavat yathā puruṣasaṃbaṃdhādacetanaṃ śarīraṃ aśmānayanādau pravartate tathā'cetanaprakṛtiḥ cetanasaṃbaṃdhātpravartata iti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ tatrāpi śarīrapravṛttāvapi cetanasya īśvarasyaiva kartṛtvena dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvaḥ ata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: puruṣa aśma vat iti ced tatra api iti asya arthaḥ puruṣa aśma vat yathā puruṣa saṃbaṃdhāt acetanam śarīram aśma ānayana ādau pravartate tathā acetana prakṛtiḥ cetana saṃbaṃdhāt pravartate iti ced na kutas yatas tatra api śarīra pravṛttau api cetanasya īśvarasya eva kartṛ tvena dṛṣṭāṃta abhāvaḥ atas iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| puruṣopasarjanaprakṛterjagatkāraṇatvasādhane dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvāt| na ca śarīrameva dṛṣṭāṃta iti vācyaṃ| na ṛte tvatkriyata iti śrutyā śarīrapravṛttāvapi paramātmādhīnatvena dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalatvāt| tataśca matāṃtaravirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva hareḥ jagat kāraṇatvam puruṣa upasarjana prakṛteḥ jagat kāraṇatva sādhane dṛṣṭāṃta abhāvāt na ca śarīram eva dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ iti vācyam na ṛte tvat kriyate iti śrutyā śarīra pravṛttau api paramātma adhīnatvena dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhya vikalatvāt tatas ca mata aṃtara virodha abhāvena yuktam jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || aṃgitvānupapatteḥ || ||
analyzed: aṃgitva anupapatteḥ

original: evaṃ śrutilakṣaṇahetunā dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyavaikalyamabhidhāya hetvaṃtareṇa dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyavaikalyopapādanāya sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam śruti lakṣaṇa hetunā dṛṣṭāṃte sādhya vaikalyam abhidhāya hetu aṃtareṇa dṛṣṭāṃte sādhya vaikalya upapādanāya sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || aṃgitvānupapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣāsyāṃgatveṃ'gīkṛte sati aṃgamaṃgīti vākye aṃgitvasya prādhānyasya ukttyanupapatteḥ| na puruṣopasarjanaprakṛtikartṛtvapakṣe dṛṣṭāṃto'stītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aṃgitva anupapatteḥ iti asya arthaḥ puruṣa asya aṃgatva iṃgīkṛte sati aṃgam aṃgī iti vākye aṃgitvasya prādhānyasya uktti anupapatteḥ na puruṣa upasarjana prakṛti kartṛ tva pakṣe dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ asti iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yadi puruṣopasarjanaṃ śarīrameva kartṛ syāttarhi puruṣom̐'gī śarīramaṃgamiti prāmāṇikalaukikavyavahāro na syāt| asti cāsau| ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca yadi puruṣa upasarjanam śarīram eva kartṛ syāt tarhi puruṣa ūm̐gī śarīram aṃgam iti prāmāṇika laukika vyavahāraḥ na syāt asti ca asau atas na ayam dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ

original: tasmātpuruṣasaṃvalitaśarīrasyaiva svataḥ pravṛttāvucyamānāyāṃ puruṣasyāṃgatvāpradhānatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvādaṃgamiti smṛtau puruṣasyāṃgitvavyavahāraḥ śarīraṃ prati prādhānyavyavahāropadeśo'nupapannaḥ syāt| evaṃ dārṣṭāṃtike'pi puruṣasya pradhānāṃgatvāpattyāṃ'gitvavyavahārānupapattiḥ| tathā ca dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvo bādhaśca darśite|
analyzed: tasmāt puruṣa saṃvalita śarīrasya eva svatas pravṛttau ucyamānāyām puruṣasya aṃga tva apradhāna tva avaśyam bhāvāt aṃgam iti smṛtau puruṣasya aṃgi tva vyavahāraḥ śarīram prati prādhānya vyavahāra upadeśaḥ anupapannaḥ syāt evam dārṣṭāṃtike api puruṣasya pradhāna aṃga tva āpattyā aṃgi tva vyavahāra anupapattiḥ tathā ca dṛṣṭāṃta abhāvaḥ bādhaḥ ca darśite

original: nanu na harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| pradhānopasarjanapuruṣādeva jagadutpattisaṃbhaveneśvaravaiyarthyāt| tathā ca prayogaḥ| vimatā pravṛttiḥ acetanopasarjanapuruṣādhīnā pravṛttitvāt aśmānayanādipravṛttivaditi| ato na jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na hareḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam pradhāna upasarjana puruṣāt eva jagat utpatti saṃbhavena īśvara vaiyarthyāt tathā ca prayogaḥ vimatā pravṛttiḥ acetana upasarjana puruṣa adhīnā pravṛtti tvāt aśma ānayana ādi pravṛtti vat iti atas na jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāditi || asyārthaḥ || śabdenāṃgitvānupapatterityasya samākarṣaḥ| yathā prācīnapakṣānyaprakāreṇa prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣakartṛtvasyānumitau sādhane'pi| jñaśaktiviyogāt| jñasya jīvasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhārthaṃ pravṛttiśaktiviyogāt āṃgitvānupapatterevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anyathā anumitau ca jña śakti viyogāt iti asya arthaḥ śabdena aṃgitva anupapatteḥ iti asya samākarṣaḥ yathā prācīna pakṣa anya prakāreṇa prakṛti upasarjana puruṣa kartṛ tvasya anumitau sādhane api jña śakti viyogāt jñasya jīvasya śarīra saṃbaṃdha artham pravṛtti śakti viyogāt āṃgitva anupapatteḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameveśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvaṃ| prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣasya kartṛtve mānābhāvāt| atha mataṃ| prācīnamatādanyathā'numitamiti| tathā sati dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyābhāvāt| kevalasya pravṛttiśakteraṃgīkāre śarīravaiyarbhyaṃ| noceccharīrasaṃbaṃdhābhāvaprasaṃgenāśmānayanādipravṛttirna syāt| asti cāsau|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva īśvarasya jagat kāraṇatvam prakṛti upasarjana puruṣasya kartṛ tve māna abhāvāt atha matam prācīna matāt anyathā anumitam iti tathā sati dṛṣṭāṃte sādhya abhāvāt kevalasya pravṛttiśakteḥ aṃgīkāre śarīra vaiyarbhyam no ced śarīra saṃbaṃdha abhāva prasaṃgena aśma ānayana ādi pravṛttiḥ na syāt asti ca asau

original: ataḥ puruṣasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhaghaṭako'śmānayanādiśaktiprada īśvaroṃ'gīkārya iti kathaṃ na dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhyavikalaḥ| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas puruṣasya śarīra saṃbaṃdha ghaṭa kośma ānayana ādi śakti pradaḥ īśvara ūṃgīkāryaḥ iti katham na dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhya vikalaḥ atas jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti siddham

original: || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasaṃ || ||
analyzed: vipratiṣedhāt ca asamaṃjasam

original: evaṃ pratyekaṃ dūṣitānyanīśvaramatāni sāmānyadūṣaṇenāpi nirākurvatsūtra paṭhati ||
analyzed: evam pratyekam dūṣitāni anīśvara matāni sāmānya dūṣaṇena api nirākurvat sūtra paṭhati

original: || || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasamiti || asyārthaḥ || vipratiṣedhāt sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvādanīśvaramataṃ asamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vipratiṣedhāt ca asamaṃjasam iti asya arthaḥ vipratiṣedhāt sakala śruti smṛti yukti viruddha tvāt anīśvara matam asamaṃjasam ayuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dyāvābhūmī janayan | yato vā | ya sarvajña ityādiśrutīnāṃ utpattisthitisaṃhārāḥ| sraṣṭā pātā tathaivāttā| ityādi smṛtīnāṃ| vimataṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt| ciccaittye kenacinniyete'svataṃtratvāt| ityādiyuktīnāṃ ca virodhena prakṛtisvātaṃtryādirūpamarthaṃ vadato'nyonīco nāstīti vacanāt|
analyzed: evam ca dyāvābhūmī janayan yatas vā sarvajñaḥ ityādi śrutīnām utpatti sthiti saṃhārāḥ sraṣṭā pātā tathā eva attā ityādi smṛtīnām vimatam sa kartṛkam kārya tvāt cit caittye kenacid niyeta isvataṃtra tvāt ityādi yuktīnām ca virodhena prakṛti svātaṃtrya ādi rūpam artham vadataḥ anyaḥ nīcaḥ na asti iti vacanāt

original: tataśca sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvātsarvamapyanīśvaramatamapramāṇaṃ| ato na sāṃkhyādimatavirodhena na lakṣaṇāsaṃbhava iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ca sakala śruti smṛti yukti viruddha tvāt sarvam api anīśvara matam apramāṇam atas na sāṃkhya ādi mata virodhena na lakṣaṇa asaṃbhavaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti anyathā'numityadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti anyathā anumiti adhikaraṇam

original: atra paramāṇvāraṃbhavādo'pākriyate|
analyzed: atra paramāṇu āraṃbha vādā upākriyate

original: || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāṃ || ||
analyzed: mahat dīrghavat vā hrasva parimaṃḍalābhyām

original: nanu dravyādipadārthāḥ saptaiva| tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivyādinavaiva| guṇāstu rūpādicaturviṃśatireva| karma cotkṣepaṇādipaṃcavidhaṃ| sāmānyamanekavidhaṃ| jātirūpamupādhirūpaṃ ca samavāyastveka eva| viśeṣāstvanaṃtāḥ| etattritayaṃ nityameva| tatrānityaṃ kāraṇatritayajanyaṃ| yatsamavetaṃ kāryamutpadyate tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ| paramāṇvādidravyameva|
analyzed: nanu dravya ādi padārthāḥ sapta eva tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivī ādi nava eva guṇāḥ tu rūpa ādi caturviṃśatiḥ eva karma ca utkṣepaṇa ādi paṃcavidham sāmānyam anekavidham jāti rūpam upādhi rūpam ca samavāyaḥ tu ekaḥ eva viśeṣāḥ tu anaṃtāḥ etat tritayam nityam eva tatra anityam kāraṇa tritaya janyam yat samavetam kāryam utpadyate tat samavāyi kāraṇam paramāṇu ādi dravyam eva

original: tatra paramāṇavo dvyaṇukādikrameṇāvayavinamārabhaṃte| samavāyikāraṇapratyāsannamavadhṛtasāmarthyasamavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra kāryadravyasyāvayavasaṃyoga eva kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati| kāraṇaguṇakarma ca kāryaguṇānāṃ kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ|
analyzed: tatra paramāṇavaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi krameṇa avayavinam ārabhaṃte samavāyi kāraṇa pratyāsannam avadhṛta sāmarthya samavāyi kāraṇam tatra kārya dravyasya avayava saṃyogaḥ eva kārya ekārtha pratyāsattyā asamavāyi kāraṇam bhavati kāraṇa guṇa karma ca kārya guṇānām kārya ekārtha pratyāsattyā asamavāyi kāraṇam

original: karmaṇaśca kāraṇagataguṇakarmaṇi kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra parimāṇaṃ kāraṇagataṃ| kāryagataparimāṇasthāsamavayikāraṇaṃ bhavati| paramāṇud‌vyaṇukatūlagataṃ parimāṇaṃ na d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukatūlapiṃḍagatāḥ parimāṇāḥ asamavāyakāraṇaṃ| kiṃtu d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukagatasaṃkhyayaiva| tūlapiṃḍaparimāṇaṃ tu pracayena bhavati|
analyzed: karmaṇaḥ ca kāraṇa gata guṇa karmaṇi kārya ekārtha pratyāsattyā asamavāyi kāraṇam tatra parimāṇam kāraṇa gatam kārya gata parimāṇa stha asamavayi kāraṇam bhavati paramāṇu dvyaṇuka tūla gatam parimāṇam na dvyaṇuka tryaṇuka tūla piṃḍa gatāḥ parimāṇāḥ asamavāya kāraṇam kiṃtu dvyaṇuka tryaṇuka gata saṃkhyayā eva tūla piṃḍa parimāṇam tu pracayena bhavati

original: etadanyatkāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ| īśvarādṛṣṭakālādi| tatreśvara ātmaviśeṣaḥ| ātmā ca saṃkhyādicaturdaśaguṇayuktaḥ| parameśvarastu saṃkhyādipaṃcaguṇakaḥ| kartṛtvopayogijñānecchā prayatnaśālī ca śiṣṭaṣaḍ‌guṇāyogya iti kathaṃ tasyānaṃtaguṇakttvaṃ yuktaṃ| ato vyartha eva pūrvādhyāya iti prāpte sūtritaṃ|
analyzed: etad anyat kāraṇam nimittam īśvara adṛṣṭa kāla ādi tatra īśvaraḥ ātma viśeṣaḥ ātmā ca saṃkhyā ādi caturdaśa guṇa yuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ tu saṃkhyā ādi paṃca guṇakaḥ kartṛ tva upayogi jñāna icchā prayatna śālī ca śiṣṭa ṣaḍguṇa ayogyaḥ iti katham tasya anaṃta guṇakt tvam yuktam atas vyarthaḥ eva pūrva adhyāyaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || mahaddīrghavat vaiśeṣikamate tryaṇukādigatānmahattvāt dīrghatvācca caturaṇukādigataparimāṇamutpadyate| tathā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmapi dvyaṇukaparamāṇūbhayagata hrasvattvapārimāṃḍilyaparimāṇābhyāmapi tryaṇukadvyaṇukagataparimāṇotpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: mahat dīrgha vat vā hrasva parimaṃḍalābhyām iti asya arthaḥ mahat dīrgha vat vaiśeṣika mate tryaṇuka ādi gatāt mahat tvāt dīrgha tvāt ca catur aṇuka ādi gata parimāṇam utpadyate tathā hrasva parimaṃḍalābhyām api dvyaṇuka paramāṇu ubhaya gata hrasva ttva pārimāṃḍilya parimāṇābhyām api tryaṇuka dvyaṇuka gata parimāṇa utpattiḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā mahattvadīrghatvābhyāmapi kāryotpattirna syāditi vā śabdārthaḥ| tasmādvaiśeṣikamatamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: anyathā mahat tva dīrgha tvābhyām api kārya utpattiḥ na syāt iti vā śabda arthaḥ tasmāt vaiśeṣika matam anupapannam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva hareranaṃtaguṇaparipūrṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ| vaiśeṣikādīnāmanupapannabhāṣitvena tatsamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| yaccoktaṃ| hrasvāṇuparimāṇayornāsamavāyikāraṇatvamiti| tanna| tathāsati mahattvadīrghatvayorapi tadabhāvāpātāt| mahaddīrghaparimāṇayoḥ kāraṇatve'nayorapi tatsāmyāt| aviśeṣāt| tasmādutpattiviruddhatvānna tayorasamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva hareḥ anaṃta guṇa paripūrṇa tva lakṣaṇam vaiśeṣika ādīnām anupapanna bhāṣi tvena tad samayasya aprāmāṇika tvāt yat ca uktam hrasva aṇu parimāṇayoḥ na asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam iti tat na tathā asati mahat tva dīrgha tvayoḥ api tad abhāva āpātāt mahat dīrgha parimāṇayoḥ kāraṇa tvena yoḥ api tad sāmyāt aviśeṣāt tasmāt utpatti viruddha tvāt na tayoḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam

original: kiṃtvetayoreveti vaiśeṣikādyuktamasamaṃjasasameveti na tadvirodha īśvarānaṃtaguṇatvasyeti yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: kiṃtu etayoḥ eva iti vaiśeṣika ādi uktam asamaṃjasasam eva iti na tad virodhaḥ īśvara anaṃta guṇatvasya iti yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāvaḥ || ||
analyzed: ubhayathā api na karma atas tad abhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ vaiśeṣikādimate mahattvadīrghatvāderasamavāyikāraṇatvakhaṃḍanarītyāsamavāyikāraṇamātraṃ nirastaṃ bhavatītyamipretya nimittakāraṇamapyevaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam vaiśeṣika ādi mate mahat tva dīrgha tva ādeḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa tva khaṃḍana rītyā asamavāyi kāraṇa mātram nirastam bhavati iti amipretya nimitta kāraṇam api evam nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāva iti || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā'pi īśvarecchayā nityatvānityavarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| na paramāṇuṣu kriyotpattisaṃbhavaḥ| atastadabhāvaḥ tasmindvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ubhayathā api na karma atas tad abhāvaḥ iti asya arthaḥ ubhayathā api īśvara icchayā nitya tva anitya va rūpa pakṣa dvaye pi na paramāṇuṣu kriyā utpatti saṃbhavaḥ atas tad abhāvaḥ tasmin dvyaṇuka ādi kārya abhāvaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃceśvarecchā nimittakāraṇamiti cet| sā kiṃ nityā'nityā vā| ubhayathā'pi na paramāṇukarma saṃbhavati| yadīśvarecchā nityā tarhi pralaye satyāmapi tasyāṃ paramāṇuceṣṭābhāvenā'nyadā'pi tadabhāvaḥ| athānityā tatkāraṇābhāveneśvarecchānutpattyā paramāṇukarmābhāvaḥ| na ca vācyaṃ pūrvakalpīyecchā'nityā'pi yāgavannimittamiti| pramāṇābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca īśvara icchā nimitta kāraṇam iti ced sā kim nitya anityā vā ubhayathā api na paramāṇu karma saṃbhavati yadi īśvara icchā nityā tarhi pralaye satyām api tasyām paramāṇu ceṣṭā bhāvena anyadā api tad abhāvaḥ atha anityā tad kāraṇa abhāvena īśvara icchā anutpattyā paramāṇu karma abhāvaḥ na ca vācyam pūrvakalpīya icchā anityā api yāga vat nimittam iti pramāṇa abhāvāt

original: atha neśvarecchā kāraṇaṃ tadevāstu| tarhyanyatrāpi kāraṇaṃ na syāt| sa eva paramate paramāṇukarmābhāvena saṃyogābhāvād‌vyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| vaidikeśvarapakṣe tu satyāmapīśvarecchāyāṃ sarvaṃ kāryānutpādikamīśvarāciṃtyaśaktita evopapadyate| na ca parapakṣe samametat| tasyānumānagamyeśvaratvena vedaikagamyeśvaratvābhāvāt|
analyzed: atha nā īśvara icchā kāraṇam tat eva astu tarhi anyatra api kāraṇam na syāt saḥ eva para mate paramāṇu karma abhāvena saṃyoga abhāvāt vyaṇuka ādi kārya abhāvaḥ vaidika īśvara pakṣe tu satyām api īśvara icchāyām sarvam kārya anutpādikam īśvara aciṃtya śaktitaḥ eva upapadyate na ca para pakṣe samam etat tasya anumāna gamya īśvara tvena veda eka gamya īśvara tva abhāvāt

original: ato vaiśeṣikādyuktasyāsāmaṃjasyena yuktaṃ hareranaṃtaguṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas vaiśeṣika ādi uktasya asāmaṃjasyena yuktam hareḥ anaṃta guṇa tva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteḥ || ||
analyzed: samavāya abhyupagamāt ca sāmyāt anavasthiteḥ

original: evaṃ vaiśeṣikādipakṣe nimittakāraṇāsaṃbhavaṃ darśayitvā samavāyikāraṇamapi nirākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: evam vaiśeṣika ādi pakṣe nimitta kāraṇa asaṃbhavam darśayitvā samavāyi kāraṇam api nirākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteriti || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣikaiḥ avayavāvayavyādīnāṃ bhinnatvanimittena samavāyābhyupagamāt samavāyasaṃbaṃdhāṃgīkārāt| sāmyāt samavāyyasamavāyinorapi bhinnatvasāmyāt| tatrāpi samavāyābhyupagame anavasthiteḥ| anavasthānācca tanmatamayuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: samavāya abhyupagamāt ca sāmyāt anavasthiteḥ iti asya arthaḥ vaiśeṣikaiḥ avayava avayavi ādīnām bhinna tva nimittena samavāya abhyupagamāt samavāya saṃbaṃdha aṃgīkārāt sāmyāt samavāyi asamavāyinoḥ api bhinna tva sāmyāt tatra api samavāya abhyupagame anavasthiteḥ anavasthānāt ca tad matam ayuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yadapi paramāṇvādidravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇamiti| tanna| avayavāvayavinorbhinnatvamaṃgīkṛtya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyābhyupagamāt| samavāyasyāpi bhinnatvasāmyena mṛddhaṭasamavāya ityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyāṃtarāpekṣā syāt| tatrāpyevamityanavasthānāt| mūlabhūtāvāyavāvayavyādisaṃbaṃdhasyaivāsidhyā tadasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: evam ca yat api paramāṇu ādi dravyam samavāyi kāraṇam iti tat na avayava avayavinoḥ bhinna tvam aṃgīkṛtya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva upapattaye samavāya abhyupagamāt samavāyasya api bhinna tva sāmyena mṛd haṭa samavāyaḥ ityādi viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva upapattaye samavāya aṃtara apekṣā syāt tatra api evam iti anavasthānāt mūla bhūta avāyava avayavi ādi saṃbaṃdhasya eva asidhyā tad asiddhiḥ

original: teṣāṃ prathamasaṃbaṃdhasidhyarthamabhyupagaṃtavyānāṃ saṃbaṃdhāṃtarāṇāṃ sutarāmasiddheḥ| samavāyasya svanirvāhakatve svasminsvayameva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvabuddhijanakatveṃ'gīkṛte samavāyāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: teṣām prathama saṃbaṃdha sidhi artham abhyupagaṃtavyānām saṃbaṃdha aṃtarāṇām sutarām asiddheḥ samavāyasya sva nirvāhaka tve svasmin svayam eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva buddhi janaka tva iṃgīkṛte samavāya asiddheḥ

original: guṇaguṇyādibhedaṃ tatsamavāyaṃ cāṃgīkṛtya tatsvanirvāhakatvakalpanāpekṣayā lāghavena guṇaguṇyāderabhedamaṃgīkṛtyaikasya dravyasyaiva svanirvāhakatvopapattau samavāyavaiyarthyāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: guṇa guṇi ādi bhedam tad samavāyam ca aṃgīkṛtya tad sva nirvāhaka tva kalpanā apekṣayā lāghavena guṇa guṇi ādeḥ abhedam aṃgīkṛtya ekasya dravyasya eva sva nirvāhaka tva upapattau samavāya vaiyarthyāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || nityameva ca bhāvāt || ||
analyzed: nityam eva ca bhāvāt

original: evaṃ paramate kāraṇatrayanirāsena sṛṣṭiṃ nirasya pralayanirāsārthaṃ pravṛttaṃ sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam para mate kāraṇa traya nirāsena sṛṣṭim nirasya pralaya nirāsa artham pravṛttam sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || nityameva ca bhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || doṣasamuccaye caḥ| īśecchāparamāṇvādikāraṇānāṃ sadātvāt| vaiśeṣikamate nityameva sarvadaiva| bhāvāt kāryotpattiḥ syāt| na tu kadācidityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: nityam eva ca bhāvāt iti asya arthaḥ doṣa samuccaye caḥ īśa icchā paramāṇu ādi kāraṇānām sadātvāt vaiśeṣika mate nityam eva sarvadā eva bhāvāt kārya utpattiḥ syāt na tu kadācid iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paramate layāsaṃbhavaḥ| samavāyikāraṇāsamavāyikāraṇanimittakāraṇānāṃ sadbhāvena kāryānutpāde kāraṇābhāvāt| samavāyikāraṇaparamāṇūnāṃ sadātanatve samavāyasyaiva janitvāṃgīkāre sarvaṃ kāryaṃ nityaṃ janimadeva syāt| samavāyikāraṇādisatve kāyotpattyuparame kadā'pi tasmātkāryotpattirna syāt|
analyzed: evam ca para mate laya asaṃbhavaḥ samavāyi kāraṇa asamavāyi kāraṇa nimitta kāraṇānām sadbhāvena kārya anutpāde kāraṇa abhāvāt samavāyi kāraṇa paramāṇūnām sadātana tve samavāyasya eva janitvā aṃgīkāre sarvam kāryam nityam janimat eva syāt samavāyi kāraṇa ādi satve kāya utpatti uparame kadāpi tasmāt kārya utpattiḥ na syāt

original: sati puṣkalakāraṇe kāryānutpāde tasya tatkāraṇatvāyogāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: sati puṣkala kāraṇe kārya anutpāde tasya tad kāraṇa tva ayogāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāt || ||
analyzed: rūpa ādimat tvāt ca viparyayaḥ darśanāt

original: evaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamubhyupetya tadāraṃbhakavādo dūṣitaḥ| idānīṃ nityatvamapākurvatsūtramupanyasyāti ||
analyzed: evam paramāṇūnām nitya tvam ubhyupetya tad āraṃbhaka vādaḥ dūṣitaḥ idānīm nitya tvam apākurvat sūtram upanyasya āti

original: || || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || kiṃca vaiśeṣikamate pārthivāpyataijasaparamāṇūnāṃ rūpādimattvāt| viparyayaḥ nityatvaviparītānityatvaṃ syāt| kutaḥ| darśanāt yadrūpādimattadanityamiti vyāpteḥ ghaṭādau dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: rūpa ādimat tvāt ca viparyayaḥ darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ kiṃca vaiśeṣika mate pārthiva āpya taijasa paramāṇūnām rūpa ādimat tvāt viparyayaḥ nitya tva viparīta anitya tvam syāt kutas darśanāt yat rūpa ādimat tat anityam iti vyāpteḥ ghaṭa ādau dṛṣṭa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca vastutastu na paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamupapadyate| prākṛtarūpatvenāvaśyaṃ bhāvāt| dṛśyate khalu loke yatprākṛtarūpādimattadanityamiti| pārthivāpyataijasaparamāṇūnāṃ bhautikarūparasagaṃdhasparśavattvādanityatvaṃ| tataśca paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvābhāvenoktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca vastutas tu na paramāṇūnām nitya tvam upapadyate prākṛta rūpa tvena avaśyam bhāvāt dṛśyate khalu loke yat prākṛta rūpa ādimat tat anityam iti pārthiva āpya taijasa paramāṇūnām bhautika rūpa rasa gaṃdha sparśavat tvāt anitya tvam tatas ca paramāṇūnām nitya tva abhāvena uktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || ||
analyzed: ubhayathā ca doṣāt

original: nanu yadrūpādimattadanityamiti sāmānyavyāptiḥ| yanniravayavaṃ dravyaṃ tannityamiti viśeṣavyāptirbalavatī| atastayā bādhitatvena rūpādimattvaṃ paramāṇūnāmanityatvaṃ na sādhayet| astu vā paramāṇūnāṃ sāditvaṃ| tathā'pi na dvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| pāramāṇūnāṃ kāraṇāṃtareṇotpattau tebhyo d‌vyaṇukādyutpattisaṃbhavāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu yat rūpa ādimat tat anityam iti sāmānya vyāptiḥ yat niravayavam dravyam tat nityam iti viśeṣa vyāptiḥ balavatī atas tayā bādhita tvena rūpa ādimat tvam paramāṇūnām anitya tvam na sādhayet astu vā paramāṇūnām sādi tvam tathā api na dvyaṇuka ādi kārya abhāvaḥ pāramāṇūnām kāraṇa aṃtareṇa utpattau tebhyaḥ dvyaṇuka ādi utpatti saṃbhavāt iti prāpte parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || ubhayathāca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣika ubhayathā ca maramāṇunityatvānityatvarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| doṣāt tadvatsarvanityatvakāraṇābhāvanimittakatadutpattibhāvasya doṣasattvāt na tatpakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ubhayathā ca doṣāt iti asya arthaḥ vaiśeṣikaḥ ubhayathā ca maramāṇu nitya tva anitya tva rūpa pakṣa dvaye api doṣāt tadvat sarva nitya tva kāraṇa abhāva nimittaka tad utpatti bhāvasya doṣa sattvāt na tad pakṣaḥ yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yaduktaṃ| yadrūpādimattadanityamiti sāmānyavyāptiriti| tanna| rūpādimatyanityatvāpavādakasya viśeṣapramāṇasyābhāvāt| na ca niravayavatvaṃ viśeṣapramāṇaṃ| rūpādimattvena paramāṇau tadabhāvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| yadapyanityatve doṣābhāva iti| tanna|
analyzed: evam ca yat uktam yat rūpa ādimat tat anityam iti sāmānya vyāptiḥ iti tat na rūpa ādimati anitya tva apavādakasya viśeṣa pramāṇasya abhāvāt na ca niravayava tvam viśeṣa pramāṇam rūpa ādimat tvena paramāṇau tad abhāvasya api sādhayitum śakya tvāt yat api anitya tve doṣa abhāvaḥ iti tat na

original: tvanmate paramāṇūnāṃ kāraṇāsaṃbhavenānutpattau d‌vyaṇukādikāryānutpattiprasaṃgalakṣaṇabādhakasadbhāvāt| evaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi doṣaduṣṭatvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tvad mate paramāṇūnām kāraṇa asaṃbhavena anutpattau dvyaṇuka ādi kārya anutpatti prasaṃga lakṣaṇa bādhaka sadbhāvāt evam pakṣa dvaye api doṣa duṣṭa tvena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || || aparigrahāccātyaṃtamanapekṣā || ||
analyzed: aparigrahāt ca atyaṃtam anapekṣā

original: evaṃ prapaṃcena dūṣitaṃ paramāṇvāraṃbhavādamaprāmāṇikatvenāpi dūṣayatsūtramāha ||

original: || || aparigrahāccātyaṃtamanapekṣeti || asyārthaḥ || aparigrahāt vaiśeṣikamatasya śrutyādiparigrahaśūnyatvāt tadviruddhatvācca| tatrātyaṃtamanapekṣā anādaraḥ kārya ityarthaḥ ||

analyzed: pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodha aprāptiḥ avicchedāt iti asya arthaḥ evam kṣaṇika mate pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodha aprāptiḥ pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodhayoḥ prati kṣaṇa vināśa saṃtāna avināśayoḥ aprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ kutas avicchedāt tad rītyā kārya utpattau akāryāṇām ca avicchinna tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paramate vināśo na yujyate| tanmate vināśo dvividhaḥ| kāryamutpādya tadapahāya tatkṣaṇe nāśaḥ| tasyāpyevamevamiti pratikṣaṇaṃ nāśaḥ| sa eva saṃtānavināśo'pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti gīyate| saṃtānaṃ vinaiva kāraṇasya naṣṭatvāt| aparastu kāryamutpādya tena sahaiva mudgarapraharādinākṣaṇamātre nāśaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca para mate vināśaḥ na yujyate tad mate vināśaḥ dvividhaḥ kāryam utpādya tat apahāya tad kṣaṇe nāśaḥ tasya api evam evam iti pratikṣaṇam nāśaḥ saḥ eva saṃtāna vināśa upratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti gīyate saṃtānam vinā eva kāraṇasya naṣṭa tvāt aparaḥ tu kāryam utpādya tena saha eva mudgara prahara ādinā akṣaṇa mātre nāśaḥ

original: sa eva saṃtānanāśaḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti ca gīyate| tatrādyastāvannayujyate| kāryamutpādya tatparityāgasamaye sattvena tataśca kāryajanakatvamiti niyamātkāryamevotpādayenna naśyet| tadviyogasamaye'pyevamiti na kadāpi niḥsaṃtāno nāśaḥ| nāpi saṃtānavināśo yujyate| sato ghaṭasya hyātyaṃtiko vināśaḥ| ato'sau sattvātkāryamutpādayenna tu naśyet|
analyzed: saḥ eva saṃtāna nāśaḥ pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti ca gīyate tatra ādyaḥ tāvat na yujyate kāryam utpādya tad parityāga samaye sattvena tatas ca kārya janaka tvam iti niyamāt kāryam eva utpādayet na naśyet tad viyoga samaye pi evam iti na kadāpi niḥsaṃtānaḥ nāśaḥ na api saṃtāna vināśaḥ yujyate sataḥ ghaṭasya hi ātyaṃtikaḥ vināśaḥ atas asau sattvāt kāryam utpādayet na tu naśyet

original: evamuttaratrāpi sattvātkāryamevotpādayenna tu naśyediti sasaṃtānocchedāvasarābhāvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam uttaratra api sattvāt kāryam eva utpādayet na tu naśyet iti sa saṃtāna uccheda avasara abhāvāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || ||
analyzed: ubhayathā ca doṣāt

original: nanvathā'pi satāṃ bhāvapadārthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ niṣedbhuṃ na śakyaṃ| sattvaṃ nāmārthakriyākāritvaṃ| na ca ṇikatāmaṃtareṇa tadupapannaṃ| yadi ghaṭa ādyakṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramutpādya svayaṃ na naśyettarhi dvitīyādikṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramapi janayet| ghaṭāṃtarāṇyapi tathetyanaṃtakāryāpātaḥ|
analyzed: nanu atha api satām bhāva padārthānām kṣaṇika tvam niṣedbhum na śakyam sattvam nāma arthakriyā kāri tvam na ca ṇikatām aṃtareṇa tat upapannam yadi ghaṭaḥ ādya kṣaṇe ghaṭa aṃtaram utpādya svayam na naśyet tarhi dvitīya ādi kṣaṇe ghaṭa aṃtaram api janayet ghaṭa aṃtarāṇi api tathā iti anaṃta kārya āpātaḥ

original: tasmādarthakriyākāritvarūpasattvasidhyai bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvameṣṭevyamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: tasmāt arthakriyā kāri tva rūpa sattva sidhyai bhāvānām kṣaṇika tvam eṣṭevyam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || ubhayathā ca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamapakṣe tadabhāvapakṣe ca| doṣasattvāt kāryakāraṇaviśeṣakāryānutpattyākhyadoṣāt| nānyatarapakṣāvalaṃbenārthāpattyā kṣaṇikapakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ubhayathā ca doṣāt iti asya arthaḥ ubhayathā kāraṇe sati kāryam bhavati eva iti niyama pakṣe tad abhāva pakṣe ca doṣa sattvāt kārya kāraṇa viśeṣa kārya anutpatti ākhya doṣāt na anyatara pakṣa avalaṃbena arthāpattyā kṣaṇika pakṣaḥ yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvāṃgīkāre tatrārthakriyākāritvaṃ sattvaṃ| tadanyathā'nupapattyā kṣaṇikatvamiti vadatā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti yo niyama āśritaḥ sa kiṃ vāstavo na vā| ādye kāryakāraṇayoḥ savyetaraviṣāṇavatsamānakālīnatvena kāryakāraṇabhāvo na syāt| dvitīye prathamakṣaṇe kāryānutpādakatve nārthakriyākāritvābhāvādasattvaṃ syāt|
analyzed: evaṃca bhāvānām kṣaṇika tva aṃgīkāre tatra arthakriyā kāri tvam sattvam tad anyathā anupapattyā kṣaṇika tvam iti vadatā kāraṇe sati kāryam bhavati eva iti yaḥ niyamaḥ āśritaḥ sa kim vāstavaḥ na vā ādye kārya kāraṇayoḥ savyetara viṣāṇa vat samāna kālīna tvena kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na syāt dvitīye prathama kṣaṇe kārya anutpādaka tve na arthakriyā kāri tva abhāvāt asattvam syāt

original: tataḥ kadā'pi kāryotpattirna syāt| tataśca sattvānyathā'nupapattyā kalpyamānaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ ca na syāt| anena parapakṣa evobhayathā doṣasattvādasmatpakṣe doṣābhāvāditi maṃtavyaṃ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ|
analyzed: tatas kadāpi kārya utpattiḥ na syāt tatas ca sattva anyathā anupapattyā kalpyamānam kṣaṇikatvam ca na syāt anena para pakṣe evā ubhayathā doṣa sattvāt asmad pakṣe doṣa abhāvāt iti maṃtavyam atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ākāśe cāviśeṣāt || ||
analyzed: ākāśe ca aviśeṣāt

original: nanu mābhūdarthāpattyā kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| yatsattatkṣaṇikaṃ| yathā dīpādi| saṃtaścāmī bhāvāḥ padārthā ityanumānena setsyati| na ca vācyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalateti| yadviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ tannānā yathā ghaṭapaṭau| tathā cāyaṃ dīpaḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣadarśanāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu mā abhūt arthāpattyā kṣaṇikatva siddhiḥ yat sat tat kṣaṇikam yathā dīpa ādi saṃtaḥ ca amī bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ iti anumānena setsyati na ca vācyam dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhya vikala tā iti yat viruddha dharma adhikaraṇam tat nānā yathā ghaṭa paṭau tathā ca ayam dīpaḥ pūrva uttara kṣaṇa viruddha dharma adhikaraṇam viśeṣa darśanāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || ākāśe cāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'pyarthe| dīpadṛṣṭāṃtena sattvahetunā jagati kṣaṇikatvasādhane ākāśadṛṣṭāṃtenākṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhanāpātaḥ| nanu dṛṣṭāte sādhyavaikalyamityata uktaṃ| ākāśe aviśeṣāditi| kṣaṇikatvasādhakatvena paroktaparimāmaviśeṣādarśanādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ākāśe ca aviśeṣāt iti asya arthaḥ copi arthe dīpa dṛṣṭāṃtena sattva hetunā jagati kṣaṇikatva sādhane ākāśa dṛṣṭāṃtena akṣaṇika tvasya api sādhanāpātaḥ nanu dṛṣṭāte sādhya vaikalyam iti atas uktam ākāśe aviśeṣāt iti kṣaṇikatva sādhaka tvena para ukta parimām aviśeṣa adarśanāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca satpratipakṣo'yaṃ heturiti na tena kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā ca sat pratipakṣaḥ yam hetuḥ iti na tena kṣaṇikatva siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca yatsattadakṣaṇikaṃ yathā''kāśamityakṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| na cākāśe sādhyābhāvaḥ| viśeṣadarśanābhāvena kṣaṇikatvasādhakābhāvāt| na ca hetvaṃtareṇa tatsiddhiḥ| paṃcamaskaṃdhātiriktatvena tatra tadanabhyupagamāt| ākāśe sattvaṃ nāstīti cet| kimidaṃ sattvaṃ yadākāśe nāsti| arthakriyākāritvaṃ cet|
analyzed: evam ca yat sat tat akṣaṇikam yathā ākāśam iti akṣaṇika tvasya api sādhayitum śakya tvāt na ca ākāśe sādhya abhāvaḥ viśeṣa darśana abhāvena kṣaṇikatva sādhaka abhāvāt na ca hetu aṃtareṇa tad siddhiḥ paṃcama skaṃdha atirikta tvena tatra tad anabhyupagamāt ākāśe sattvam na asti iti ced kim idam sattvam yat ākāśe na asti arthakriyā kāri tvam ced

original: tvanbhate pūrvoktarītyā kasyāpyarthākriyākāritvābhāvenāsiddhiḥ| sādhanavikalatā ca nidarśanasya| atha svarūpeṇeti vidyamānatā'bhāvarūpatā vā| sāpyākāśe'styeveti vyabhicāro duṣparihāraḥ| ataḥ sattvahetoḥ svenaiva pratipakṣitatvānnānenāpi kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tu anbhate pūrvokta rītyā kasya api artha akriyā kāri tva abhāvena asiddhiḥ sādhana vikala tā ca nidarśanasya atha sva rūpeṇa iti vidyamāna tā bhāva rūpa tā vā sā api ākāśā īsti eva iti vyabhicāraḥ duṣparihāraḥ atas sattva hetoḥ svena eva pratipakṣita tvāt na anena api kṣaṇikatva siddhiḥ atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || anusmṛteśca || ||
analyzed: anusmṛteḥ ca

original: evaṃ pratipakṣeṇa sattvānumānaṃ nirasya pramāṇabādhenāpi nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam pratipakṣeṇa sattva anumānam nirasya pramāṇa bādhena api nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || anusmṛteśceti|| asyārthaḥ || tadevedamiti pratyabhijñānācca tadvirodhāt na sattvahetunā kṣaṇikatvasādhanaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anusmṛteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ tat eva idam iti pratyabhijñānāt ca tad virodhāt na sattva hetunā kṣaṇikatva sādhanam yuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca so'yaṃ ghaṭa iti pratijñāvirodhaḥ| tathā syāyitvasiddheḥ| na ca pratijñābhrāṃtiḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| ghaṭo'yaṃ niraṃtarottarakṣaṇavṛttidhvaṃsapratiyogī ghaṭatvāt musalāhataikakṣaṇavṛttivaṭavaditi coktarītyā parāstaṃ| kiṃca ghaṭaśabdena paramāṇūṃllakṣayitvā ghaṭatvaśabdena paramāṇutvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate|
analyzed: evam ca saḥ yam ghaṭaḥ iti pratijñā virodhaḥ tathā syāyitva siddheḥ na ca pratijñā bhrāṃtiḥ bādhaka abhāvāt ghaṭaḥ yam niraṃtara uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti dhvaṃsa pratiyogī ghaṭa tvāt musala āhata eka kṣaṇa vṛtti vaṭa vat iti ca ukta rītyā parāstam kiṃca ghaṭa śabdena paramāṇūn lakṣayitvā ghaṭa tva śabdena paramāṇu tvam eva hetutayā vivakṣyate

original: uta samudāyamaiva pakṣīkṛtya ghaṭatvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate| nādyaḥ| musalāhatasya ghaṭasya samudāyatvena paramāṇutvābhāvāt| tatra hetvabhāvena vyāptigrahaṇābāvaprasaṃgāt| na dvitīyaḥ| sata eva tvayā kṣaṇikatvasya sādhanīyatvenāvastunastatsādhanasyānupayuktatvāt|
analyzed: uta samudāyam ā eva pakṣīkṛtya ghaṭa tvam eva hetutayā vivakṣyate na ādyaḥ musala āhatasya ghaṭasya samudāya tvena paramāṇu tva abhāvāt tatra hetu abhāvena vyāpti grahaṇa abāva prasaṃgāt na dvitīyaḥ sataḥ eva tvayā kṣaṇikatvasya sādhanīya tvena avastunaḥ tad sādhanasya anupayukta tvāt

original: ato vaibhāṣikasaitrāṃtikamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktamīśvarasyāśeṣajagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas vaibhāṣika saitrāṃtika matasya anupapanna tvena avirodhaka tvāt yuktam īśvarasya aśeṣa jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || iti samudāyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti samudāya adhikaraṇam

original: atra śūnyavādo nirākriyate|
analyzed: atra śūnyavādaḥ nirākriyate

original: || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāt || ||
analyzed: na asataḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt

original: nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| śūnyasamayaviruddhatvāt| ekameva śūnyamataṃ| tatra parahitaṃ paramārthasat| tasmādevāśeṣaṃ jagadupaiti| na cāsaṃgasya tadanupapattiḥ| saṃvṛttisaṃbaṃdhena tadupapatteḥ| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| tatprāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt| tataśca śūnyasamayaviruddhatvādayuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam śūnya samaya viruddha tvāt ekam eva śūnya matam tatra para hitam paramārtha sat tasmāt eva aśeṣam jagat upaiti na ca asaṃgasya tad anupapattiḥ saṃvṛtti saṃbaṃdhena tad upapatteḥ na ca śruti virodhaḥ tad prāmāṇya anabhyupagamāt tatas ca śūnya samaya viruddha tvāt ayuktam viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || asataḥ śūnyasya| na jagatkartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| pramāṇābhāvāditi śeṣaḥ| tatkutaḥ| adṛṣṭatvāt| kvāpyasataḥ kāraṇatvādarśanāt| ata evānumānāmayorapyabhāvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na asataḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt iti asya arthaḥ asataḥ śūnyasya na jagat kartṛ tvam yuktam kutas pramāṇa abhāvāt iti śeṣaḥ tat kutas adṛṣṭa tvāt kvāpi asataḥ kāraṇatva adarśanāt atas eva anumāna āmayoḥ api abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| sūnyasamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| śūnyameva jagatkāraṇamityatra pramāṇābhāvāt| pramāṇaṃ bhavatprayakṣaṃ vā'numānaṃ vā''gamo vā syāt| na tāvatpratyakṣaṃ| śūnyakāraṇatvasyāpratyakṣatvāt| nāpyanumānaṃ| dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvāt| ghaṭādāveva kāraṇatvadarśane'pi nāsau dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam sūnya samayasya aprāmāṇika tvāt śūnyam eva jagat kāraṇam iti atra pramāṇa abhāvāt pramāṇam bhavat prayakṣam vā anumānam vā āgamaḥ vā syāt na tāvat pratyakṣam śūnya kāraṇatvasya apratyakṣa tvāt na api anumānam dṛṣṭāṃta abhāvāt ghaṭa ādau eva kāraṇatva darśane pi na asau dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ

original: tasya tvanmate'sattvenāsati prativādinā kāraṇatvasyānupalabdhatvena kāraṇatvābhāvasyānumātuṃ śakyatvena sādhyavaikalyāt| āgamo'pi bauddhādyāgamo vā vedādirvā bhavet| nādyaḥ| tatprāmāṇyasya prativādino'saṃmateḥ| na dvitīyaḥ| tatprāmāṇyasya vādyasaṃpratipatteḥ| tathāvidhavedānupalaṃbhācca|
analyzed: tasya tvad mate sattvena asati prativādinā kāraṇa tvasya anupalabdha tvena kāraṇa tva abhāvasya anumātum śakya tvena sādhya vaikalyāt āgamaḥ api bauddha ādi āgamaḥ vā veda ādiḥ vā bhavet na ādyaḥ tad prāmāṇyasya prativādinā usaṃmateḥ na dvitīyaḥ tad prāmāṇyasya vādi asaṃpratipatteḥ tathāvidha veda anupalaṃbhāt ca

original: ataḥ śūnyamatasyāyuktatveneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas śūnya matasya ayukta tvena īśvarasya jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti siddham

original: || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiḥ || ||
analyzed: udāsīnānām api ca evam siddhiḥ

original: nanvadṛṣṭamapi jagatkāraṇatvaṃ sūnyasyābhyupagate ko doṣaḥ| na coktamadṛṣṭatvādevāprāmāṇikatvānnāṃgīkārārhateti| nādṛṣṭatvena dṛṣṭānumānānupattāvapi sāmānyato dṛṣṭatvopapatteḥ| kāraṇasya hi kāryavadvastutvena sattve niṣiddhe kāryatvena hetunā'sata eva janma setsyatītyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu adṛṣṭam api jagat kāraṇatvam sūnyasya abhyupagate kaḥ doṣaḥ na ca uktam adṛṣṭa tvāt eva aprāmāṇika tvāt na aṃgīkāra arha tā iti na adṛṣṭa tvena dṛṣṭa anumāna anupattau api sāmānyatas dṛṣṭa tva upapatteḥ kāraṇasya hi kārya vat vastu tvena sattve niṣiddhe kārya tvena hetunā asataḥ eva janma setsyati iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiriti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ satyasataḥ kāryotpādakatveṃ'gīkṛte sati| udāsīnānāṃ heyopādeyatvabudhyaviṣayāṇāṃ gaganakusumādīnāṃ sakāśādapi sāraibhyādikāryasiddhiḥ syādityarthaḥ| anyathā śūnyādapi kāryotpattirna syāditi ca śabdārthaḥ ||
analyzed: udāsīnānām api ca evam siddhiḥ iti asya arthaḥ evam sati asataḥ kārya utpādaka tva iṃgīkṛte sati udāsīnānām heya upādeya tva budhyaviṣayāṇām gagana kusuma ādīnām sakāśāt api sāraibhya ādi kārya siddhiḥ syāt iti arthaḥ anyathā śūnyāt api kārya utpattiḥ na syāt iti ca śabda arthaḥ

original: aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca| aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryatvāt| avacchedakaśarīraṃ vinā avacchedyaparimāṇasattvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ| parimāṇameva kuta ityato'pyāha| aṃtyeti|

original: aṃtyasya mauktikātmasvarūpasya muktāvasthiteravaśyaṃ svarūpasattvasya parimāṇaṃ vinā'yogāditi bhāvaḥ| astu mokṣe'pi śarīraṃ tataḥ kimityata uktaṃ| ubhayanityatvāditi| tathā sati ubhayoḥ muktikālīnayordehātmanornityatvaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ| astu mauktikaśarīranityatvaṃ tataḥ kimityata āha| tataśca sarvanityatvaṃ syādityāpādyavākyamadhyāhāryaṃ|

original: ata eva samuccayārthakaśca śabdaḥ sarveṣāmadhunātanaśarīrāṇāṃ nityatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha| aviśeṣāditi| muktikālīnānāṃ adhunātanānāṃ ca śarīrāṇāṃ śarīratvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ| tasmānna kāyaparimāṇatvamātmano yuktamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: atas eva samuccaya arthakaḥ ca śabdaḥ sarveṣām adhunātana śarīrāṇām nitya tvam syāt iti arthaḥ kutas iti atas āha aviśeṣāt iti mukti kālīnānām adhunātanānām ca śarīrāṇām śarīra tva aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ tasmāt na kāya parimāṇa tvam ātmanaḥ yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca jīvasya mokṣe parimāṇābhāva cedātmasvarūpābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| na hi parimāṇaśūnyaṃ dravyamasti| asti ceccharīramaṃtareṇa parimāṇāyogāt| tatrāpi taccharīramanityaṃ cetsaṃsārasamānadharmatāpātaḥ| nityaṃ ceccharīratvāviśeṣādidānīṃtanaśarīramapi nityaṃ syāt| ato nātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatvapakṣo yuktaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca jīvasya mokṣe ced ātma svarūpa abhāva prasaṃgaḥ na hi parimāṇa śūnyam dravyam asti asti ced śarīram aṃtareṇa parimāṇa ayogāt tatra api tat śarīram anityam ced saṃsāra samāna dharmatā āpātaḥ nityam ced śarīra tva aviśeṣāt idānīṃtana śarīram api nityam syāt atas na ātmanaḥ kāya parimāṇa tva pakṣaḥ yuktaḥ

original: tasmājjainamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || iti nekasminnadhikaraṇaṃ ||

analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam pāśupata samaya viruddha tvāt paśupatiḥ khalu sārvajñya ādi guṇa śālī māyām upādānīkṛtya hari hiraṇyagarbha ādi jagat utpatti ādi sarvam karoti śruti smṛtayaḥ ca asmin arthe bhavanti atas lakṣaṇa sūtram ayuktam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || patyurasāmaṃjasyāditi || asyārthaḥ || patyuḥ paśupateḥ| jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| asāmaṃjasyāt pārataṃtryotpattyādidoṣavattvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: patyuḥ asāmaṃjasyāt iti asya arthaḥ patyuḥ paśupateḥ jagat kāraṇatvam na yuktam kutas asāmaṃjasyāt pārataṃtrya utpatti ādi doṣavattvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| pāśupatasamayasyāpramāṇikatvāt| na paśupatirgatkartā| pārataṃtryajananamaraṇadoṣaduṣṭatvāt| na cāsiddho hetuḥ| yaṃ kāmaye taṃ tamugramiti śrutisiddhatvāt| api caiko nārāyaṇa āsīditi śrutyā pralaye paśupaterabhāvāvagamāt| tataśca pāśupatasamayasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yuktam viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam pāśupata samayasya apramāṇika tvāt na paśupatiḥ gat kartā pārataṃtrya janana maraṇa doṣa duṣṭatvāt na ca asiddhaḥ hetuḥ yam kāmaye tam tam ugram iti śruti siddha tvāt api ca ekaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ āsīt iti śrutyā pralaye paśupateḥ abhāva avagamāt tatas ca pāśupata samayasya anupapanna tvena avirodhaka tvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśca || ||

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||

original: || || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || śivasyāśarīratvena jagatā saṃbaṃdhānupapatte na tasya kartṛtvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃbaṃdha anupapatteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ śivasya aśarīra tvena jagatā saṃbaṃdha anupapatte na tasya kartṛ tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na kevalaṃ pārataṃtryādeḥ kiṃtvaśarīratvācca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogāt| na hyaśarīrasya kartṛtvaṃ dṛśyate yena tasya tathā bhavet| na ca kāryeṇa jagatā'pi saṃbaṃdhamātramaśarīrasyāpi saṃbhavati gaganāderghaṭādisaṃyogavaditi vācyaṃ| tyaktadehapuruṣavatkartṛtvarūpasaṃbaṃdhābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca na kevalam pārataṃtrya ādeḥ kiṃtu aśarīra tvāt ca paśupateḥ jagat kartṛ tva ayogāt na hi aśarīrasya kartṛ tvam dṛśyate yena tasya tathā bhavet na ca kāryeṇa jagatā api saṃbaṃdha mātram aśarīrasya api saṃbhavati gagana ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi saṃyoga vat iti vācyam tyakta deha puruṣa vat kartṛ tva rūpa saṃbaṃdha abhāvāt

original: tataśca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśca || ||

original: hetvaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: hetu aṃtareṇa paśupateḥ jagat kāraṇatvam parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || pralaye sarveṣāṃ naṣṭatvātpunaḥ sṛṣṭikāle paśupateḥ pṛthivyādyāśrayānupapatteśca na tasya jagatkartṛtvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: adhiṣṭhāna anupapatteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ pralaye sarveṣām naṣṭa tvāt punar sṛṣṭi kāle paśupateḥ pṛthivī ādi āśraya anupapatteḥ ca na tasya jagatkartṛ tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paśupateradhiṣṭhānānupalaṃbhena kartṛtvāyogāt| pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhāne sthitasya kulālāderghaṭādikāryadarśanenāsya tadabhāvāt| sautrahetunā vyatirekavyāpteḥ sāmānyataḥ pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhānadṛṣṭāṃtena darśitatvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca paśupateḥ adhiṣṭhāna anupalaṃbhena kartṛ tva ayogāt pṛthivī ādi adhiṣṭhāne sthitasya kulāla ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi kārya darśanena asya tad abhāvāt sautra hetunā vyatireka vyāpteḥ sāmānyatas pṛthivī ādi adhiṣṭhāna dṛṣṭāṃtena darśita tvāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

analyzed: nanu na pralaya kāle nitya tayā vidyamānam prakṛti ādikam sākṣāt prayatna adhiṣṭheya tayā śarīra ādi vat na ca sākṣāt prayatna adhiṣṭheya preraṇāya śarīra apekṣā śarīra preraṇa artham api śarora aṃtara apekṣā prasaṃgāt atas śarīra ādi pratinidhi sadbhāvāt kartṛ tvam upapannam iti prāpte sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || nanu yataḥ sādhanajātaṃ paśupateḥ kāraṇavat śarīravat| śarīreṇatulyaṃ adhiṣṭhānatulyaṃ ca ato noktadoṣa iti cenna| kutaḥ| bhogādibhyaḥ śarīrakṛtasukhaduḥkhabhogotpattimaraṇādidoṣebhya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: karaṇavat ced na bhoga ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ nanu yatas sādhana jātam paśupateḥ kāraṇavat śarīravat śarīreṇa tulyam adhiṣṭhāna tulyam ca atas na ukta doṣaḥ iti ced na kutas bhoga ādibhyaḥ śarīra kṛta sukha duḥkha bhoga utpatti maraṇa ādi doṣebhyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca kārakasamūhasya śarīratulyatvena śarīropādānaparityāgābhyāṃ jananamaraṇavattadupādānaparityāgābhyāmapi jananamaraṇaprasaṃgāt| tataśca sukhaduḥkhabhogaprāpteḥ| yajñadattādeḥ sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheyavikārātmakaśarīropādānahānayoḥ satostīnnamittayorutpattivināśayordarśanāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca kāraka samūhasya śarīra tulya tvena śarīra upādāna parityāgābhyām janana maraṇa vat tad upādāna parityāgābhyām api janana maraṇa prasaṃgāt tatas ca sukha duḥkha bhoga prāpteḥ yajñadatta ādeḥ sākṣāt prayatna adhiṣṭheya vikāra ātmaka śarīra upādāna hānayoḥ satoḥ tīnna mittayoḥ utpatti vināśayoḥ darśanāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || aṃtavattvamasarvajñatā vā || ||
analyzed: aṃtavat tvam asarvajña tā vā

original: saṃbaṃdhānupapatteḥ, karaṇavacca, ityābhyāmuktaśarīrabhāvābhāvapakṣāveva vikalpabhaṃgya doṣāṃtareṇa dūṣayatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: saṃbaṃdha anupapatteḥ karaṇa vat ca iti ābhyām ukta śarīra bhāva abhāva pakṣau eva vikalpa bhaṃgya doṣa aṃtareṇa dūṣayat sūtram paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe

original: || || aṃtavattvamasarvajñatāveti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ śivasya dehitvatadabhāvapakṣayoḥ krameṇāṃtavattvaṃ nāśavattvaṃ asarvajñatā na sarvajñatvaṃ syāt ato na tadyuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aṃtavat tvam asarvajña tā vā iti asya arthaḥ yatas śivasya dehi tva tad abhāva pakṣayoḥ krameṇa aṃtavat tvam nāśavat tvam asarvajña tā na sarvajña tvam syāt atas na tat yuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāṃgīkāre tasya śarīravattvapakṣe vināśaprasaṃgaḥ tadabhāve tu jñānābhāvaḥ| na caite doṣā viṣṇupakṣe'pi buddhimānmanovānityādiśrutyā jñānābhāvasya parihṛtatvāt| yadātmako bhagavānityādināṃ'tavattvādidoṣāṇāṃ nirastatvāt| tatra bhagavaddehasya tatsvarūpatvajñānādyātmakatvenoktatvāt|
