original: ataḥ puruṣasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhaghaṭako'śmānayanādiśaktiprada īśvaroṃ'gīkārya iti kathaṃ na dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhyavikalaḥ| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas puruṣasya śarīra saṃbaṃdha ghaṭa kośma ānayana ādi śakti pradaḥ īśvara ūṃgīkāryaḥ iti katham na dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhya vikalaḥ atas jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam yuktam iti siddham

original: || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasaṃ || ||
analyzed: vipratiṣedhāt ca asamaṃjasam

original: evaṃ pratyekaṃ dūṣitānyanīśvaramatāni sāmānyadūṣaṇenāpi nirākurvatsūtra paṭhati ||
analyzed: evam pratyekam dūṣitāni anīśvara matāni sāmānya dūṣaṇena api nirākurvat sūtra paṭhati

original: || || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasamiti || asyārthaḥ || vipratiṣedhāt sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvādanīśvaramataṃ asamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vipratiṣedhāt ca asamaṃjasam iti asya arthaḥ vipratiṣedhāt sakala śruti smṛti yukti viruddha tvāt anīśvara matam asamaṃjasam ayuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dyāvābhūmī janayan | yato vā | ya sarvajña ityādiśrutīnāṃ utpattisthitisaṃhārāḥ| sraṣṭā pātā tathaivāttā| ityādi smṛtīnāṃ| vimataṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt| ciccaittye kenacinniyete'svataṃtratvāt| ityādiyuktīnāṃ ca virodhena prakṛtisvātaṃtryādirūpamarthaṃ vadato'nyonīco nāstīti vacanāt|
analyzed: evam ca dyāvābhūmī janayan yatas vā sarvajñaḥ ityādi śrutīnām utpatti sthiti saṃhārāḥ sraṣṭā pātā tathā eva attā ityādi smṛtīnām vimatam sa kartṛkam kārya tvāt cit caittye kenacid niyeta isvataṃtra tvāt ityādi yuktīnām ca virodhena prakṛti svātaṃtrya ādi rūpam artham vadataḥ anyaḥ nīcaḥ na asti iti vacanāt

original: tataśca sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvātsarvamapyanīśvaramatamapramāṇaṃ| ato na sāṃkhyādimatavirodhena na lakṣaṇāsaṃbhava iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ca sakala śruti smṛti yukti viruddha tvāt sarvam api anīśvara matam apramāṇam atas na sāṃkhya ādi mata virodhena na lakṣaṇa asaṃbhavaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti anyathā'numityadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti anyathā anumiti adhikaraṇam

original: atra paramāṇvāraṃbhavādo'pākriyate|
analyzed: atra paramāṇu āraṃbha vādā upākriyate

original: || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāṃ || ||
analyzed: mahat dīrghavat vā hrasva parimaṃḍalābhyām

original: nanu dravyādipadārthāḥ saptaiva| tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivyādinavaiva| guṇāstu rūpādicaturviṃśatireva| karma cotkṣepaṇādipaṃcavidhaṃ| sāmānyamanekavidhaṃ| jātirūpamupādhirūpaṃ ca samavāyastveka eva| viśeṣāstvanaṃtāḥ| etattritayaṃ nityameva| tatrānityaṃ kāraṇatritayajanyaṃ| yatsamavetaṃ kāryamutpadyate tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ| paramāṇvādidravyameva|
analyzed: nanu dravya ādi padārthāḥ sapta eva tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivī ādi nava eva guṇāḥ tu rūpa ādi caturviṃśatiḥ eva karma ca utkṣepaṇa ādi paṃcavidham sāmānyam anekavidham jāti rūpam upādhi rūpam ca samavāyaḥ tu ekaḥ eva viśeṣāḥ tu anaṃtāḥ etat tritayam nityam eva tatra anityam kāraṇa tritaya janyam yat samavetam kāryam utpadyate tat samavāyi kāraṇam paramāṇu ādi dravyam eva

original: tatra paramāṇavo dvyaṇukādikrameṇāvayavinamārabhaṃte| samavāyikāraṇapratyāsannamavadhṛtasāmarthyasamavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra kāryadravyasyāvayavasaṃyoga eva kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati| kāraṇaguṇakarma ca kāryaguṇānāṃ kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ|
analyzed: tatra paramāṇavaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi krameṇa avayavinam ārabhaṃte samavāyi kāraṇa pratyāsannam avadhṛta sāmarthya samavāyi kāraṇam tatra kārya dravyasya avayava saṃyogaḥ eva kārya ekārtha pratyāsattyā asamavāyi kāraṇam bhavati kāraṇa guṇa karma ca kārya guṇānām kārya ekārtha pratyāsattyā asamavāyi kāraṇam

original: karmaṇaśca kāraṇagataguṇakarmaṇi kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra parimāṇaṃ kāraṇagataṃ| kāryagataparimāṇasthāsamavayikāraṇaṃ bhavati| paramāṇud‌vyaṇukatūlagataṃ parimāṇaṃ na d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukatūlapiṃḍagatāḥ parimāṇāḥ asamavāyakāraṇaṃ| kiṃtu d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukagatasaṃkhyayaiva| tūlapiṃḍaparimāṇaṃ tu pracayena bhavati|
analyzed: karmaṇaḥ ca kāraṇa gata guṇa karmaṇi kārya ekārtha pratyāsattyā asamavāyi kāraṇam tatra parimāṇam kāraṇa gatam kārya gata parimāṇa stha asamavayi kāraṇam bhavati paramāṇu dvyaṇuka tūla gatam parimāṇam na dvyaṇuka tryaṇuka tūla piṃḍa gatāḥ parimāṇāḥ asamavāya kāraṇam kiṃtu dvyaṇuka tryaṇuka gata saṃkhyayā eva tūla piṃḍa parimāṇam tu pracayena bhavati

original: etadanyatkāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ| īśvarādṛṣṭakālādi| tatreśvara ātmaviśeṣaḥ| ātmā ca saṃkhyādicaturdaśaguṇayuktaḥ| parameśvarastu saṃkhyādipaṃcaguṇakaḥ| kartṛtvopayogijñānecchā prayatnaśālī ca śiṣṭaṣaḍ‌guṇāyogya iti kathaṃ tasyānaṃtaguṇakttvaṃ yuktaṃ| ato vyartha eva pūrvādhyāya iti prāpte sūtritaṃ|
analyzed: etad anyat kāraṇam nimittam īśvara adṛṣṭa kāla ādi tatra īśvaraḥ ātma viśeṣaḥ ātmā ca saṃkhyā ādi caturdaśa guṇa yuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ tu saṃkhyā ādi paṃca guṇakaḥ kartṛ tva upayogi jñāna icchā prayatna śālī ca śiṣṭa ṣaḍguṇa ayogyaḥ iti katham tasya anaṃta guṇakt tvam yuktam atas vyarthaḥ eva pūrva adhyāyaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || mahaddīrghavat vaiśeṣikamate tryaṇukādigatānmahattvāt dīrghatvācca caturaṇukādigataparimāṇamutpadyate| tathā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmapi dvyaṇukaparamāṇūbhayagata hrasvattvapārimāṃḍilyaparimāṇābhyāmapi tryaṇukadvyaṇukagataparimāṇotpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: mahat dīrgha vat vā hrasva parimaṃḍalābhyām iti asya arthaḥ mahat dīrgha vat vaiśeṣika mate tryaṇuka ādi gatāt mahat tvāt dīrgha tvāt ca catur aṇuka ādi gata parimāṇam utpadyate tathā hrasva parimaṃḍalābhyām api dvyaṇuka paramāṇu ubhaya gata hrasva ttva pārimāṃḍilya parimāṇābhyām api tryaṇuka dvyaṇuka gata parimāṇa utpattiḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā mahattvadīrghatvābhyāmapi kāryotpattirna syāditi vā śabdārthaḥ| tasmādvaiśeṣikamatamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: anyathā mahat tva dīrgha tvābhyām api kārya utpattiḥ na syāt iti vā śabda arthaḥ tasmāt vaiśeṣika matam anupapannam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva hareranaṃtaguṇaparipūrṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ| vaiśeṣikādīnāmanupapannabhāṣitvena tatsamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| yaccoktaṃ| hrasvāṇuparimāṇayornāsamavāyikāraṇatvamiti| tanna| tathāsati mahattvadīrghatvayorapi tadabhāvāpātāt| mahaddīrghaparimāṇayoḥ kāraṇatve'nayorapi tatsāmyāt| aviśeṣāt| tasmādutpattiviruddhatvānna tayorasamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva hareḥ anaṃta guṇa paripūrṇa tva lakṣaṇam vaiśeṣika ādīnām anupapanna bhāṣi tvena tad samayasya aprāmāṇika tvāt yat ca uktam hrasva aṇu parimāṇayoḥ na asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam iti tat na tathā asati mahat tva dīrgha tvayoḥ api tad abhāva āpātāt mahat dīrgha parimāṇayoḥ kāraṇa tvena yoḥ api tad sāmyāt aviśeṣāt tasmāt utpatti viruddha tvāt na tayoḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam

original: kiṃtvetayoreveti vaiśeṣikādyuktamasamaṃjasasameveti na tadvirodha īśvarānaṃtaguṇatvasyeti yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: kiṃtu etayoḥ eva iti vaiśeṣika ādi uktam asamaṃjasasam eva iti na tad virodhaḥ īśvara anaṃta guṇatvasya iti yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāvaḥ || ||
analyzed: ubhayathā api na karma atas tad abhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ vaiśeṣikādimate mahattvadīrghatvāderasamavāyikāraṇatvakhaṃḍanarītyāsamavāyikāraṇamātraṃ nirastaṃ bhavatītyamipretya nimittakāraṇamapyevaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam vaiśeṣika ādi mate mahat tva dīrgha tva ādeḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa tva khaṃḍana rītyā asamavāyi kāraṇa mātram nirastam bhavati iti amipretya nimitta kāraṇam api evam nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāva iti || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā'pi īśvarecchayā nityatvānityavarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| na paramāṇuṣu kriyotpattisaṃbhavaḥ| atastadabhāvaḥ tasmindvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ubhayathā api na karma atas tad abhāvaḥ iti asya arthaḥ ubhayathā api īśvara icchayā nitya tva anitya va rūpa pakṣa dvaye pi na paramāṇuṣu kriyā utpatti saṃbhavaḥ atas tad abhāvaḥ tasmin dvyaṇuka ādi kārya abhāvaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃceśvarecchā nimittakāraṇamiti cet| sā kiṃ nityā'nityā vā| ubhayathā'pi na paramāṇukarma saṃbhavati| yadīśvarecchā nityā tarhi pralaye satyāmapi tasyāṃ paramāṇuceṣṭābhāvenā'nyadā'pi tadabhāvaḥ| athānityā tatkāraṇābhāveneśvarecchānutpattyā paramāṇukarmābhāvaḥ| na ca vācyaṃ pūrvakalpīyecchā'nityā'pi yāgavannimittamiti| pramāṇābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca īśvara icchā nimitta kāraṇam iti ced sā kim nitya anityā vā ubhayathā api na paramāṇu karma saṃbhavati yadi īśvara icchā nityā tarhi pralaye satyām api tasyām paramāṇu ceṣṭā bhāvena anyadā api tad abhāvaḥ atha anityā tad kāraṇa abhāvena īśvara icchā anutpattyā paramāṇu karma abhāvaḥ na ca vācyam pūrvakalpīya icchā anityā api yāga vat nimittam iti pramāṇa abhāvāt

original: atha neśvarecchā kāraṇaṃ tadevāstu| tarhyanyatrāpi kāraṇaṃ na syāt| sa eva paramate paramāṇukarmābhāvena saṃyogābhāvād‌vyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| vaidikeśvarapakṣe tu satyāmapīśvarecchāyāṃ sarvaṃ kāryānutpādikamīśvarāciṃtyaśaktita evopapadyate| na ca parapakṣe samametat| tasyānumānagamyeśvaratvena vedaikagamyeśvaratvābhāvāt|
analyzed: atha nā īśvara icchā kāraṇam tat eva astu tarhi anyatra api kāraṇam na syāt saḥ eva para mate paramāṇu karma abhāvena saṃyoga abhāvāt vyaṇuka ādi kārya abhāvaḥ vaidika īśvara pakṣe tu satyām api īśvara icchāyām sarvam kārya anutpādikam īśvara aciṃtya śaktitaḥ eva upapadyate na ca para pakṣe samam etat tasya anumāna gamya īśvara tvena veda eka gamya īśvara tva abhāvāt

original: ato vaiśeṣikādyuktasyāsāmaṃjasyena yuktaṃ hareranaṃtaguṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas vaiśeṣika ādi uktasya asāmaṃjasyena yuktam hareḥ anaṃta guṇa tva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteḥ || ||
analyzed: samavāya abhyupagamāt ca sāmyāt anavasthiteḥ

original: evaṃ vaiśeṣikādipakṣe nimittakāraṇāsaṃbhavaṃ darśayitvā samavāyikāraṇamapi nirākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: evam vaiśeṣika ādi pakṣe nimitta kāraṇa asaṃbhavam darśayitvā samavāyi kāraṇam api nirākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteriti || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣikaiḥ avayavāvayavyādīnāṃ bhinnatvanimittena samavāyābhyupagamāt samavāyasaṃbaṃdhāṃgīkārāt| sāmyāt samavāyyasamavāyinorapi bhinnatvasāmyāt| tatrāpi samavāyābhyupagame anavasthiteḥ| anavasthānācca tanmatamayuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: samavāya abhyupagamāt ca sāmyāt anavasthiteḥ iti asya arthaḥ vaiśeṣikaiḥ avayava avayavi ādīnām bhinna tva nimittena samavāya abhyupagamāt samavāya saṃbaṃdha aṃgīkārāt sāmyāt samavāyi asamavāyinoḥ api bhinna tva sāmyāt tatra api samavāya abhyupagame anavasthiteḥ anavasthānāt ca tad matam ayuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yadapi paramāṇvādidravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇamiti| tanna| avayavāvayavinorbhinnatvamaṃgīkṛtya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyābhyupagamāt| samavāyasyāpi bhinnatvasāmyena mṛddhaṭasamavāya ityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyāṃtarāpekṣā syāt| tatrāpyevamityanavasthānāt| mūlabhūtāvāyavāvayavyādisaṃbaṃdhasyaivāsidhyā tadasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: evam ca yat api paramāṇu ādi dravyam samavāyi kāraṇam iti tat na avayava avayavinoḥ bhinna tvam aṃgīkṛtya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva upapattaye samavāya abhyupagamāt samavāyasya api bhinna tva sāmyena mṛd haṭa samavāyaḥ ityādi viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva upapattaye samavāya aṃtara apekṣā syāt tatra api evam iti anavasthānāt mūla bhūta avāyava avayavi ādi saṃbaṃdhasya eva asidhyā tad asiddhiḥ

original: teṣāṃ prathamasaṃbaṃdhasidhyarthamabhyupagaṃtavyānāṃ saṃbaṃdhāṃtarāṇāṃ sutarāmasiddheḥ| samavāyasya svanirvāhakatve svasminsvayameva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvabuddhijanakatveṃ'gīkṛte samavāyāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: teṣām prathama saṃbaṃdha sidhi artham abhyupagaṃtavyānām saṃbaṃdha aṃtarāṇām sutarām asiddheḥ samavāyasya sva nirvāhaka tve svasmin svayam eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva buddhi janaka tva iṃgīkṛte samavāya asiddheḥ

original: guṇaguṇyādibhedaṃ tatsamavāyaṃ cāṃgīkṛtya tatsvanirvāhakatvakalpanāpekṣayā lāghavena guṇaguṇyāderabhedamaṃgīkṛtyaikasya dravyasyaiva svanirvāhakatvopapattau samavāyavaiyarthyāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: guṇa guṇi ādi bhedam tad samavāyam ca aṃgīkṛtya tad sva nirvāhaka tva kalpanā apekṣayā lāghavena guṇa guṇi ādeḥ abhedam aṃgīkṛtya ekasya dravyasya eva sva nirvāhaka tva upapattau samavāya vaiyarthyāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || nityameva ca bhāvāt || ||
analyzed: nityam eva ca bhāvāt

original: evaṃ paramate kāraṇatrayanirāsena sṛṣṭiṃ nirasya pralayanirāsārthaṃ pravṛttaṃ sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam para mate kāraṇa traya nirāsena sṛṣṭim nirasya pralaya nirāsa artham pravṛttam sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || nityameva ca bhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || doṣasamuccaye caḥ| īśecchāparamāṇvādikāraṇānāṃ sadātvāt| vaiśeṣikamate nityameva sarvadaiva| bhāvāt kāryotpattiḥ syāt| na tu kadācidityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: nityam eva ca bhāvāt iti asya arthaḥ doṣa samuccaye caḥ īśa icchā paramāṇu ādi kāraṇānām sadātvāt vaiśeṣika mate nityam eva sarvadā eva bhāvāt kārya utpattiḥ syāt na tu kadācid iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paramate layāsaṃbhavaḥ| samavāyikāraṇāsamavāyikāraṇanimittakāraṇānāṃ sadbhāvena kāryānutpāde kāraṇābhāvāt| samavāyikāraṇaparamāṇūnāṃ sadātanatve samavāyasyaiva janitvāṃgīkāre sarvaṃ kāryaṃ nityaṃ janimadeva syāt| samavāyikāraṇādisatve kāyotpattyuparame kadā'pi tasmātkāryotpattirna syāt|
analyzed: evam ca para mate laya asaṃbhavaḥ samavāyi kāraṇa asamavāyi kāraṇa nimitta kāraṇānām sadbhāvena kārya anutpāde kāraṇa abhāvāt samavāyi kāraṇa paramāṇūnām sadātana tve samavāyasya eva janitvā aṃgīkāre sarvam kāryam nityam janimat eva syāt samavāyi kāraṇa ādi satve kāya utpatti uparame kadāpi tasmāt kārya utpattiḥ na syāt

original: sati puṣkalakāraṇe kāryānutpāde tasya tatkāraṇatvāyogāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: sati puṣkala kāraṇe kārya anutpāde tasya tad kāraṇa tva ayogāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāt || ||
analyzed: rūpa ādimat tvāt ca viparyayaḥ darśanāt

original: evaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamubhyupetya tadāraṃbhakavādo dūṣitaḥ| idānīṃ nityatvamapākurvatsūtramupanyasyāti ||

original: || || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyatheti || asyārthaḥ || kṣaṇikamate na pratikṣaṇaṃ kāryotpattiryujyate| kutaḥ| asati kāraṇe kāryamutpadyata ityaṃgīkāre| pratijñoparodhaḥ tasya tatkāryatvamiti pratijñāya siddhāṃtavyavahārasyoparodho hāniḥ syāt| anyathā kāraṇe sati kāryamutpadyata ityaṃgīkāre|
analyzed: asati pratijñā uparodhaḥ yaugapadyam anyathā iti asya arthaḥ kṣaṇika mate na pratikṣaṇam kārya utpattiḥ yujyate kutas asati kāraṇe kāryam utpadyate iti aṃgīkāre pratijñā uparodhaḥ tasya tat kārya tvam iti pratijñāya siddhāṃta vyavahārasya uparodhaḥ hāniḥ syāt anyathā kāraṇe sati kāryam utpadyate iti aṃgīkāre

original: yaugapadyaṃ kāraṇena saha kāraṇānāṃ ekadā'vasthā prasajjatetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yaugapadyam kāraṇena saha kāraṇānām ekadā avasthā prasajjatā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca pratikṣaṇaṃ kāryotpattyaṃgīkāre kimasati kāraṇe kāryamutpadyate| uta sati| ādye pratijñāhāniḥ| dvitīya prathamakṣaṇotpannānāṃ viralaparamāṇūnāṃ kāryotpattisamaye'pi bhāve kṣaṇikatvaniyamābhāvena vināśakasaṃpattiparyaṃtamavasthānaṃ syāt|
analyzed: evam ca pratikṣaṇam kārya utpatti aṃgīkāre kim asati kāraṇe kāryam utpadyate uta sati ādye pratijñā hāniḥ dvitīya prathama kṣaṇa utpannānām virala paramāṇūnām kārya utpatti samaye api bhāve kṣaṇika tva niyama abhāvena vināśaka saṃpatti paryaṃtam avasthānam syāt

original: tanmateca kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamātpunaḥ punaḥ kāryotpattiḥ syāditi sakalakāryāṇāṃ yaugapadyaṃ syāt| tataścaikasyāṃ ghaṭikāyāṃ kulālaśālāpūrtiprasaṃgaḥ| yadvā| paramāṇūnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena yasminkṣaṇe paramāṇavastasminneva kṣaṇe kāryamiti kāryakāraṇayoḥ paurvāparyaṃ na syāt| na ca kṣaṇe pūrvāparamadhyabhāgo'sti|
analyzed: tad mate ca kāraṇe sati kāryam bhavati eva iti niyamāt punar punar kārya utpattiḥ syāt iti sakala kāryāṇām yaugapadyam syāt tatas ca ekasyām ghaṭikāyām kulāla śālā pūrti prasaṃgaḥ yat vā paramāṇūnām kṣaṇika tvena yasmin kṣaṇe paramāṇavaḥ tasmin eva kṣaṇe kāryam iti kārya kāraṇayoḥ paurvāparyam na syāt na ca kṣaṇe pūrva apara madhya bhāgaḥ asti

original: yena prathamabhāge paramāṇūtpattiḥ| dvitīyabhāge tu kāryajanakatvamiti syāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: yena prathama bhāge paramāṇu utpattiḥ dvitīya bhāge tu kārya janaka tvam iti syāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāt || ||
analyzed: pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodha aprāptiḥ avicchedāt

original: evaṃ kṣaṇikavāde kāryotpatiṃ nirākṛtya vināśaṃ ca nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam kṣaṇika vāde kārya utpatim nirākṛtya vināśam ca nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāditi || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ kṣaṇikamate pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiḥ pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhayoḥ pratikṣaṇavināśasaṃtānāvināśayoḥ aprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| avicchedāt tadrītyā kāryo'tpattāvakāryāṇāṃ cāvicchinnatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodha aprāptiḥ avicchedāt iti asya arthaḥ evam kṣaṇika mate pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodha aprāptiḥ pratisaṃkhyā pratisaṃkhyā nirodhayoḥ prati kṣaṇa vināśa saṃtāna avināśayoḥ aprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ kutas avicchedāt tad rītyā kārya utpattau akāryāṇām ca avicchinna tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paramate vināśo na yujyate| tanmate vināśo dvividhaḥ| kāryamutpādya tadapahāya tatkṣaṇe nāśaḥ| tasyāpyevamevamiti pratikṣaṇaṃ nāśaḥ| sa eva saṃtānavināśo'pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti gīyate| saṃtānaṃ vinaiva kāraṇasya naṣṭatvāt| aparastu kāryamutpādya tena sahaiva mudgarapraharādinākṣaṇamātre nāśaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca para mate vināśaḥ na yujyate tad mate vināśaḥ dvividhaḥ kāryam utpādya tat apahāya tad kṣaṇe nāśaḥ tasya api evam evam iti pratikṣaṇam nāśaḥ saḥ eva saṃtāna vināśa upratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti gīyate saṃtānam vinā eva kāraṇasya naṣṭa tvāt aparaḥ tu kāryam utpādya tena saha eva mudgara prahara ādinā akṣaṇa mātre nāśaḥ

original: sa eva saṃtānanāśaḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti ca gīyate| tatrādyastāvannayujyate| kāryamutpādya tatparityāgasamaye sattvena tataśca kāryajanakatvamiti niyamātkāryamevotpādayenna naśyet| tadviyogasamaye'pyevamiti na kadāpi niḥsaṃtāno nāśaḥ| nāpi saṃtānavināśo yujyate| sato ghaṭasya hyātyaṃtiko vināśaḥ| ato'sau sattvātkāryamutpādayenna tu naśyet|
analyzed: saḥ eva saṃtāna nāśaḥ pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti ca gīyate tatra ādyaḥ tāvat na yujyate kāryam utpādya tad parityāga samaye sattvena tatas ca kārya janaka tvam iti niyamāt kāryam eva utpādayet na naśyet tad viyoga samaye pi evam iti na kadāpi niḥsaṃtānaḥ nāśaḥ na api saṃtāna vināśaḥ yujyate sataḥ ghaṭasya hi ātyaṃtikaḥ vināśaḥ atas asau sattvāt kāryam utpādayet na tu naśyet

original: evamuttaratrāpi sattvātkāryamevotpādayenna tu naśyediti sasaṃtānocchedāvasarābhāvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam uttaratra api sattvāt kāryam eva utpādayet na tu naśyet iti sa saṃtāna uccheda avasara abhāvāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || ||
analyzed: ubhayathā ca doṣāt

original: nanvathā'pi satāṃ bhāvapadārthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ niṣedbhuṃ na śakyaṃ| sattvaṃ nāmārthakriyākāritvaṃ| na ca ṇikatāmaṃtareṇa tadupapannaṃ| yadi ghaṭa ādyakṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramutpādya svayaṃ na naśyettarhi dvitīyādikṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramapi janayet| ghaṭāṃtarāṇyapi tathetyanaṃtakāryāpātaḥ|
analyzed: nanu atha api satām bhāva padārthānām kṣaṇika tvam niṣedbhum na śakyam sattvam nāma arthakriyā kāri tvam na ca ṇikatām aṃtareṇa tat upapannam yadi ghaṭaḥ ādya kṣaṇe ghaṭa aṃtaram utpādya svayam na naśyet tarhi dvitīya ādi kṣaṇe ghaṭa aṃtaram api janayet ghaṭa aṃtarāṇi api tathā iti anaṃta kārya āpātaḥ

original: tasmādarthakriyākāritvarūpasattvasidhyai bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvameṣṭevyamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: tasmāt arthakriyā kāri tva rūpa sattva sidhyai bhāvānām kṣaṇika tvam eṣṭevyam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || ubhayathā ca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamapakṣe tadabhāvapakṣe ca| doṣasattvāt kāryakāraṇaviśeṣakāryānutpattyākhyadoṣāt| nānyatarapakṣāvalaṃbenārthāpattyā kṣaṇikapakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ubhayathā ca doṣāt iti asya arthaḥ ubhayathā kāraṇe sati kāryam bhavati eva iti niyama pakṣe tad abhāva pakṣe ca doṣa sattvāt kārya kāraṇa viśeṣa kārya anutpatti ākhya doṣāt na anyatara pakṣa avalaṃbena arthāpattyā kṣaṇika pakṣaḥ yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvāṃgīkāre tatrārthakriyākāritvaṃ sattvaṃ| tadanyathā'nupapattyā kṣaṇikatvamiti vadatā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti yo niyama āśritaḥ sa kiṃ vāstavo na vā| ādye kāryakāraṇayoḥ savyetaraviṣāṇavatsamānakālīnatvena kāryakāraṇabhāvo na syāt| dvitīye prathamakṣaṇe kāryānutpādakatve nārthakriyākāritvābhāvādasattvaṃ syāt|
analyzed: evaṃca bhāvānām kṣaṇika tva aṃgīkāre tatra arthakriyā kāri tvam sattvam tad anyathā anupapattyā kṣaṇika tvam iti vadatā kāraṇe sati kāryam bhavati eva iti yaḥ niyamaḥ āśritaḥ sa kim vāstavaḥ na vā ādye kārya kāraṇayoḥ savyetara viṣāṇa vat samāna kālīna tvena kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na syāt dvitīye prathama kṣaṇe kārya anutpādaka tve na arthakriyā kāri tva abhāvāt asattvam syāt

original: tataḥ kadā'pi kāryotpattirna syāt| tataśca sattvānyathā'nupapattyā kalpyamānaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ ca na syāt| anena parapakṣa evobhayathā doṣasattvādasmatpakṣe doṣābhāvāditi maṃtavyaṃ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ|
analyzed: tatas kadāpi kārya utpattiḥ na syāt tatas ca sattva anyathā anupapattyā kalpyamānam kṣaṇikatvam ca na syāt anena para pakṣe evā ubhayathā doṣa sattvāt asmad pakṣe doṣa abhāvāt iti maṃtavyam atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || ākāśe cāviśeṣāt || ||
analyzed: ākāśe ca aviśeṣāt

original: nanu mābhūdarthāpattyā kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| yatsattatkṣaṇikaṃ| yathā dīpādi| saṃtaścāmī bhāvāḥ padārthā ityanumānena setsyati| na ca vācyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalateti| yadviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ tannānā yathā ghaṭapaṭau| tathā cāyaṃ dīpaḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣadarśanāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu mā abhūt arthāpattyā kṣaṇikatva siddhiḥ yat sat tat kṣaṇikam yathā dīpa ādi saṃtaḥ ca amī bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ iti anumānena setsyati na ca vācyam dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhya vikala tā iti yat viruddha dharma adhikaraṇam tat nānā yathā ghaṭa paṭau tathā ca ayam dīpaḥ pūrva uttara kṣaṇa viruddha dharma adhikaraṇam viśeṣa darśanāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || ākāśe cāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'pyarthe| dīpadṛṣṭāṃtena sattvahetunā jagati kṣaṇikatvasādhane ākāśadṛṣṭāṃtenākṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhanāpātaḥ| nanu dṛṣṭāte sādhyavaikalyamityata uktaṃ| ākāśe aviśeṣāditi| kṣaṇikatvasādhakatvena paroktaparimāmaviśeṣādarśanādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ākāśe ca aviśeṣāt iti asya arthaḥ copi arthe dīpa dṛṣṭāṃtena sattva hetunā jagati kṣaṇikatva sādhane ākāśa dṛṣṭāṃtena akṣaṇika tvasya api sādhanāpātaḥ nanu dṛṣṭāte sādhya vaikalyam iti atas uktam ākāśe aviśeṣāt iti kṣaṇikatva sādhaka tvena para ukta parimām aviśeṣa adarśanāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca satpratipakṣo'yaṃ heturiti na tena kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā ca sat pratipakṣaḥ yam hetuḥ iti na tena kṣaṇikatva siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca yatsattadakṣaṇikaṃ yathā''kāśamityakṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| na cākāśe sādhyābhāvaḥ| viśeṣadarśanābhāvena kṣaṇikatvasādhakābhāvāt| na ca hetvaṃtareṇa tatsiddhiḥ| paṃcamaskaṃdhātiriktatvena tatra tadanabhyupagamāt| ākāśe sattvaṃ nāstīti cet| kimidaṃ sattvaṃ yadākāśe nāsti| arthakriyākāritvaṃ cet|
analyzed: evam ca yat sat tat akṣaṇikam yathā ākāśam iti akṣaṇika tvasya api sādhayitum śakya tvāt na ca ākāśe sādhya abhāvaḥ viśeṣa darśana abhāvena kṣaṇikatva sādhaka abhāvāt na ca hetu aṃtareṇa tad siddhiḥ paṃcama skaṃdha atirikta tvena tatra tad anabhyupagamāt ākāśe sattvam na asti iti ced kim idam sattvam yat ākāśe na asti arthakriyā kāri tvam ced

original: tvanbhate pūrvoktarītyā kasyāpyarthākriyākāritvābhāvenāsiddhiḥ| sādhanavikalatā ca nidarśanasya| atha svarūpeṇeti vidyamānatā'bhāvarūpatā vā| sāpyākāśe'styeveti vyabhicāro duṣparihāraḥ| ataḥ sattvahetoḥ svenaiva pratipakṣitatvānnānenāpi kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tu anbhate pūrvokta rītyā kasya api artha akriyā kāri tva abhāvena asiddhiḥ sādhana vikala tā ca nidarśanasya atha sva rūpeṇa iti vidyamāna tā bhāva rūpa tā vā sā api ākāśā īsti eva iti vyabhicāraḥ duṣparihāraḥ atas sattva hetoḥ svena eva pratipakṣita tvāt na anena api kṣaṇikatva siddhiḥ atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || anusmṛteśca || ||
analyzed: anusmṛteḥ ca

original: evaṃ pratipakṣeṇa sattvānumānaṃ nirasya pramāṇabādhenāpi nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam pratipakṣeṇa sattva anumānam nirasya pramāṇa bādhena api nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || anusmṛteśceti|| asyārthaḥ || tadevedamiti pratyabhijñānācca tadvirodhāt na sattvahetunā kṣaṇikatvasādhanaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anusmṛteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ tat eva idam iti pratyabhijñānāt ca tad virodhāt na sattva hetunā kṣaṇikatva sādhanam yuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca so'yaṃ ghaṭa iti pratijñāvirodhaḥ| tathā syāyitvasiddheḥ| na ca pratijñābhrāṃtiḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| ghaṭo'yaṃ niraṃtarottarakṣaṇavṛttidhvaṃsapratiyogī ghaṭatvāt musalāhataikakṣaṇavṛttivaṭavaditi coktarītyā parāstaṃ| kiṃca ghaṭaśabdena paramāṇūṃllakṣayitvā ghaṭatvaśabdena paramāṇutvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate|
analyzed: evam ca saḥ yam ghaṭaḥ iti pratijñā virodhaḥ tathā syāyitva siddheḥ na ca pratijñā bhrāṃtiḥ bādhaka abhāvāt ghaṭaḥ yam niraṃtara uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti dhvaṃsa pratiyogī ghaṭa tvāt musala āhata eka kṣaṇa vṛtti vaṭa vat iti ca ukta rītyā parāstam kiṃca ghaṭa śabdena paramāṇūn lakṣayitvā ghaṭa tva śabdena paramāṇu tvam eva hetutayā vivakṣyate

original: uta samudāyamaiva pakṣīkṛtya ghaṭatvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate| nādyaḥ| musalāhatasya ghaṭasya samudāyatvena paramāṇutvābhāvāt| tatra hetvabhāvena vyāptigrahaṇābāvaprasaṃgāt| na dvitīyaḥ| sata eva tvayā kṣaṇikatvasya sādhanīyatvenāvastunastatsādhanasyānupayuktatvāt|
analyzed: uta samudāyam ā eva pakṣīkṛtya ghaṭa tvam eva hetutayā vivakṣyate na ādyaḥ musala āhatasya ghaṭasya samudāya tvena paramāṇu tva abhāvāt tatra hetu abhāvena vyāpti grahaṇa abāva prasaṃgāt na dvitīyaḥ sataḥ eva tvayā kṣaṇikatvasya sādhanīya tvena avastunaḥ tad sādhanasya anupayukta tvāt

original: ato vaibhāṣikasaitrāṃtikamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktamīśvarasyāśeṣajagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas vaibhāṣika saitrāṃtika matasya anupapanna tvena avirodhaka tvāt yuktam īśvarasya aśeṣa jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || iti samudāyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti samudāya adhikaraṇam

original: atra śūnyavādo nirākriyate|
analyzed: atra śūnyavādaḥ nirākriyate

original: || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāt || ||
analyzed: na asataḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt

original: nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| śūnyasamayaviruddhatvāt| ekameva śūnyamataṃ| tatra parahitaṃ paramārthasat| tasmādevāśeṣaṃ jagadupaiti| na cāsaṃgasya tadanupapattiḥ| saṃvṛttisaṃbaṃdhena tadupapatteḥ| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| tatprāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt| tataśca śūnyasamayaviruddhatvādayuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||

original: || || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyamiti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃcātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇāṃgīkṛte sati| ātmakārtsnyaṃ ātmanaḥ prāk pipīlikādehaṃ prāptasya tatkāyaparimitasya jīvasya| akārtsnyaṃ gajagardabhādiśarīraprāptāvapūrṇatā syādityarthaḥ| evaṃ gajaśarīraṃ prāptasyātmanaḥ pipīlikādehaprāptāvakārtsnyamādhikyaṃ ca syāditi draṣṭavyaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ātma akārtsnyam iti asya arthaḥ evam ca ātmanaḥ kāya parimāṇa aṃgīkṛte sati ātma kārtsnyam ātmanaḥ prāk pipīlikā deham prāptasya tad kāya parimitasya jīvasya akārtsnyam gaja gardabha ādi śarīra prāptau apūrṇa tā syāt iti arthaḥ evam gaja śarīram prāptasya ātmanaḥ pipīlikā deha prāptau akārtsnyam ādhikyam ca syāt iti draṣṭavyam

original: evaṃcātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇābhyupagame'pi prāptavyasarvaśarīreṣu sarvaceṣṭānupapādakatvāt| gajagardabhādiśarīrasya tatparimāṇasyātmanaḥ pipīlikādiśarīre karmavaśātprāpte sati taccharīra evātirekaḥ syāt| tathā ca śarīraparimāṇatvabhaṃgaḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ātmanaḥ kāya parimāṇa abhyupagame api prāptavya sarva śarīreṣu sarva ceṣṭā anupapādaka tvāt gaja gardabha ādi śarīrasya tad parimāṇasya ātmanaḥ pipīlika ādi śarīre karma vaśāt prāpte sati tad śarīre eva atirekaḥ syāt tathā ca śarīra parimāṇa tva bhaṃgaḥ atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhyaḥ || ||

analyzed: nanu na eka deha parimāṇaḥ eva ātmā kiṃtu yadā yat śarīram prāpnoti tadā tad parimāṇaḥ iti na ca evam sati prāc ukta doṣa prasaktiḥ iti prāpte pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || paryāyāt kramāt| krameṇa tattaddehaparimāṇatvāṃgīkārādapi| avirodhaḥ noktadoṣa iti ca na yujyate| kutaḥ| yataḥ paryāyo| na yujyate| tadapi kutaḥ| virākādibhyaḥ tathā sati tattatkālīnaparimāṇabhedena vastubhedāt| ātmano vikāritvāpatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca paryāyāt api avirodhaḥ vikāra ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ paryāyāt kramāt krameṇa tad tad deha parimāṇa tva aṃgīkārāt api avirodhaḥ na ukta doṣaḥ iti ca na yujyate kutas yatas paryāyaḥ na yujyate tat api kutas virāka ādibhyaḥ tathā sati tad tad kālīna parimāṇa bhedena vastu bhedāt ātmanaḥ vikāri tva āpatteḥ

original: tataścānityatvānnirmokṣatvādidoṣaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tatas ca anitya tvāt nirmokṣa tva ādi doṣa prasaṃgāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcātmano vikāritvenānityatvaprasaṃgāt| tathā cānirmokṣaprasaṃgaḥ| śāstravaiphalyaṃ ca| gajapipīlikādiśarīrasthasyātmanaḥ kramikatattaddehaparimāṇatvābhyupagame coktadoṣānapagamena vikāritvāpatteranityatāpātāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ātmanaḥ vikāri tvena anitya tva prasaṃgāt tathā ca anirmokṣa prasaṃgaḥ śāstra vaiphalyam ca gaja pipīlikā ādi śarīra sthasya ātmanaḥ kramika tad tad deha parimāṇa tva abhyupagame ca ukta doṣa anapagamena vikāri tva āpatteḥ anitya tā āpātāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || aṃtyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣāt || ||
analyzed: antya avasthiteḥ ca ubhaya nitya tvāt aviśeṣāt

original: idānīṃ śarīrāvacchedamaṃtareṇātmanaḥ svataḥ parimāṇābhāvāttadarthaṃ kāyaparimāṇatvamaṃgīkriyata iti dvitīyapakṣaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: idānīm śarīra avacchedam aṃtareṇa ātmanaḥ svatas parimāṇa abhāvāt tad artham kāya parimāṇa tvam aṃgīkriyate iti dvitīya pakṣam nirākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || aṃtyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || pūrvasūtrādevaṃcetyanuṣajyate| aṃtyāvasthiterityetadāvartate| ca śabdo'vadhāraṇe samuccaye ca| tathā ca evaṃ sati ātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatveṃ'gīkṛte aṃtyāvastiteḥ prasaṃga iti śeṣaḥ| mokṣe'pi sataḥ ātmanaḥ śarīrasattvamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca|
analyzed: aṃtya avasthiteḥ ca ubhaya nitya tvāt aviśeṣāt iti asya arthaḥ pūrva sūtrāt evam ca iti anuṣajyate aṃtya avasthiteḥ iti etat āvartate ca śabdaḥ vadhāraṇe samuccaye ca tathā ca evam sati ātmanaḥ kāya parimāṇa tva iṃgīkṛte aṃtya avastiteḥ prasaṃgaḥ iti śeṣaḥ mokṣe api sataḥ ātmanaḥ śarīra sattvam aṃgīkāryam syāt iti arthaḥ kutas aṃtya avasthiteḥ ca

original: aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca| aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryatvāt| avacchedakaśarīraṃ vinā avacchedyaparimāṇasattvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ| parimāṇameva kuta ityato'pyāha| aṃtyeti|
analyzed: aṃtyasya mauktika parimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyam aṃgīkāryam syāt iti arthaḥ kutas aṃtya avasthiteḥ ca aṃtyasya mauktika parimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyam aṃgīkārya tvāt avacchedaka śarīram vinā avacchedya parimāṇa sattva ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ parimāṇam eva kutas iti atas api āha aṃtya iti

original: aṃtyasya mauktikātmasvarūpasya muktāvasthiteravaśyaṃ svarūpasattvasya parimāṇaṃ vinā'yogāditi bhāvaḥ| astu mokṣe'pi śarīraṃ tataḥ kimityata uktaṃ| ubhayanityatvāditi| tathā sati ubhayoḥ muktikālīnayordehātmanornityatvaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ| astu mauktikaśarīranityatvaṃ tataḥ kimityata āha| tataśca sarvanityatvaṃ syādityāpādyavākyamadhyāhāryaṃ|
analyzed: aṃtyasya mauktika ātma svarūpasya mukta avasthiteḥ avaśyam sva rūpa sattvasya parimāṇam vinā ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ astu mokṣe api śarīram tatas kim iti atas uktam ubhaya nitya tvāt iti tathā sati ubhayoḥ mukti kālīnayoḥ deha ātmanoḥ nitya tva prasaṃgāt iti arthaḥ astu mauktika śarīra nitya tvam tatas kim iti atas āha tatas ca sarva nitya tvam syāt iti āpādya vākyam adhyāhāryam

original: ata eva samuccayārthakaśca śabdaḥ sarveṣāmadhunātanaśarīrāṇāṃ nityatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha| aviśeṣāditi| muktikālīnānāṃ adhunātanānāṃ ca śarīrāṇāṃ śarīratvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ| tasmānna kāyaparimāṇatvamātmano yuktamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: atas eva samuccaya arthakaḥ ca śabdaḥ sarveṣām adhunātana śarīrāṇām nitya tvam syāt iti arthaḥ kutas iti atas āha aviśeṣāt iti mukti kālīnānām adhunātanānām ca śarīrāṇām śarīra tva aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ tasmāt na kāya parimāṇa tvam ātmanaḥ yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃca jīvasya mokṣe parimāṇābhāva cedātmasvarūpābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| na hi parimāṇaśūnyaṃ dravyamasti| asti ceccharīramaṃtareṇa parimāṇāyogāt| tatrāpi taccharīramanityaṃ cetsaṃsārasamānadharmatāpātaḥ| nityaṃ ceccharīratvāviśeṣādidānīṃtanaśarīramapi nityaṃ syāt| ato nātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatvapakṣo yuktaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca jīvasya mokṣe ced ātma svarūpa abhāva prasaṃgaḥ na hi parimāṇa śūnyam dravyam asti asti ced śarīram aṃtareṇa parimāṇa ayogāt tatra api tat śarīram anityam ced saṃsāra samāna dharmatā āpātaḥ nityam ced śarīra tva aviśeṣāt idānīṃtana śarīram api nityam syāt atas na ātmanaḥ kāya parimāṇa tva pakṣaḥ yuktaḥ

original: tasmājjainamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tasmāt jaina matasya anupapanna tvena avirodhaka tva āt yuktam jagat kāraṇatva lakṣaṇam iti siddham

original: || iti nekasminnadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na ikasmin adhikaraṇam

original: atra pāśupatapakṣo'pākriyate ||
analyzed: atra pāśupata pakṣā upākriyate

original: || patyurasāmaṃjasyāt || ||
analyzed: patyuḥ asāmaṃjasyāt

analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam pāśupata samaya viruddha tvāt paśupatiḥ khalu sārvajñya ādi guṇa śālī māyām upādānīkṛtya hari hiraṇyagarbha ādi jagat utpatti ādi sarvam karoti śruti smṛtayaḥ ca asmin arthe bhavanti atas lakṣaṇa sūtram ayuktam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || patyurasāmaṃjasyāditi || asyārthaḥ || patyuḥ paśupateḥ| jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| asāmaṃjasyāt pārataṃtryotpattyādidoṣavattvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: patyuḥ asāmaṃjasyāt iti asya arthaḥ patyuḥ paśupateḥ jagat kāraṇatvam na yuktam kutas asāmaṃjasyāt pārataṃtrya utpatti ādi doṣavattvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| pāśupatasamayasyāpramāṇikatvāt| na paśupatirgatkartā| pārataṃtryajananamaraṇadoṣaduṣṭatvāt| na cāsiddho hetuḥ| yaṃ kāmaye taṃ tamugramiti śrutisiddhatvāt| api caiko nārāyaṇa āsīditi śrutyā pralaye paśupaterabhāvāvagamāt| tataśca pāśupatasamayasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yuktam viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam pāśupata samayasya apramāṇika tvāt na paśupatiḥ gat kartā pārataṃtrya janana maraṇa doṣa duṣṭatvāt na ca asiddhaḥ hetuḥ yam kāmaye tam tam ugram iti śruti siddha tvāt api ca ekaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ āsīt iti śrutyā pralaye paśupateḥ abhāva avagamāt tatas ca pāśupata samayasya anupapanna tvena avirodhaka tvāt yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśca || ||
analyzed: saṃbaṃdha anupapatteḥ ca

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa paśupateḥ jagat kāraṇatvam parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || śivasyāśarīratvena jagatā saṃbaṃdhānupapatte na tasya kartṛtvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃbaṃdha anupapatteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ śivasya aśarīra tvena jagatā saṃbaṃdha anupapatte na tasya kartṛ tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na kevalaṃ pārataṃtryādeḥ kiṃtvaśarīratvācca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogāt| na hyaśarīrasya kartṛtvaṃ dṛśyate yena tasya tathā bhavet| na ca kāryeṇa jagatā'pi saṃbaṃdhamātramaśarīrasyāpi saṃbhavati gaganāderghaṭādisaṃyogavaditi vācyaṃ| tyaktadehapuruṣavatkartṛtvarūpasaṃbaṃdhābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca na kevalam pārataṃtrya ādeḥ kiṃtu aśarīra tvāt ca paśupateḥ jagat kartṛ tva ayogāt na hi aśarīrasya kartṛ tvam dṛśyate yena tasya tathā bhavet na ca kāryeṇa jagatā api saṃbaṃdha mātram aśarīrasya api saṃbhavati gagana ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi saṃyoga vat iti vācyam tyakta deha puruṣa vat kartṛ tva rūpa saṃbaṃdha abhāvāt

original: tataśca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ca paśupateḥ jagatkartṛ tva ayogena yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśca || ||
analyzed: adhiṣṭhāna anupapatteḥ ca

original: hetvaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: hetu aṃtareṇa paśupateḥ jagat kāraṇatvam parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || pralaye sarveṣāṃ naṣṭatvātpunaḥ sṛṣṭikāle paśupateḥ pṛthivyādyāśrayānupapatteśca na tasya jagatkartṛtvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: adhiṣṭhāna anupapatteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ pralaye sarveṣām naṣṭa tvāt punar sṛṣṭi kāle paśupateḥ pṛthivī ādi āśraya anupapatteḥ ca na tasya jagatkartṛ tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca paśupateradhiṣṭhānānupalaṃbhena kartṛtvāyogāt| pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhāne sthitasya kulālāderghaṭādikāryadarśanenāsya tadabhāvāt| sautrahetunā vyatirekavyāpteḥ sāmānyataḥ pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhānadṛṣṭāṃtena darśitatvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca paśupateḥ adhiṣṭhāna anupalaṃbhena kartṛ tva ayogāt pṛthivī ādi adhiṣṭhāne sthitasya kulāla ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi kārya darśanena asya tad abhāvāt sautra hetunā vyatireka vyāpteḥ sāmānyatas pṛthivī ādi adhiṣṭhāna dṛṣṭāṃtena darśita tvāt atas yuktam lakṣaṇa sūtram iti siddham

original: || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhyaḥ || ||

original: ataḥ a vaśyakatvādadṛṣṭavaicitryameva suranarādivaicitryaniyāmakamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atas a vaśyaka tvāt adṛṣṭa vaicitryam eva sura nara ādi vaicitrya niyāmakam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca svargādiprāpterapyadṛṣṭasādhyatvāt| ekapradeśasthitānāṃ vecitryadarśanācca| tadeva pāribhāṣikapratibiṃbatvasya yuktivirodhaprasaktyabhāvāt| naivāṃśo na saṃbaṃdha iti śruteśca| pratimukhatvapratibiṃbatvābhāvaviṣayatvena tadvirodhasyāpyabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpamiti śrutyā pāribhāṣika pratibiṃbatvasiddheryukto nārāyaṇe śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca svarga ādi prāpteḥ api adṛṣṭa sādhya tvāt eka pradeśa sthitānām vecitrya darśanāt ca tat eva pāribhāṣika pratibiṃba tvasya yukti virodha prasakti abhāvāt na eva aṃśaḥ na saṃbaṃdhaḥ iti śruteḥ ca pratimukha tva pratibiṃba tva abhāva viṣaya tvena tad virodhasya api abhāvena rūpam rūpam iti śrutyā pāribhāṣika pratibiṃba tva siddheḥ yuktaḥ nārāyaṇe śruti samanvayaḥ iti siddham

original: nanu na prāṇāutpattimaṃtaḥ| prāṇā eveti śruteḥ| na cotpattāvapi etasmāditi śrutirastīti vācyaṃ| anutpattiśruteḥ spaṣṭārthatayā niravakāśatvena prābalyāt| etasmājjāyata iti śruteḥ prādurbhāvaparatayā'pi yojayituṃ śakyatvādavispaṣṭārthatvena daurbalyāt| prāṇā notpattimaṃtaḥ nirupādānatvāditi yuktiyuktatvāt| na cāsiddhiḥ|
analyzed: nanu na prāṇāḥ utpattimaṃtaḥ prāṇāḥ eva iti śruteḥ na ca utpattau api etasmāt iti śrutiḥ asti iti vācyam anutpatti śruteḥ spaṣṭa artha tayā niravakāśa tvena prābalyāt etasmāt jāyate iti śruteḥ prādurbhāva para tayā api yojayitum śakya tvāt avispaṣṭa artha tvena daurbalyāt prāṇāḥ na utpattimaṃtaḥ nirupādāna tvāt iti yukti yukta tvāt na ca asiddhiḥ

original: nopādānamiti smṛtisiddhatvāt| ataḥ prabalaśrutivirodhādutpattiśrutirapramāṇameveti neśvarasya śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: na upādānam iti smṛti siddha tvāt atas prabala śruti virodhāt utpatti śrutiḥ apramāṇam eva iti na īśvarasya śruti samanvayena jagat kāraṇatva siddhiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || tathā prāṇā iti || asyārthaḥ || yathā ākāśādayaḥ viṣṇorutpadyaṃte| tathā prāṇāḥ iṃdriyāṇyapi utpadyaṃta eva na tvanutpattimaṃtītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā prāṇāḥ iti asya arthaḥ yathā ākāśa ādayaḥ viṣṇoḥ utpadyaṃte tathā prāṇāḥ iṃdriyāṇi api utpadyaṃte eva na tu anutpattimaṃti iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcotpattimaṃta eva prāṇāḥ| ākāśasyotpattisādhakānāṃ hetūnāmihāpi sadbhāvāt| tataśca parādhīnaviśeṣāvāptimaṃta eveti paramātmana utpannatvasiddheryuktaṃ śrutisamanvayena brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca utpattimaṃtaḥ eva prāṇāḥ ākāśasya utpatti sādhakānām hetūnām iha api sadbhāvāt tatas ca para adhīna viśeṣa avāptimaṃtaḥ eva iti paramātmanaḥ utpannatva siddheḥ yuktam śruti samanvayena brahmaṇaḥ jagat kāraṇatvam iti siddham

original: || gauṇyasaṃbhavāt || ||
analyzed: gauṇī asaṃbhavāt

original: nanvākāśotpattisidhyarthaṃ śrutyabhāvoheturuktaḥ| na cāsāviha saṃbhavati| prāṇā evetyanutpattiśrutervidyamānatvāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu ākāśa utpatti sidhi artham śruti abhāvaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ na ca asau iha saṃbhavati prāṇāḥ eva iti anutpatti śruteḥ vidyamāna tvāt iti prāpte parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || gauṇyasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || prāṇā evānādaya ityanāditvaśrutiḥ gauṇī amukhyā| sūkṣmarūpeṇānutpattiviṣayā| kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt iṃdriyāṇāṃ mukhyānāditvāyogāt| etasmāditi śrutyayogāccetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: gauṇī asaṃbhavāt iti asya arthaḥ prāṇāḥ eva anādayaḥ iti anādi tva śrutiḥ gauṇī amukhyā sūkṣma rūpeṇa anutpatti viṣayā kutas asaṃbhavāt iṃdriyāṇām mukhya anādi tva ayogāt etasmāt iti śruti ayogāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca śrutisadbhāve'pi tasyā mukhyārthatvābhāvena gauṇyarthatvāt| paramātmanā sāmyaprasaṃgena mukhyārthāsaṃbhavāt| prāṇā utpattimaṃtaḥ alpaśaktitvāditi yuktiviruddhatvācca| ataḥ prāṇānāṃ paramātmana utpannatvaṃ siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca śruti sadbhāve api tasyāḥ mukhya artha tva abhāvena gauṇī artha tvāt paramātmanā sāmya prasaṃgena mukhya artha asaṃbhavāt prāṇāḥ utpattimaṃtaḥ alpa śakti tvāt iti yukti viruddha tvāt ca atas prāṇānām paramātmanaḥ utpanna tvam siddham

original: || pratijñānuparodhācca || ||
analyzed: pratijñā an uparodhāt ca

original: viyadadhikaraṇoktapratijñāhānyuktyeṃdriyāṇāmutpattiṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: viyat adhikaraṇa ukta pratijñā hāni uktyā iṃdriyāṇām utpattim samarthayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || pratijñānuparodhācceti || asyārthaḥ || idaṃ sarvamasṛjateti pratijñānuparodhāt pratijñā'nusārācca prāṇā utpadyaṃta ityaṃgīkāryamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pratijñā an uparodhāt ca iti asya arthaḥ idam sarvam asṛjata iti pratijñā an uparodhāt pratijñā anusārāt ca prāṇāḥ utpadyaṃte iti aṃgīkāryam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prāṇānāmutpatyaṃgīkāre sa idamiti śruteranusārādavirodhaḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇānāṃ paramātmana utpannatvaṃ siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prāṇānām utpati aṃgīkāre saḥ idam iti śruteḥ anusārāt avirodhaḥ atas śruti avirodhena prāṇānām paramātmanaḥ utpanna tvam siddham

original: || iti prāṇotpattyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti prāṇa utpattyā adhikaraṇam

original: atra manojanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra manaḥ janma viṣaya śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || tatprāk śruteśca || ||
analyzed: tat prāk śruteḥ ca

original: nanu notpattirmanasaḥ| nityaṃ mano'nāditvāditi śruteḥ| na cotpattiśrutyanusāreṇeṃdriyotpattiśrutivadanāditvaśrutergauṇārthavarṇanaṃ yuktaṃ| iṃdriyāṇāmanityatvamuktvā viśiṣya manaso nityatvābhidhānāt| kiṃ ca manasaḥ sāditve tadvinā kadācidanādinā puruṣeṇāvasthātavyaṃ| na ca tatsaṃbhavati| tathā sati tadā saṃsārābhāvaprasaṃgāt|
analyzed: nanu na utpattiḥ manasaḥ nityam manaḥ nādi tvāt iti śruteḥ na ca utpatti śruti anusāreṇa iṃdriya utpatti śruti vat anādi tva śruteḥ gauṇa artha varṇanam yuktam iṃdriyāṇām anitya tvam uktvā viśiṣya manasaḥ nitya tva abhidhānāt kim ca manasaḥ sādi tve tat vinā kadācid anādinā puruṣeṇa avasthātavyam na ca tat saṃbhavati tathā sati tadā saṃsāra abhāva prasaṃgāt

original: manasaḥ saṃsārakāraṇatvāt| mana eva manuṣyāṇāmiti smaraṇāt| ato nityameva manaḥ| evaṃca yuktiyuktiviśeṣaśruteḥ prābalyāttadvirodhenotpattiśruteraprāmāṇyānna śrutisamanvayeneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: manasaḥ saṃsāra kāraṇa tvāt manaḥ eva manuṣyāṇām iti smaraṇāt atas nityam eva manaḥ evam ca yukti yukti viśeṣa śruteḥ prābalyāt tad virodhena utpatti śruteḥ aprāmāṇyāt na śruti samanvayena īśvarasya jagat kāraṇatva siddhiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || tatprāk‌śruteśceti || asyārthaḥ || tadanutpattīti samuccaye ca śabdaḥ| tasya manasaḥ| tebhyo'nyeṃdriyebhyaḥ prāk pūrvaṃ utpannatvena| śruteḥ manaḥ sarveṃdriyāṇi ceti śravaṇāt| mana utpattimadeva na tvanutpattimadityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tat prāk śruteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ tad anutpatti iti samuccaye ca śabdaḥ tasya manasaḥ tebhyaḥ nya iṃdriyebhyaḥ prāk pūrvam utpanna tvena śruteḥ manaḥ sarva iṃdriyāṇi ca iti śravaṇāt manaḥ utpattimat eva na tu anutpattimat iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nānutpattirmanaso yujyate| utpannatve śrutisadbhāvāt| na cāsyā gatyaṃtaraṃ| pṛthaṅmanaso janmābhidhāyakatvena viśeṣaśrutitvāt| na cānyeṃdriyavanmanaso'pyutpattimatve tasyeṃdriyārthasya pṛthagabhidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ| anyeṃdriyebhyo'pi prāguktotpannatvābhiprāyeṇa tadupapatteḥ| na cānutpattiśrutivirodhaḥ| tasyāḥ sūkṣmarūpamanoviṣayattvāt|
analyzed: evam ca nā anutpattiḥ manasaḥ yujyate utpannatve śruti sadbhāvāt na ca asyāḥ gati aṃtaram pṛthak manasaḥ janma abhidhāyaka tvena viśeṣa śruti tvāt na ca anya iṃdriya vat manasaḥ upi utpattimatve tasya iṃdriya arthasya pṛthak abhidhānam vyartham anya iṃdriyebhyaḥ api prāgukta utpannatva abhiprāyeṇa tad upapatteḥ na ca anutpatti śruti virodhaḥ tasyāḥ sūkṣma rūpa manaḥ viṣaya ttvāt

original: na ca viśiṣyanityatvoktivirodhaḥ| anyeṃdriyebhyo'lpopacayābhiprāyakatvāttasyāḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena manasobhagavadutpannatvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca viśiṣya nitya tva ukti virodhaḥ anya iṃdriyebhyaḥ alpa upacaya abhiprāyaka tvāt tasyāḥ atas śruti avirodhena manasaḥ bhagavat utpannatva siddheḥ yuktaḥ jagat kāraṇe brahmaṇi śruti samanvayaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti tatprāgadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti tat prāc adhikaraṇam

original: atra vāgutpattiśruteranutpattiśrutyā virodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra vāc utpatti śruteḥ anutpatti śrutyā virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || tatpūrvakatvādvācaḥ || ||
analyzed: tad pūrvaka tvāt vācaḥ

original: nanu na vāgutpattimatī| vāgvāveti śruteḥ| na ceyaṃ śrutirvedaviṣayeti vācyaṃ| asyāṃ hi śrutiravatiṣṭhata iti śrutaśrutyāśrayatvāyogāt| kiṃca vāganutpattimatī nityaśrutyāśrayatvādityanumānavirodho vācaḥ sāditve duṣpariharaḥ| sādernityāśrayatvādarśanāt| na cānāditvaśrutiḥ sūkṣmarūpaviṣayā|
analyzed: nanu na vāc utpattimatī vāc vāva iti śruteḥ na ca iyam śrutiḥ veda viṣayā iti vācyam asyām hi śrutiḥ avatiṣṭhate iti śruta śruti āśraya tva ayogāt kiṃca vāc anutpattimatī nitya śruti āśraya tvāt iti anumāna virodhaḥ vācaḥ sādi tve duṣpariharaḥ sādeḥ nitya āśraya tva adarśanāt na ca anādi tva śrutiḥ sūkṣma rūpa viṣayā

original: nityaśrutaśrutyuccāraṇasāmarthyarūpaśrutyāśrayatvāyogāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nitya śruta śruti uccāraṇa sāmarthya rūpa śruti āśraya tva ayogāt iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || tatpūrvakatvādvāca iti || asyārthaḥ || vācaḥ vāgiṃdriyasya| tatpūrvakatvāt manaḥ pūrvarūpamiti manaḥ kāraṇakatvaśravaṇādvāṃgiṃdriyamutpattimadeva na tvanutpattimadevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tad pūrvaka tvāt vācaḥ iti asya arthaḥ vācaḥ vāc iṃdriyasya tad pūrvaka tvāt manaḥ pūrvarūpam iti manaḥ kāraṇaka tva śravaṇāt vāṃgiṃdriyam utpattimat eva na tu anutpattimat eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca vāgutpattimatī| vāguttararūpamiti kāryatvaśravaṇāt| na ca kāraṇābhāvātkāryatvamanupapannaṃ| manaḥ pūrvarūpamiti śākhāṃtaraśrutyā'rthānmanaḥ kāraṇakatvasyāsidhyā kāryatvopapatteḥ| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| śruterupacāreṇa nityatvābhidhānāt| na ca nityāśrayatvayuktyā nityatvaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca vāc utpattimatī vāc uttara rūpam iti kārya tva śravaṇāt na ca kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya tvam anupapannam manaḥ pūrva rūpam iti śākhāṃtara śrutyā arthāt manaḥ kāraṇaka tvasya asidhyā kārya tva upapatteḥ na ca śruti virodhaḥ śruteḥ upacāreṇa nitya tva abhidhānāt na ca nitya āśraya tva yuktyā nitya tvam

original: vāco nityaśrutisaṃnidhiyogyatāyā evāṃgīkṛtatvena nityaphalopahitaśrutyāśrayatvānaṃgīkārāt| śrutyarthaparyālocanayaupacārikanityatvasyaiva lābhāt| evaṃ satyeva hi vedāśrayatvena nityayā purāṇāśrayatvenānityayāstaumīti vākyārtho ghaṭate nānyathā| ataḥ śrutyavirodhenotpattisiddhervāco yuktaḥ śrutisamanvayo jagatkāraṇe harāviti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: vācaḥ nitya śruti saṃnidhi yogyatāyāḥ eva aṃgīkṛta tvena nitya phala upahita śruti āśraya tva anaṃgīkārāt śruti artha paryālocanayā aupacārika nitya tvasya eva lābhāt evam sati eva hi veda āśraya tvena nityayā purāṇa āśraya tvena anityayā āstaumi iti vākya arthaḥ ghaṭate na anyathā atas śruti avirodhena utpatti siddheḥ vācaḥ yuktaḥ śruti samanvayaḥ jagat kāraṇe harau iti siddham

original: || iti tatpūrvakatvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti tad pūrvakatva adhikaraṇam

original: atra prāṇasaṃkhyāviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra prāṇa saṃkhyā viṣaya śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: nanu `sapta prāṇāḥ prabhavaṃti' iti `dvādaśa vā' iti ca śrutyo parasparaviruddhatvādanirṇāyakatvaṃ| na cānyataraśrutyā'nyatarabādho yuktaḥ| samabalatvāt| na cābhimānināṃ saptatvātprāṇānāmapi saptatvameva| abhimānyabhimanyamānayoḥ samasaṃkhyātvaniyamāt| na ca saptatvaśrutiḥ sayuktikatvena prabalā|
analyzed: nanu sapta prāṇāḥ prabhavanti iti dvādaśa vā iti ca śrutyoḥ paraspara viruddha tvāt anirṇāyaka tvam na ca anyatara śrutyā anyatara bādhaḥ yuktaḥ sama bala tvāt na ca abhimāninām sapta tvāt prāṇānām api sapta tvam eva abhimāni abhimanyamānayoḥ sama saṃkhyā tva niyamāt na ca sapta tva śrutiḥ sayuktika tvena prabalā

original: dvādaśaveti śrutau prāṇamāsādīnāmekadaivatyābhiprāyeṇa dvādaśamāsā ityabhihitatvena prāṇābhimānināṃ dvādaśatvena prāṇānāmapi dvādaśatvaṃ vācyaṃ| uktayukterapyatrāpi sāmyāt| na ca dvādaśaprāṇeṣu saptā api saṃbhavaṃtīti śrutyoravirodhaḥ| dvādaśatve kāraṇaviśeṣābhāvena saptatvokterayogāt|
analyzed: śrutau prāṇa māsa ādīnām eka daivatya abhiprāyeṇa dvādaśa māsāḥ iti abhihita tvena prāṇa abhimāninām dvādaśa tvena prāṇānām api dvādaśa tvam vācyam ukta yukteḥ api atra api sāmyāt na ca dvādaśa prāṇeṣu saptā api saṃbhavanti iti śrutyoḥ avirodhaḥ dvādaśa tve kāraṇa viśeṣa abhāvena saptatva ukteḥ ayogāt

original: tataśca śrutyoraprāmāṇyena na śrutisamanvayeneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ca śrutyoḥ aprāmāṇyena na śruti samanvayena īśvarasya jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || sapta gaterviśeṣitatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdaḥ saptaprāṇāstvavagateriti pramāṇasamuccaye| gateḥ jñānasya| janakānīṃdriyāṇi sapta sapta saṃkhyākānīti nirṇaya eva| naṃ tvanirṇayaḥ| kutaḥ| viśeṣitatvāt sapta prāṇā iti śrutau guhāśayāṃ budhyarthaṃ nihitāḥ viśeṣaṇayuktatayā nirdiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sapta gateḥ viśeṣita tvāt ca iti asya arthaḥ ca śabdaḥ sapta prāṇāḥ tu avagateḥ iti pramāṇasamuccaye gateḥ jñānasya janakāni iṃdriyāṇi sapta sapta saṃkhyākāni iti nirṇayaḥ eva tu anirṇayaḥ kutas viśeṣita tvāt sapta prāṇāḥ iti śrutau guhā āśayām budhi artham nihitāḥ viśeṣaṇa yuktatayā nirdiṣṭa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dvādaśaiva prāṇāḥ| dvādaśaveti śruteḥ| na ca saptatvaśrutivirodhaḥ| dvādaśaprāṇeṣu saptatvasyāpi bhāvāt| na ca prāṇānāṃ dvādaśatve kāraṇābhāve saptatvokterayogaḥ| śrotracakṣuḥsparśanarasanaghrāṇamanobuddhīnāṃ jñānasādhaneṃdriyatvena tadvivakṣayā saptatvoktisaṃbhavāt| na ca teṣāṃ jñānārthatvamaprasiddhaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca dvādaśa eva prāṇāḥ dvādaśa vā iti śruteḥ na ca saptatva śruti virodhaḥ dvādaśa prāṇeṣu saptatvasya api bhāvāt na ca prāṇānām dvādaśa tve kāraṇa abhāve saptatva ukteḥ ayogaḥ śrotra cakṣuḥ sparśana rasana ghrāṇa manaḥ buddhīnām jñāna sādhana iṃdriya tvena tad vivakṣayā saptatva ukti saṃbhavāt na ca teṣām jñāna artha tvam aprasiddham

original: guhāśayāṃ nihitā iti vākyaśeṣasiddhatvāt| tataśca śrutyoravirodhena prāmāṇyācchrutisamanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: guhā āśayām nihitāḥ iti vākyaśeṣa siddha tvāt tatas ca śrutyoḥ avirodhena prāmāṇyāt śruti samanvayena viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatvam yuktam iti siddham

original: || hastādayastu sthite'tonaivaṃ || ||
analyzed: hasta ādayaḥ tu

original: nanu saptabhyo'nyeṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ sadbhāve'trātharvaṇaśrutau teṣāṃ paramātmajanyatvenocyamānaiḥ saptabhiḥ `saha sapta paṃca prāṇāḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ syāt| atra sahapāṭhābhāvo dvedhā bhavet| anāditvena vā paramātmanastadakāraṇatvena veti| tadubhayamapi `tathā prāṇāḥ' ityukti viruddhatvāt| na ca sahapāṭhe vā paramātmanastadakāraṇatve vā kāraṇaṃtaramasti|
analyzed: nanu saptabhyaḥ anyeṣām prāṇānām sadbhāve trātharvaṇa śrutau teṣām paramātma janya tvena ucyamānaiḥ saptabhiḥ saha sapta paṃca prāṇāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ syāt atra sahapāṭha abhāvaḥ dvedhā bhavet anādi tvena vā paramātmanaḥ tad akāraṇa tvena vā iti tat ubhayam api tathā prāṇāḥ iti ukti viruddha tvāt na ca sahapāṭhe vā paramātmanaḥ tad akāraṇa tve vā kāraṇaṃtaram asti

original: akāraṇakāryotpattiścāyuktā| tataśca sahapāṭhābhāvānna saptabhyo'nye prāṇāḥ saṃtīti prāpte pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati|
analyzed: akāraṇa kārya utpattiḥ ca ayuktā tatas ca sahapāṭha abhāvāt na saptabhyaḥ anye prāṇāḥ saṃti iti prāpte pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || || hastādayastu sthite'tonaivamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo vailakṣaṇyadyotakaḥ yato hastādayastu hastādīṃdriyāṇi tu| sthite sthitaṃ karma| tādarthye saptamī| karmārthīni| ataḥ asmādvailakṣaṇyāttāni| evaṃ jñāneṃdriyasaha bhāvena na paṭhitāni| atasteṣāṃ saptatā siddhaivetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: hasta ādayaḥ tu sthitā itas na evam iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ vailakṣaṇya dyotakaḥ yatas hasta ādayaḥ tu hasta ādi iṃdriyāṇi tu sthite sthitam karma tādarthye saptamī karma arthīni atas asmāt vailakṣaṇyāt tāni evam jñāna iṃdriya saha bhāvena na paṭhitāni atas teṣām saptatā siddhā eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca hastādīnāṃ paṃcānāṃ sthitihetutvalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyamāśritya sahapāṭhopapatteḥ| ataḥ śrutyoravirodhena prāmāṇyācchrutisamanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaniścayo yukta iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca hasta ādīnām paṃcānām sthiti hetutva lakṣaṇa vailakṣaṇyam āśritya sahapāṭha upapatteḥ atas śrutyoḥ avirodhena prāmāṇyāt śruti samanvayena viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatva niścayaḥ yuktaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti saptagatyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti sapta gati adhikaraṇam

original: atra prāṇaparimāṇaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra prāṇa parimāṇa viṣaya śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || aṇavaśca || ||
analyzed: aṇavaḥ ca

original: nanu vyāptāḥ prāṇāḥ| divīva cakṣuriti vyāptiśruteḥ| dūrasthavastudarśanaśravaṇānusaṃdhānādiyukteśca| na cāṇutvaśrutivirodhaḥ| viṣṇorvyāptatve dṛṣṭāṃtena cakṣurvyāpteruktatvenaitacchruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ prabalavyāptiśrutivirodhādaṇuśrutirapramāṇameveti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu vyāptāḥ prāṇāḥ divi iva cakṣuḥ iti vyāpti śruteḥ dūra stha vastu darśana śravaṇa anusaṃdhāna ādi yukteḥ ca na ca aṇu tva śruti virodhaḥ viṣṇoḥ vyāpta tve dṛṣṭāṃtena cakṣuḥ vyāpteḥ ukta tvena etad śruteḥ prābalyāt atas prabala vyāpti śruti virodhāt aṇu śrutiḥ apramāṇam eva iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || aṇavaśceti || asyārthaḥ || prāṇāḥ iṃdriyāṇi aṇavaḥ svato'ṇunītyarthaḥ| na kevalaṃ aṇūni kiṃtu tejasā vyāptāni ceti ca śabdārthaḥ ||
analyzed: aṇavaḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ prāṇāḥ iṃdriyāṇi aṇavaḥ svatas ṇuni iti arthaḥ na kevalam aṇūni kiṃtu tejasā vyāptāni ca iti ca śabda arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāṇava eva hi prāṇāḥ tathāśruteḥ| na ca divīva cakṣuriti prabalaśrutivirodhenāṇutvābhāvaḥ| aṇutvasyāpi tadyathā hyaṇu na iti prabalaśrutisiddhatvāt| na caivaṃ satyanirṇayaḥ| tadyathā hyaṇu naṃ iti śrutervispaṣṭavāditvena vyāptiśrutito'pi balavatvāt| na ca tadapramāṇaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca aṇavaḥ eva hi prāṇāḥ tathā śruteḥ na ca divi iva cakṣuḥ iti prabala śruti virodhena aṇu tva abhāvaḥ aṇu tvasya api tat yathā hi aṇu naḥ iti prabala śruti siddha tvāt na ca evam satya nirṇayaḥ tat yathā hi aṇu naḥ iti śruteḥ vispaṣṭa vādi tvena vyāpti śrutitaḥ api balavat tvāt na ca tat apramāṇam

original: tadyathā hyaṇu na iti śrutyanusāreṇa vyāptiśrutestejasāṃ vyāptyarthakatvanirṇayena yuktivirodhasya parākṛtatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇānāmaṇutvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tat yathā hi aṇu naḥ iti śruti anusāreṇa vyāpti śruteḥ tejasām vyāpti arthaka tva nirṇayena yukti virodhasya parākṛta tvāt atas śruti avirodhena prāṇānām aṇu tvam iti siddham

original: || iti aṇvadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti aṇu adhikaraṇam

original: atra mukhyaprāṇajanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra mukhya prāṇa janma viṣaya śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || śreṣṭhaśca || ||
analyzed: śreṣṭhaḥ ca

original: nanu notpattimānmukhyaprāṇaḥ| naiṣa prāṇa iti śruteḥ| na ca mukhyavāyvanutpattiśrutivadiyamapi śrutiranyathā yojanīyā| tasyā utpattimaraṇakāraṇatvenotpattyādyayoga iti yuktiyuktānāditvaśruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ prabalānāditvaśrutivirodhādutpattiśruteraprāmāṇyānna jagatkāraṇe parameśvare śrutisamanvayopapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na utpattimān mukhya prāṇaḥ na eṣa prāṇaḥ iti śruteḥ na ca mukhya vāyu anutpatti śruti vat iyam api śrutiḥ anyathā yojanīyā tasyāḥ utpatti maraṇa kāraṇa tvena utpatti ādi ayogaḥ iti yukti yukta anāditva śruteḥ prābalyāt atas prabala anāditva śruti virodhāt utpatti śruteḥ aprāmāṇyāt na jagat kāraṇe parameśvare śruti samanvaya upapattiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || śreṣṭhaśceti || asyārthaḥ || yathetare prāṇā utpadyaṃte evaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ mukhyaprāṇo'pi viṣṇorutpadyata eva na tvanutpattimānityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: śreṣṭhaḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ yathā itare prāṇāḥ utpadyaṃte evam śreṣṭhaḥ mukhya prāṇaḥ api viṣṇoḥ utpadyate eva na tu anutpattimān iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yathetare prāṇā utpadyaṃte tathā śreṣṭho'pi mukhyaprāṇa utpattimāneva| saukṣmyeṇa ha veti śruteḥ| na cānāditvaśrutivirodhaḥ| tasya sūkṣmarūpeṇa sadāsthiteḥ sthūlarūpeṇa kadāciduditatvasya coktatvāt| sthūlādibhāvasya svarūpatvābhāvāt| yadyapyasyetarajīvasādhāraṇatvānna viśeṣaḥ| tathā'pi śarīrādiṣvevāyaṃ sthūlo na tvitarajīvānāmiva caitanye|
analyzed: evam ca yathā itare prāṇāḥ utpadyaṃte tathā śreṣṭhaḥ api mukhya prāṇaḥ utpattimān eva saukṣmyeṇa ha vā iti śruteḥ na ca anādi tva śruti virodhaḥ tasya sūkṣma rūpeṇa sadā sthiteḥ sthūla rūpeṇa kadācid udita tvasya ca ukta tvāt sthūla ādi bhāvasya svarūpa tva abhāvāt yadi api asya itara jīva sādhāraṇa tvāt na viśeṣaḥ tathā api śarīra ādiṣu eva ayam sthūlaḥ na tu itara jīvānām iva caitanye

original: tadabhimānikṛtavikriyāviśeṣavāniti viśeṣasadbhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyavāyorjananasiddheryuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvaṃ śrutisamanvayena vāsudevasyeti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tad abhimāni kṛta vikriyā viśeṣavān iti viśeṣa sadbhāvāt atas śruti avirodhena mukhya vāyoḥ janana siddheḥ yuktam jagat kāraṇa tvam śruti samanvayena vāsudevasya iti siddham

original: || na vāyukriye pṛthagupadeśāt || ||
analyzed: na vā āyu kriye pṛthak upadeśāt

original: nanvanāditvaśruteḥ sayuktikatvena prabalatvāttadunusāreṇotpattiśrutereva ceṣṭā bāhyavāyuviṣayatayā vyākhyātavyā| tayorapi ceṣṭāyāmiti vākye prāṇaśabdavācyatvokteretayoranutpattivacanābhāvenotpattyaṃgīkāre virodhābhāvāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu anādi tva śruteḥ sayuktika tvena prabala tvāt tad unusāreṇa utpatti śruteḥ eva ceṣṭā bāhya vāyu viṣayatayā vyākhyātavyā tayoḥ api ceṣṭāyām iti vākye prāṇa śabda vācyatva ukteḥ etayoḥ anutpatti vacana abhāvena utpatti aṃgīkāre virodha abhāvāt iti prāpte sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || na vāyukriye pṛthagupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || vāyukriye bāhyavāyuceṣṭākhyakarmaṇī na| etasmāditi prāṇotpattiśrutipratipādye na bhavataḥ| kiṃtu mukhyavāyureva tatpratipādyaḥ| kutaḥ| pṛthagupadeśāt| sa prāṇamasṛjatetyādau mukhyavāyutpatteḥ vāyukriyotpattibhyāṃ sakāśāt pṛthak śravaṇādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na vāyu kriye pṛthak upadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ vāyu kriye bāhya vāyu ceṣṭā ākhya karmaṇī na etasmāt iti prāṇa utpatti śruti pratipādye na bhavataḥ kiṃtu mukhya vāyuḥ eva tad pratipādyaḥ kutas pṛthak upadeśāt sa prāṇam asṛjata ityādau mukhya vāyu utpatteḥ vāyu kriyā utpattibhyām sakāśāt pṛthak śravaṇāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca saprāṇamṛsṛjateti śrutau prāṇasyotpattimattvamabhidhāyaṃ prāṇācca ceṣṭāvāyvoḥ pṛthagutpattyābhidhānāt| tathaiva bhūtāni maṃtrāśceṣṭāśceti smṛtāvapyabhidhānāt| na ca sarvabhūtotpattikāraṇatvenottamatvena tasyotpattyabhāvaḥ| mahato'pi tasya tato'pyatimahatā viṣṇunā janmasaṃbhavāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyaprāṇasyotpattiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca śrutau prāṇasya utpattimattvam abhidhāyam prāṇāt ca ceṣṭā vāyvoḥ pṛthak utpattyā abhidhānāt tathā eva bhūtāni maṃtrāḥ ceṣṭāḥ ca iti smṛtau api abhidhānāt na ca sarva bhūta utpatti kāraṇa tvena uttama tvena tasya utpatti abhāvaḥ mahataḥ api tasya tatas upi atimahatā viṣṇunā janma saṃbhavāt atas śruti avirodhena mukhya prāṇasya utpattiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti śreṣṭhādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti śreṣṭha adhikaraṇam

original: atra mukhyaprāṇasvātaṃtryāsvātaṃtryaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra mukhya prāṇa svātaṃtrya asvātaṃtrya śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || cakṣurādivattu tatsahaśiṣṭyādibhyaḥ || ||
analyzed: cakṣuḥ ādi vat tu tad saha śiṣṭi ādibhyaḥ

original: nanu svataṃtra eva mukhyaprāṇaḥ| kiṃcidāśrita iti śruteḥ| na ca prāṇasyeti pārataṃtryaśrutivirodhaḥ| svātaṃtryasādhakākhilajagacceṣṭakatvayuktiyuktatvena svātaṃtryaśruterbalavattvāt| nacotpattimatvayuktiyuktatvena parataṃtryaśrutirapi balavatī| svātaṃtryavādino janmāsaṃpratipatteḥ| janmaśrutīnāmapyetacchrutivirodhenāprāmāṇyāt|
analyzed: nanu svataṃtraḥ eva mukhya prāṇaḥ kiṃcid āśritaḥ iti śruteḥ na ca prāṇasya iti pārataṃtrya śruti virodhaḥ svātaṃtrya sādhaka akhila jagat ceṣṭaka tva yukti yukta tvena svātaṃtrya śruteḥ balavat tvāt na ca utpattimatva yukti yukta tvena parataṃtrya śrutiḥ api balavatī svātaṃtrya vādinaḥ janma asaṃpratipatteḥ janma śrutīnām api etad śruti virodhena aprāmāṇyāt

original: prāmāṇye'pi līlayā vigrahagrahaṇasaṃbhavena tasya pārataṃtryasādhakatvābhāve pārataṃtryaśruteḥ sayuktikatvābhāvaḥ| ataḥ prabalaśrutivirodhāparihārādapramāṇaṃ pārataṃtryaśrutiḥ| ato nārāyaṇasya śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvāsiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: prāmāṇye api līlayā vigraha grahaṇa saṃbhavena tasya pārataṃtrya sādhaka tva abhāve pārataṃtrya śruteḥ sayuktika tva abhāvaḥ atas prabala śruti virodha aparihārāt apramāṇam pārataṃtrya śrutiḥ atas nārāyaṇasya śruti samanvayena jagat kāraṇatva asiddhiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || cakṣurādivattu tatsahaśiṣṭyādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| mukhyaprāṇo'pi cakṣurādivatparamātmādhīna eva na tu svataṃtraḥ| kutaḥ| tatsahaśiṣṭayādibhyaḥ taiścakṣurādibhiḥ saha mukhyavāyorapi sarvaṃ hyevaitāditi śrutau parādhīnatvokteḥ| sarvakartetyādivacanoktayuktibhyaścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: cakṣuḥ ādi vat tu tad sahaśiṣṭi ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ tu śabde eva arthe mukhya prāṇaḥ api cakṣuḥ ādi vat paramātma adhīnaḥ eva na tu svataṃtraḥ kutas tad sahaśiṣṭayādibhyaḥ taiḥ cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ saha mukhya vāyoḥ api sarvam hi eva etāt iti śrutau para adhīna tva ukteḥ sarva kartā ityādi vacana ukta yuktibhyaḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca mukhyaprāṇaścakṣurādivatparamātmādhīna eva| sarvaṃ hyevaitaditi cakṣurādibhiḥ sahaiva tadvaśatvābhidhānāt| mukhyavāyurna svataṃtraḥ bhagavatpreraṇāmaṃtareṇa darśanādiśaktividhuratvāditi yukteḥ| na cāsiddhiḥ| nānyo'to'stīti śrutisiddhatvāt| yadyapi prāṇaḥ sarvakartā tathā'pi sa īśvarādhīno'bhyupagaṃtavyaḥ| anyathā prāṇa eva na syāt|
analyzed: evam ca mukhya prāṇaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi vat paramātma adhīnaḥ eva sarvam hi eva etat iti cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ saha eva tad vaśatva abhidhānāt mukhya vāyuḥ na svataṃtraḥ bhagavat preraṇām aṃtareṇa darśana ādi śakti vidhura tvāt iti yukteḥ na ca asiddhiḥ śruti siddha tvāt yadi api prāṇaḥ sarva kartā tathā api saḥ īśvara adhīnaḥ abhyupagaṃtavyaḥ anyathā prāṇaḥ eva na syāt

original: paramātmanaḥ svātaṃtryasyāpalāpe jagadudayādyabhāvena svātaṃtryavastudvayāsaṃbhavena ca śrutyavirodhena prāṇasyeśavaśatvasiddheruktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: paramātmanaḥ svātaṃtryasya apalāpe jagat udaya ādi abhāvena svātaṃtrya vastu dvaya asaṃbhavena ca śruti avirodhena prāṇasya īśa vaśa tva siddheḥ uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || akaraṇatvācca na doṣastathā hi darśayati || ||
analyzed: akaraṇa tvāt ca na doṣaḥ tathā hi darśayati

original: nanu yadi cakṣurādivadeveśvarādhīnatvaṃ mukhyaprāṇasya tarhi tasyāvāṃtareśvaratvādyasaṃbhavena na prāṇaḥ kiṃciditi svātaṃtryaśrutervaiyarthya syādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu yadi cakṣuḥ ādi vat eva īśvara adhīnatvam mukhyaprāṇasya tarhi na prāṇaḥ kiṃcid iti svātaṃtrya śruteḥ vaiyarthya syāt iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || || akaraṇatvācca na doṣastathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || mukhyaprāṇasya karaṇatvāt kartṛprayojyatvarūpakaraṇābhannatvāt cakṣurādīnāṃ tadrūpatvācca asmādeva vailakṣaṇyānmukhyasyetarebhya uttamatvasiddheḥ| na doṣaḥ mukhyaprāṇasvātaṃtryavāciśruteravāṃtareśvaraparatvābhāvadoṣo nāsti| kasmādevaṃ kalpyata iti cet| hi yasmāt|
analyzed: akaraṇa tvāt ca na doṣaḥ tathā hi darśayati iti asya arthaḥ mukhya prāṇasya karaṇa tvāt kartṛ prayojya tva rūpa karaṇa abhanna tvāt cakṣuḥ ādīnām tad rūpa tvāt ca asmāt eva vailakṣaṇyāt mukhyasya itarebhyaḥ uttama tva siddheḥ na doṣaḥ mukhya prāṇa svātaṃtrya vāci śruteḥ avāṃtareśvara paratva abhāva doṣaḥ na asti kasmāt evam kalpyate iti ced hi yasmāt

original: tāni ha vā iti śrutistathā uktaprakāreṇa| darśayati jñāpayati| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tāni ha vai iti śrutiḥ tathā ukta prakāreṇa darśayati jñāpayati tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca sarveṣāmīśvarādhīnatvasāmye'pītareṣāṃ kartṛprayojyatvānmukhyaprāṇasya tadabhāvena viśeṣāt| suptyādau vyāpārabhāvābhāvarūpayuktyā tāni ha veti śrutyāca viśeṣasiddheścopapannaṃ tasyāvāṃtareśvaratvaṃ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇasyeśavaśatvaṃ siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sarveṣām īśvara adhīna tva sāmye pi itareṣām kartṛ prayojya tvāt mukhyaprāṇasya tad abhāvena viśeṣāt supti ādau vyāpāra bhāva abhāva rūpa yuktyā tāni ha vā iti śrutyā ca viśeṣa siddheḥ ca upapannam atas śruti avirodhena prāṇasya īśa vaśa tvam siddham

original: || iti cakṣurādyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti cakṣuḥ ādya adhikaraṇam

original: atra prāṇāpānādermukhyaprāṇasvarūpatvataddāsatvaviṣaye śrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra prāṇa apāna ādeḥ mukhya prāṇa svarūpa tva tad dāsa tva viṣaye śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || paṃcavṛttirmanovadvyapadiśyate || ||
analyzed: paṃca vṛttiḥ manaḥ vat vyapadiśyate

original: nanu sarve vā ete mukhyadāsā iti mukhyasyaiva svarūpāṇīti śrutidvayamapramāṇaṃ| arthānirṇāyakatvāt| yadyeko mukhyasyaiva svarūpāṇīti śrutiṃ vyaktasadguṇatvayuktiṃ cāvalaṃbya prāṇādayo mukhyaprāṇasvarūpāṇyeveti brūyāttarhyaparopi sarve vā eta iti tadājñayā karmakāritvayuktiṃ cāvalaṃbya prāṇādayo dāsā eveti brūyāt|
analyzed: nanu sarve vai ete mukhya dāsāḥ iti mukhyasya eva sva rūpāṇi iti śruti dvayam apramāṇam artha anirṇāyaka tvāt yadi ekaḥ mukhyasya eva sva rūpāṇi iti śrutim vyakta sat guṇa tva yuktim ca avalaṃbya prāṇa ādayaḥ mukhya prāṇa sva rūpāṇi eva iti brūyāt tarhi aparaḥ api sarve vai ete iti tad ājñayā karma kāri tva yuktim ca avalaṃbya prāṇa ādayaḥ dāsāḥ eva iti brūyāt

original: ata etadyuktiśrutyavaṣṭhaṃbhenādyā dāsā eveti vrūyāttarhi paro'pi prācīnaśrutiyuktyavaṣṭhaṃbhena svarūpāṇyeveti brūyāt| samabalatvenānyataraśrutibādhāyogāt| evaṃcārthānirṇayena śrutidvayāprāmāṇyānna śrutibalena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: atas etad yukti śruti avaṣṭhaṃbhena ādyāḥ dāsāḥ eva iti vrūyāt tarhi paraḥ api prācīna śruti yukti avaṣṭhaṃbhena svarūpāṇi eva iti brūyāt sama bala tvena anyatara śruti bādhā ayogāt evam ca artha anirṇayena śruti dvaya aprāmāṇyāt na śruti balena viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatva siddhiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || || paṃcavṛttirmanobad‌vyapadiśyata iti || asyārthaḥ || manovat manasa iva| yathā manasaḥ manobudhyahaṃkāracittacetanākhyapaṃcaprakāropetatvaṃ tathā mukhyaprāṇo'pi paṃcavṛttiḥ prāṇāpānāpaṃcarūpavān| kutaḥ| yasmāt atha paṃcavṛttyeti śrutau tathā vyapadiśyate pratipādyate| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: paṃca vṛttiḥ manaḥ bat vyapadiśyate iti asya arthaḥ manaḥ vat manasaḥ iva yathā manasaḥ manaḥ budhi ahaṃkāra citta cetanā ākhya paṃca prakāra upeta tvam tathā mukhya prāṇaḥ api paṃca vṛttiḥ prāṇa apāna apaṃca rūpavān kutas yasmāt atha paṃca vṛttyā iti śrutau tathā vyapadiśyate pratipādyate tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prāṇādayo dāsā eva svarūpāṇyeveti na brūmaḥ| yena parasparavirodhenānirṇayaḥ| kiṃ nāmārtha paṃcavṛttyaitaditi śrutyavaṣṭhaṃbhena manovat| prāṇādayaḥ svarūpāṇi dāsāśceti dvividhāḥ| tataśca śrutyorbhinnaviṣayatvenābādhaḥ| na ca prāṇānāṃ dāsatve vyaktasadguṇatvavirodhaḥ| dāsānāmapi tadaṃgīkārāt| na ca svāmibhṛtyabhāvānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: evam ca prāṇa ādayaḥ dāsāḥ eva sva rūpāṇi eva iti na brūmaḥ yena paraspara virodhena anirṇayaḥ kim nāma artha paṃca vṛttyā etat iti śruti avaṣṭhaṃbhena manaḥ vat prāṇa ādayaḥ sva rūpāṇi dāsāḥ ca iti dvividhāḥ tatas ca śrutyoḥ bhinna viṣaya tvena ābādhaḥ na ca prāṇānām dāsa tve vyakta sat guṇa tva virodhaḥ dāsānām api tad aṃgīkārāt na ca svāmi bhṛtya bhāva anupapattiḥ

original: svāmināṃ tato'pi vyaktasadguṇatvena tadbhāvopapatteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇādisvarūpasiddheryakto jagatkāraṇi brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: svāminām tatas api vyakta sat guṇa tvena tad bhāva upapatteḥ atas śruti avirodhena prāṇa ādi svarūpa siddheḥ yaktaḥ jagat kāraṇi brahmaṇi śruti samanvayaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti paṃcavṛttyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti paṃca vṛtti adhikaraṇam

original: atra mukhyaprāṇaparimāṇaviṣayaśrutirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra mukhya prāṇa parimāṇa viṣaya śruti rodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || aṇuśca || ||
analyzed: aṇuḥ ca

original: nanu vyāpta evāyaṃ prāṇaḥ| prāṇa evādhastāditi vyāptiśruteḥ| na ca `aṇunetyaṇutvaśrutivirodhaḥ'| sakalajagaddhārakatvayuktiyuktatvena vyāptiśruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ prabalaśrutivirodhādapramāṇamaṇutvaśrutiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu vyāptaḥ eva ayam prāṇaḥ prāṇaḥ eva adhastāt iti vyāpti śruteḥ na ca aṇunā iti aṇu tva śruti virodhaḥ sakala jagat dhāraka tva yukti yuktatvena vyāpti śruteḥ prābalyāt atas prabala śruti virodhāt apramāṇam aṇu tva śrutiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || || aṇuśceti || asyārthaḥ || mukhyaprāṇaḥ prāṇarūpeṇāṇuḥ| vāyurūpeṇa vyāptaścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aṇuḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ mukhya prāṇaḥ prāṇa rūpeṇa aṇuḥ vāyu rūpeṇa vyāptaḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāṇureva mukhya prāṇaḥ| sa vā eṣa prāṇa iti śruteḥ| na ca vyāptiśrutivirodhaḥ| tasyā bahirdehādvartamānavāyurūpaviṣayatvāt| aṃtarvā'ṇurbahirmahāniti viśeṣaśruteḥ| nāḍīsaṃcāritvayukteśca| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyaprāṇasyāṇutvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca aṇuḥ eva mukhya prāṇaḥ sa vai eṣa prāṇaḥ iti śruteḥ na ca vyāpti śruti virodhaḥ tasyāḥ bahis dehāt vartamāna vāyu rūpa viṣaya tvāt aṃtar vā aṇuḥ bahis mahān iti viśeṣa śruteḥ nāḍī saṃcāri tva yukteḥ ca atas śruti avirodhena mukhya prāṇasya aṇu tva siddheḥ yuktaḥ jagat kāraṇe brahmaṇi śruti samanvayaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti aṇvadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti aṇu adhikaraṇam

original: atreṃdriyaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra iṃdriya viṣaya śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu tadāmananāt || ||
analyzed: jyotiḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam tu tad āmananāt

original: nanviṃdriyāṇi jīvakaraṇāni| jīvasya karaṇānyāhuriti jīvasaṃbaṃdhitvaśruteḥ| na ca brahmaṇyoveti śrutyaṃtaravirodhaḥ| jīvavaśatvena prāṇānāṃ dṛśyamānatvayuktiyuktatvena jīvakaraṇatvaśruteḥ prābalyāt| tataścaitacchrutivirodhena brahmakaraṇaśruteraprāmāṇyāt| na śrutisamanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu iṃdriyāṇi jīva karaṇāni jīvasya karaṇāni āhuḥ iti jīva saṃbaṃdhi tva śruteḥ na ca brahmaṇyaḥ vā iti śruti aṃtara virodhaḥ jīva vaśa tvena prāṇānām dṛśyamāna tva yukti yukta tvena jīva karaṇa tva śruteḥ prābalyāt tatas ca etad śruti virodhena brahma karaṇa śruteḥ aprāmāṇyāt na śruti samanvayena viṣṇoḥ jagat kāraṇatva siddhiḥ iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || || jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu tadāmananāditi || asyārthaḥ || jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānamityāvartate| tattvityanvayaḥ| tathā ca jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ agnyādibhūtaprerakaṃ tat‌brahmaiva| jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakṣurādiprerakaṃ na jīvaḥ| kutaḥ| tadāmananāt yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhannityādinā tathā pratipādanādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: jyotiḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam tu tad āmananāt iti asya arthaḥ jyotiḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam iti āvartate tat tu iti anvayaḥ tathā ca jyotiḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam agni ādi bhūta prerakam tat brahmā eva jyotiḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam cakṣuḥ ādi prerakam na jīvaḥ kutas tad āmananāt yaḥ cakṣuṣi tiṣṭhan ityādinā tathā pratipādanāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca brahmasaṃbaṃdhīnyeva karaṇāni jīvasya jñānādisādhanāni| na punarjīvakaraṇāni| jīvāpekṣayā teṣāmuttamatvena jīvaprayojyatvāsaṃbhavāt| tadeva hi svaṃ nāma bhavati| yadyatheṣṭhaviniyogārhaṃ na ca tata eva na brahmasaṃbaṃdhīnyapīti vācyaṃ| etanmūlatejaḥ prabhṛti bhūtasyaiva brahmaniyamyatvena sutarāmeṣāṃ tanniyamyatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca brahma saṃbaṃdhīni eva karaṇāni jīvasya jñāna ādi sādhanāni na punar jīva karaṇāni jīva apekṣayā teṣām uttama tvena jīva prayojya tva asaṃbhavāt tat eva hi svam nāma bhavati yat yatheṣṭha viniyoga arham na ca tatas eva na brahma saṃbaṃdhīni api iti vācyam etat mūla tejaḥ prabhṛti bhūtasya eva brahma niyamya tvena sutarām eṣām tad niyamya tvāt

original: yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhannityādiśruteśca| ato śrutyavirodhena prāṇānāṃ brahmakāraṇatvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: yaḥ cakṣuṣi tiṣṭhan ityādi śruteḥ ca atas śruti avirodhena prāṇānām brahma kāraṇatva siddheḥ yuktaḥ jagatkāraṇe harau śruti samanvayaḥ iti siddham

original: || prāṇavatā śabdāt || ||
analyzed: prāṇavatā śabdāt

original: nanu na karaṇāni jīvasaṃbaṃdhīni cettarhi tatkaraṇatvābidhāyakaśruteraprāmāṇyaprasaṃga ityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu na karaṇāni jīva saṃbaṃdhīni ced tarhi tad karaṇa tva a bidhāyaka śruteḥ aprāmāṇya prasaṃgaḥ iti āśaṃkām apākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || || prāṇavatā śabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || paramātmā svaprayojyaireva cakṣurādibhiḥ karaṇaiḥ prāṇavatā jīvena kartrā darśanādi kārayati na jīvaprayojyaiḥ| kutaḥ| śabdāt eṣa hyaneneti śruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prāṇavatā śabdāt iti asya arthaḥ paramātmā sva prayojyaiḥ eva cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ karaṇaiḥ prāṇavatā jīvena kartrā darśana ādi kārayati na jīva prayojyaiḥ kutas śabdāt eṣa hi anena iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca karaṇatvābhidhāyakaśruterbrahma svakaraṇaireva darśanādi kārayatīti yācitakuṭhāravadīṣatsaṃbaṃdhitvamastīti tatparatvena prāmāṇyapapatteḥ| jīvakaraṇasaṃbaṃdhasyānādinityatvena tadabhiprāyeṇāpi pravṛttāyāstasyāḥ prāmāṇyopapatteḥ| dṛśyate khalu loke parakīye bahukālasaṃbaṃdhini tadīyatvopacāraḥ|
analyzed: evam ca karaṇatva abhidhāyaka śruteḥ brahma sva karaṇaiḥ eva darśana ādi kārayati iti yācita kuṭhāra vat īṣat saṃbaṃdhi tvam asti iti tad paratvena prāmāṇya apapatteḥ jīva karaṇa saṃbaṃdhasya anādi nitya tvena tad abhiprāyeṇa api pravṛttāyāḥ tasyāḥ prāmāṇya upapatteḥ dṛśyate khalu loke parakīye bahu kāla saṃbaṃdhini tadīya tva upacāraḥ

original: na ca yadīṃdriyāṇi brahmakaraṇāni tarhi mukhyaprāṇasyāpi tatsamāna eveti prāguktaṃ| tasmātprāma evākaraṇa iti mukhyaprāṇakaraṇatvamayuktamiti cenna| īśvaraścakṣurādīn kiṃcijjīvecchayā prerayati| mukhyaprāṇastu svaicchayaiveti viśeṣasadbhāvena tadupapatteḥ| karaṇeḥ kāraṇamiti tyādivacanasadbhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca yadi iṃdriyāṇi brahma karaṇāni tarhi mukhya prāṇasya api tad samānaḥ eva iti prāguktam tasmāt prāmaḥ eva akaraṇaḥ iti mukhya prāṇa karaṇa tvam ayuktam iti ced na īśvaraḥ cakṣuḥ ādīn kiṃcid jīva icchayā prerayati mukhya prāṇaḥ tu sva aicchayā eva iti viśeṣa sadbhāvena tad upapatteḥ karaṇeḥ kāraṇam iti tyādi vacana sadbhāvāt

original: ataḥ śrutyavirodhena brahmaṇijagatkāraṇe śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas śruti avirodhena brahmaṇi jagatkāraṇe śruti samanvayaḥ yuktaḥ iti siddham

original: || tasya ca nityatvāt || ||
analyzed: tasya ca nitya tvāt

original: evaṃ bhagavadadhīnānyapīṃdriyāṇyasvataṃtrajīvakartṛke karmaṇi sādhanatvāttatkaraṇānītyucyaṃte| yathā parakīya kuṭhāreṇāpi vraścato'sau tatkaraṇamucyata ityevaṃ mukyamarthaṃ jīvakaraṇatvaśruteruktvā'dhunā mukhyārthātarapratipādakaṃ sūtramavatārayati ||
analyzed: evam bhagavat adhīnāni api iṃdriyāṇi asvataṃtra jīva kartṛke karmaṇi sādhana tvāt tad karaṇāni iti ucyaṃte yathā parakīya kuṭhāreṇa api vraścataḥ asau tat karaṇam ucyate iti evam mukyam artham jīva karaṇa tva śruteḥ uktvā adhunā mukhya artha atara pratipādakam sūtram avatārayati

original: || || tasya ca nityatvāditi || asyārthaḥ|| cakṣurādīnāṃ brahmakaraṇatve'pi tasya jīvasya karaṇasya ca tayoḥ saṃbaṃdhasya ca nityatvāt| tadvivakṣayā jīvakaraṇatvaśrutirapyupapadyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tasya ca nitya tvāt iti asya arthaḥ cakṣuḥ ādīnām brahma karaṇa tve pi tasya jīvasya karaṇasya ca tayoḥ saṃbaṃdhasya ca nitya tvāt tad vivakṣayā jīva karaṇa tva śrutiḥ api upapadyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca parakīye'pi bahukālasaṃbaṃdhini vastunyupacāratastadīyatvavyavahāradarśanādatrāpi bhagavadīyeṣvapīṃdriyeṣu bahukālanijīvasaṃbaṃdhitāyāḥ sadbhāvena tatkaraṇatvaśrutiḥ pravṛtteti śruterupacāritārthatvāt| athāviyogīnīti śruteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena pare brahmaṇi jagatkāraṇe śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca parakīye api bahu kāla saṃbaṃdhini vastuni upacārataḥ tadīya tva vyavahāra darśanāt atra api bhagavadīyeṣu api iṃdriyeṣu bahu kāla nijīva saṃbaṃdhitāyāḥ sadbhāvena tad karaṇatva śrutiḥ pravṛttā iti śruteḥ upacārita artha tvāt atha aviyogīni iti śruteḥ atas śruti avirodhena pare brahmaṇi jagat kāraṇe śruti samanvayaḥ yuktaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti jyotiradhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti jyotiḥ adhikaraṇam

original: atra mukhya prāṇasyeṃdriyatvāniṃdriyatvaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate|
analyzed: atra mukhya prāṇasya iṃdriya tva aniṃdriya tva śruti virodhaḥ parihriyate

original: || ta iṃdriyāṇi tadvyapadeśādanyatra śreṣṭhāt || ||
analyzed: te iṃdriyāṇi tad vyapadeśāt anyatra śreṣṭhāt

original: nanu sarve'pi prāṇā iṃdriyāṇi| prāṇā vā iṃdriyāṇīti śruteḥ| sāmānyaśruteḥ sarvagāmitvāt| na ca dvādaśaiveṃdriyāṇīti viśeṣaśrutyā bādhaḥ| idaṃ dravaṇayuktiyuktatvena sāmānyaśruterbalavattvāt| duṣkaraṃ ca dvādaśānāmeveṃdriyatvagrahaṇaṃ| anyatamaniveśanasyāśakyatvāt| niyāmakaṃ vinā kasyacitparityāge'parasyāpi tatsyāditi dvādaśatvahāniḥ|

analyzed: evam ca vairāgya ādi ananuṣṭhāne mokṣa asiddheḥ na ca evam śrutiṃvirodhaḥ karma hi kāmyam akāmyam ca iti dvividham akāmyam api jñānāt pūrva bhāvi paścāt bhāvi ca iti dvividham tat sarvam api śruti arthaḥ eva adhikāri bhedāt yadā śrutiḥ kāmya karma parā na tadā mukhya amṛta tvam kiṃtu bahu kāla jīvana rūpa bhāktam artham āha

original: karmaṇāṃ bhinnadeśakālavipākatve'pi yajñādyārādhitabhagavatprasādena bhavanmate saubharyādivatsvargādāveva sarvakarmakṣayo nānupapannaḥ| tataśca vairāgyāderanāvaśyakatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||

original: evaṃcopādānanimittasadbhāvāt| manogatāṃśca saṃskārāniti smṛtibalena vāsanāyā upādānatveneśvarecchāyāśca nimittatvenāṃgīkārāt| vāsanāmayānāṃ mervādīnāṃ manasaiva darśanasaṃbhavāt| bāhyakāraṇābhāvāt| prāk‌piṃḍādīnāmūrdhvaṃ kapālādīnāṃ pratīteraprasaṃgāt| ataḥ svapnaviṣayasya bhagavadadhīnatvasiddhestatra bhaktiryukteti siddhaṃ ||

original: || sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvidaḥ ||

original: || sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvida iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| svāpnapadārthaḥ sūcakaḥ śubhāśubhajñāpakaḥ| ato'pi nāsatyaḥ| tatkutaḥ| yadeti śruteḥ| pratyakṣataḥ phaladarśanācceti hi śabdaḥ| kiṃca tadvidaḥ svapnavido vyāsādayaḥ ācakṣate ca| yadeti śrutau svāpnāmarthakriyākāritvaṃ vadaṃtyo'pītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sūcakaḥ ca hi śruteḥ ācakṣate ca tad vidaḥ iti asya arthaḥ caḥ yatas svāpna padārthaḥ sūcakaḥ śubha aśubha jñāpakaḥ atas api na asatyaḥ tat kutas yadā iti śruteḥ pratyakṣataḥ phala darśanāt ca iti hi śabdaḥ kiṃca tadvidaḥ svapnavidaḥ vyāsa ādayaḥ ācakṣate ca yadā iti śrutau svāpnām arthakriyā kāri tvam vadaṃtyāḥ upi iti arthaḥ

original: nanu na viśvādīnāmabhedo yuktaḥ| kāryakāraṇamiti śrutau bhedakadharmavyapadeśādityādinoktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati ||
