original: || na bhedāditi cenna pratyekamatadvacanāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhedāt kāryakāraṇabaddhāviti svapnajāgradanubhavajanakatvarūpabhedakatvadharmaśravaṇāt viśvādirūpāṇāṃ nābheda iti cenna| kutaḥ| pratyekaṃ parasparaṃ| teṣāṃ rūpāṇāṃ| atadvacanāt| ya eta ātmetyabhedaśruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na bhedāt iti ced na pratyekam atadvacanāt iti asya arthaḥ bhedāt kārya kāraṇa baddhau iti svapna jāgrat anubhava janaka tva rūpa bhedaka tva dharma śravaṇāt viśva ādi rūpāṇām na abhedaḥ iti ced na kutas pratyekam parasparam teṣām rūpāṇām atadvacanāt ye ete ātmā iti abheda śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcaiṣata ātmetyayameva sa ityayaṃ vai haraya ityādi śrutīnāmabhedabodhakatvāt| api cāmātro'naṃtamātreti śrutau viśvādyanaṃtarūpeṇa mūlarūpasya cābhedasyoktatvāt| ato hareḥ svagatabhedarahitatvena tasminbhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca eṣataḥ ātmā iti ayam eva saḥ iti ayam vai haraye ityādi śrutīnām abheda bodhaka tvāt api ca amātraḥ ūnaṃta mātrā iti śrutau viśva ādi anaṃta rūpeṇa mūla rūpasya ca abhedasya ukta tvāt atas hareḥ svagata bheda rahita tvena tasmin bhaktiḥ kāryā iti siddham

original: || api caivameke ||
analyzed: api ca evam eke

original: nanu nābhedaśrutibhirbhedaśruterbādho yuktaḥ tāsāṃ katipayarūpaviṣayatvena sāvakāśatvāt| nāpyayaṃ vai haraya iti śrutivirodhaḥ| tatra parasparamabhedānuktermularūpeṇāpi| eṣa ta ātmeti śrutivatspaṣṭamabhedāpratīteḥ| ato bhedaśrutibalādviśvādīnāṃ bheda evetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu na abheda śrutibhiḥ bheda śruteḥ bādhaḥ yuktaḥ tāsām katipaya rūpa viṣaya tvena sāvakāśa tvāt na api ayam vai haraye iti śruti virodhaḥ tatra parasparam abheda anukteḥ mula rūpeṇa api eṣa te ātmā iti śruti vat spaṣṭam abheda apratīteḥ atas bheda śruti balāt viśva ādīnām bhedaḥ eva iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || api caivameka iti|| yataḥ evamabhedaṃ ca śabdādanaṃtarūpatvaṃ caike śākhinaḥ amātra iti śrutau paṭhaṃti| api abhede'pi bhedavyapadeśaḥ sthānabhedādyajyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: api ca evam eke iti yatas evam abhedam ca śabdāt anaṃta rūpa tvam ca eke śākhinaḥ amātraḥ iti śrutau paṭhaṃti api abhede pi bheda vyapadeśaḥ sthāna bhedāt yajyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcaike śākhino viśvādyanaṃtarūpeṇa cābhedaṃ paṭhaṃti| ato hareḥ svagatabhedaśūnyatvena sarvaguṇāpūrṇatvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca eke śākhinaḥ viśva ādi anaṃta rūpeṇa ca abhedam paṭhaṃti atas hareḥ svagata bheda śūnya tvena sarva guṇa āpūrṇa tvāt yuktā tatra bhaktiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti na sthānato'pyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na sthānatas api adhikaraṇam

original: atra viṣṇoraprākṛtarūpaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra viṣṇoḥ aprākṛta rūpam samarthyate

original: || arūpavadeva hi tatpradhānatvāt ||
analyzed: a rūpavat eva hi tad pradhāna tvāt

original: nanu nāṃgīkartavyā'tiśayā bhaktirbhagavati| bhagavato rūpitvāṃgīkāre'nityatvaprasaṃgāt| tadarūpamiti śrutyapramāṇyaprasaṃgācca| tataśca bhaktivilopaḥ| na hyanityaśarīre niratiśayā bhaktirupapadyate| nāpyarūpitvaśrutyaprāmāṇye sā yujyate| arūpitvaśrutyaprāmāṇye'viśeṣāt| śrutimātrāprāmāṇyāpattyā bhaktiprayojakaguṇasiddheḥ|
analyzed: nanu na aṃgīkartavya atiśayā bhaktiḥ bhagavati bhagavataḥ rūpi tva aṃgīkāre nitya tva prasaṃgāt tat arūpam iti śruti apramāṇya prasaṃgāt ca tatas ca bhakti vilopaḥ na hi anitya śarīre niratiśayā bhaktiḥ upapadyate na api arūpi tva śruti aprāmāṇye sā yujyate arūpi tva śruti aprāmāṇye viśeṣāt śruti mātra aprāmāṇya āpattyā bhakti prayojaka guṇa siddheḥ

original: tataśca bhakteranupapannatvād‌vyartho'yaṃ pāda iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ca bhakteḥ anupapanna tvāt vyarthaḥ yam pādaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || arūpavadeva hi tatpradhānatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || brahma arūpavadeva prākṛtarūparahitameva| kutaḥ| tatpradhānatvāt prakṛtyādyuttamatvāt| hi śabdasūcitāsthūlamiti śruteścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: arūpavat eva hi tad pradhāna tvāt iti asya arthaḥ brahma arūpavat eva prākṛta rūpa rahitam eva kutas tad pradhāna tvāt prakṛti ādi uttama tvāt hi śabda sūcita asthūlam iti śruteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāpekṣitaiva bhagavadbhaktiḥ| tasyārūpitve nānityatvarūpitvaśrutyapramāṇyalakṣaṇadoṣarahitatvāt| na cārūpitvamasiddhaṃ| prakṛtyuttamatvena prākṛtarūpavaidhuryasiddheḥ| tadevaṃ bhakterupapannatvātsārthako'yaṃ pāda iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca apekṣitā eva bhagavat bhaktiḥ tasya arūpi tve na anitya tva rūpi tva śruti apramāṇya lakṣaṇa doṣa rahitatvāt na ca arūpi tvam asiddham prakṛti uttama tvena prākṛta rūpa vaidhurya siddheḥ tat evam bhakteḥ upapanna tvāt sārthakaḥ yam pādaḥ iti siddham

original: || prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyaṃ ||
analyzed: prakāśa vat ca a vaiyarthyam

original: nanu brahmaṇo rūpābhāve rukmavarṇamityādirūpitvaśrutivaiyarthyaṃ syāt| api ca sauṃdaryasaulakṣaṇyādyabhāvāpatteścetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu brahmaṇaḥ rūpa abhāve rukma varṇam ityādi rūpi tva śruti vaiyarthyam syāt api ca sauṃdarya saulakṣaṇya ādi abhāva āpatteḥ ca iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram paṭhati

original: || prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyamiti || asyārthaḥ || co hetusūcakaḥ| prakāśavat lokavilakṣaṇacakṣurādiprakāśe nāsti prakāśa iti vyavahārasyeva| avaiyarthyaṃ na brahmaṇo rūpitvaśrutīnāmaprāmāṇyaṃ| kutaḥ tasyārūpitve'pi vilakṣaṇarūpitvābhyupagamādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prakāśa vat ca avaiyarthyam iti asya arthaḥ caḥ hetu sūcakaḥ prakāśa vat loka vilakṣaṇa cakṣuḥ ādi prakāśe na asti prakāśaḥ iti vyavahārasya iva avaiyarthyam na brahmaṇaḥ rūpi tva śrutīnām aprāmāṇyam kutas tasya arūpi tve api vilakṣaṇa rūpi tva abhyupagamāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca rukmavarṇamityādiśrutervaiyarthyābhāvaḥ sauṃdaryādyabhāvaśca| aprākṛtaśarīrasyāṃgīkārāt| ato'pekṣitaiva bhagavadbhaktiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca rukma varṇam ityādi śruteḥ vaiyarthya abhāvaḥ sauṃdarya ādi abhāvaḥ ca aprākṛta śarīrasya aṃgīkārāt atas upekṣitā eva bhagavat bhaktiḥ iti siddham

original: || āha ca tanmātraṃ ||
analyzed: āha ca tanmātram

original: nanu kathaṃ brahmaṇo lokavilakṣaṇarūpatvaṃ| yenānityatvādidoṣābhāvaḥ| sarvarūpāṇāṃ prakṛtyādyātmakatvaniyamāt| itararūpāpekṣayā tadrūpasya vailakṣaṇyānukteriti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu katham brahmaṇaḥ loka vilakṣaṇa rūpatvam yena anitya tva ādi doṣa abhāvaḥ sarva rūpāṇām prakṛti ādi ātmaka tva niyamāt itara rūpa apekṣayā tad rūpasya vailakṣaṇya anukteḥ iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || āha ca tanmātramiti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ ekātmyamiti śrutiḥ brahmaṇaḥ tanmātraṃ vijñānānaṃdaikasvarūpamāha vaktītyarthaḥ| ato navailakṣaṇyāniruktiriti ca śabdārthaḥ ||
analyzed: āha ca tanmātram iti asya arthaḥ yatas ekātmyam iti śrutiḥ brahmaṇaḥ tanmātram vijñāna ānaṃda eka svarūpam āha vakti iti arthaḥ atas na vailakṣaṇya aniruktiḥ iti ca śabda arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutipramāṇasadbhāvād‌brahmaṇo vilakṣaṇarūpatvamanityatvādidoṣābhāvaśceti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śruti pramāṇa sadbhāvāt brahmaṇaḥ vilakṣaṇa rūpa tvam anitya tva ādi doṣa abhāvaḥ ca iti siddham

original: || darśayati cātho api smaryate ||
analyzed: darśayati ca atha u api smaryate

original: nanūktaśrutidvaye brahmaṇo jñānānaṃdādyātmakatvamevocyate natvānaṃdāderbrahmaśarīratvaṃ| ato rūpipadoktadehitvaśruterlokavilakṣaṇarūpaviṣayatvābhāvādvaiyarthyaṃ sauṃdaryābhāvaścāparihṛtaḥ| na ca rūparūpiṇorabhedāditi tattvapradīpe tadapi śrutyabhipretamityuktamiti vācyaṃ| spaṣṭoktyabhāvenānirṇayādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu ukta śruti dvaye brahmaṇaḥ jñāna ānaṃda ādi ātmaka tvam eva ucyate na tu ānaṃda ādeḥ brahma śarīratvam atas rūpi pada ukta dehi tva śruteḥ loka vilakṣaṇa rūpa viṣayatva abhāvāt vaiyarthyam sauṃdarya abhāvaḥ ca aparihṛtaḥ na ca rūpa rūpiṇoḥ abhedāt iti tattvapradīpe tat api śruti abhipretam iti uktam iti vācyam spaṣṭa ukti abhāvena anirṇayāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || darśayati cātho api smaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ caḥ samuccaye| na kevalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ ānaṃdādyātmakatvaṃ darśayati| kiṃtu tadvijñāneneti śrutirjñānasya brahmātmakatvamapi darśayati pratipādayati| atho ityarthāṃtaravāci| atho vijñānasyāpi brahmarūpatvaṃ smaryate| vyāsādibhiḥ śuddhasphaṭikamityādinā|
analyzed: darśayati ca atho api smaryate iti asya arthaḥ caḥ yatas caḥ samuccaye na kevalam brahmaṇaḥ ānaṃda ādi ātmaka tvam darśayati kiṃtu tad vijñānena iti śrutiḥ jñānasya brahma ātmaka tvam api darśayati pratipādayati atho iti artha aṃtara vāci atho vijñānasya api brahma rūpa tvam smaryate vyāsa ādibhiḥ śuddha sphaṭikam ityādinā

original: ato na jñānānaṃdayorbrahmarūpatvamaprāmāṇikamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atas na jñāna ānaṃdayoḥ brahma rūpa tvam aprāmāṇikam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca brahmaṇo vilakṣaṇarūpatvasya tadrūpāṇāṃ parasparamabhedasya ca siddhatvāt| śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśamiti smṛteḥ| tadeva bhakterupapannatvātsārthako'yaṃ pāda iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca brahmaṇaḥ vilakṣaṇa rūpa tvasya tad rūpāṇām parasparam abhedasya ca siddha tvāt śuddha sphaṭika saṃkāśam iti smṛteḥ tat eva bhakteḥ upapanna tvāt sārthakaḥ yam pādaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti arūpādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti arūpa adhikaraṇam

original: atreśvarasya jīvādbhedābhedo nirākriyate|
analyzed: atra īśvarasya jīvāt bheda abhedaḥ nirākriyate

original: || ata eva copamā sūryakādivat ||
analyzed: atas eva ca upamā sūryaka ādi vat

original: nanu jīvastāvatparamātmano bhidyata iti śrutyādisiddhaṃ| anumataṃ bhavatāṃ| evaṃ sati prayujyate| jīvaḥ paramātmābhinnaḥ| cetanatvāt| tadaṃśatvāt| matsyādivat| evaṃceśvarasya jīvena bhinnatvepyabhedasyāpi bhāvāt| doṣeṇaikye ca duṣṭatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvānna paramātmani bhaktiryukteti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu jīvaḥ tāvat paramātmanaḥ bhidyate iti śruti ādi siddham anumatam bhavatām evam sati prayujyate jīvaḥ paramātmā abhinnaḥ cetana tvāt tad aṃśa tvāt matsya ādi vat evam ca īśvarasya jīvena bhinna tve pi abhedasya api bhāvāt doṣeṇa aikye ca duṣṭa tva avaśyam bhāvāt na paramātmani bhaktiḥ yuktā iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || ataeva copamā sūrya kādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || ataeva īśatadrūpāṇāmabedoktereva| atae cetanatvādihetoreva| upamā jīvasya matsyādisāmyaṃ| matsyādivadīśvarābheda iti cennetiśeṣaḥ| ca śabdena bhinnatvasāmyaṃ samuccinoti| kutaḥ|
analyzed: ataeva ca upamā sūrya ka ādi vat iti asya arthaḥ ataeva īśa tad rūpāṇām a beda ukteḥ eva cetana tva ādi hetoḥ eva upamā jīvasya matsya ādi sāmyam matsya ādi vat īśvara abhedaḥ iti ced na iti śeṣaḥ ca śabdena bhinnatva sāmyam samuccinoti kutas

original: yataḥ sūryakādivat yathā jalapratibiṃbitasūryakādeḥ sūryādipratibiṃbādbhinnatvaṃ tathā jīvasya pratibiṃbatvāt bhinnatvamityarthaḥ || yadvā || ataeva matsyādīnāṃ brahmaṇo jñānādi guṇairaviśeṣoktereva| ataeva sūryakādivat| upamā sūryakādyupamā| jīvasya matsyāditulyāṃśatve tadaviśeṣāpattereva upamā brahmapratibiṃbatetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yatas sūryaka ādi vat yathā jala pratibiṃbita sūryaka ādeḥ sūrya ādi pratibiṃbāt bhinna tvam tathā jīvasya pratibiṃba tvāt bhinna tvam iti arthaḥ yat vā ataeva matsya ādīnām brahmaṇaḥ jñāna ādi guṇaiḥ aviśeṣa ukteḥ eva ataeva sūryaka ādi vat upamā sūryaka ādi upamā jīvasya matsya ādi tulya aṃśatve tad aviśeṣa āpatteḥ eva upamā brahma pratibiṃba tā iti arthaḥ

original: ataeva brahmapratibiṃbatvādeva sūryakādivanna brahmābhinno jīva iti ca śabdārthaḥ || athavā || ataeva prakṛtābhyāṃ tadadhīnatvatatsadṛśatvābhyāmeva| upamā sūryakādivadityupamā dīveśvarapratibiṃbatvāt nopādhyadhīnatvādinā na tannivṛttyā pratibiṃbatānivṛttirityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ataeva brahma pratibiṃba tvāt eva sūryaka ādi vat na brahma abhinnaḥ jīvaḥ iti ca śabda arthaḥ athavā ataeva prakṛtābhyām tad adhīnatva tad sadṛśatvābhyām eva upamā sūryaka ādi vat iti upamā dīva īśvara pratibiṃba tvāt na upādhi adhīnatva ādinā na tad nivṛttyā pratibiṃba tā nivṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jīvaḥ paramātmanā bhinnaḥ| tatpratibiṃbatvāt| yo yatpratibiṃbaḥ ca cāsau tadabhinnaḥ| yathā sūryakādiḥ| nanūpādhyāyattaḥ pratibiṃba ucyate| na ca sa upādhyāyattaḥ| tathātve'nityatvaprasaṃgāt| tataścāsiddhaṃ pratibiṃbatvaṃ| atha paramātmādhīnatve sati cetanatvena tatsādṛśyaṃ hetutayā vivakṣitaṃ| tarhanupapanno dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ prāpnotīti cenna|
analyzed: evam ca jīvaḥ paramātmanā bhinnaḥ tad pratibiṃba tvāt yaḥ yad pratibiṃbaḥ ca ca asau tad abhinnaḥ yathā sūryaka ādiḥ nanu upādhi āyattaḥ pratibiṃbaḥ ucyate na ca saḥ upādhyā āyattaḥ tathātve nitya tva prasaṃgāt tatas ca asiddham pratibiṃba tvam atha paramātma adhīna tve sati cetana tvena tad sādṛśyam hetutayā vivakṣitam tarhi anupapannaḥ dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ prāpnoti iti ced na

original: cetanatvādiviśeṣarūpamavivakṣitvā tadadhīnatvatatsādṛśyayoreva hetutayā vivakṣitatvāt| ata evopamāpyupapannā| biṃbādhīnatvamiva biṃbasādṛśyasyāpi tatra sattvāt| nanvevamapi pakṣe sarvadṛṣṭāṃtadharmābhāvāt| tatā cāyamityupanayo na saṃbhavatīti cenna|
analyzed: cetanatva ādi viśeṣa rūpam avivakṣitvā tad adhīnatva tad sādṛśyayoḥ eva hetutayā vivakṣita tvāt atas eva upamā api upapannā biṃba adhīnatvam iva biṃba sādṛśyasya api tatra sattvāt nanu evam api pakṣe sarva dṛṣṭāṃta dharma abhāvāt ca ayam iti upanayaḥ na saṃbhavati iti ced na

original: yathā dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhyavyāpyasādhanavān tathā pakṣepītyetāvanmātrasyopanaye vivakṣitatvena yāvatsādharmyasyāvivakṣitatvāt| anyathā'numānamātrocchoccheprasaṃga iti| ato jīvaparamātmanorabhedābhāvādyukta bhagavati bhaktiriti tanmahimāvarṇanamupapannamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: yathā dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhya vyāpya sādhanavān tathā pakṣe pi iti etāvat mātrasya upanaye vivakṣita tvena yāvat sādharmyasya avivakṣita tvāt anyathā anumāna mātra ucchocche prasaṃgaḥ iti atas jīva paramātmanoḥ abheda abhāvāt yukta bhagavati bhaktiḥ iti tat mahima varṇanam upapannam iti siddham

original: || iti upamādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti upamā adhikaraṇam

original: atreśvare bhaktyarthaṃ tasyā jīvasvarūpābhivyaktirūpaphalaṃ nirūpyate|
analyzed: atra īśvare bhakti artham tasyāḥ jīva svarūpa abhivyakti rūpa phalam nirūpyate

original: || aṃbuvadagrahaṇāttu na tathātvaṃ ||
analyzed: aṃbu vat agrahaṇāt tu na tathātvam

original: nanu na mokṣo bhaktiphalaṃ| anādisiddhatvāt| nityānaṃdajñānādimattvaṃ hi mokṣaḥ| tacca svarūpameva| na ca svarūpamāgaṃtukaṃ ceti saṃbhavati| tataśca mokṣasya bhaktiphalatvābhāvānna tadarthaṃ bhaktiḥ kartavyā| nāpi prayojanāṃtaramastītyakartavyaiva bhaktiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na mokṣaḥ bhakti phalam anādi siddha tvāt nitya ānaṃda jñāna ādimattvam hi mokṣaḥ tat ca svarūpam eva na ca svarūpam āgaṃtukam ca iti saṃbhavati tatas ca mokṣasya bhakti phala tva abhāvāt na tad artham bhaktiḥ kartavyā nā api prayojana aṃtaram asti iti akartavyā eva bhaktiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || aṃbuvadagrahaṇāttu na tathātvamiti || asyārthaḥ || sādṛśyārthe vatiḥ| sādṛśyaṃ snehākhyaviśeṣaṇena vivakṣitaṃ| tathā ca yataḥ aṃbuvadagrahaṇāt snehasahitamāhātmyajñānābhāvāt| bhaktiṃ vineti yāvat| tathātvaṃ sukhādyātmakatvarūpeśvarasādṛśyaṃ| na tu samyagvyajyate| ato bhaktireva samyak svarūpābhivyaktijaniketi tadarthaṃ sā kartavyetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aṃbu vat agrahaṇāt tu na tathātvam iti asya arthaḥ sādṛśya arthe vatiḥ sādṛśyam sneha ākhya viśeṣaṇena vivakṣitam tathā ca yatas aṃbu vat agrahaṇāt sneha sahita māhātmya jñāna abhāvāt bhaktim vinā iti yāvat tathātvam sukha ādi ātmaka tva rūpa īśvara sādṛśyam na tu samyak vyajyate atas bhaktiḥ eva samyak svarūpa abhivyakti janikā iti tad artham sā kartavyā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhaktiphalameva mokṣaḥ| jñānānaṃdāderjīvasvarūpatvena nityasiddhatve'pi tadāvirbhāvasya bhaktisādhyatvāt| bhaktyabhāve tadabhāva iti niyamāt| suptau bhaktyabhāvena jñānānaṃdādyāvirbhāvamātrasadbhāve'pi samyagāvirbhāvābhāvāt| tathā ca samyagāvirbhāva eva mokṣa śabdārtho bhaktyā sādhyo nāvirbhāvamātraṃ|
analyzed: evam ca bhakti phalam eva mokṣaḥ jñāna ānaṃda ādeḥ jīva sva rūpa tvena nitya siddhatve pi tad āvirbhāvasya bhakti sādhya tvāt bhakti abhāve tad abhāve iti niyamāt suptau bhakti abhāvena jñāna ānaṃda ādi āvirbhāva mātra sadbhāve pi samyak āvirbhāva abhāvāt tathā ca samyak āvirbhāvaḥ eva mokṣa śabda arthaḥ bhaktyā sādhyaḥ na āvirbhāva mātram

original: yamaiveṣa iti śrutermahitvabuddhiriti smṛteśca| atau mokṣasya bhaktisādhyatvātkartavyaiva tadarthaṃ bhaktistanmahimāvarṇana ca sārthakamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: yamā evā eṣa iti śruteḥ mahitva buddhiḥ iti smṛteḥ ca atau mokṣasya bhakti sādhya tvāt kartavyā eva tad artham bhaktiḥ ca sārthakam iti siddham

original: || iti aṃbuvadadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti aṃbu vat adhikaraṇam

original: atra puruṣeṣu bhaktestāratamyena vṛttitvaṃ tadanusṛtya bhagavatā phaladātṛtvaṃ ca nirūpyate |
analyzed: atra puruṣeṣu bhakteḥ tāratamyena vṛtti tvam tat anusṛtya bhagavatā phala dātṛ tvam ca nirūpyate

original: || vṛddhihrāsabhāktvamaṃtarbhāvādubhayasāmaṃjasyādevaṃ ||
analyzed: vṛddhi hrāsa bhāj tvam aṃtarbhāvāt ubhaya sāmaṃjasyāt evam

original: nanu brahmādīnāṃ manuṣyottamānāṃ ca bhaktirekaprakāraiva| mokṣaikarūpaphalabhāgitvāt| na hi yāvatyā bhaktyā manuṣyottamānāṃ mokṣastāvatyā bhrahmādīnāṃ mokṣasaṃbhave'dhikānuṣṭhānāya prekṣāvatpravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati| atha na tāvatā bhaktisteṣāṃ mokṣasādhanatayā'laṃ| haṃta tarhi manuṣyottamānāmapi bhaktirna syāt| paryāptasādhanābhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu brahma ādīnām manuṣya uttamānām ca bhaktiḥ eka prakārā eva mokṣa eka rūpa phala bhāgi tvāt na hi yāvatyā bhaktyā manuṣya uttamānām mokṣaḥ tāvatyā bhrahma ādīnām mokṣa saṃbhava idhika anuṣṭhānāya prekṣāvat pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati atha na tāvatā bhaktiḥ teṣām mokṣa sādhanatayā alam haṃta tarhi manuṣya uttamānām api bhaktiḥ na syāt paryāpta sādhana abhāvāt

original: na hi duḥkhābhāvarūpamokṣe tāratamyamasti yena bhaktitāratamyumupapannaṃ syāt| ato bhaktirekaprakāraiveti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: na hi duḥkha abhāva rūpa mokṣe tāratamyam asti yena syāt atas bhaktiḥ eka prakārā eva iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || vṛddhihrāsabhākttvāmaṃtarbhāvādubhayasāmaṃjasyādevamiti || asyārthaḥ || vṛddhihrāsabhāktvaṃ bhaktyādeḥ sādhakeṣvādhikyanyūnatā na tāvadatrāṃgīkāryaṃ| kutaḥ| aṃtarbhāvāt mahadalpaphalavatāṃ brahmādīnāmanyeṣāṃ ca bhāktatveṃ'tarbhāvāt| tathā'pi kuto vṛddhihrāsabhāktvaṃ| evaṃ bhaktitāratamye satyeva|
analyzed: vṛddhi hrāsa bhāktvām antarbhāvāt ubhaya sāmaṃjasyāt evam iti asya arthaḥ vṛddhi hrāsa bhāktvam bhakti ādeḥ sādhakeṣu ādhikya nyūnatā na tāvat atra aṃgīkāryam kutas aṃtarbhāvāt mahat alpa phalavatām brahma ādīnām anyeṣām ca bhākta tva iṃtarbhāvāt tathā api kutas vṛddhi hrāsa bhāktvam evam bhakti tāratamye sati eva

original: ubhayasāmaṃjasyāt ubhayān mahadalpaphalān brahmādijīvānprati phaladāturīśvarasya sāmaṃjasyāt vaiṣamyena phaladānasya bhaktitāratamyena yuktatvāt| anyathā'yuktatvāt| atastadaṃgīkāryamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ubhaya sāmaṃjasyāt ubhayān mahat alpa phalān brahma ādi jīvān prati phala dātuḥ īśvarasya sāmaṃjasyāt vaiṣamyena phala dānasya bhakti tāratamyena yukta tvāt anyathā yukta tvāt atas tat aṃgīkāryam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca naikaprakārā sarveṣāṃ bhaktiḥ| kiṃtu vṛddhihrāsavatī| anyathā pramāṇasiddhaṃ sarvabhaktānprati parameśvare sāmaṃjasyaṃ na syāt| sādhanasyottamatveneti tataśca bhakteḥ phalānusāreṇa tāratamyasadbhāvena yuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nā eka prakārā sarveṣām bhaktiḥ kiṃtu vṛddhi hrāsavatī anyathā pramāṇa siddham sarva bhaktān prati parameśvare sāmaṃjasyam na syāt sādhanasya uttama tvena iti tatas ca bhakteḥ phala anusāreṇa tāratamya sadbhāvena yuktā tatra bhaktiḥ iti siddham

original: || darśanācca ||
analyzed: darśanāt ca

original: nanu bhavetsādhanatāratamyaṃ yadānaṃdatāratamyaṃ syāt| tadeva kuta iti hetvasiddhimākṣipya pariharatsūtramācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: nanu bhavet sādhana tāratamyam yat ānaṃda tāratamyam syāt tat eva kutas iti hetu asiddhim ākṣipya pariharat sūtram ācaṣṭe

original: || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || athāta iti śrutau yatheti smṛtau ca phalatāratamyadarśanāt uktatvāccoktaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: darśanāt ca iti asya arthaḥ atha atas iti śrutau yathā iti smṛtau ca phala tāratamya darśanāt ukta tvāt ca uktam yuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutismṛtibhyāṃ bhakteḥ phalānusāreṇa tāratamyasadbhāveneśvarasya viṣamatvābhāvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śruti smṛtibhyām bhakteḥ phala anusāreṇa tāratamya sadbhāvena īśvarasya viṣama tva abhāvāt yuktā tatra bhaktiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti vṛddhihrāsādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vṛddhi hrāsa adhikaraṇam

original: atra viśvapālakatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra viśva pālaka tvam samarthyate

original: || prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūyaḥ ||
analyzed: prakṛtā etāvat tvam hi pratiṣedhati tatas bravīti ca bhūyas

original: nanu neśvaraḥ pālakaḥ| jagatsṛṣṭ‌vā sthitasyeśvarasya vināśapravṛtyabhāvamātreaiṇa kāliviśeṣasaṃbaṃdharūpasthitisaṃbhavena pālanarūpatad‌vyāpārānapekṣatvāt| na cāvāṃtaropadravanirāsāyeśvaravyāpāro'pekṣita iti vācyaṃ| īśvarasyaivāvāṃtaropadravakartṛtvena tadakaraṇamātreṇa samīhitasiddheḥ|
analyzed: nanu na īśvaraḥ pālakaḥ jagat sṛṣṭvā sthitasya īśvarasya kāli viśeṣa saṃbaṃdha rūpa sthiti saṃbhavena pālana rūpa tad vyāpāra anapekṣa tvāt na ca avāṃtara upadrava nirāsāya īśvara vyāpāra upekṣitaḥ iti vācyam īśvarasya eva avāṃtara upadrava kartṛ tvena tad akaraṇa mātreṇa samīhita siddheḥ

original: yadyanyasyopadravakartṛtve tannirāsakavyāpārarūpatvaṃ pālakatvamanyasya syāt| na ceśvarādanyasaṃhartā yena tannirāseneśvarasya pālakatvaṃ syāt| virodhābhāvena svasya svanivārakatvāyogāt| tataśca pālakatvābhāvena mahāmahimatvābhāvānna tatra bhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: yadi anyasya upadrava kartṛ tve tad nirāsaka vyāpāra rūpatvam pālakatvam anyasya syāt na ca īśvarāt anya saṃhartā yena tad nirāsena īśvarasya pālakatvam syāt virodha abhāvena svasya sva nivāraka tva ayogāt tatas ca pālakatva abhāvena mahāmahima tva abhāvāt na tatra bhaktiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūya iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yataḥ| naitāvadeneti śrutiḥ prakṛtaitāvatvaṃ| prakṛtasya sṛṣṭyādikartṛtvasya| etāvattvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartṛtvamātraparyavasitatvaṃ| pratiṣedhati nirācaṣṭe| tataḥ sṛṣṭyādikartṛtvāt| bhūyaḥ adhikaṃ| pālakatvaṃ ca bravīti| ataḥ pālakatvāt|
analyzed: prakṛta etāvattvam hi pratiṣedhati tatas bravīti ca bhūyas iti asya arthaḥ hi yatas na etāvat enā iti śrutiḥ prakṛta etāvatvam prakṛtasya sṛṣṭi ādi kartṛ tvasya etāvattvam sṛṣṭi saṃhāra kartṛ tva mātra paryavasita tvam pratiṣedhati nirācaṣṭe tatas sṛṣṭi ādi kartṛ tvāt bhūyaḥ adhikam pālaka tvam ca bravīti atas pālaka tvāt

original: sṛṣṭiṃ ceti būcitapālakatvākhyaṃ mahimāṃtaramapi harestīti jñāpayatītyarthaḥ || ca śabdena sṛṣṭiṃ ceti smṛtiḥ sūcitā ||
analyzed: sṛṣṭim ca iti mahima aṃtaram api hareḥ ti iti jñāpayati iti arthaḥ ca śabdena sṛṣṭim ca iti smṛtiḥ sūcitā

original: evaṃca bhavatyeveśvaraḥ pālakaḥ| naitāvadenāpara iti śrutyā sṛṣṭisaṃhāramātrakartṛtvaṃ pratiṣidhya pālakatvasyāpyabhidhānāt| na copadravasaṃhāravilaṃbamātreṇaiva sthitisiddherna tadarthamīśvarāpekṣeti vācyaṃ| sarvasya dhāraṇārthaṃ cetanānāmannapānadyarthaṃ tad‌vyāpārasyāvaśyakatvāt| ataḥ pālanādimahāmahimni harau bhaktaryukteti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca bhavati eva īśvaraḥ pālakaḥ na etāvat enā aparaḥ iti śrutyā sṛṣṭi saṃhāra mātra kartṛ tvam pratiṣidhya pālaka tvasya api abhidhānāt na ca upadrava saṃhāra vilaṃba mātreṇa eva sthiti siddheḥ na tad artham īśvara apekṣā iti vācyam sarvasya dhāraṇā artham cetanānām anna pānadī artham tad vyāpārasya āvaśyaka tvāt atas pālana ādi mahā mahimni harau bhaktari uktā iti siddham

original: || iti prakṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti prakṛti adhikaraṇam

original: atra bhagavadbhakteḥ kartavyatā marthanāya tasyopalabdhiyogyatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra bhagavat bhakteḥ kartavya tā marthanāya tasya upalabdhi yogya tvam samarthyate

original: || tadavyaktamāha hi ||
analyzed: tat avyaktam āha hi

original: nanu vyaktamevāyamīśvaraḥ| mahattvasamānādhikaraṇodbhūtarūpatvāt| yadā paśya iti śruteśca| na hyavyaktasvabhāvatve sādhanaśatenāpi darśanamupapadyate| svabhāvasyānapāyāt| tataśca staṃbhādivatpuruṣaprayatnenaiva pratyakṣasaṃbhavād‌vyarthaiva tadbhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu vyaktam eva ayam īśvaraḥ mahat tva samāna adhikaraṇa udbhūta rūpatvāt yadā paśya iti śruteḥ ca na hi avyakta svabhāva tve sādhana śatena api darśanam upapadyate svabhāvasya anapāyāt tatas ca staṃbha ādi vat puruṣa prayatnena eva pratyakṣa saṃbhavāt vyarthā eva tad bhaktiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || tadavyaktamāha hīti || asyārthaḥ || tat brahmā| avyaktaṃ puruṣaprayatnena draṣṭumaśakyasvabhāvaṃ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt | avyaktaṃca niṣphalamiti śrutisthathā''ha tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tat avyaktam āha hi iti asya arthaḥ tat brahmā avyaktam puruṣa prayatnena draṣṭum aśakya svabhāvam kutas hi yasmāt avyaktam ca niṣphalam iti tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāvyaktamevāyamīśvaraḥ| arūpamiti śruteḥ| ata eva pratyakṣatāprayojakaprākṛtarūpattvamasiddhaṃ| tataśca svato'vyaktasyāpi īśvarasya bhaktisādhyaprasādādāparokṣyasaṃbhavātsaphalatvādbhakti kartavyeti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca avyaktam eva ayam īśvaraḥ arūpam iti śruteḥ atas eva pratyakṣatā prayojaka prākṛta rūpattvam asiddham tatas ca svatas vyaktasya api īśvarasya bhakti sādhya prasādāt āparokṣya saṃbhavāt saphalatvāt bhakti kartavyā iti siddham

original: || api saṃrādhane pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ ||
analyzed: api saṃrādhane pratyakṣa anumānābhyām

original: nanvastu svato'vyaktaṃ brahma| tathā'pi saṃrādhanena puruṣaprayatnena yakṣādivad‌vyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ cet kiṃ bhaktyetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu astu svatas vyaktam brahma tathā api saṃrādhanena puruṣa prayatnena yakṣa ādi vat vyaktam bhaviṣyati evam ced kim bhaktyā iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || api saṃrādhane pratyakṣānumānābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || api bhaktirahitārādhanenāpi na brahma vyaktīkartuṃ śakyaḥ| kutaḥ| saṃrādhane'pi saṃpūjane'pi| avyaktatvasya pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ jñānipratyakṣasūkṣmatvahetukānumānābhyāṃ| siddhatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: api saṃrādhane pratyakṣa anumānābhyām iti asya arthaḥ api bhakti rahita ārādhanena api na brahma vyaktīkartum śakyaḥ kutas saṃrādhane api saṃpūjane api avyakta tvasya pratyakṣa anumānābhyām jñāni pratyakṣa sūkṣma tva hetuka anumānābhyām siddha tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhaktyabhāve satyapi samārādhane brahmāpratyakṣatvasya jñānipratyakṣasiddhatvena samārādhanasya brahmapratyakṣahetutvābhāvāt| yakṣasyātisūkṣmatvābhāvena samārādhanasahakṛtoṃdriyagrāhyatvepyatisūkṣmatvena brahmaṇo yakṣādivattadayogāt| tataśca bhakteḥ saphalatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca bhakti abhāve sati api samārādhane brahma apratyakṣa tvasya jñāni pratyakṣa siddhatvena samārādhanasya brahma pratyakṣa hetutva abhāvāt yakṣasya ati sūkṣma tva abhāvena samārādhana sahakṛta uṃdriya grāhya tve pi ati sūkṣma tvena brahmaṇaḥ yakṣa ādi vat tad ayogāt tatas ca bhakteḥ saphalatvam iti siddham

original: || prakāśavaccāvaiśeṣyaṃ ||
analyzed: prakāśavat ca a vaiśeṣyam

original: nanvastu mūlarūpeṇāvyaktaṃ brahma| anutpannatvāt| avatārarūpeṇa vyaktībhaviṣyati| utpannatvāt| mūlarūpeṇāvyaktānāmapyanalajalabhuvāmutpannarūpeṇa vyaktatvadarśanāt| na ca mūlarūpameva dṛṣṭaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ tāvatā rūpamiti śakyate vaktuṃ| līlāvigrahasya gṛhītatvenotpattyādoṣatvāt| mūlarūpeṇa samaśaktimattvāt| pūrṇamada iti vacanācca|
analyzed: nanu astu mūla rūpeṇa avyaktam brahma anutpanna tvāt avatāra rūpeṇa vyaktībhaviṣyati utpanna tvāt mūla rūpeṇa avyaktānām api anala jalabhuvām utpanna rūpeṇa vyakta tva darśanāt na ca mūla rūpam eva dṛṣṭam mokṣa sādhanam tāvatā rūpam iti śakyate vaktum līlā vigrahasya gṛhīta tvena utpattyā adoṣa tvāt mūla rūpeṇa sama śaktimat tvāt pūrṇamadaḥ iti vacanāt ca

original: tato vyarthā bhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas vyarthā bhaktiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || prakāśavaccāvaiśeṣyamiti || asyārthaḥ || co nañarthaḥ || prakāśavat yathā'gneḥ sthūlasūkṣmābhyāṃ vyaktāvyaktatve| tathā brahma na kiṃtu svato'vyaktameva| kutaḥ| yataḥ avaiśeṣyaṃ brahmaṇi sthūlasūkṣmatvaviśeṣo nāsti| ata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prakāśa vat ca avaiśeṣyam iti asya arthaḥ caḥ nañ arthaḥ prakāśa vat yathā agneḥ sthūla sūkṣmābhyām vyakta avyakta tve tathā brahma na kiṃtu svatas vyaktam eva kutas yatas avaiśeṣyam brahmaṇi sthūla sūkṣma tva viśeṣaḥ na asti atas iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca mūlarūpāvatārarūpayorubhayorapyavyaktatvena vyaktatvāvyaktatvaviśeṣābhāvāt| sthūlasūkṣmaviśeṣa iti vacanāt| ato bhakteḥ saphalatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca mūla rūpa avatāra rūpayoḥ ubhayoḥ api avyakta tvena vyakta tva avyakta tva viśeṣa abhāvāt sthūla sūkṣma viśeṣaḥ iti vacanāt atas bhakteḥ saphala tvam iti siddham

original: || prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāt ||

analyzed: evam ca laukika pāda svarūpa aṃśābhyām vilakṣaṇeṣu bhinna aṃśeṣu jīveṣu pādaḥ usya iti pāda śabda prayoga vat laukikānām budhi artham eva loke gṛhīta saṃgatikasya ānaṃda ādi śabdasya kiṃcid sādṛśya mātreṇa bhagavat ānaṃda ādau prayoga upapatteḥ jñāta tāvat mātrasya pramāṇa aṃtara vaśāt vailakṣaṇye jñāte śabdānām tatra parama mukhya vṛtti grahaḥ api bhavati

original: || sthānaviśeṣātprakāśādivat ||
analyzed: sthāna viśeṣāt prakāśa ādi vat

original: nanu na brahmādyānaṃdādayo bhagavadānaṃdādipratibiṃbabhūtāḥ| tathātve vaicitryābhāvaprasaṃgāt| pratibiṃbaivacitrye hi kāraṇadvayaṃ| biṃbavaicitryaṃ sthānavaicitryaṃ ceti| na cātra brahmādisthānavaicitryaṃ pratibiṃbavaicitryopapādakaṃ saṃbhavati| tasyāpi bhagavaddharmapratibiṃbatvena vaicitryasiddhaye sthānaguṇāṃtaravaicitryānusaraṇe'navasthānāt|

original: nāpi biṃbānaṃdādivaicitryaṃ| bhaktyabhāvaprasaṃgāt| tataśca kāraṇābhāvena vaicitryāsaṃbhavāt| na brahmānaṃdādirbhagavadānaṃdādipratibiṃba iti tasyālaukikatvābhāvānna tatra niratiśayābhaktiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nā api biṃba ānaṃda ādi vaicitryam bhakti abhāva prasaṃgāt tatas ca kāraṇa abhāvena vaicitrya asaṃbhavāt na brahma ānaṃda ādiḥ bhagavat ānaṃda ādi pratibiṃbaḥ iti tasya alaukika tva abhāvāt na tatra niratiśayā abhaktiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || sthānaviśeṣātprakāśādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || prakāśādivat| yathā sūryakāṃtādigatasūryādipratibiṃbe'gnijanakatvādivaicitryaṃ| sthānaviśeṣāt| sūryakāṃtādisthānaguṇavaicitryādupapadyate tathā brahmādisthānagatabhaktyādiguṇavaicitryādbhagavadānaṃdapratibiṃbeṣu brahmādyānaṃdeṣvapi vaicitryamupapadyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sthāna viśeṣāt prakāśa ādi vat iti asya arthaḥ prakāśa ādi vat yathā sūrya kāṃta ādi gata sūrya ādi pratibiṃba agni janaka tva ādi vaicitryam sthāna viśeṣāt sūrya kāṃta ādi sthāna guṇa vaicitryāt upapadyate tathā brahma ādi sthāna gata bhakti ādi guṇa vaicitryāt bhagavat ānaṃda pratibiṃbeṣu brahma ādi ānaṃdeṣu api vaicitryam upapadyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca pratibiṃba eva brahmādyānaṃdādiḥ| bhagavadānaṃdāderbrahmādīnāmanādikālīnabhaktyādiguṇavaicitryaparamaiśvaryābhyāṃ sūryapratibiṃbavaicitryavat ānaṃdādivaicitryasaṃbhavāt| brahmādiguṇeti smṛteḥ| ato brahmādiguṇabiṃbālaukikaguṇe harau bhaktiryukteti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca pratibiṃbaḥ eva brahma ādi ānaṃda ādiḥ bhagavat ānaṃda ādeḥ brahma ādīnām anādi kālīna bhakti ādi guṇa vaicitrya parama aiśvaryābhyām sūrya pratibiṃba vaicitrya vat ānaṃda ādi vaicitrya saṃbhavāt brahma ādi guṇa iti smṛteḥ atas brahma ādi guṇa biṃba alaukika guṇe harau bhaktiḥ yuktā iti siddham

original: || upapatteśca ||
analyzed: upapatteḥ ca

original: yuktyaṃtareṇabiṃvānaṃdādyavaicitrye'pi pratibiṃbavaicitryamupapādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa biṃva ānanda ādi a vaicitrye pi pratibiṃba vaicitryam upapādayat sūtram paṭhati

original: || upapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || biṃbabhūtabhagavadaiśvaryavaśādeva pratibiṃbabhūtabrahmādyānaṃdavaicitryopapatteśca tatpratibiṃbatvamitareṣāṃ yuktamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: upapatteḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ biṃba bhūta bhagavat aiśvarya vaśāt eva pratibiṃba bhūta brahma ādi ānaṃda vaicitrya upapatteḥ ca tad pratibiṃba tvam itareṣām yuktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhaktyādivaicitryānupapattyabhāvāt| tasya parameśvaraiśvaryādevopapatteḥ| parameśvarohi vedāprāmāṇyakāraṇavaiṣamyādiparihārāya bhaktyādivaicitryamapekṣyaiva vicitrānaṃdādīn dadāti| anādikālīnabhaktyādivicitraguṇāṃstu svaicchayaivaiśvaryavaśāddadāti| tatra vaiṣamyāderadoṣatvāt| aiśvaryātparamāditi smṛteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca bhakti ādi vaicitrya anupapatti abhāvāt tasya parameśvara aiśvaryāt eva upapatteḥ parameśvaraḥ hi veda aprāmāṇya kāraṇa vaiṣamya ādi parihārāya bhakti ādi vaicitryam apekṣya eva vicitra ānaṃda ādīn dadāti anādi kālīna bhakti ādi vicitra guṇān tu sva aicchayā eva aiśvarya vaśāt dadāti tatra vaiṣamya ādeḥ adoṣa tvāt aiśvaryāt paramāt iti smṛteḥ

original: ato brahmādiguṇabiṃbālaukikaguṇe harau yuktaiva bhaktiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas brahma ādi guṇa biṃba alaukika guṇe harau yuktā eva bhaktiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti sthānaviśeṣādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti sthāna viśeṣa adhikaraṇam

original: atra brahmaṇo dhyānapratītādanyatvoktyā punaravyaktatva samarthyate|
analyzed: atra brahmaṇaḥ dhyāna pratītāt anya tva uktyā samarthyate

original: || tathā'nyatpratiṣedhāt ||
analyzed: tathā anya pratiṣedhāt

original: nanu vyaktameva brahma| dhyānakāle pratīyamānatvāt| na ca dhyeyānāṃ bahutvena brahmabhedāpattiḥ| viśeṣabalenaiva bahutvopapatteḥ| dhyeyasyābrahmatve ca brahmadhyānābhāvena phalaṃ na syāt| ato dhyānakāle pratītasya brahmatvenāvyaktatvābhāvād‌vyarthā bhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu vyaktam eva brahma dhyāna kāle pratīyamāna tvāt na ca dhyeyānām bahutvena brahma bheda āpattiḥ viśeṣa balena eva bahutva upapatteḥ dhyeyasya abrahma tve ca brahma dhyāna abhāvena phalam na syāt atas dhyāna kāle pratītasya brahma tvena avyakta tva abhāvāt vyarthā bhaktiḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || tathā'nyatpratiṣedhāditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā jīvānaṃdādi brahmānaṃdādervilakṣaṇaṃ| tathā dhyānakāle pratītaṃ vāsanātmakaṃ vastu| brahmaṇo'nyat tadbhinnaṃ| kutaḥ| yanmanaseti śrutāvanyasya brahmatvapratiṣedhādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā anya pratiṣedhāt iti asya arthaḥ yathā jīvānaṃda ādi brahma ānaṃda ādeḥ vilakṣaṇam tathā dhyāna kāle pratītam vāsanā ātmakam vastu brahmaṇaḥ anyat tat bhinnam kutas yat manasā iti śrutau anyasya brahmatva pratiṣedhāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcāvyaktameva brahma| jīvānaṃdād‌brahmānaṃdasya bhinnatvavatdhyeyasya durlakṣaṇatvena brahmaṇastadanyatvāt| tadeveti dhyeyasya brahmatvaniṣedhācca| pratimopāsanavatpratibiṃbopāsanasyāpi brahmopāsanatvena dhyānakālānupapattyabhāvāt| ato dhyānakāle pratītasyābrahmatvenāvyaktatvātkartavyaiva tadbhaktiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca avyaktam eva brahma jīvānaṃdāt brahmānaṃdasya bhinna tva vat dhyeyasya durlakṣaṇa tvena brahmaṇaḥ tad anya tvāt tat eva iti dhyeyasya brahmatva niṣedhāt ca pratimā upāsana vat pratibiṃba upāsanasya api brahma upāsana tvena dhyāna kāla anupapatti abhāvāt atas dhyāna kāle pratītasya abrahma tvena avyakta tvāt kartavyā eva tad bhaktiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti tathā'nyatvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti tathā anyatva adhikaraṇam

original: atra bhagavata eva sarvakartṛtvādi samarthyate|

analyzed: anena sarvagata tva māyā maya śa pabda ādibhyaḥ

original: nanu na bhagavata eva sarvasṛṣṭyādikriyā yujyate| kiṃtu deśakālāṃtare'nyatopi jagataḥ sā bhavati| rājādau tathā darśanāt| tathā ca na brahmaṇaḥ sakāśādeva sarvasṛṣṭyādikaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu na bhagavataḥ eva sarva sṛṣṭi ādi kriyā yujyate kiṃtu jagataḥ sā bhavati rāja ādau tathā darśanāt tathā ca na brahmaṇaḥ sakāśāt eva sarva sṛṣṭi ādikam yuktam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || anena sarvagatatvamāyāmayaśabdādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || anena bhagavataiva| sarvadeśakālayoḥ sṛṣṭyādirbhavati| na tu deśakālāṃtarayoranyena| kutaḥ| sarvagatatvamāyāmayaśabdādibhyaḥ| eṣa sarvagata iti sarvagatatvaśruteḥ| tasya ca sṛṣṭyādyarthatvāt| viṣṇau prayuktamāyāmayaśabdavyākhyānarūpasarvatretyādi śruteścetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: anena sarvagata tva māyā maya śabda ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ anena bhagavatā eva sarva deśa kālayoḥ sṛṣṭi ādiḥ bhavati na tu deśa kāla antarayoḥ anyena kutas sarvagata tva māyā maya śabda ādibhyaḥ eṣa sarva gataḥ iti sarva gata tva śruteḥ tasya ca sṛṣṭi ādi artha tvāt viṣṇau prayukta māyā maya śabda vyākhyāna rūpa sarvatra ityādi śruteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: anyatra prāmāṇābhāvāccetyādi śabdārthaḥ ||
analyzed: anyatra prāmāṇa abhāvāt ca ityādi śabda arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhagavataiva sarvadeśakālīnasṛṣṭyādi| anupraviśyeti śrutisiddhasṛṣṭyupayogisarvagatatvasyaiṣa sarvagata iti śrutau viṣṇorabhidhānāt| māyāmayaśabdavyākhyānarūpasarvatra sarvametasmāditi caturvedaśikhokteśca| kālato'nyasya jagatkāraṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt| tadabhāve saṃbhāvanāmātrasyāprayojakatvāt|

original: ataḥ sarvajagajanmādikartari brahmaṇi bhaktiḥ kāryaiveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas sarva jaga janma ādi kartari brahmaṇi bhaktiḥ kāryā eva iti siddham

original: || iti phalādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti phala adhikaraṇam

original: atra bhagavataḥ svargādikarmaphaladātṛtvaṃ sādhyate|

original: || phalamata upapatteḥ ||

original: || phalamata upapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || phalaṃ svargādi| ataḥ īśvarādeva bhavati| na karmataḥ| kutaḥ| upapatteḥ| īśvarasya cetanatvena phaladātṛtvasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: phalam atas upapatteḥ iti asya arthaḥ phalam svarga ādi atas īśvarāt eva bhavati na karmataḥ kutas upapatteḥ īśvarasya cetana tvena phala dātṛ tvasya yuktatvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcācetanatvātkarmaṇaiva phalasaṃbhavābhāvenānyathāsiddhatvahetorasiddhatvena bādhakābhāvāt| ataḥ parameśvara eva karmaphaladāteti tasminbhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca acetana tvāt karmaṇā eva phala saṃbhava abhāvena anyathā siddha tva hetoḥ asiddha tvena bādhaka abhāvāt atas parameśvaraḥ eva karma phala dātā iti tasmin bhaktiḥ kāryā iti siddham

original: || śrutatvācca ||
analyzed: śruta tvāt ca

original: nanvīśvarasya cetanatvena phaladātṛtvasaṃbhāvanaiva bhavet| na niścayaḥ| ataḥ kuto'sau niścaya ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu īśvarasya cetana tvena phala dātṛ tva saṃbhāvanā eva bhavet na niścayaḥ atas kutas asau niścayaḥ iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || śrutatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || śratatvācca| ratiriti śrutyuktatvācceśvarasyaiva phaladārtṛtvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: śruta tvāt ca iti asya arthaḥ śrata tvāt ca ratiḥ iti śruti ukta tvāt ca īśvarasya eva phala dārtṛ tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na kevalaṃ cetanatvādyupapatteḥ kiṃtu śrutyuktatvācceśvarasya phaladātṛtvena niścitatvāttasminbhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca na kevalam cetana tva ādi upapatteḥ kiṃtu śruti ukta tvāt ca īśvarasya phala dātṛ tvena niścita tvāt tasmin bhaktiḥ kāryā iti siddham

original: || dharmaṃ jaiminirata eva ||
analyzed: dharmam jaiminiḥ atas eva

original: nanu naitacchrutibaleneśvarasya phaladātṛtvamaṃgīkāryaṃ| kāraṇasya karmaṇa īśvarajanyatvena śrutāvīśvarasya phaladātṛtvasyopācāreṇaivoktatvāt| kiṃcaivamāptatamo jaimanirācāryo manyata iticettatpariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu na etad śruti balena īśvarasya phala dātṛ tvam aṃgīkāryam kāraṇasya karmaṇaḥ īśvara janya tvena śrutau īśvarasya phala dātṛ tvasya upācāreṇa eva uktatvāt kiṃca evam āptatamaḥ jaimaniḥ ācāryaḥ manyate iti ced tat pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || dharmaṃ jaiminirata eveti || asyārthaḥ || jaiminirācāryaḥ dharmaṃ phalapradamāha| taṃ ca dharmaṃ| ata eva īśvarādeva janyaṃ manyate| kutaḥ| ata eva eṣa hyeveti śruterevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: dharmam jaiminiḥ atas eva iti asya arthaḥ jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ dharmam phala pradam āha tam ca dharmam atas eva īśvarāt eva janyam manyate kutas atas eva eṣa hi eva iti śruteḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcoktaśrutyā jaiminyācāryābhiprāyeṇa yataḥ phalaṃ tasmādīśvarādeva karma bhavatīti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ukta śrutyā jaiminī ācārya abhiprāyeṇa yatas phalam tasmāt īśvarāt eva karma bhavati iti siddham

original: || pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt ||
analyzed: pūrvam tu bādarāyaṇaḥ hetu vyapadeśāt

original: etatparihārāya sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: etad parihārāya sūtram upanyasyati

original: || pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt iti || asyārthaḥ || bādarāyaṇācāryastu| pūrvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ| brahma dharmaṃ cobhayaṃ phalahetuṃ manyate| tatra brahma kartṛtvena karmakaraṇatvena heturiti viśeṣastu śabdārthaḥ| kutaḥ| hetuvyapadeśāt puṇyeneti śrutau brahmakarmaṇoḥ kartṛtvakaraṇatvarūpahetutvasyoktatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pūrvam tu bādarāyaṇaḥ hetu vyapadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ bādarāyaṇa ācāryaḥ tu pūrvam pūrva uktam brahma dharmam ca ubhayam phala hetum manyate tatra brahma kartṛ tvena karma karaṇa tvena hetuḥ iti viśeṣaḥ tu śabda arthaḥ kutas hetu vyapadeśāt puṇyena iti śrutau brahma karmaṇoḥ kartṛ tva karaṇa tva rūpa hetu tvasya ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca śruteraupacārikatvakalpanaṃ bhavet| yadīśvaraṃ vinā kevalena karmaṇā phalaṃ bhavet| na ca tatsaṃbhavati| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛttyayogāt| evaṃca śrutyanvayavyatirekabalādubhayorapi kāraṇatve siddhe karmaiveśvaraprayojyamabhyupagaṃtavyaṃ| puṇyena puṇyaṃ pāpena pāpamiti hetuvyapadeśāt|
