original: || saṃbaṃdhādevamanyatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || hiraṇyagarbhasya tu anyatrāpi trivikramatvādikriyāviśeṣe'pi| evaṃ sarvadopasaṃhāro yujyate| kutaḥ| saṃbaṃdhāt kriyāṇāṃ brahmaṇā tādātmyarūpasaṃbaṃdhena nityatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃbaṃdhāt evam anyatra api iti asya arthaḥ hiraṇyagarbhasya tu anyatra api trivikrama tva ādi kriyā viśeṣe pi evam sarvadā upasaṃhāraḥ yujyate kutas saṃbaṃdhāt kriyāṇām brahmaṇā tādātmya rūpa saṃbaṃdhena nitya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca brahmāṇī hi brahmavatsarvānguṇānupasaṃhṛtyevopāste| trivikramādīṃstu nityavikrāṃtyādikriyāsvaṃtarbhāvyaiva na tu pṛthak| yogyatāvirahāt| brahmā tu trivikramādīṃstu sadopasaṃhṛtyopāste| trivikramatvādirapi brahmasvarūpatvānnitya eva| ato yathopāsanaṃ muktau phalasadbhāvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca brahmāṇī hi brahma vat sarvān guṇān upasaṃhṛtya iva upāste trivikrama ādīn tu nitya vikrāṃti ādi kriyāsu aṃtar bhāvya eva na tu pṛthak yogyatā virahāt brahmā tu trivikrama ādīn tu sadā upasaṃhṛtya upāste trivikrama tva ādiḥ api brahma svarūpa tvāt nityaḥ eva atas yathā upāsanam muktau phala sadbhāvāt uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti samānādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti samāna adhikaraṇam

original: atrātmaśabdoktaguṇopāsanasya sarvaiḥ kartavyatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra ātma śabda ukta guṇa upāsanasya sarvaiḥ kartavya tvam samarthyate

original: || na vā viśeṣāt ||
analyzed: na vā viśeṣāt

original: nanu nātmetyevopāsīteti vidhiḥ sarvādhikārisādhāraṇaḥ| anaṃtaguṇābhidhāyakātmaśabdaghaṭitatvāt| na cātmaśabdasyottamānprati sarvaguṇābhidhāyakatve'pi taditarānprati tadabhāvena tattadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvāditi sarvasādhāraṇamupapannamiti vācyaṃ| asaṃbhavāt| na hi śabdo buddhimān|
analyzed: nanu na ātmā iti eva upāsīta iti vidhiḥ sarva adhikāri sādhāraṇaḥ anaṃta guṇa abhidhāyaka ātma śabda ghaṭita tvāt na ca ātma śabdasya uttamān prati sarva guṇa abhidhāyaka tve pi tad itarān prati tad abhāvena tad tad yogya guṇa abhidhāyaka tvāt iti sarva sādhāraṇam upapannam iti vācyam asaṃbhavāt na hi śabdaḥ buddhimān

original: yenottamatvādhikāriviśeṣaṃ prati sarvaguṇānbodhayitvā'nuttamatvādaparaṃ pratyalpāneva bodhayatīti syāt| tataścānupasaṃhārapramāṇatvoktirayukteti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: yena uttama tva adhikāri viśeṣam prati sarva guṇān bodhayitvā anuttama tvāt aparam prati alpān eva bodhayati iti syāt tatas ca anupasaṃhāra pramāṇa tva uktiḥ ayuktā iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || na vā viśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || ātmeti vākyasthātmaśabdena sarvaguṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na vā'bhyupagamyate| kutaḥ| viśeṣāt adhikāriyogyatāviśeṣamapekṣya tasya tadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na vā viśeṣāt iti asya arthaḥ ātmā iti vākya stha ātma śabdena sarva guṇānām grahaṇam na vā abhyupagamyate kutas viśeṣāt adhikāri yogyatā viśeṣam apekṣya tasya tad yogya guṇa abhidhāyaka tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca vidhirayaṃ sarvādhikārisādhāraṇaḥ| tāṃstānprati tattadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvāt| na cāsaṃbhavaḥ| adhikāramapekṣya tattvamasyādivākyasya pramā'pramājanakatvavatsarvaguṇābhidhāyakasyāpyātmaśabdasya tadyogyatāmapekṣyaiva guṇabodhakatvasaṃbhavāt| tasmādātmaśabdoktasarvaguṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca vidhiḥ ayam sarva adhikāri sādhāraṇaḥ tān tān prati tad tad yogya guṇa abhidhāyaka tvāt na ca asaṃbhavaḥ adhikāram apekṣya tattvamasyādi vākyasya pramā pramā janaka tva vat sarva guṇa abhidhāyakasya api ātma śabdasya tad yogyatām apekṣya eva guṇa bodhaka tva saṃbhavāt tasmāt ātma śabda ukta sarva guṇānām sarva upāsya tvam iti siddham

original: || darśayati ca ||
analyzed: darśayati ca

original: nanu caturguṇopāsakasyāpyātmaśabdātpaṃcaguṇānamapyevaṃ bodhasaṃbhavena na prātisvikaniyamāyogāt| upāsanānupapattiriti prāpte viśeṣāditi yuktisiddhārthaṃ śrutyā'pi samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu caturguṇa upāsakasya api ātma śabdāt paṃcaguṇa api evam bodha saṃbhavena na prātisvika niyama ayogāt upāsana anupapattiḥ iti prāpte viśeṣāt iti yukti siddhārtham śrutyā api samarthayat sūtram paṭhati

original: || darśayati ceti || asyārthaḥ || sarvāniti śrutiḥ svoktārthaṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: darśayati ca iti asya arthaḥ sarvān iti śrutiḥ sva ukta artham pratipādayati iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yasya yugapatsvabhujāvivātmaśabdena yāvaṃto guṇāḥ pratīyaṃte tāvaṃta evopāsyā iti niyamasaṃbhavāt| sarvān guṇāniti śruteḥ| tasmādātmaśabdoktaguṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca yasya yugapad sva bhujau iva ātma śabdena yāvaṃtaḥ guṇāḥ pratīyaṃte tāvaṃtaḥ eva upāsyāḥ iti niyama saṃbhavāt sarvān guṇān iti śruteḥ tasmāt ātma śabda ukta guṇānām sarva upāsya tvāt uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti na vā'dhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na vā adhikaraṇam

original: atra saṃbhṛtyādiguṇasya sarvopāsyatvaṃ netyucyate|
analyzed: atra saṃbhṛti ādi guṇasya sarva upāsya tvam na iti ucyate

original: || saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptyapi cātaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃbhṛti dyu vyāpti api ca atas

original: nanu saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptī sarveṣāṃ manuṣyādīnāmupāsye mumukṣutvāt devādivat| tatphalayoḥ svādhamaphalabharaṇaprakāśavyāptyorbhāvyatvāt| na caivaṃ sarvaguṇopāstiprasaṃgaḥ| tatphalānicchutvāt| tataśca caturguṇopāsananiyamabhaṃga iti || yadvā || devādayo na saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptyupāsanāyogyāḥ| pramāṇābhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu saṃbhṛti dyu vyāptī sarveṣām manuṣya ādīnām upāsye mumukṣu tvāt deva ādi vat tad phalayoḥ sva adhama phala bharaṇa prakāśa vyāptyoḥ bhāvya tvāt na ca evam sarva guṇa upāsti prasaṃgaḥ tad phala anicchu tvāt tatas ca caturguṇa upāsana niyama bhaṃgaḥ iti yat vā deva ādayaḥ na saṃbhṛti dyu vyāpti upāsana ayogyāḥ pramāṇa abhāvāt

original: na ca mumukṣutvāttadupāsanādhikārasiddhiriti vācyaṃ| yadi mumukṣutvāddevāḥ saṃbhṛtyādyupāsanādhikāriṇaḥ syustarhi manuṣyā api tathā syuraviśeṣāditi tarkabādhāt| ata eva na tatphalecchutvāddevānāmadhikārasiddhiḥ| tataśca devānāṃ manuṣyebhyo'tiśayāsiddhiriti| evaṃ pūrvapakṣadvikaprāpte samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: na ca mumukṣu tvāt tad upāsana adhikāra siddhiḥ iti vācyam yadi mumukṣu tvāt devāḥ saṃbhṛtya ādi upāsana adhikāriṇaḥ syuḥ tarhi manuṣyāḥ api tathā syuḥ aviśeṣāt iti tarka bādhāt atas eva na tad phala icchu tvāt devānām adhikāra siddhiḥ tatas ca devānām manuṣyebhyaḥ atiśaya asiddhiḥ iti evam pūrvapakṣa dvika prāpte samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || saṃbhṛti dyuvyāptyapi cāta iti || asyārthaḥ || api padena nañaḥ samākarṣaḥ| ca śabda evārthaḥ| saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptī samyagbharaṇaprakāśavyāptī| na sarvasyopāsye| kiṃtu devādyupāsye eva| kutaḥ| ata evādhikāriyogyatāyāṃ viśeṣasadbhāvādevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃbhṛti dyu vyāptī api ca atas iti asya arthaḥ api padena nañaḥ samākarṣaḥ ca śabdaḥ eva arthaḥ saṃbhṛti dyu vyāptī samyak bharaṇa prakāśa vyāptī na sarvasya upāsye kiṃtu deva ādi upāsye eva kutas atas eva adhikāri yogyatāyām viśeṣa sadbhāvāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptī na sarvopāsye| manuṣyāṇāṃ tata upāsanāyogyatāvirahāt| na ca muktāvapekṣitaprakāśādyasiddhiḥ| bhagavadrūpapratītiviṣayīkṛtaprakāśādinaiva tatsiddheḥ| tataśca noktacaturguṇopāsananiyamabhaṃgaḥ || yadvā || devādayaḥ saṃbhṛtādyupāsanāvaṃtaḥ| devādhikāre'nyādhikārādviśeṣasadbhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca saṃbhṛti dyu vyāptī na sarva upāsye manuṣyāṇām tatas upāsana ayogya tā virahāt na ca muktau apekṣita prakāśa ādi asiddhiḥ bhagavat rūpa pratīti viṣayīkṛta prakāśa ādinā eva tad siddheḥ tatas ca na ukta caturguṇa upāsana niyama bhaṃgaḥ yat vā deva ādayaḥ saṃbhṛta ādi upāsanāvaṃtaḥ

original: devādīnāmupāsyāstu saṃbhṛtidyupāsanāsadbhāvānnātiśayabhaṃga iti siddhāṃtadvayamuktaṃ bhavati ||
analyzed: deva ādīnām upāsyāḥ tu saṃbhṛti di upāsana asadbhāvāt na atiśaya bhaṃgaḥ iti siddhāṃta dvayam uktam bhavati

original: || iti saṃbhṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti saṃbhṛti adhikaraṇam

original: atra sarvavidyāto guṇopasaṃhāraḥ kartavya iti sādhyate|
analyzed: atra sarva vidyātaḥ guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti sādhyate

original: || puruṣavidyāyāmapi cetareṣāmanāmnānāt ||
analyzed: puruṣa vidyāyām api ca itareṣām an āmnānāt

original: nanu na viprakīrṇaguṇopasaṃhṛtiḥ kāryā| prayojanābhāvāt| na ca svayogyaguṇopāsanāyopasaṃhṛtiriti vācyaṃ| uttamānāṃ bahuguṇābidāyakaikavidyoktaguṇopasaṃhāramātreṇa maṃdānāmalpaguṇābhidhāyakaikavidyoktaguṇopasaṃhāramātreṇaiva tatsiddheḥ| ata upasaṃhāravaiyarthyānna sarvajñānopayoga iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na viprakīrṇa guṇa upasaṃhṛtiḥ kāryā prayojana abhāvāt na ca sva yogya guṇa upāsanāya upasaṃhṛtiḥ iti vācyam uttamānām bahu guṇa abhidāyaka eka vidyā ukta guṇa upasaṃhāra mātreṇa maṃdānām alpa guṇa abhidhāyaka eka vidyā ukta guṇa upasaṃhāra mātreṇa eva tad siddheḥ atas upasaṃhāra vaiyarthyāt na sarva jñāna upayogaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || puruṣavidyāyāmapi cetareṣāmanānmānāditi || asyārthaḥ || puruṣavidyāyāmapi sarvavidyottamatvena pratijñātāyāmapi| puruṣasūktākhyavidyāyāṃ keṣāṃcidevoktatvāditareṣāṃ tatroktebhyo'nyeṣāṃ ca guṇānāmanāmnānāt| kartavya eva sarvavidyāguṇopasaṃhāra ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: puruṣa vidyāyām api ca itareṣām anānmānāt iti asya arthaḥ puruṣa vidyāyām api sarva vidyā uttama tvena pratijñātāyām api puruṣasūkta ākhya vidyāyām keṣāṃcid eva ukta tvāt itareṣām tatra uktebhyaḥ nyeṣām ca guṇānām anāmnānāt kartavyaḥ eva sarva vidyā guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca kāryā eva viprakīrṇaguṇopasaṃhṛtiḥ| sarvaguṇopāsakānāmuttamānāṃ bhāvāt| sarvottamāyāmapi puruṣasūktākhyavidyāyāṃ sarvaguṇānāmanāmnānāt| maṃdāpekṣitanāmapyekatroktiniyamābhāvācca| ato sarvato guṇopasaṃhārasya kartavyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca kāryā eva viprakīrṇa guṇa upasaṃhṛtiḥ sarva guṇa upāsakānām uttamānām bhāvāt sarva uttamāyām api puruṣasūkta ākhya vidyāyām sarva guṇānām anāmnānāt maṃda apekṣita nāma pi ekatra ukti niyama abhāvāt ca atas sarvatas guṇa upasaṃhārasya kartavya tvāt uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti puruṣādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti puruṣa adhikaraṇam

original: atra bhedanādiguṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvaṃ nirasyate|
analyzed: atra bhedana ādi guṇānām sarva upāsya tvam nirasyate

original: || vedhādyarthabhedāt ||
analyzed: vedha ādi artha bhedāt

original: nanvagne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhiṃdhītyādinoktā bhedanādiguṇāḥ sarvopāsyāḥ| tatphalasya duṣṭanigrahasya sarvāpekṣitatvāt| ato vedhādīnāṃ sarvopāsyatvānna caturguṇopāsananiyama iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu agne tvacam yātudhānasya bhiṃdhi ityādinā uktāḥ bhedana ādi guṇāḥ sarva upāsyāḥ tad phalasya duṣṭa nigrahasya sarva apekṣita tvāt atas vedha ādīnām sarva upāsya tvāt na caturguṇa upāsana niyamaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || vedhādyarthabhedāditi || asyārthaḥ || arthabhedāt vedhādyupāsaphalasya hiṃsāderyatyādiyogyaphalādvilakṣaṇatvāt vedhādi bhiṃdhi vitvi śṛṇīhītyuktavedhādikaṃ na sarvopāsyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vedha ādi artha bhedāt iti asya arthaḥ artha bhedāt vedha ādi upāsa phalasya hiṃsā ādeḥ yati ādi yogya phalāt vilakṣaṇa tvāt vedha ādi śṛṇīhi iti ukta vedha ādikam na sarva upāsyam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca navedhādayaḥ sarvopāsyāḥ| tatphale bhedanādau yatyādīnāmanadhikārāt| ato vedhādīnāṃ sarvopāsyatvābhāvānnābhihitaniyamo bhajyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca na vedha ādayaḥ sarva upāsyāḥ tad phale bhedana ādau yati ādīnām anadhikārāt atas vedha ādīnām sarva upāsya tva abhāvāt na abhihita niyamaḥ bhajyate iti siddham

original: || iti vedhādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vedha adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanasya muktāvapyanuvṛttiḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsanasya muktau api anuvṛttiḥ samarthyate

original: || hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvātkuśācchaṃdastutyupagānavattaduktaṃ ||
analyzed: hānau tu upāyana śabda śeṣa tvāt kuśācchaṃda stuti upagāna vat tat uktam

original: nanu na muktenopāsanā kriyate| muktasyopāsanavidhyaṃgīkāre phalaprāptiprasaṃgāt| muktatvābhāvaprasaṃgācca| tadanaṃgīkāre ca prāptavyaphalaprasaṃgāt| prāptavyamaṃtarāpekṣāvatpravṛtyanupapatteḥ| tataśca sopādhikamevopāsanamiti muktisādhanatvādevopāsanaṃ kāryaṃ na tūpāsane ādarātiśaya iti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na muktena upāsanā kriyate muktasya upāsana vidhi aṃgīkāre phala prāpti prasaṃgāt mukta tva abhāva prasaṃgāt ca tad anaṃgīkāre ca prāptavya phala prasaṃgāt prāptavyam aṃtara apekṣāvat pravṛti anupapatteḥ tatas ca sopādhikam eva upāsanam iti mukti sādhana tvāt eva upāsanam kāryam na tu upāsane ādara atiśayaḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvātkuśācchaṃdastyutyupagānavattaduktamiti || asyārthāḥ || turavadhāraṇe yataḥ hānau baṃdhahānirūpamuktau| taduktaṃ muktānāmetatsāmeti śrutā vupāsanamuktaṃ| ato mokṣe'pi teṣāmupāsanamastyeva| tadapi kaśācchaṃdastutyupagānavadeva na vidhitaḥ|
analyzed: hānau tu upāyana śabda śeṣa tvāt kuśācchaṃdas tyuti upagāna vat tat uktam iti asya arthāḥ tuḥ avadhāraṇe yatas hānau baṃdha hāni rūpa muktau tat uktam muktānām etat sāma iti śrutau upāsanam uktam atas mokṣe pi teṣām upāsanam asti eva tat api kaśācchaṃda stuti upagāna vat eva na vidhitaḥ

original: yathā niyatabrahmayajñānāṃ niyatasaṃdhyopāsanānaṃtaramapi kuśairācchaṃdena svecchayaiva stutyupagāna ivobhayatra nāmnoradhyayanaṃ| tathā svecchayaiva na vidhitaḥ| kutaḥ| upāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt| upāyanaṃ mokṣaḥ| upāsanavidhīnāṃ mokṣavākyaśeṣatvādityarthaḥ| tathā ca mokṣārthopāsanāvidhayaḥ kathaṃ tatrāpi tā vidadhyurityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yathā niyata brahmayajñānām niyata saṃdhyā upāsana anaṃtaram api kuśaiḥ ācchaṃdena sva icchayā eva stuti upagāne iva ubhayatra nāmnoḥ adhyayanam tathā sva icchayā eva na vidhitaḥ kutas upāyana śabda śeṣa tvāt upāyanam mokṣaḥ upāsana vidhīnām mokṣa vākya śeṣa tvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca mokṣa artha upāsanā vidhayaḥ katham tatra api tāḥ vidadhyuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcānuṣṭheyameva muktāvupāsanaṃ| etatsāmeti vacanāt| na ca vidhibaddhatvena saṃsārasamānadharmatvaṃ mukteḥ| vinā'pi vidhiṃ svecchayaivopāsanamityaṃgīkārāt| dṛśyate ca niyatabrahmayajñaśabdasvādhyāyānaṃtaramapi svecchayaiva kuśairācchādanenaiva dvijanmanāmadhyayanādi| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca anuṣṭheyam eva muktau upāsanam etat sāma iti vacanāt na ca vidhi baddha tvena saṃsāra samāna dharma tvam mukteḥ vinā api vidhim sva icchayā eva upāsanam iti aṃgīkārāt dṛśyate ca niyata brahmayajña śabda svādhyāya anaṃtaram api sva icchayā eva kuśaiḥ ācchādanena eva dvijanmanām adhyayana ādi atas uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāttathā hyanye ||
analyzed: sāṃparāye tartavya abhāvāt tathā hi anye

original: nanu muktasyopāsanaṃ na svecchayā kiṃtu mokṣe tadā tadā prāptāniṣṭaparihārārthameva| kasyāpi niṣphalapravṛtteradarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu muktasya upāsanam na sva icchayā kiṃtu mokṣe tadā tadā prāpta aniṣṭa parihāra artham eva kasya api niṣphala pravṛtteḥ adarśanāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāttathā hyanya iti || asyārthaḥ || sāṃparāye mokṣe| upāsanaṃ svecchayaivetyaṃgīkāryaṃ| natvaniṣṭanivṛttyarthaṃ| kutaḥ| tartavyābhāvāt| muktaiḥ parihartavyāniṣṭasyaivābhāvāt| tadapi kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| anye śākinaḥ tathā tīrṇohīti śrutiṃ paṭhaṃti| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sāṃparāye tartavya abhāvāt tathā hi anye iti asya arthaḥ sāṃparāye mokṣe upāsanam sva icchayā eva iti aṃgīkāryam na tu aniṣṭa nivṛtti artham kutas tartavya abhāvāt muktaiḥ parihartavya aniṣṭasya eva abhāvāt tat api kutas hi yasmāt anye śākinaḥ tathā śrutim paṭhaṃti tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāt| api ca muktairyogādyapyanuṣṭhīyate| kimutopāsanaṃ| kṛṣṇau muktairiti bhāratavacanāt| ato muktāvapyupāsanānuvṛttairnirūpādhikaṃ tatsaṃsāre kartavyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sāṃparāye tartavya abhāvāt api ca muktaiḥ yoga ādi api anuṣṭhīyate kim uta upāsanam kṛṣṇau muktaiḥ iti bhārata vacanāt atas muktau api upāsana anuvṛttaiḥ nirūpa adhikam tat saṃsāre kartavyam iti siddham

original: || iti hānyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti hāni adhikaraṇam

original: atra muktānāṃ karmaṇi niyamābhāvaḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra muktānām karmaṇi niyama abhāvaḥ samarthyate

original: || chaṃdata ubhayāvirodhāt ||
analyzed: chaṃdataḥ ubhaya avirodhāt

original: nanu muktā niyamenānuṣṭhānavaṃtaḥ| viṣṇupūjātmakatvātkarmaṇi śaktatvācca teṣāṃ| anyathā niyamenopāsanamapi na te kuryuḥ| aviśeṣāt| ato muktānāṃ karmopāsanayoḥ sāmyātprāk na karmaṇo'tiśayopāsanaṃ kāryamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu muktāḥ niyamena anuṣṭhānavaṃtaḥ viṣṇu pūjā ātmaka tvāt karmaṇi śakta tvāt ca teṣām anyathā niyamena upāsanam api na te kuryuḥ aviśeṣāt atas muktānām karma upāsanayoḥ sāmyāt prāk na karmaṇā utiśaya upāsanam kāryam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || chaṃdata ubhayāvirodhāditi || asyārthaḥ || muktāḥ chaṃdataḥ svecchāmanusṛtyaiva karma kurvaṃti na vidhitaḥ| kutaḥ| ubhayāvirodhāt| karmakaraṇākaraṇayoḥ vidhibaṃdhapratyavāyayoḥ abhāvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: chaṃdataḥ ubhaya avirodhāt iti asya arthaḥ muktāḥ chaṃdataḥ sva icchām anusṛtya eva karma kurvaṃti na vidhitaḥ kutas ubhaya avirodhāt karma karaṇa akaraṇayoḥ vidhi baṃdha pratyavāyayoḥ abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na muktānāṃ karmaṇi niyamaḥ| api tu svecchayā kadācitkurvaṃti kadācinna kurvaṃti| niyamenānuṣṭhānaprayojakayorvidhibaṃdhapratyavāyayorābhāvāt| ato muktasya karmaniyamābhāvātsaṃsārepyupāsanamādhikyena kartavyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca na muktānām karmaṇi niyamaḥ api tu sva icchayā kadācid kurvaṃti kadācid na kurvaṃti niyamena anuṣṭhāna prayojakayoḥ vidhi baṃdha pratyavāyayoḥ ābhāvāt atas muktasya karma niyama abhāvāt saṃsāre api upāsanam ādhikyena kartavyam iti siddham

original: || gaterarthavattvamubhayathā'nyathā hi virodhaḥ ||
analyzed: gateḥ arthavat tvam ubhayathā anyathā hi virodhaḥ

original: nanu muktānāṃ vidhibaṃdhapratyavāyābhāva eva kuto yena karmaṇyaniyama ityataḥ samādadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu muktānām vidhi baṃdha pratyavāya abhāvaḥ eva kutas yena karmaṇi aniyamaḥ iti atas samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || gaterarthavattvamubhayathā'nyathā hi virodha iti || asyārthaḥ || hirhetau| ubhayathā hi baṃdhapratyavāyayorabhāvādeva| gateḥ mukteḥ| puruṣārthatvaṃ| anyathā muktau baṃdhapratyavāyayorbhāve| virodhaḥ mukteḥ saṃsārasamatvenāpuruṣārthatvarūpavirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: gateḥ arthavat tvam ubhayathā anyathā hi virodhaḥ iti asya arthaḥ hiḥ hetau ubhayathā hi baṃdha pratyavāyayoḥ abhāvāt eva gateḥ mukteḥ puruṣa artha tvam anyathā muktau baṃdha pratyavāyayoḥ bhāve virodhaḥ mukteḥ saṃsāra sama tvena a puruṣa artha tva rūpa virodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca mukteḥ karmaniyamābhāvāṃgīkāra eva mukteḥ puruṣārthatvādanyathā tanna syāt| ataḥ saṃsārepyupāsanamādhikyena kāryamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca mukteḥ karma niyama abhāva aṃgīkāraḥ eva mukteḥ puruṣa artha tvāt anyathā tat na syāt atas saṃsāre api upāsanam ādhikyena kāryam iti siddham

original: || upapannastallakṣaṇārthopalabdherlokavat ||
analyzed: upapannaḥ tad lakṣaṇa artha upalabdheḥ loka vat

original: nanu vidhyādyabhāvo muktānāṃ karmaniyamasaṃbhāvanāyaiva bhavati| na tūpapādanāya| īśvarakarmaṇi vyabhicārāt| ata upapādakābhāvādanupapanna evāsau niyama iti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu vidhi ādi abhāvaḥ muktānām karma niyama saṃbhāvanāya eva bhavati na tu upapādanāya īśvara karmaṇi vyabhicārāt atas upapādaka abhāvāt anupapannaḥ eva asau niyamaḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || upapannastallakṣaṇārthopalabdherlokavaditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā loke yāgāṃgaviṣṇukramaṇasya kriyānuṣṭhānaniyamaḥ na yāgasaṃpūrttyanaṃtaramapi asti| kiṃtu kadācideva| tathā muktānāṃ kadācitkarma kurvaṃti na vetyevaṃ tāvadupapannaḥ yuktaḥ| kuta etat| tallakṣaṇārthopalabdheḥ tallakṣaṇasya paraṃparayā karmasādhyasyārthasya mokṣasya|
analyzed: upapannaḥ tad lakṣaṇa artha upalabdheḥ loka vat iti asya arthaḥ yathā loke yāga aṃga viṣṇu kramaṇasya kriyā anuṣṭhāna niyamaḥ na yāga saṃpūrtti anaṃtaram api asti kiṃtu kadācid eva tathā muktānām kadācid karma kurvaṃti na vā iti evam tāvat upapannaḥ yuktaḥ kutas etat tad lakṣaṇa artha upalabdheḥ tad lakṣaṇasya paraṃparayā karma sādhyasya arthasya mokṣasya

original: upalabdheḥ prāptatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: upalabdheḥ prāpta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcopapanna eva svecchayā kadācitkarma kurvaṃti kadācinnetyevaṃ bhāvaḥ| tatphalasya mokṣasya prāptatvāt| tatphalasya ca prāptyanaṃtaramapravartakatvāt| yathā loke yāgapūrtilakṣaṇaphalasya yāgapūrtyanaṃtaraṃ viṣṇukramaṇādau na pravartakatvaṃ kiṃtvicchayaiva pravartakatvaṃ| atra prayogaḥ| muktā na karmānuṣṭhānaniyamavaṃtaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca upapannaḥ eva sva icchayā kadācid karma kurvaṃti kadācid na iti evam bhāvaḥ tad phalasya mokṣasya prāptatvāt tad phalasya ca prāpti anaṃtaram apravartaka tvāt yathā loke yāga pūrti lakṣaṇa phalasya yāga pūrti anaṃtaram viṣṇukramaṇa ādau na pravartaka tvam kiṃtu icchayā eva pravartaka tvam atra prayogaḥ muktāḥ na karma anuṣṭhāna niyamavaṃtaḥ

original: viśeṣahetvabhāve sati prāptatatphalatvāt| yajamānavaditi| ato muktasya karmaniyamābhāvena saṃsārepyupāsanamādhikyena kāryamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: viśeṣa hetu abhāve sati prāpta tad phala tvāt yajamāna vat iti atas muktasya karma niyama abhāvena saṃsāre api upāsanam ādhikyena kāryam iti siddham

original: || iti chaṃdādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti chaṃda adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanotpannabrahmajñānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mokṣanaiyatyaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra upāsana utpanna brahma jñānānām sarveṣām mokṣa naiyatyam sādhyate

original: || aniyamaḥ sarveṣāmavirodācchabdānumānābhyāṃ ||
analyzed: aniyamaḥ sarveṣām avirodāt śabda anumānābhyām

original: nanu na sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣaḥ| keṣāṃcitjñānināṃ svottamadrohaśāpābhyāmayogyatotpādāt| na hyayogyānāṃ tatprāptiḥ saṃbhavati| tathā satyayogyānāmapi sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraprasaṃgāt| ataḥ sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣābhāvena na niḥśaṃkopāsanaṃ kartavyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na sarveṣām jñāninām mokṣaḥ keṣāṃcid jñāninām sva uttama droha śāpābhyām ayogya tā utpādāt na hi ayogyānām tad prāptiḥ saṃbhavati tathā sati ayogyānām api sarva guṇa upasaṃhāra prasaṃgāt atas sarveṣām jñāninām mokṣa abhāvena na niḥśaṃka upāsanam kartavyam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || aniyamaḥ sarveṣāmavirodhācchabdānumānābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || aniyamaḥ aparokṣajñānināṃ madhye keṣāṃcinmokṣaḥ keṣāṃcinnetyevaṃrūpavyavasthā'bhāvo jñāyate| kutaḥ| sarveṣāmapi mokṣe| avirodhāt niṣedhakābhāvāt| kiṃca śabdānumānābhyāṃ na kaściditi śruteḥ tanmūlakānumānāccetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aniyamaḥ sarveṣām avirodhāt śabda anumānābhyām iti asya arthaḥ aniyamaḥ aparokṣa jñāninām madhye keṣāṃcid mokṣaḥ keṣāṃcid na iti evaṃrūpa vyavasthā bhāvaḥ jñāyate kutas sarveṣām api mokṣe avirodhāt niṣedhaka abhāvāt kiṃca śabda anumānābhyām na kaścid iti śruteḥ tad mūlaka anumānāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcātsyeva sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣaḥ| keṣāṃcideva mokṣo na sarveṣāmiti vadan praṣṭavyaḥ| kiṃ bādhakasadbhāvānna sarveṣāṃ mokṣa uta sādhakābhāvāt| nādyaḥ| tadabhāvāt| na cāyogyatotpādako bādhakaḥ| ye jñānaviṣayā iti vacanādayogyatotpādānaṃgīkārāt| na dvitīyaḥ| na kaściditi śrutivirodhāpatteḥ|
analyzed: sarveṣām jñāninām mokṣaḥ keṣāṃcid eva mokṣaḥ na sarveṣām iti vadan praṣṭavyaḥ kim bādhaka sadbhāvāt na sarveṣām mokṣaḥ uta sādhaka abhāvāt na ādyaḥ tad abhāvāt na ca ayogyatā utpādakaḥ bādhakaḥ ye jñāna viṣayāḥ iti vacanāt ayogyatā utpāda anaṃgīkārāt na dvitīyaḥ na kaścid iti śruti virodha āpatteḥ

original: vipratipannā jñānino mokṣavaṃtaḥ jñānitvātsaṃmatavadityanumānācca| bādhakābhāvena śrutimūlakatvena copasaṃhārānumānābādhāt| ato jñānināṃ mokṣasya niyatatvānniḥśaṃkamupāsanaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: vipratipannāḥ jñāninaḥ mokṣavaṃtaḥ jñāni tvāt saṃmata vat iti anumānāt ca bādhaka abhāvena śruti mūlaka tvena ca upasaṃhāra anumāna ābādhāt atas jñāninām mokṣasya niyata tvāt niḥśaṃkam upāsanam kāryam iti siddham

original: || iti aniyamādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti aniyama adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsane'dhikāraniyamaḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsana idhikāra niyamaḥ samarthyate

original: || yāvadadhikāramavasthitirādhikārikāṇāṃ ||
analyzed: yāvadadhikāram avasthitiḥ ādhikārikāṇām

original: nanu nopāsanāvaṃto'dhikāraniyamavaṃtaḥ| pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca muktāvānaṃdatāratamyānyathānupapattiḥ pramāṇaṃ| tāratamyaprāmāṇikatvepyupāsanāprayatnatāratamyenaivānyathāsiddheḥ| ata upātsyadhikāraniyamābhāveneti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na upāsanāvaṃtaḥ adhikāra niyamavaṃtaḥ pramāṇa abhāvāt na ca muktau ānaṃda tāratamya anyathā anupapattiḥ pramāṇam tāratamya prāmāṇika tve pi upāsanā prayatna tāratamyena eva anyathā siddheḥ atas prāpte sūtritam

original: || yāvadadhikāramavasthitirādhikārikāṇāmiti || asyārthaḥ || ādhikārikāṇāṃ yogyatānusāryupāsanaśīlānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ svasvādhikārānusāreṇaiva muktau| avasthitiḥ avasthitānāmupāsanāvattāratamyenaiva muktau teṣāṃ phalamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yāvadadhikāram avasthitiḥ ādhikārikāṇām iti asya arthaḥ ādhikārikāṇām yogyatā anusāri upāsana śīlānām brahma ādīnām sva sva adhikāra anusāreṇa eva muktau avasthitiḥ avasthitānām upāsanā vat tāratamyena eva muktau teṣām phalam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcātsyeva niyamaḥ| ayametadguṇopāsane yogyo'yaṃ neti tena vinā śrutyuktānaṃdatāratamyakathanasyāpyayogāt| prayatnatāratamyasyāpi yogyatātāratamyādhīnatvāt| adhikārādhiko yatna iti vacanāt| tataścopāsanādhikāre niyamāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: niyamaḥ ayam etad guṇa upāsane yogyaḥ yam na iti tena vinā śruti ukta ānaṃda tāratamya kathanasya api ayogāt prayatna tāratamyasya api yogyatā tāratamya adhīna tvāt adhikāra adhikaḥ yatnaḥ iti vacanāt tatas ca upāsana adhikāre niyamāt uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavirodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavattaduktaṃ ||
analyzed: akṣara dhiyām tu avirodhaḥ sāmānya tad bhāvābhyām aupasada vat tat uktam

original: nanu muktāvānaṃdatāratamyameva nopapadyate| asamatve muktānāṃ parasparavirodhaprāpteḥ| loke tathā darśanāt| tāratamyaśrutīnāṃ tu saṃsāraviṣayatvāt| tadaṃgīkāre muktau dveṣerṣyādiprasakteśca| ata upātsyadhikāraniyamābhāvena prāpteśca samaṃjasamityādyayuktamiti prāpte siddhāṃtitaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu muktau ānaṃda tāratamyam eva nā upapadyate asamatve muktānām paraspara virodha prāpteḥ loke tathā darśanāt tāratamya śrutīnām tu saṃsāra viṣaya tvāt tad aṃgīkāre muktau dveṣa īrṣyā ādi prasakteḥ ca atas upātsi adhikāra niyama abhāvena prāpteḥ ca samaṃjasam iti ādi ayuktam iti prāpte siddhāṃtitaṃ

original: || akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavirodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavattaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'pyarthaḥ| akṣaradhiyāṃ brahmajñānināṃ| viṣamatvepyavirodhaḥ virodho nāsti| kutaḥ| brahmadhītvāt| kiṃca sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāṃ sarveṣāṃ doṣābhāvāt uttamebhyaḥ adhamānāṃ upakārābhāvācca| kathaṃ| aupasadavat sacchiṣyavat| kiṃca taduktaṃ|
analyzed: akṣara dhiyām tu avirodhaḥ sāmānya tad bhāvābhyām aupasada vat tat uktam iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ upi arthaḥ akṣara dhiyām brahma jñāninām viṣama tve ipi avirodhaḥ virodhaḥ na asti kutas brahma dhī tvāt kiṃca sāmānya tad bhāvābhyām sarveṣām doṣa abhāvāt uttamebhyaḥ adhamānām upakāra abhāvāt ca katham aupasada vat sat śiṣya vat kiṃca tat uktam

original: tat asamatve'pi virodho nāstītyetannāneti turaśrutāvuktamato'pyavirodha ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tat asamatve pi virodhaḥ na asti iti etat nānā iti turaśrutau uktam atas upi avirodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca virodhāprasaṃgāt| virodhe hi viṣayalaṃpaṭyāṃ mātsaryādayo'nupakāritvaṃ ca hetavaḥ| na ca mukteṣu saṃbhavaṃti| brahmadhītvāt| nirdoṣatvācca| anupakāritvamapi nāstīti pratiyogisatvasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt| tasmādupāsanādhikāre niyamāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca virodha aprasaṃgāt virodhe hi viṣaya laṃpaṭyām mātsarya ādayaḥ nupakāri tvam ca hetavaḥ na ca mukteṣu saṃbhavaṃti brahma dhī tvāt nirdoṣa tvāt ca anupakāri tvam api nā asti iti pratiyogi satvasya pramāṇa siddha tvāt tasmāt upāsana adhikāre niyamāt uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti yāvadadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti yāvadadhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanādhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsana adhikāriṇām prāṇa avasāna tvam samarthyate

original: || iyadāmananāt ||
analyzed: iyat āmananāt

original: nanu nādhikāriṇaḥ prāṇāvasānāḥ| prāṇaḥ svottamādhikāriniyamyaḥ| adhikāritvāt| nāmādivat| ityanumānavirodhāt| ato'dhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānātvābhāvena hiraṇyagarbha eva sarvaguṇopāstiyogya ityuktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na adhikāriṇaḥ prāṇa avasānāḥ prāṇaḥ sva uttama adhikāri niyamyaḥ adhikāri tvāt nāma ādi vat iti anumāna virodhāt atas adhikāriṇām prāṇa avasānā tva abhāvena hiraṇyagarbhaḥ eva sarva guṇa upāsti yogyaḥ iti uktam ayuktam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || iyadāmananāditi || asyārthaḥ || adhikāritāratamyaṃ iyadeva prāṇāvadhikameva| kutaḥ| āmananāt| prāṇo vāveti śruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: iyat āmananāt iti asya arthaḥ adhikāri tāratamyam iyat eva prāṇau adhikam eva kutas āmananāt prāṇaḥ vāva iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prāṇāvasānatvamevādhikāriṇaḥ| nirdiṣṭaśruteḥ| anumānasya ca bādhitaviṣayatvena bādhābhāvāt| tataścādhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvena sa eva sarvaguṇopāstiyogya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prāṇa avasāna tvam eva adhikāriṇaḥ nirdiṣṭa śruteḥ anumānasya ca bādhita viṣaya tvena bādhā abhāvāt tatas ca adhikāriṇām prāṇa avasāna tvena saḥ eva sarva guṇa upāsti yogyaḥ iti siddham

original: || aṃtarā bhūtagrāmavaditi cettaduktaṃ ||
analyzed: aṃtarā bhūta grāma vat iti ced tat uktam

original: uktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: uktam ākṣipya samādadhat sūtram paṭhati

original: || aṃtarā bhūtagrāmavaditi cettaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || bhūtagrāmavat yathā nāmādiprāṇasamūhe ekasbhādeka uttamo dṛṣṭaḥ| tathā aṃtarā paramātmānaṃ śriyaṃ ca vinā prāṇāduttamostviti cenneti śeṣaḥ| yatastaduktaṃ| tatra prāṇāduttamābhāve| nahīti pramāṇamuktaṃ| ata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aṃtarā bhūta grāma vat iti ced tat uktam iti asya arthaḥ bhūta grāma vat yathā nāma ādi prāṇa samūhe uttamaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā aṃtarā paramātmānam śriyam ca vinā prāṇāt uttamaḥ astu iti ced na iti śeṣaḥ yatas tat uktam tatra prāṇāt uttama abhāve nahi iti pramāṇam uktam atas iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcoktānumānasya prāṇo vāveti śrutibādhitatvenāvirodhāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ukta anumānasya prāṇaḥ vāva iti śruti bādhita tvena avirodhāt atas uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || anyathā bhedānupapattiriti cennopadeśavat ||
analyzed: anyathā bheda anupapattiḥ iti ced nā upadeśa vat

original: nanu prāṇo vāveti śrutibalena na prāṇasya sarvottamatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyaṃ| tathā satīśvaradvayāyogena prāṇa paramātmanoraikyaprasaṃgāditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu prāṇaḥ vāva iti śruti balena na prāṇasya sarva uttama tvam vaktum śakyam tathā sati īśvara dvaya ayogena prāṇa paramātmanoḥ aikya prasaṃgāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || anyathā bhedānupapattiriti cennopadeśavaditi || asyārthaḥ || anyathā prāṇādapyuttamatvābhāve| prāṇaparamātmanorbhedānupapattiriti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ upadeśavat yathā śrutāvuktaṃ tathāṃ'gīkriyate| ato noktadoṣa ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anyathā bheda anupapattiḥ iti ced na upadeśa vat iti asya arthaḥ anyathā prāṇāt api uttama tva abhāve prāṇa paramātmanoḥ bheda anupapattiḥ iti ced na kutas yatas upadeśa vat yathā śrutau uktam tathā aṃgīkriyate atas na ukta doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca chaṃdogaśrutyuktaprakāreṇa sarvaśabdasya saṃkocamaṃgīkṛtya prāṇasya sarvādhikāryuttamatvaṃ tato mahālakṣmyāstataḥ paramātmana uttamatvāṃgīkārāt| ato'dhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvena sa eva sarvaguṇopāstiyogya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca chaṃdoga śruti ukta prakāreṇa sarva śabdasya saṃkocam aṃgīkṛtya prāṇasya sarva adhikāri uttamatvam tatas mahālakṣmyāḥ tatas paramātmanaḥ uttama tva aṃgīkārāt atas adhikāriṇām prāṇa avasāna tvena saḥ eva sarva guṇa upāsti yogyaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti iyadāmananādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti iyat āmanana adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanādhikāriṇaḥ prāṇātparameśvarasyottamatvaṃ prasādhyate|
analyzed: atra upāsana adhikāriṇaḥ prāṇāt parameśvarasya uttama tvam prasādhyate

original: || vyatihāro viśiṃṣaṃti hītaravat ||
analyzed: vyatihāraḥ viśiṃṣaṃti hi itara vat

original: nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvaṃ yuktaṃ| prāṇasyottamatvamuktvā taduttamatvānabhidhānāt| na hi satyapi prāṇāduttametadanabhidhāne kāraṇamasti| yenānuktimagaṇyya prāṇāduttamatvaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratīmaḥ| na ca satyapadoditasya viṣṇoḥ prāṇāduttamatvaṃ yuktamiti vācyaṃ| prakaraṇabhedakābhāvena satyatvasya prāṇaviśeṣaṇatvāt|
analyzed: nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarva uttama tvam yuktam prāṇasya uttama tvam uktvā tad uttama tva anabhidhānāt na hi sati api prāṇāt uttam etad anabhidhāne kāraṇam asti yena anuktim a gaṇyya prāṇāt uttama tvam viṣṇoḥ pratīmaḥ na ca satya pada uditasya viṣṇoḥ prāṇāt uttama tvam yuktam iti vācyam prakaraṇa bhedaka abhāvena satya tvasya prāṇa viśeṣaṇa tvāt

original: tataśca na viṣṇoḥ sarvopāsyatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: tatas ca na viṣṇoḥ sarva upāsya tvam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || vyatihāro viśiṃṣaṃti hītaravaditi || asyārthaḥ || vyatihāraḥ prāṇaprakaraṇādanaṃtaraṃ viṣṇoḥ prakaraṇāt prāk praśnaprativacanayoradhyāhāraḥ kāryaḥ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| itaravat nāmādito vāgādikamivaprāṇavādinaḥ sakāśāt satyākhyaviṣṇuvādinaḥ chaṃdogā eṣa tu veti tu śabdena viśiṃṣaṃti vyāvartayaṃti| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vyatihāraḥ viśiṃṣaṃti hi itara vat iti asya arthaḥ vyatihāraḥ prāṇa prakaraṇāt anaṃtaram viṣṇoḥ prakaraṇāt prāk praśna prativacanayoḥ adhyāhāraḥ kāryaḥ kutas hi yasmāt itaravat nāma āditaḥ vāc ādikam iva prāṇa vādinaḥ sakāśāt satya ākhya viṣṇu vādinaḥ chaṃdogāḥ eṣa tu vā iti tu śabdena viśiṃṣaṃti vyāvartayaṃti tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvaṃ| na ca nāmādāviva praśnaprativacanābhāvātprāṇāduttamābhāve tātparyamiti vācyaṃ| prāyapāṭhabalena praśnaprativacanasyānumātuṃ śakyatvāt| na ca prakaraṇabhedakābhāvānna praśnaprativacanādhyāhāra iti vācyaṃ| tu śabdasya prakaraṇabhedakasya sadbhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca yuktam eva viṣṇoḥ sarva uttama tvam na ca nāma ādau iva praśna prativacana abhāvāt prāṇāt uttama abhāve tātparyam iti vācyam prāya pāṭha balena praśna prativacanasya anumātum śakya tvāt na ca prakaraṇa bhedaka abhāvāt na praśna prativacana adhyāhāraḥ iti vācyam tu śabdasya prakaraṇa bhedakasya sadbhāvāt

original: tataśca praśnaprativacanasaṃdhānapūrvakaṃ maṃtradraṣṭrā viṣṇoḥ prāṇāduttamatvasyoktatvāttasya sarvopāsyatvaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tatas ca praśna prativacana saṃdhāna pūrvakam maṃtra draṣṭrā viṣṇoḥ prāṇāt uttama tvasya ukta tvāt tasya sarva upāsya tvam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti vyatihārādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vyatihāra adhikaraṇam

original: atra prāṇādviṣṇorevottamatvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra prāṇāt viṣṇoḥ eva uttama tvam sādhyate

original: || saiva hi satyādayaḥ ||
analyzed: sā eva hi satya ādayaḥ

original: nanu na kevalaṃ prāṇātsatyapadokto viṣṇurevottamaḥ| api tu bahavaḥ| satyādapyupari vijñānamiti śraddhāniṣṭhākṛtisukhabhūmāhaṃkārātmanāmuktatvāt| satyādīnāmabhede pramāṇābhāvāt| ataḥ prāṇādapi bahūnāmuttamatvāttasya viṣṇuṃ vinā sarvottamatvaṃ viṣṇornirupacaritasarvottamatvaṃ na yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na kevalam prāṇāt satya pada uktaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva uttamaḥ api tu bahavaḥ satyāt api upari vijñānam iti śraddhā niṣṭhā ākṛti sukha bhūma ahaṃkāra ātmanām ukta tvāt satya ādīnām abhede pramāṇa abhāvāt atas prāṇāt api bahūnām uttama tvāt tasya viṣṇum vinā sarva uttama tvam viṣṇoḥ nirupacarita sarva uttama tvam na yuktam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || saiva hi satyādaya iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| satyādyāḥ aha mātmāṃtā padārthāḥ| saiva īśvarākhya paradevataiva| tasmātprāṇādhikāḥ bahavaḥ na| kiṃtu śrīstadīśāvevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sā eva hi satya ādayaḥ iti asya arthaḥ hi yasmāt satya ādyāḥ padārthāḥ sā eva īśvara ākhya para devatā eva tasmāt prāṇa adhikāḥ bahavaḥ na kiṃtu śrīḥ tad īśau eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca satyādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ paradevatātvāt| na cābhedoktyabhāvaḥ| satyamiti praśne yathā vai iti tad‌vyāptārthāṃtaropadeśasya kathamapyayogena vijñānasya satyaguṇatvābhidhāyakatvāt| guṇasya ca guṇyabhinnatvāt| sa vā eṣa ityādinā'haṃkārātmajñānānmokṣābhidhānāt| sa evādhāstāditi pūrṇatvābhidhānācca|
analyzed: evam ca satya ādīnām sarveṣām para devatā tvāt na ca abheda ukti abhāvaḥ satyam iti praśne yathā vai iti tad vyāpta artha aṃtara upadeśasya katham api ayogena vijñānasya satya guṇa tva abhidhāyaka tvāt guṇasya ca guṇya bhinna tvāt sa vai eṣaḥ ityādinā ahaṃkāra ātma jñānāt mokṣa abhidhānāt saḥ eva adha āstāt iti pūrṇa tva abhidhānāt ca

original: kiṃca sarveṣāṃ satyādīnāṃ śrutyaṃtare satyaṃ pūrṇamityādinā pūrṇatvasya bhagavallakṣaṇatvoktyā tato'pi sarveṣāṃ tadaikyaṃ| ataḥ satyādīnāmātmāṃtānāṃ bhagavatsvarūpatvena sa eva prāṇāduttama ityuktamupapannamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: kiṃca sarveṣām satya ādīnām śruti aṃtare satyam pūrṇam ityādinā pūrṇa tvasya bhagavat lakṣaṇa tva uktyā sarveṣām tad aikyam atas satya ādīnām ātmāṃtānām bhagavat svarūpa tvena saḥ eva prāṇāt uttamaḥ iti uktam upapannam iti siddham

original: || iti satyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti satya adhikaraṇam

original: atra śriya upāsanānadhikāritvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra śriyaḥ upāsana anadhikāri tvam sādhyate

original: || kāmāditaratra tatra cāyatanādibhyaḥ ||
analyzed: kāmāt itaratra tatra ca āyatana ādibhyaḥ

original: nanu bhavatyeva prakṛtiradhikāriṇī| na ca nāmādiṣvapaṭhitatvāditi vācyaṃ| asiddheḥ| na ca śravaṇaprasaṃgaḥ| anuccāritameva tadvākyaṃ ṛṣyabhipretamastītyaṃgīkārāt| na ca saṃsāritvāsiddhiḥ| sītārugmiṇyadirjananamaraṇādidarśanena tatsiddheḥ| tataśca nādhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu bhavati eva prakṛtiḥ adhikāriṇī na ca nāma ādiṣu apaṭhita tvāt iti vācyam asiddheḥ na ca śravaṇa prasaṃgaḥ anuccāritam eva tat vākyam ṛṣi abhipretam asti iti aṃgīkārāt na ca saṃsāri tva asiddhiḥ sītā rugmiṇī adiḥ janana maraṇa ādi darśanena tad siddheḥ tatas ca na adhikāriṇām prāṇa avasāna tvam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || kāmāditaratra tatra cāyatanādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || lakṣmīḥ tatra bhagavatsamīpe sthitā satī| itaratraca bhūmyādāvapi| kāmāt īśvarecchayaivāvatārānkaroti| kutaḥ| āyatanādibhyaḥ sarvagatatvapratipādaka sarvāyatanetyādiśrutyādibya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: kāmāt itaratra tatra ca āyatana ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ lakṣmīḥ tatra bhagavat samīpe sthitā satī itaratra ca bhūmi ādau api kāmāt īśvara icchayā eva avatārān karoti kutas āyatana ādibhyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prakṛtirnādhikāriṇī| abaddhatvāt| na ca jananādinā tatsiddhiḥ| sītārugmiṇyādeḥ prādurbhūtatvenotpatterabhāvāt| sarvāyatanā sarvakāleti vatsaśruteḥ| ataḥ prakṛteradhikāritvābhāvādyuktaṃ prāṇāvasānatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prakṛtiḥ nā adhikāriṇī abaddha tvāt na ca janana ādinā tad siddhiḥ sītārugmiṇī ādeḥ prādurbhūta tvena utpatteḥ abhāvāt sarva āyatanā sarva kālā iti vatsa śruteḥ atas prakṛteḥ adhikāri tva abhāvāt yuktam prāṇa avasāna tvam iti siddham

original: || ādarādalopaḥ ||
analyzed: ādara āda lopaḥ

original: nanu ramāyā asaṃsāritve kṛtakṛtyatvena bhagavadupāsanādyabhāvaḥ syāt| na cāsau yuktaḥ| yadarcitaṃ brahmetyādipramāṇaviruddhatvāt| ātrārcitamupāsitaṃ pūjitaṃ cetyukterityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu ramāyāḥ asaṃsāri tve kṛtakṛtya tvena bhagavat upāsana ādi abhāvaḥ syāt na ca asau yuktaḥ yat arcitam brahma ityādi pramāṇa viruddha tvāt

original: || ādarādalopa iti || asyārthaḥ || ādarāt bhagavati nirupādhikabhaktyatiśayāt| alopaḥ śriyo bhagavadupāsanābhāvo netyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ādarāt alopaḥ iti asya arthaḥ ādarāt bhagavati nirupādhika bhakti atiśayāt alopaḥ śriyaḥ bhagavat upāsana abhāvaḥ na iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca śrīrnityamuktā'baddhā'pi nirupādhikasarvātiśayitabhaktivaśānniyamena tasyā bhagavadupāsanopapatteḥ| yathā śrīriti vacanāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca śrīḥ nityam uktā ābaddhā api nirupādhika sarva atiśayita bhakti vaśāt niyamena tasyāḥ bhagavat upāsana upapatteḥ yathā śrīḥ iti vacanāt atas uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || upasthitestadvacanāt ||
analyzed: upasthiteḥ tad vacanāt

original: nanu na ramāyā nityamuktatvaṃ yuktaṃ| kāraṇābhāvāt| na ca svata eva tat| tasyā asvātaṃtryāditi prāpte pariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu na ramāyāḥ nitya mukta tvam yuktam kāraṇa abhāvāt na ca svatas eva tat tasyāḥ asvātaṃtryāt iti prāpte pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || upasthitestadvacanāditi || asyārthaḥ || śriyo nityamuktatvaṃ yujyate| kutaḥ| upasthiteḥ harisamīpe sadā sthiteḥ| śriyo nityasamīpasthatvaṃ ca| tadvacanāt dvāvetāviti nityasaṃbaṃdhitvavacanāt| jñāyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: upasthiteḥ tad vacanāt iti asya arthaḥ śriyaḥ nitya mukta tvam yujyate kutas upasthiteḥ hari samīpe sadā sthiteḥ śriyaḥ nitya samīpa stha tvam ca tad vacanāt dvau etau iti nitya saṃbaṃdhi tva vacanāt jñāyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dvāviti śrutivacanādramāyāḥ samīpasthiteḥ siddhatvāt| atiśayitabhagavatprasādākhyakāraṇasadbhāvāt| atastasyā nityamuktatvenādhikārikatvābhāvādyuktaṃ prāṇāvasānatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca dvau iti śruti vacanāt ramāyāḥ samīpa sthiteḥ siddhatvāt atiśayita bhagavat prasāda ākhya kāraṇa sadbhāvāt atas tasyāḥ nitya mukta tvena ādhikārika tva abhāvāt yuktam prāṇāvasāna tvam iti siddham

original: || iti kāmādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti kāma adhikaraṇam

original: atra śravaṇamanananididhyāsanarūpasya samastasyāpyupāsanasya kartavyatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra śravaṇa manana nididhyāsana rūpasya samastasya api upāsanasya kartavya tvam samarthyate

original: || tannirdhāraṇārthaniyamastadṛṣṭeḥ pṛthagghyapratibaṃdhaḥ phalaṃ ||
analyzed: tad nirdhāraṇa artha niyamaḥ tad dṛṣṭeḥ pṛthak hi apratibaṃdhaḥ phalam

original: nanu śravaṇamanane eva kārye| tābhyāmevājñānasaṃśayaviparyanivṛttau svakāraṇādeva darśanasaṃbhavāt| athocyeta| ajñānapratibaṃdhakānāṃ dṛḍhatvātdhyānenaiva pratibaṃdhakanivṛttiriti| tarhi dhyānenaiva jñānamastu| na jñānārthaṃ śravaṇamanane| na ca samucitānāṃ jñānahetutve mānamasti| na ca jñānotpāde śravaṇamananayorupayogo'sti|
analyzed: nanu śravaṇa manane eva kārye tābhyām eva ajñāna saṃśaya viparya nivṛttau sva kāraṇāt eva darśana saṃbhavāt atha ucyeta ajñāna pratibaṃdhakānām dṛḍha tvāt dhyānena eva pratibaṃdhaka nivṛttiḥ iti tarhi dhyānena eva jñānam astu na jñāna artham śravaṇa manane na ca samucitānām jñāna hetu tve mānam asti na ca jñāna utpāde śravaṇa mananayoḥ upayogaḥ asti

original: ataḥ samastopāsanasyāvaśyākartavyatvena tadvidhānavaiyarthyamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: atas samasta upāsanasya avaśya a kartavya tvena tad vidhāna vaiyarthyam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || tannirdhāraṇārthaniyamastaddṛṣṭeḥ pṛthagghyapratibaṃdhaḥ phalamiti || asyārthaḥ || yatastannardhāraṇārthaniyamaḥ vedārthaniścayo vedārthaniyamaścetyetadrūpaṃ| śravaṇamananaphalaṃ dhyānaphalabhūtāyāḥ| taddṛṣṭeḥ brahmadarśanāt| pṛthagena bhinnameva| ato na brahmadṛṣṭiḥ śravaṇādinā bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathāpi na śravaṇamananavaiyarthyaṃ| kutaḥ|
analyzed: tad nirdhāraṇa artha niyamaḥ tad dṛṣṭeḥ pṛthak hi apratibaṃdhaḥ phalam iti asya arthaḥ yatas tad nirdhāraṇa artha niyamaḥ veda artha niścayaḥ veda artha niyamaḥ ca iti etad rūpam śravaṇa manana phalam dhyāna phala bhūtāyāḥ tad dṛṣṭeḥ brahma darśanāt pṛthak ena bhinnam eva atas na brahma dṛṣṭiḥ śravaṇa ādinā bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā api na śravaṇa manana vaiyarthyam kutas

original: hi yasmāt| apratibaṃdhaḥ brahmadṛṣṭipratibaṃdhakanivṛttiḥ| tannaścayaḥ tanniyamadvārā śravaṇamananayoḥ phalaṃ| ato dhyānasādhyāpi dṛṣṭiḥ pratibaṃdhakanivṛttidvārā śravaṇādisādhyā bhavati| tadarthaṃ śravaṇādikamapi kāryamevetyarthaḥ| hi śabdena ātmā vā'ra iti śrutiḥ sūcitā ||
analyzed: hi yasmāt apratibaṃdhaḥ brahma dṛṣṭi pratibaṃdhaka nivṛttiḥ tad naścayaḥ tad niyama dvārā śravaṇa mananayoḥ phalam atas dhyāna sādhyā api dṛṣṭiḥ pratibaṃdhaka nivṛtti dvārā śravaṇa ādi sādhyā bhavati tad artham śravaṇa ādikam api kāryam eva iti arthaḥ hi śabdena ātmā vāraḥ iti śrutiḥ sūcitā

original: evaṃca kartavyameva samastopāsanaṃ| na śravaṇamananamātraṃ| tayostattvajñānavedārthanirṇayarūpadarśanātiriktaphalahetutvenadarśanahetutvābhāvāt| dhyānasya ca darśanahetutvenāvaśyakatvāt| na caivaṃ śravaṇamananābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| tayoḥ sākṣāddarśanahetutvābhāve'pi pratibaṃdhakībhūtājñānasaṃśayaviparyayanivṛttidvārā darśanopayogitvenāvaśyakatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca kartavyam eva samasta upāsanam na śravaṇa manana mātram tayoḥ tattva jñāna veda artha nirṇaya rūpa darśana atirikta phala hetutvena darśana hetutva abhāvāt dhyānasya ca darśana hetutvena āvaśyakatvāt na ca evam śravaṇa manana abhāva prasaṃgaḥ tayoḥ sākṣāt darśana hetutva abhāve pi pratibaṃdhakībhūta ajñāna saṃśaya viparyaya nivṛtti dvārā darśana upayogi tvena āvaśyakatvāt

original: na ca tatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ| darśanārtha śrotavya iti vihitatvāt| śrutvā matveti smṛteśca| ataḥ samastopāsanasya kartavyatvādyuktaṃ tadvidhānamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca tatra pramāṇa abhāvaḥ darśana artha śrotavyaḥ iti vihita tvāt śrutvā matvā iti smṛteḥ ca atas samasta upāsanasya kartavya tvāt yuktam tad vidhānam iti siddham

original: || iti nirdhāraṇādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti nirdhāraṇa adhikaraṇam

original: atra bhagavatjñānasādhanaśravaṇādyupāsanasya setikartavyatākatvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra bhagavat jñāna sādhana śravaṇa ādi upāsanasya sa itikartavyatāka tvam sādhyate

original: || pradānavadeva hi taduktaṃ ||
analyzed: pradāna vat eva hi tat uktam

original: nanu śravaṇādikameva jñānasādhanaṃ| na gurupradānapūrvakaṃ| ātmāveti śrutau śravaṇādīnāmeva jñānatvābhidhānāt| na hi śravaṇāditrayamuktvāviśiṣyagurupradānasyānuktau kāraṇamasti| kiṃca guruprasādasya śravaṇādyaṃgatve'nuṣṭhitaśravaṇāderapi gurukopena jñānābhāvaḥ syāt| tathā ca jātāparokṣasya mokṣābhāvaḥ syādaviśeṣāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu śravaṇa ādikam eva jñāna sādhanam na guru pradāna pūrvakam śrutau śravaṇa ādīnām eva jñāna tva abhidhānāt na hi śravaṇa ādi trayam uktvā a viśiṣya guru pradānasya anuktau kāraṇam asti kiṃca guru prasādasya guru kopena jñāna abhāvaḥ syāt tathā ca jāta aparokṣasya mokṣa abhāvaḥ syāt aviśeṣāt iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || pradānavadeva hi taduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || pradānavat prītipūrvakaṃ gurupadeśayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ jñānasādhanaṃ na kevalaṃ| kutaḥ| hi yataḥ| taduktaṃ tasya jñānasya guruprasādārdhānatvaṃ ācāryavāniti śrutāvuktamata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pradāna vat eva hi tat uktam iti asya arthaḥ pradāna vat prīti pūrvakam guru upadeśa yuktam eva śravaṇa ādikam jñāna sādhanam na kevalam kutas hi yatas tat uktam tasya jñānasya ācāryavān iti śrutau uktam atas iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca gurupradānayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ| ācāryavānpuruṣo vedeti vacanāt| na cātmāveti śrutau śravaṇāderiva gurupradānasyāpyuktiprasaṃgaḥ| gurupradānasya śravaṇādyaṃgatvena tatsamakakṣitvābhāvāt| na cānuṣṭhitaśravaṇāderapi jñānābhāvo jñānino'pi mokṣābhāvo gurukopena syāditi vācyaṃ| tatjñānamokṣayorīśvarakalpitatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca guru pradāna yuktam eva śravaṇa ādikam mokṣa sādhanam ācāryavān puruṣaḥ veda iti vacanāt na ca ātmā aveti śrutau śravaṇa ādeḥ iva guru pradānasya api ukti prasaṃgaḥ guru pradānasya śravaṇa ādi aṃga tvena tad samakakṣi tva abhāvāt na ca anuṣṭhita śravaṇa ādeḥ api jñāna abhāvaḥ jñāninaḥ api mokṣa abhāvaḥ guru kopena syāt iti vācyam tad jñāna mokṣayoḥ īśvara kalpita tvāt

original: na caivaṃ guruśāpo viphalaḥ| jñānādihrāsahetutvāt| jñānino guruśāpopīti ye jñānaviṣayā iti cokteḥ| ato gurupradānasyāvaśyakatvādyuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca evam guru śāpaḥ viphalaḥ jñāna ādi hrāsa hetutvāt jñāninaḥ guru śāpaḥ api iti ye jñāna viṣayāḥ iti ca ukteḥ atas guru pradānasya āvaśyaka tvāt yuktam eva śravaṇa ādikam kartavyam iti siddham

original: || iti pradānādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti pradāna adhikaraṇam

original: atretikartavyatārūpaguruprasādasya balīyastvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra itikartavya tā rūpa guru prasādasya balīyaḥ tvam samarthyate

original: || liṃgabhūyastvāttaddhi balīyastadapi ||
analyzed: liṃga bhūyaḥ tvāt tat hi balīyaḥ tat api

original: nanu viśiṣṭaśiṣyaprayatna eva balavān| pradhānatvāt| na guruprasādaḥ| itikartavyatārūpatvāt| mābhūdvā''dhikyaṃ sāmyaṃ tu syāt| na śiṣyaprayatnasya daurbalyaṃ| guruśiṣyayoḥ| puruṣatvasāmyāt| ato guruprasādasyāprābalyānnāvaśyakatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu viśiṣṭa śiṣya prayatnaḥ eva balavān pradhāna tvāt na guru prasādaḥ itikartavya tā rūpatvāt sāmyam tu syāt na śiṣya prayatnasya daurbalyam guru śiṣyayoḥ puruṣa tva sāmyāt atas guru prasādasya aprābalyāt na āvaśyaka tvam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || liṃgabhūyastvāttaddhi balīyastadapīti || asyārthaḥ || tat guruprasādapūrvakapradānamātraṃ| balīyaḥ atiśayena balavat| kutaḥ| liṃgabhūyastvāt vṛṣabhahaṃsajalavāyasarūpebhyo vāyvagnivaruṇebhyo śrutavidyenāpi satyakāmena gurupradānādirūpaliṃgabāhulyadarśanāt tathā'pi tadapi śravaṇādikamapi kāryaṃ| kutaḥ| śretavya iti śruterityarthaḥ|
analyzed: liṃga bhūyaḥ tvāt tat hi balīyaḥ tat api iti asya arthaḥ tat guru prasāda pūrvaka pradāna mātram balīyaḥ atiśayena balavat kutas liṃga bhūyaḥ tvāt vṛṣabha haṃsa jala vāyasa rūpebhyaḥ vāyu agni varuṇebhyaḥ śrutavidyena api satyakāmena guru pradāna ādi rūpa liṃga bāhulya darśanāt tathā api tat api śravaṇa ādikam api kāryam kutas śretavyaḥ iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: hi śabdaḥ śrutisūcakaḥ ||
analyzed: hi śabdaḥ śruti sūcakaḥ

original: evaṃca guruprasādo balavāneva na durbalaḥ| nāpi samaḥ| liṃgabhūyastvāt| daurbalyamanumātuṃ na śakyaṃ| na ca guruprasādasya prābalyābhāve tadyujyate na cetikartavyatātvāddaurbalyamanumātuṃ śakyaṃ| liṃgabhūyastvena bādhitaviṣayatvāt| tathopakosalopyagnyādibhyo vidyāṃ śrutvā'pi guruṃ prārthayate|
analyzed: evam ca guru prasādaḥ balavān eva na durbalaḥ nā api samaḥ liṃga bhūyaḥ tvāt daurbalyam anumātum na śakyam na ca guru prasādasya prābalya abhāve tat yujyate na ca itikartavya tā tvāt daurbalyam anumātum śakyam liṃga bhūyaḥ tvena bādhita viṣaya tvāt tathā upakosalaḥ api agni ādibhyaḥ vidyām śrutvā api gurum prārthayate

original: tathā ṛṣabhādibhyo vidyāṃ śrutvā'pi satyakāmo guruṃ prārthayate| yāgīyahiṃsāṃge tu vyabhicārācca| na ca tāvatā'lamiti naṃ maṃtavyaṃ| api vā''tmeti vacanena tasyānuṣṭheyatvāt| ato guruprasādapūrvakaṃ pradānasya prābalyāttadapekṣitamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tathā ṛṣabha ādibhyaḥ vidyām śrutvā api satyakāmaḥ gurum prārthayate yāgīya hiṃsā aṃge tu vyabhicārāt ca na ca tāvatā alam iti naṃ maṃtavyam api vā ātmā iti vacanena tasya anuṣṭheya tvāt atas guru prasāda pūrvakam pradānasya prābalyāt tat apekṣitam iti siddham

original: || iti liṃgabhūyastvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti liṃga bhūyaḥ tva adhikaraṇam

original: atra pūrvaprāptādanyo'pi guruḥ svīkārya eveti samarthyate|
analyzed: atra pūrva prāptāt anyaḥ api guruḥ svīkāryaḥ eva iti samarthyate

original: || pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇātsyātkriyāmānasavata ||
analyzed: pūrva vikalpaḥ prakaraṇāt syāt kriyā mānasa vata

original: nanu prathama prāpta eva guruḥ svīkāryo na tu tatparityāgenānyaḥ| parityāga kāraṇībhūtapātityādidoṣābhāvāt| na ca prathamaprāptagurvasādhyaphalalābhāyānyaḥ svīkārya iti vācyaṃ| gurusvīkāryeṇaiva tadupapatteḥ| na hi gurusvīkārasyāsādhyaṃ nāsti yenānyaḥ svīkāryaḥ syāt| anyathaikalavyasya vidyāprāptirna syāt|
analyzed: nanu prathama prāptaḥ eva guruḥ svīkāryaḥ na tu tad parityāgena anyaḥ parityāga kāraṇībhūta pātitya ādi doṣa abhāvāt na ca prathama prāpta guru asādhya phala lābhāya anyaḥ svīkāryaḥ iti vācyam guru svīkāryeṇa eva tad upapatteḥ na hi guru svīkārasya asādhyam na asti yena anyaḥ svīkāryaḥ syāt anyathā ekalavyasya vidyā prāptiḥ na syāt

original: pātityādidoṣaṃ vināpi guruparityāge ca doṣaprāpteśca| ataḥ pūrvaprāpta eva gururiti niyamātkvacitsarvajñaguroḥ prathama prāptatvābhāve prāguktaṃ na yujyata iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: pātitya ādi doṣam vinā api guru parityāge ca doṣa prāpteḥ ca atas pūrva prāptaḥ eva guruḥ iti niyamāt kvacid sarvajña guroḥ prathama prāptatva abhāve prāguktam na yujyate iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇātsyātkriyāmānasavāditi || asyārthaḥ || kriyāmānasavat mānasakriyārūpadhyāne vikalpaḥ tathā pūrvavikalpaḥ pūrvaprāptena guruṇā samasya paścātprāptasya guroḥ| vikalpaḥ grāhye vā naveti vikalpaḥ syāt| na tu svīkārya eveti vidhiḥ| kutaḥ| prakaraṇāt| prakṛṣṭānugrahamapekṣya guroḥ svīkāryatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pūrva vikalpaḥ prakaraṇāt syāt kriyā mānasavāt iti asya arthaḥ kriyā mānasa vat mānasa kriyā rūpa dhyāne vikalpaḥ tathā pūrva vikalpaḥ pūrva prāptena guruṇā samasya paścāt prāptasya guroḥ vikalpaḥ grāhye vā na vā iti vikalpaḥ syāt na tu svīkāryaḥ eva iti vidhiḥ kutas prakaraṇāt prakṛṣṭa anugraham apekṣya guroḥ svīkārya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na pūrva prāpta eva gururiti niyamaḥ| paścāttanaḥ samagrānugrahaṃ karoti cetso'pi grāhyaḥ| guruparigrahasya samagrānugrahārthatvāt| guruprasādamaṃtarā gurusvīkārādimātreṇa mokṣādilakṣaṇamahāphalābhāvāt| samagrānugrahaṃ kartā pūrvasmāduttamaścetpūrvānujñāṃ vinā niḥsaṃśayaṃ svīkārya eva| samaścetpūrvānujñayā svīkāryaḥ| nocenna svīkāryaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca na pūrva prāptaḥ eva guruḥ iti niyamaḥ paścāttanaḥ samagra anugraham karoti ced saḥ api grāhyaḥ guru parigrahasya samagra anugraha artha tvāt guru prasādam aṃtarā guru svīkāra ādi mātreṇa mokṣa ādi lakṣaṇa mahā phala abhāvāt samagra anugraham kartā pūrvasmāt uttamaḥ ced pūrva anujñām vinā niḥsaṃśayam svīkāryaḥ eva samaḥ ced pūrva anujñayā svīkāryaḥ no ced na svīkāryaḥ

original: iti vikalpaḥ syāt| mānasakriyāvat| adhamaścenna svīkārya eva pūrvasmāduttama iti śruteḥ| ataḥ sarvajñagurusvīkārasyopapannatvena taduktaprakāreṇopāsanaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vikalpaḥ syāt mānasa kriyā vat adhamaḥ ced na svīkāryaḥ eva pūrvasmāt uttamaḥ iti śruteḥ atas sarvajña guru svīkārasya upapanna tvena tad ukta prakāreṇa upāsanam kartavyam iti siddham

original: || atideśācca ||
analyzed: atideśāt ca

original: hetvaṃtareṇa samottamagurusvīkāraṃ samarthayatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: hetu aṃtareṇa sama uttama guru svīkāram samarthayat sūtram āha

original: || atideśācceti || asyārthaḥ || pūrvaguruṇaiva svasamottamagurusvīkārāyātideśāt| yathetyātidiśyamānatvāt| yuktameva paścāttanasvīkaraṇamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atideśāt ca iti asya arthaḥ pūrva guruṇā eva sva sama uttama guru svīkārāya atideśāt yathā iti ātidiśyamāna tvāt yuktam eva paścāttana svīkaraṇam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcācāryopāsanaṃ nāma savinayamaṃte sthitiḥ| tasyopacāro nāmābhīṣṭakaraṇādirityarthakatvāt| brahmopāsva brahmopacarasveti pauṣyāyaṇaśrutāvatideśāt| ataḥ sarvajñagurusvīkārasyopapannatvena taduktaprakāreṇopāsanaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca ācārya upāsanam nāma sa vinayam aṃte sthitiḥ tasya upacāraḥ nāma abhīṣṭa karaṇa ādiḥ iti arthaka tvāt brahma upāsva brahma upacarasva iti pauṣyāyaṇa śrutau atideśāt atas sarvajña guru svīkārasya upapanna tvena tad ukta prakāreṇa upāsanam kāryam iti siddham

original: || iti vikalpādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vikalpa adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanasya kartavyatāsamarthanāya jñānameva muktiheturiti samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsanasya kartavya tā samarthanāya jñānam eva mukti hetuḥ iti samarthyate

original: || vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇāt ||
analyzed: vidyā eva tu nirdhāraṇāt

original: nanu na bhagavata upāsanaṃ kāryaṃ| vyarthatvāt| na ca jñānārthamupāsanaṃ| tasyāpi vyarthatvāt| na ca mokṣārthaṃ jñānaṃ| jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvāniścayāt| yathā jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ śrūyate tathā karmaṇo'pi karmaṇaiva hītyādi mokṣasādhanatvaṃ smaryate|
analyzed: nanu na bhagavataḥ upāsanam kāryam vyartha tvāt na ca jñāna artham upāsanam tasya api vyartha tvāt na ca mokṣa artham jñānam jñānasya mokṣa sādhana tva aniścayāt yathā jñānasya mokṣa sādhana tvam śrūyate tathā karmaṇaḥ api karmaṇā eva hi ityādi mokṣa sādhana tvam smaryate

original: na ca puruṣārthasādhanatvasaṃdehe'pi kṛṣyādāviva jñānopāsanādau pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ| alpavittavyayāyāsasādhye tatra tathā saṃbhave'pi bahuvittavyayāyāsasādhyapāratrikapravṛtteḥ saṃdehamātreṇāyogāt| tato jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvānirṇayānna jñānopāsanaṃ kāryamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca puruṣa artha sādhanatva saṃdehe pi kṛṣi ādau iva jñāna upāsana ādau pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati iti vācyam alpa vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhye tatra tathā saṃbhave api bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhya pāratrika pravṛtteḥ saṃdeha mātreṇa ayogāt tatas jñānasya mokṣa sādhanatva anirṇayāt na jñāna upāsanam kāryam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || nānyaḥpaṃthā iti nirdhāraṇāt anyaniṣedhena jñānasyaiva mokṣasādhanatvaniścayāt| vidyaiva mokṣasādhanaṃ na karmādikamityarthaḥ| śruteḥ prābalyadyotakastu śabda ||
analyzed: vidyā eva tu nirdhāraṇāt iti asya arthaḥ na anyaḥ paṃthāḥ iti nirdhāraṇāt anya niṣedhena jñānasya eva mokṣa sādhanatva niścayāt vidyā eva mokṣa sādhanam na karma ādikam iti arthaḥ śruteḥ prābalya dyotakaḥ tu śabdaḥ

original: evaṃca kāryameva jñānārthamupāsanaṃ| tamevaṃ viditveti śruteḥ| karmavacanādapi prābalyena vidyaiva mokṣa ityavadhāraṇa saṃbhavāt| ato jñānasya muktisādhanatvāttadarthamupāsanaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca kāryam eva jñāna artham upāsanam tam evam viditvā iti śruteḥ karma vacanāt api prābalyena vidyā eva mokṣaḥ iti avadhāraṇa saṃbhavāt atas jñānasya mukti sādhana tvāt tad artham upāsanam kartavyam iti siddham

original: || darśanācca ||
analyzed: darśanāt ca

original: nanvevaṃ tarhi dhyānavaiyarthyaṃ bhavet| śravaṇenaiva mananarūpavicārasaṃbhavāt| tanmātreṇa mokṣasaṃbhavādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu evam tarhi dhyāna vaiyarthyam bhavet śravaṇena eva manana rūpa vicāra saṃbhavāt tad mātreṇa mokṣa saṃbhavāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalaṃ parokṣajñāptirūpavidyaiva mokṣaḥ| kiṃtu darjñanācca brahmasākṣātkārādapi| ato na dhyānavaiyarthyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: darśanāt ca iti asya arthaḥ na kevalam parokṣa jñāpti rūpa vidyā eva mokṣaḥ kiṃtu darjñanāt ca brahma sākṣātkārāt api atas na dhyāna vaiyarthyam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca parokṣajñānena mokṣānukteryena mananenaiva kṛtatvātdhyānavaiyarthyaṃ syāt| kiṃnāmopāsanājanitenāparokṣajñānenetyabhyupagamāt| na ca tamevaṃ viditveti sāmānyaśrutisadbhāvena jñānameva mokṣasādhanaṃ tattvaparokṣajñānameveti niyamo niyāmakābhāvāditi vācyaṃ| dṛṣṭ‌vaiveti śrutibalena sādhāraṇaśruterapyaparokṣajñānaparatayā vyākhye yatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca parokṣa jñānena mokṣa anukteḥ yena mananena eva kṛta tvāt dhyāna vaiyarthyam syāt kiṃnāma upāsana a janitena aparokṣa jñānena iti abhyupagamāt na ca tam evam viditvā iti sāmānya śruti sadbhāvena jñānam eva mokṣa sādhanam tattva parokṣa jñānam eva iti niyamaḥ niyāmaka abhāvāt iti vācyam dṛṣṭvā eva iti śruti balena sādhāraṇa śruteḥ api aparokṣa jñāna paratayā vyākhye ya tvāt

original: ato jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvena tadarthamupāsanaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas jñānasya mokṣa sādhana tvena tad artham upāsanam kartavyam iti siddham

original: || iti vidyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vidyā adhikaraṇam

original: atra yatsādhanaṃ bhagavadupāstiḥ tasya jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra yad sādhanam bhagavat upāstiḥ tasya jñānasya mokṣa sādhana tvam samarthyate

original: || śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādhaḥ ||
analyzed: śruti ādi balīyaḥ tvāt ca na bādhaḥ

original: nanu karmasādhya eva mokṣaḥ| karmaṇaiva saṃsiddhiriti vacanāt| śrutismṛtyoḥ sāvadhāraṇatve'pi bhagavadvākyatvena smṛterevabalavattvāt| tataḥ śruteḥ smṛtibādhitatvena jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvābhāvena na tadarthamupāsanaṃ kāryamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu karma sādhyaḥ eva mokṣaḥ karmaṇā eva saṃsiddhiḥ iti vacanāt śruti smṛtyoḥ sāvadhāraṇa tve api bhagavat vākya tvena smṛteḥ eva balavat tvāt tatas śruteḥ smṛti bādhita tvena jñānasya mokṣa sādhanatva abhāvena na tad artham upāsanam kāryam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādha iti || asyārthaḥ || mokṣasya jñānasādhyatve'bādhaḥ karmaṇaiveti smṛtivirodho nāsti| kutaḥ| śrutyādibalīyastvāt| jñānasya mokṣasādhakatvopapādakatvamevaṃ viditvetyādi śrutiliṃgāderatibalatvena smṛtigataiva śabdasyāyogavyavacchedārthatvopapatterityarthaḥ || etatsūcanāya ca śabdaḥ ||
analyzed: śruti ādi balīyaḥ tvāt ca na bādhaḥ iti asya arthaḥ mokṣasya jñāna sādhya tve bādhaḥ karmaṇā eva iti smṛti virodhaḥ na asti kutas śruti ādi balīyaḥ tvāt jñānasya mokṣa sādhaka tva upapādaka tvam evam viditvā ityādi śruti liṃga ādeḥ atibala tvena smṛti gatā eva śabdasya ayoga vyavaccheda artha tva upapatteḥ iti arthaḥ etad sūcanāya ca śabdaḥ

original: evaṃca vidyaiva mokṣaḥ| tamevaṃ viditveti nānyaḥ paṃthā iti nirdhāraṇāt| tamevaṃ viditveti vacanātparokṣajñānenaiva mokṣa iti na maṃtavyaṃ| dṛṣṭ‌vaiva taṃ mucyata iti vacanādviditveti śruterapyaparokṣajñānaparatāyā eva grāhyatvāt| na ca karmaṇaiveti sāvadhāraṇāyā īsvaravacanena balavatyā smṛtyā bādhaḥ|
analyzed: evaṃca vidyā eva mokṣaḥ tam evam viditvā iti na anyaḥ paṃthāḥ iti nirdhāraṇāt tam evam viditvā iti vacanāt parokṣa jñānena eva mokṣaḥ iti na maṃtavyam dṛṣṭvā eva tam mucyate iti vacanāt viditvā iti śruteḥ api aparokṣa jñāna para tāyāḥ eva grāhya tvāt na ca karmaṇā eva iti sāvadhāraṇāyāḥ īsvara vacanena balavatyā smṛtyā bādhaḥ

original: tamevaṃ viditveti śruterna karmabhiriti tattvajñānaprārthanarligasya karmaṇā badhyata iti yuktimadbhagavadvacanasya ca tato balavattvāt| na ca karmaṇaiveti smṛtyaprāmāṇyaṃ| avadhāraṇasya karmayogāvyavacchedārthakatvāt| ato jñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvena kartavyaivopāsaneti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: tam evam viditvā iti śruteḥ na karmabhiḥ iti karmaṇā badhyate iti yuktimat bhagavat vacanasya ca tatas balavat tvāt na ca karmaṇā eva iti smṛti aprāmāṇyam avadhāraṇasya karmayoga avyavaccheda arthaka tvāt atas jñānasya eva mokṣa hetu tvena kartavyā eva upāsanā iti siddham

original: || iti śrutyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti śruti adhikaraṇam

original: atra brahmajñānasādhanopāsanasya bhaktipūrvakatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra brahma jñāna sādhana upāsanasya bhakti pūrvaka tvam samarthyate

original: || anubaṃdhādibhyaśca ||
analyzed: anubaṃdha ādibhyaḥ ca

original: nanu na jñānārthaṃ bhaktirapekṣitā| prasādasya jñānahetutve sahāyānapekṣatvāt| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanna iti vacanāt| na caivamupāsanābhāvaḥ jñānasyopāsanā'nvayavyatirekadarśanena prasādasyopāsanātiriktāpekṣatvasya pramāṇārthatvāt| na copāsanā bhaktimaṃtareṇa saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ| dveṣeṇāpi dhyānasaṃbhavāt| dveṣāccaidyādaya iti vacanāt|
analyzed: nanu na jñāna artham bhaktiḥ apekṣitā prasādasya jñāna hetu tve sahāya anapekṣa tvāt sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannaḥ iti vacanāt na ca evam upāsana abhāvaḥ jñānasya upāsana anvaya vyatireka darśanena prasādasya upāsana atirikta apekṣa tvasya pramāṇa artha tvāt na ca upāsanā bhaktim aṃtareṇa saṃbhavati iti vācyam dveṣeṇa api dhyāna saṃbhavāt dveṣāt caidya ādayaḥ iti vacanāt

original: ato dveṣeṇa vā bhaktyā votpannenopāsanena guruprasādalakṣaṇasahakārivāśātjñānasaṃbhavena na tadarthaṃ bhaktyādikamāvaśyakamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: atas dveṣeṇa vā bhaktyā vā utpannena upāsanena guru prasāda lakṣaṇa sahakāri vāśāt jñāna saṃbhavena na tad artham bhakti ādikam āvaśyakam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || anubaṃdhādibhyaśceti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalaṃ śravaṇādinā| nāpi prabalaguruprasādena brahmadarśanaṃ bhavati| kiṃtvanubaṃdhaśabditaharigurubhaktiśamādibhyaścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anubaṃdha ādibhyaḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ na kevalam śravaṇa ādinā na api prabala guru prasādena brahma darśanam bhavati kiṃtu anubaṃdha śabdita hari guru bhakti śama ādibhyaḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca na kevalaṃ jñānārthaṃ śravaṇādikaṃ guruprasādaścāpekṣitaḥ| kiṃtu bhaktyādikamapi prasādārthaṃ jñānārthaṃ cāpekṣitaṃ| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanna iti vacanāt| ato bhaktyāderjñānārthamapekṣitatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca na kevalam jñāna artham śravaṇa ādikam guru prasādaḥ ca apekṣitaḥ kiṃtu bhakti ādikam api prasāda artham jñāna artham ca apekṣitam sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannaḥ iti vacanāt atas bhakti ādeḥ jñāna artham apekṣita tvāt uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti anubaṃdhādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti anubaṃdha adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanāsādhyajñāne viśeṣatāratamyaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsanā sādhya jñāne viśeṣa tāratamyam samarthyate

original: || prajñāṃtarapṛthaktvavadṛṣṭiśca taduktaṃ ||
analyzed: prajñā aṃtara pṛthaktva vat ṛṣṭiḥ ca tat uktam

original: nanu sarveṣāmekaprakāramevāparokṣajñānaṃ| bhaktyā māmabhijānātītyanena sarveṣāṃ pūrṇajñānena mokṣasya cābhidhānāt| ataḥ sarveṣāṃ darśanasāmyāduktaṃ muktatāratamyamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu sarveṣām eka prakāram eva aparokṣa jñānam bhaktyā mām abhijānāti iti anena sarveṣām pūrṇa jñānena mokṣasya ca abhidhānāt atas sarveṣām darśana sāmyāt uktam mukta tāratamyam ayuktam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || prajñāṃtara pṛthaktvavaddṛṣṭiśca taduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || prajñāṃtaraṃ prajñāviśeṣaḥ| dhyānamiti yāvat| tasya pṛthaktvavat anekaprakārattvavat| tadanusāreṇa dṛṣṭiśca brahmadṛṣṭirapi anekaprakārā na srevaṣāmekavidhā| kiṃca taduktaṃ dṛṣṭeranekavidhatvaṃ aṃtardṛṣṭaya iti śrutāvuktaṃcetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: prajñā aṃtara pṛthaktva vat dṛṣṭiḥ ca tat uktam iti asya arthaḥ prajñā aṃtaram prajñā viśeṣaḥ dhyānam iti yāvat tasya pṛthaktva vat aneka prakāra ttva vat tad anusāreṇa dṛṣṭiḥ ca brahma dṛṣṭiḥ api aneka prakārā na kiṃca tat uktam dṛṣṭeḥ anekavidha tvam aṃtar dṛṣṭayaḥ iti śrutau uktam ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcānekaprakāramevādhikāriṇāṃ bhagavaddarśanaṃ| tatsādhanasyopāsanasyānekaprakāratvāt| phalasya ca sādhanānusāritvāt| na caivaṃ saṃpūrṇadarśanābhāvādviriṃcetareṣāṃ mokṣābhāvaḥ| yathāyogya dṛṣṭereva mokṣahetutvena svayogyadarśanena sarveṣāṃ mokṣasaṃbhavāt| ato jñānaviśeṣasadbhāvādyuktaṃ mokṣatāratamyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca aneka prakāram eva adhikāriṇām bhagavat darśanam tad sādhanasya upāsanasya aneka prakāra tvāt phalasya ca sādhana anusāri tvāt na ca evam saṃpūrṇa darśana abhāvāt viriṃca itareṣām mokṣa abhāvaḥ yathāyogya dṛṣṭeḥ eva mokṣa hetu tvena sva yogya darśanena sarveṣām mokṣa saṃbhavāt atas jñāna viśeṣa sadbhāvāt yuktam mokṣa tāratamyam iti siddham

original: || iti prajñāṃtarādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti prajñā aṃtara adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanasya biṃbaśabditayogyātmarūpaviṣayakasyaiva muktisādhanatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsanasya biṃba śabdita yogya ātma rūpa viṣayakasya eva mukti sādhanatvam samarthyate

original: || na sāmānyādapyupalabdhermṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiḥ ||
analyzed: na sāmānyāt api upalabdheḥ mṛtyu vat na hi loka āpattiḥ

original: nanu yatkiṃcidrūpadarśanameva mokṣasādhanaṃ| bhagavataḥ pūrvarūpeṣvapi sāmyāt| ato yatkiṃcidrūpadarśanasya mokṣasādhanatvānna biṃbopāsanāniyatirapekṣitā sidyatīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu yat kiṃcid rūpa darśanam eva mokṣa sādhanam bhagavataḥ pūrva rūpeṣu api sāmyāt atas yat kiṃcid rūpa darśanasya mokṣa sādhana tvāt na biṃba upāsana niyatiḥ apekṣitā sidyati iti prāpte parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || nā sāmānyāpapyupalabdhermṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiriti || asyārthaḥ || mṛtyuvat mṛtyumātrānaṃtaraṃ yathā na muktiḥ| kiṃtu caramamṛtiviśeṣānaṃtarameva| tadvadatrāpi bhagavadrūpāṇāṃ sāmye'pi upalabdheḥ| bhagavaddaṣṭisāmānyāt sādhāraṇarūpāparokṣajñānāt| na sarveṣāṃ muktiḥ kiṃtu svasvabiṃbadarśanādeva| na caivaṃ sāmānyadarśanasya vaiphalyaṃ|
analyzed: nā upalabdheḥ mṛtyu vat na hi loka āpattiḥ iti asya arthaḥ mṛtyu vat mṛtyu mātra anaṃtaram yathā na muktiḥ kiṃtu carama mṛti viśeṣa anaṃtaram eva tadvat atra api bhagavat rūpāṇām sāmye api upalabdheḥ bhagavat daṣṭi sāmānyāt sādhāraṇa rūpa aparokṣa jñānāt na sarveṣām muktiḥ kiṃtu sva sva biṃba darśanāt eva na ca evam sāmānya darśanasya vaiphalyam

original: tasya maharādilokaprāptisādhanatvāt| na caitāvatā tasya mokṣahetutvaṃ prāpneti| hi yataḥ| lokapattiḥ lokaprāptimātraṃ na muktiḥ| tasmādityarthaḥ || hītyanena sanmānyadarśanetyādipramāṇaprasiddhiśca sūcitā ||
analyzed: tasya mahar ādi loka prāpti sādhanatvāt na ca etāvatā tasya mokṣa hetu tvam hi yatas loka pattiḥ loka prāpti mātram na muktiḥ tasmāt iti arthaḥ hi iti anena sanmānya darśana ityādi pramāṇa prasiddhiḥ ca sūcitā

original: evaṃca bhagavadrūpāṇāṃ sāmānyena sāmānyato darśanena na sarveṣāṃ muktiḥ| kiṃ nāma svabiṃbadarśanādeva| darśanenātmayogyeneti vacanāt| na ca darśanāṃtaravaiyarthyaṃ| sāmānyadarśanāditivacanabalena teṣāṃ maharādilokaprāptihetutvāt| svayogyajñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvāt| mṛtyutvasāmye'pi liṃgabhaṃgasyaivānaṃdāvirbhāvahetutvāt|
analyzed: evam ca bhagavat rūpāṇām sāmānyena sāmānyatas darśanena na sarveṣām muktiḥ kim nāma sva biṃba darśanāt eva darśanena ātma yogyena iti vacanāt na ca darśana aṃtara vaiyarthyam sāmānya darśanāt iti vacana balena teṣām mahar ādi loka prāpti hetutvāt sva yogya jñānasya eva mokṣa hetutvāt mṛtyu tva sāmye pi liṃga bhaṃgasya eva ānaṃda āvirbhāva hetutvāt

original: na ca lokaprāptireva mokṣaḥ| maharādilokaṃ gatānāṃ prayalānaṃtaraṃ mokṣaśravaṇāt| ato biṃbadarśanasyaiva mokṣasādhanatvāttadevopāsyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: na ca loka prāptiḥ eva mokṣaḥ mahar ādi lokam gatānām prayala anaṃtaram mokṣa śravaṇāt atas biṃba darśanasya eva mokṣa sādhana tvāt tat eva upāsyam iti siddham

original: || iti na sāmānyādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti na sāmānya adhikaraṇam

original: atrānubaṃdhādibhya ityatra darśanasādhanatayopāsanāsāhityenoktabhakteḥ svātaṃtryaṃ nirasyate|
analyzed: atra anubaṃdha ādibhyaḥ iti atra darśana sādhanatayā upāsanā sāhityena ukta bhakteḥ svātaṃtryam nirasyate

original: || pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāttvanubaṃdhaḥ ||
analyzed: pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyam bhūyaḥ tvāt tu anubaṃdhaḥ

original: nanu bhaktyaivāparokṣajānaṃ| na paramātmaprasādena| bhaktirevainaṃ mocayatīti śruteḥ| tataḥ sādhanasāmarthyenaiva darśanasaṃbhavānna tasyāvyaktatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu bhaktyā eva aparokṣa jānam na paramātma prasādena bhaktiḥ eva enam mocayati iti śruteḥ tatas sādhana sāmarthyena eva darśana saṃbhavān na tasya avyakta tvam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāttvanubaṃdha iti || asyārthaḥ || turapi yadyapi| pareṇa ca paramātmanaiva| brahmadarśanaṃ tathā'pi śabdasya bhaktirevainamiti śruteḥ| tadvidhyaṃ paramātmana iva bhakteḥ svātaṃtryeṇa brahmadarśanahetutvavācitvaṃ yujyate| kutaḥ| darśanādau karaṇatvāditi heturupaskartavyaḥ| yadvā|
analyzed: pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyam bhūyaḥ tvāt tu anubaṃdhaḥ iti asya arthaḥ tuḥ api yadi api pareṇa ca paramātmanā eva brahma darśanam tathā api śabdasya bhaktiḥ eva enam iti śruteḥ tadvidhyam paramātmanaḥ iva bhakteḥ svātaṃtryeṇa brahma darśana hetutva vācitvam yujyate kutas darśana ādau karaṇa tvāt iti hetuḥ upaskartavyaḥ yat vā

original: pareṇa vācyena nimittena śabdasya bhaktiriti śruteḥ| tādvidhyaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ| tarhi kathaṃ bhaktiriti vākyena satsvapyanyasādhaneṣu anubaṃdho bhaktiḥ viśiṣyocyata ityata uktaṃ| bhūyastvāditi| tasyāḥ sādhaneṣu| bhūyastvāt prādhānyāt| tadabhiprāyeṇānubaṃdho bhaktirviśiṣyocyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pareṇa vācyena nimittena śabdasya bhaktiḥ iti śruteḥ tādvidhyam yuktam iti arthaḥ tarhi katham bhaktiḥ iti vākyena satsu api anya sādhaneṣu anubaṃdhaḥ bhaktiḥ viśiṣya ucyate iti atas uktam bhūyastvāt iti tasyāḥ sādhaneṣu bhūyastvāt prādhānyāt tad abhiprāyeṇa anubaṃdhaḥ bhaktiḥ viśiṣya ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhaktyā prasannaparamātmanaivāparokṣajñānaṃ| etairupāyairiti śrutyā svecchayaiva bhaktāparokṣasidhyarthaṃ brahmadhāmaśabdavācyavāyupraveśokteḥ| na ca pūrvaśrutivirodhaḥ| bhagavatprasādasādhaneṣu bhakteḥ prādhānyābhiprāyeṇa bhaktirevainaṃ mocayatītyabhidhānāt| ato darśanādeḥ puruṣasādhyatvābhāvādyuktamavyaktatvaṃ brahmaṇa iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca bhaktyā prasanna paramātmanā eva aparokṣa jñānam etaiḥ upāyaiḥ iti śrutyā sva icchayā eva bhakta aparokṣa sidhi artham brahma dhāma śabda vācya vāyupraveśa ukteḥ na ca pūrva śruti virodhaḥ bhagavat prasāda sādhaneṣu bhakteḥ prādhānya abhiprāyeṇa bhaktiḥ eva enam mocayati iti abhidhānāt atas darśana ādeḥ puruṣa sādhya tva abhāvāt yuktam avyakta tvam brahmaṇaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti pareṇādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti pareṇa adhikaraṇam

original: atropāsanasyānādiyogyatāsāpekṣatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra upāsanasya anādi yogyatā sāpekṣa tvam samarthyate

original: || eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt ||
analyzed: eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt

original: nanu nopāsanā'nādiyogyatāsāpekṣā| iṃdrādyaṃśajīvānāmutpattimattvena tadyogyatāyā anādinityatvābhāvāt| na ceṃdrādiyogyataivārjunādīnāṃ yogyatā| aṃśasyaṃśimārgavṛttitvābhāvāt| jñānādibhedena tayorbhinnatvāt| tataścopāsanasyānādiyogyatānapekṣatvāttadavyavasthitamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||

original: evaṃca brahmadarśanasya mokṣasādhanatvasadbhāvena svargādiṣu sādhanatvābhāvāt| yaṃ yaṃ lokamiti śruteḥ karmaṇaiva sidhyati svarge'tiśayādhāyakatvarūpataccheṣārthatvena puruṣārathavādāvirodhāt| iti jaiminirācāryo manyate| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca brahma darśanasya mokṣa sādhanatva sadbhāvena svarga ādiṣu sādhanatva abhāvāt yam yam lokam iti śruteḥ karmaṇā eva sidhyati svarga itiśaya ādhāyaka tva rūpa tad śeṣa arthatvena puruṣārathavāda avirodhāt iti jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate atas jñānasya sarva puruṣa artha sādhanatvam iti siddham

original: || ācāradarśanāt ||
analyzed: ācāra darśanāt
