analyzed: nanu śruti balāt jñānasya eva sarva puruṣa artha sādhanatvam yuktam tatas ca jñānasya eva sarva puruṣa artha sādhanatvena kutas śruteḥ artha aṃtara parikalpanā iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || ācāra darśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || yajñena yajñamiti devānāmapi karmānuṣṭhānaśruteśca na jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptirityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ācāra darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ yajñena yajñam iti devānām api karma anuṣṭhāna śruteḥ ca na jñānāt eva sarva puruṣa artha prāptiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jñānināmeva na tu jñānarahitānāṃ devāditvaprāptānāṃ karmānuṣṭhānasya śravaṇāt| devādikarmānuṣṭhānavaiyarthyaprasaṃgāt| ato na jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jñāninām eva na tu jñāna rahitānām deva ādi tva prāptānām karma anuṣṭhānasya śravaṇāt deva ādi karma anuṣṭhāna vaiyarthya prasaṃgāt atas na jñānāt eva sarva puruṣa artha prāptiḥ iti siddham

original: || tacchruteḥ ||
analyzed: tad śruteḥ

original: nanvevamastu jñānakarmaṇorubhayorapi svargasādhanatvaṃ| jñānasya karmaśeṣatvaṃ tu kuta ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu evam astu jñāna karmaṇoḥ ubhayoḥ api svarga sādhanatvam jñānasya karma śeṣa tvam tu kutas iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || tacchruteriti || asyārthaḥ || yadeva vidyayeti jñānasya karmaśeṣatvaśruterna tatpradhānamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tad śruteḥ iti asya arthaḥ yat eva vidyayā iti jñānasya karma śeṣa tva śruteḥ na tat pradhānam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭā śrutirbādarāyaṇamate mānuṣaviṣayā tatkartṛkajñānaśeṣatvavādinī pratibaṃdhakayuktadevatāviṣayā cetītyabhiprāyakatvāt| jñāninā jñānena kṛtakarmaṇo'dhikaphalasādhanatvāt| ataḥ karmaśeṣatvaśruterna pradhānamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭā śrutiḥ bādarāyaṇa mate mānuṣa viṣayā tad kartṛka jñānaśeṣatva vādinī pratibaṃdhaka yukta devatā viṣayā ca iti iti abhiprāyaka tvāt jñāninā jñānena kṛta karmaṇā adhika phala sādhanatvāt atas karma śeṣa tva śruteḥ na pradhānam iti siddham

original: || samanvāraṃbhaṇāt ||
analyzed: samanvāraṃbhaṇāt

original: nanu yathā jñānasya yaṃ yamiti śrutamapi prādhānyaṃ na svīkriyate| kiṃtu śeṣatvameva| tathā yadeva vidyayeti śrutamapi karmaṇaḥ prādhānyaṃ nāṃgīkāryaṃ! kiṃ nāma jñānaśeṣatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ sāmyaṃ vā bhavet| viśeṣapramāṇābhāvādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu yathā jñānasya yam yam iti śrutam api prādhānyam na svīkriyate kiṃtu śeṣatvam eva tathā yat eva vidyayā iti śrutam api karmaṇaḥ prādhānyam na aṃgīkāryam kim nāma jñāna śeṣatvam karmaṇaḥ sāmyam vā bhavet viśeṣa pramāṇa abhāvāt iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram āha

original: || samanvāraṃbhaṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || na karmaṇaḥ jñānaśeṣatvaṃ| tatsāmyaṃ ca| kiṃtu prādhānyaṃ| kutaḥ| samanvāraṃbhaṇāt| karmaiveti prādhānyena svargādyāraṃbhakatvaśruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: samanvāraṃbhaṇāt iti asya arthaḥ na karmaṇaḥ jñāna śeṣa tvam tad sāmyam ca kiṃtu prādhānyam kutas samanvāraṃbhaṇāt karma eva iti prādhānyena svarga ādi āraṃbhaka tva śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jñānottarakālīnaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karmaiva manuṣyāṇāmeva devaloke jyotirmayadehaṃ mānuṣaṃ vā dehaṃ pratibaṃdhakayuktadevānāṃ cobhayaṃ dehamanvārabhet| karmātiriktajñānādiḥ śarīrādyutpādane prādhānyena kāraṇaṃ na bhavati| kiṃtu karmaśeṣatayaiva kāraṇaṃ bhavati| ato na karmaṇo jñānaśeṣatvaṃ kiṃtu prādhānyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jñāna uttara kālīnam śubha aśubham karma eva manuṣyāṇām eva deva loke jyotiḥ maya deham mānuṣam vā deham pratibaṃdhaka yukta devānām ca ubhayam deham anvārabhet karma atirikta jñāna ādiḥ śarīra ādi utpādane prādhānyena kāraṇam na bhavati kiṃtu karma śeṣatayā eva kāraṇam bhavati atas na karmaṇaḥ jñāna śeṣa tvam kiṃtu prādhānyam iti siddham

original: || tadvato vidhānāt ||
analyzed: tadvataḥ vidhānāt

original: nanu tathā'pi na jñānasya karmaśeṣatvaṃ yuktaṃ| kiṃtu svayameva puruṣārtha hetuḥ| kasmāt| karmaṇāṃ phalābhāvāt| phalābhāvepyācārastu muktavallīlayā bhavedityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: nanu tathā api na jñānasya karma śeṣa tvam yuktam kiṃtu svayam eva puruṣa artha hetuḥ kasmāt karmaṇām phala abhāvāt phala abhāve pi ācāraḥ tu mukta vat līlayā bhavet iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram vyācaṣṭe

original: || tadvato vidhānāditi || asyārthaḥ || tadvataḥ vidhānāt jñānī ca karmāṇīti karmavidhānāt na jñānikarma līlārūpamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tadvataḥ vidhānāt iti asya arthaḥ tadvataḥ vidhānāt jñānī ca karmāṇi iti karma vidhānāt na jñāni karma līlā rūpam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jñānau ca karmāṇīti jñānino'pi karmavidhānena phalasiddheḥ| jñānikṛtakarmaphalābhāvaśrutistu duṣkarmaviṣayā| evameva viditi vacanāt| ato jñānikṛtakarma na līlārūpamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jñānau ca karmāṇi iti jñāninaḥ api karma vidhānena phala siddheḥ jñāni kṛta karma phala abhāva śrutiḥ tu duṣkarma viṣayā evam eva vid iti vacanāt atas jñāni kṛta karma na līlā rūpam iti siddham

original: || niyamācca ||
analyzed: niyamāt ca

original: itaśca jñānikṛtakarma na līlāmātrīmatyabhidadhatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: itas ca jñāni kṛta karma na līlāmātrīm atyabhidadhat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || niyamācceti || asyārthaḥ || jñānino'pi karmaniyamākaraṇe pratyavāyasya ca kurvanniti śruteśca| na jñānikarma līlārūpamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: niyamāt ca iti asya arthaḥ jñāninaḥ api karma niyama akaraṇe pratyavāyasya ca kurvan iti śruteḥ ca na jñāni karma līlā rūpam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca karmakaraṇena pāpalepābhāvena bhagavatpūjātvena karmakaraṇasyāvaśyakatvāt| api ca karmākaraṇe evaṃ tvayīti vacanātpratyavāyaśravaṇāt| ato jñānikarma na līlāmātramiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca karma karaṇena pāpa lepa abhāvena bhagavat pūjā tvena karma karaṇasya āvaśyaka tvāt api ca karma akaraṇe evam tvayi iti vacanāt pratyavāya śravaṇāt atas jñāni karma na līlā mātram iti siddham

original: || adhikopadeśāttu bādarāyaṇasyaivaṃ taddarśanāt ||
analyzed: adhika upadeśāt tu bādarāyaṇasya evam tad darśanāt

original: evaṃ jaiminimatāvalaṃbena ccedite svamataṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam jaimini mata avalaṃbena sva matam samarthayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || adhikopadeśāttu bādarāyaṇasyaivaṃ taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo vyāsamataviśeṣadyotakaḥ| bādarāyaṇasya tvevaṃ jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptirityevaṃ mataṃ| kutaḥ| adhikopadeśāt| adhikasya jñānajanyamokṣe karmādhīnātiśayasya| jñānādeveti śrutāvuktatvāt| kiṃca taddarśanācca|
analyzed: adhika upadeśāt tu bādarāyaṇasya evam tad darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ vyāsa mata viśeṣa dyotakaḥ bādarāyaṇasya tu evam jñānāt eva sarva puruṣa artha prāptiḥ iti evam matam kutas adhika upadeśāt adhikasya jñāna janya mokṣe karma adhīna atiśayasya jñānāt eva iti śrutau ukta tvāt kiṃca tad darśanāt ca

original: tasya jñānajanyaphale karmajanyātiśayasya rājasūyādinā yudhiṣṭhirādāvupalaṃbhāccetyarthaḥ| atra bhagavanmataṃ devatāniṣṭhajñānaviṣayaṃ| daiminyādimataṃ tadyamanuṣyaniṣṭhajñānaviṣayaṃ| ato na virodha iti jñeyaṃ ||
analyzed: tasya jñāna janya phale karma janya atiśayasya rājasūya ādinā yudhiṣṭhira ādau upalaṃbhāt ca iti arthaḥ atra bhagavat matam devatā niṣṭha jñāna viṣayam daimini ādi matam atas na virodhaḥ iti jñeyam

original: evaṃca jñānasyaiva sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvāt| jñānādeveti śrutau tathābhidhānāt| yudhiṣṭhirādīnāṃ jñānenaiva sidhyati puruṣārthe karmaṇātiśayadarśanāt| ato jñānādeva devānāṃ svargādiphalasya karmaṇastu tatrātiśayādhāyakatvena jñānaśeṣatvasya siddhatvenācārādervaiyarthyābhāvādvidhyanupapatterabhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca jñānasya eva sarva puruṣa artha sādhanatvāt jñānāt eva iti śrutau tathā abhidhānāt yudhiṣṭhira ādīnām jñānena eva sidhyati puruṣa arthe karmaṇā atiśaya darśanāt atas jñānāt eva devānām svarga ādi phalasya karmaṇaḥ tu tatra atiśaya ādhāyaka tvena jñānaśeṣa tvasya siddhatvena ācāra ādeḥ vaiyarthya abhāvāt vidhi anupapatteḥ abhāvāt

original: jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptiriti bādarāyaṇamatasya sadbhāvāt| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvenātyaṃtāpekṣitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: jñānāt eva sarva puruṣa artha prāptiḥ iti bādarāyaṇa matasya sadbhāvāt atas jñānasya sarva puruṣa artha sādhanatvena atyaṃta apekṣitam tat iti siddham

original: || tulyaṃ tu darśanaṃ ||
analyzed: tulyam tu darśanam

original: nanvastu jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthahetutvaṃ karmaṇastu taccheṣatvaṃ| śeṣatvaṃ ca na jñānaphale'tiśayādhāyakatvena| nāpi tadutpattyupayogitvena taduttarabhāvitvāt| kiṃtu jñānena phale sādhayitavye sāmarthyasaṃpādakatayā jñāne'tiśayādhāyakatveneti kiṃ na syādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu astu jñānasya sarva puruṣa artha hetutvam karmaṇaḥ tu tad śeṣatvam śeṣatvam ca na jñāna phala itiśaya ādhāyakatvena nā api tad utpatti upayogitvena tad uttara bhāvi tvāt kiṃtu jñānena phale sādhayitavye sāmarthya saṃpādaka tayā jñāna itiśaya ādhāyakatvena iti kim na syāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || tulyaṃ tu darśanamiti || asyārthaḥ || jñānikarma na jñāne'tiśayakṛt| kiṃtu jñānaphala eva| kutaḥ| yato darśanaṃ jñānaṃ| tulyaṃ tu karmakaraṇākaraṇayoḥ samānameva| ata itvarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tulyam tu darśanam iti asya arthaḥ jñāni karma na jñāna itiśaya kṛt kiṃtu jñāna phalaḥ eva kutas yatas darśanam jñānam tulyam tu karma karaṇa akaraṇayoḥ samānam eva atas iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca jñānikarma na jñāne'tiśayādhāyakaṃ| kiṃtu jñānaphala eva| karmakaraṇākaraṇayorjñānasya samatvāt| anyathā karmābhāve jñānasya puruṣārthahetutvaṃ na syāt| nāpi jaiminimatasthāprāmāṇyaṃ| tasya bhagavanmataikadeśatvena prāmāṇyāt| na ca visaṃvādidvayoḥ prāmāṇyāyogaḥ| bhagavanmatasya devatāviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca jñāni karma na jñāna itiśaya ādhāyakam kiṃtu jñāna phale eva karma karaṇa akaraṇayoḥ jñānasya samatvāt anyathā karma abhāve jñānasya puruṣa artha hetutvam na syāt nā api jaimini mata stha aprāmāṇyam tasya bhagavat mata eka deśa tvena prāmāṇyāt na ca visaṃvādi dvayoḥ prāmāṇya ayogaḥ bhagavat matasya devatā viṣaya tvāt

original: jaiminimatasya pratibaddhadevatāviṣayatvena mānuṣaviṣayatvena vā'virodhāt| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvādatyaṃtāpekṣitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: jaimini matasya pratibaddha devatā viṣaya tvena mānuṣa viṣaya tvena vā avirodhāt atas jñānasya sarva puruṣa artha sādhanatvāt atyaṃta apekṣitam tat iti siddham

original: || iti puruṣārthādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti puruṣa artha adhikaraṇam

original: atra jñāne sarveṣāmadhikārābhāvo varṇyate|
analyzed: atra jñāne sarveṣām adhikāra abhāvaḥ varṇyate

original: || asārvatrikī ||
analyzed: a sārvatrikī

original: nanvasti sarveṣāmapi jñāne'dhikāraḥ| tadupayogino'rthitvādeḥ sarvatra saulabhyāt| satyapyadhikāraprayojake kasyacidadhikāre kasyāpi na syāditi niradhikāritāprasaṃgaḥ| athavā| puruṣairarthyamānajñānasādhyasya mokṣasya tadapekṣitatvāt| sarveṣāṃ jñānasādhane śravaṇādau sāmarthyāttadupayogividvattāsadbhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu asti sarveṣām api jñāna idhikāraḥ tad upayoginaḥ ṛthi tva ādeḥ sarvatra saulabhyāt sati api adhikāra prayojake kasyacid adhikāre kasya api na syāt iti niradhikāri tā prasaṃgaḥ athavā puruṣaiḥ arthyamāna jñāna sādhyasya mokṣasya tad apekṣita tvāt sarveṣām jñāna sādhane śravaṇa ādau sāmarthyāt tad upayogi vidvas tā sadbhāvāt

original: ataḥ sarveṣāṃ jñānādhikāritvānnatadatiśayavaditi prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: atas sarveṣām jñāna adhikāri tva anna tad atiśayavat iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || asārvatrikīti || asyārthaḥ || jñānādhikaritā sarvajanasthitānetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: asārvatrikī iti asya arthaḥ jñāna adhikari tā

original: evaṃca na sarveṣāṃ jñānādhikāra iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evaṃca na sarveṣām jñāna adhikāraḥ iti siddham

original: || vibhāgaḥ śatavat ||
analyzed: vibhāgaḥ śatavat

original: nanvarthitvādeḥ sarveṣāṃ sadbhāvātkathaṃ nādhikāritetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: nanu arthi tva ādeḥ sarveṣām sadbhāvāt katham na adhikāri tā iti āśaṃkām parākurvat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || vibhāgaḥ śatavaditi || asyārthaḥ || vibhāgaḥ keṣāṃcitjñānādhikāritā anyevāṃ neti vibhāgaḥ| śatavat parāparabrahmādhikadevatāśatasyaiva somādhikāraḥ nānyeṣāmiti vibhāgavat nava kāṭyo hītyādāvuktatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vibhāgaḥ śata vat iti asya arthaḥ vibhāgaḥ keṣāṃcid jñāna adhikāri tā na iti vibhāgaḥ śata vat para apara brahma adhika devatā śatasya eva soma adhikāraḥ na anyeṣām iti vibhāga vat nava kāṭyaḥ hi ityādau ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca satyapi devatve brahmadvayādhikaśatānāmeva somādhikāra iti vibhāgaḥ| tathā satyapyārthatve keṣāṃcidadhikāro na sarveṣāmityabhiprāyakatvāt| ato jñāne sarveṣāmadhikārābhāvenātiśayitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca sati api deva tve brahma dvaya adhika śatānām eva soma adhikāraḥ iti vibhāgaḥ tathā sati api ārthatve keṣāṃcid adhikāraḥ na sarveṣām iti abhiprāyaka tvāt atas jñāne sarveṣām adhikāra abhāvena atiśayitam tat iti siddham

original: || adhyayanamātravataḥ ||
analyzed: adhyayana mātravataḥ

original: nanu yadyarthitvādisāmye'pi na sarveṣāmadhikārastarhi kasyāpyasau na syāt| yadi keṣāṃcidadhikāro'sti tarhyarthitvād‌vyatiriktādhikāraprayojakaviśeṣaṇasya vaktavyatvāt| na ca tastīti sarveṣāṃ jñānādhikāritvānna tadatiśayavaditi prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu yadi arthi tva ādi sāmye api na sarveṣām adhikāraḥ tarhi kasya api asau na syāt yadi keṣāṃcid adhikāraḥ usti tarhi arthi tvāt vyatirikta adhikāra prayojaka viśeṣaṇasya vaktavyatvāt na ca sarveṣām jñāna adhikāri tvāt na tat atiśayavat iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || adhyayanamātravata iti || asyārthaḥ || yathāśakti sarvavedādhyayanavato brahmavidyādhikāritā nānvasyetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: adhyayana mātravataḥ iti asya arthaḥ yathāśakti sarva veda adhyayanavataḥ brahma vidyā adhikāri tā na anvasya iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca haribhaktipūrvakādhyayanavatāmeva grahaṇāt| na cābhaktasyānadhikāritve caturmukhasya virocanādhyāpane kathaṃ pravṛttiriti na śaṃkyaṃ| abhaktānāmanadhikāritayā tadadhyayanasya vaiphalyameveti jñāpanāyādhyāpanopapatteḥ| paṭhedvedāniti śruteśca| ato jñāne sarveṣāmadikārābhāvādatiśayitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ ||

original: || stutaye'numativeti || asyārthaḥ || jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyorviśeṣo'styeva| kutaḥ| yataḥ yatheṣṭhācāro jñānī mucyata eveti jñānistutaya eva yena syātkena syādityucyate| anumatirvā jñānināṃ yatheṣṭhācāre'bhyanujñāmātraṃ vā na tvatra yatheṣṭhācāravidhirata ityarthaḥ ||

analyzed: nanu sat asat pravṛttibhyām jñāninaḥ viśeṣa aṃgīkāraḥ na yujyate tathā satya sat pravṛttyā kuṃṭhita śakteḥ jñānasya mokṣa sādhanatva abhāva prasaṃgāt tathā ca sat asat pravṛttibhyām katham viśeṣaḥ yujyate iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || kāmakāreṇa caika iti || asyārthaḥ || eke śākhinaḥ| kāmakāreṇa ca yatheṣṭhācāreṇāpi jñānināṃ mokṣaṃ kāmacārā iti śrutau paṭhaṃti| ato na jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyormokṣahāniḥ kiṃtu phale viśeṣamātramastītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: kāmakāreṇa ca eke iti asya arthaḥ eke śākhinaḥ kāmakāreṇa ca yatheṣṭha ācāreṇa api jñāninām mokṣam kāma cārāḥ iti śrutau paṭhaṃti atas na jñāninaḥ sat asat pravṛttyoḥ mokṣa hāniḥ kiṃtu phale viśeṣa mātram asti iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca kāmacārā iti vacanātjñānināṃ yatheṣṭhācāre'pi mokṣābhidhānenāsatpravṛtterapratibaṃdhakatvātteṣāṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣo'stīti siddhaṃ ||

original: sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣo'stītīdameva sādhyaṃ kaimutyena sādhayatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā ca śabdasya viṣabhakṣānmṛterivānivāryatayā prāptasya prārabdhakarmaṇo'pītyevamapyarthatvena kaimutyadyotakatvamabhipretyavyācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: sat asat pravṛttibhyām jñāninaḥ viśeṣaḥ usti iti idam eva sādhyam kaimutyena sādhayat sūtram paṭhitvā ca śabdasya viṣa bhakṣāt mṛteḥ iva anivārya tayā prāptasya prārabdha karmaṇaḥ api iti evam api artha tvena kaimutya dyotaka tvam abhipretya vyācaṣṭe

original: || upamardaṃ ceti || ca śabdo'pyarthaḥ || yadā jñāninaḥ prārabdhakarmaṇo'pi kiṃcid‌bhuktasya jñāninopamardaṃ īṣatphalahrāsaṃ| omityuccāryeti śrutāveke sākhinaḥ paṭhaṃti tadā jñānottara kālonāsatkarma na mokṣapratibaṃdhakamiti kiṃ varṇanāyamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: upamardam ca iti ca śabda upyarthaḥ yadā jñāninaḥ prārabdha karmaṇaḥ api kiṃcid bhuktasya jñāninā upamardam īṣat phala hrāsam om iti uccārya iti śrutau eke sākhinaḥ paṭhaṃti tadā jñāna uttara kāla ūna asat karma na mokṣa pratibaṃdhakam iti kim varṇanā ayam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prārabdhasyāpi pāpasyopamardenomityuccāryeti śrutau mokṣaḥ śrūyate| tataśca jñānikṛtapāpasya mokṣāpratibaṃdhakatvamityanāyāsena siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prārabdhasya api pāpasya upamardena ūm iti uccārya iti śrutau mokṣaḥ śrūyate tatas ca jñāni kṛta pāpasya mokṣa apratibaṃdhaka tvam iti anāyāsena siddham

original: || ūrdhvaretaḥsu ca śabde hi ||
analyzed: ūrdhvaretaḥsu ca śabde hi

original: nanu yadikāmacārāṇāmapi jñānināṃ muktiyogyatā tarhi tadvajjijñāsūnāmapi kāmacārāṇāṃ jñānādhikāraḥ sthāt| aviśeṣāt| tathā cādhyayanamātravata ityuktasya viṣṇubhaktiśamadamādivatāmevādhikāra ityasya bādhaḥ syādityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||

original: || ūrdhvaretaḥ su ca śabde hīti || asyārthaḥ || kāmacārāṇāmapi jñānināṃ muktyādhikāravatkāmacārāṇāṃ jijñāsūnāṃ na jñānādhikāraḥ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| śabde ya imamivi śrutāvūrdhvaretatsvādi guṇavatsveva jñānopadeśo vihitaḥ| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ūrdhvaretaḥ ca śabde hi iti asya arthaḥ kāmacārāṇām api jñāninām muktyā adhikāra vat kāmacārāṇām jijñāsūnām na jñāna adhikāraḥ kutas hi yasmāt śabde yaḥ imam ivi śrutau ūrdhvaretat sva ādi guṇavatsu eva jñāna upadeśaḥ vihitaḥ tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā gurukulavāsabrahmacaryāparaparyāyordhvaretastvādi guṇavatsveva jñānopadeśasya vihitatvātkāmacārāṇāṃ jijñāsūnāṃ sutarāmaparokṣajñānādhikārābhāvena teṣāmaparokṣajñānādhikārābhāvatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śrutyā guru kula vāsa brahmacarya apara paryāya ūrdhvaretaḥ tva ādi guṇavatsu eva jñāna upadeśasya vihita tvāt kāmacārāṇām jijñāsūnām sutarām aparokṣa jñāna adhikāra abhāvena teṣām aparokṣa jñāna adhikāra abhāva tvam iti siddham

original: || parāmarśaṃ jaiminiracodanā cāpavadati hi ||
analyzed: parāmarśam jaiminiḥ acodanā ca apavadati hi

original: evaṃ kenasyādityasya yatheṣṭhācāravidhitvamanaṃgīkṛtya stutyanumatirūpārthāvuktau| adhunā yatheṣṭhācāravidhitvānaṃgīkāreṇaiva yajjaimininā'rthāṃtaramuktaṃ tatpratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam yatheṣṭha ācāra vidhi tvam an aṃgīkṛtya stuti anumati rūpa arthau uktau adhunā yatheṣṭha ācāra vidhi tva anaṃgīkāreṇa eva yat jaimininā artha aṃtaram uktam tat pratipādayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || parāmarśaṃ jaiminiracodanā cāpavadati hīti || asyārthaḥ || jaiminiḥ parāmarśaṃ yena syāditi vākye prātarutthāyetyādiśrutyuktasadācārasyaiva grahaṇamabhyupetyātra sadācārasyaiva svecchayā niyamenācaraṇaṃ pratipādyaṃ| na tu niṣiddhasya karaṇamiti manyate| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt|
analyzed: parāmarśam jaiminiḥ acodanā ca apavadati hi iti asya arthaḥ jaiminiḥ parāmarśam yena syāt iti vākye prātar utthāya ityādi śruti ukta sat ācārasya eva grahaṇam abhyupetya atra sat ācārasya eva sva icchayā niyamena ācaraṇam pratipādyam na tu niṣiddhasya karaṇam iti manyate kutas hi yasmāt

original: acodanā aniṣiddhaṃ jñāninā kāryamiti vidhyabhāvaḥ apavadati ca pratyuta brāhmaṇo na haṃtavya iti śrutiḥ vikarma niṣedhati ca iti| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: acodanā aniṣiddham jñāninā kāryam iti vidhi abhāvaḥ apavadati ca pratyuta brāhmaṇaḥ na haṃtavyaḥ iti śrutiḥ vikarma niṣedhati ca iti tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prātarutthāyātha saṃdhyāmupāsītetyādinā jñānino saṃdhyāvaṃdanādyacāraparāmarśādvidhibaṃdhavarjitvena kāmacāraṇameva yena syāditi śrutyā cocyate| na tu niṣiddhaṃ kartavyameveti vidhīyate| brahmaṇo na haṃtavya ityapavāda śravaṇāt| ato jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prātar utthāya atha saṃdhyām upāsīta ityādinā saṃdhyā vaṃdana ādi acāra parāmarśāt vidhi baṃdha varji tvena kāma cāraṇam eva yena syāt iti śrutyā ca ucyate na tu niṣiddham kartavyam eva iti vidhīyate brahmaṇaḥ na haṃtavyaḥ iti apavāda śravaṇāt atas jñāninām sat asat pravṛttibhyām viśeṣaḥ iti siddham

original: || anuṣṭheyaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmyaśruteḥ ||
analyzed: anuṣṭheyam bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmya śruteḥ

original: evaṃ yena syāditi vākyasya jaiminimatānusāreṇa svecchayā sadācāravidhitvamevoktvā yatstutaye'numatirvetyuktamabhyanujñānaṃ tadeva kāmacāraśrutyarthatayā pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: evam yena syāt iti vākyasya jaimini mata anusāreṇa sva icchayā sat ācāra vidhi tvam eva uktvā yat stuta yenu matiḥ vā iti uktam abhyanujñānam tat eva kāmacāra śruti arthatayā pratipādayat sūtram paṭhati

original: || anuṣṭheyaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmyaśruteriti || asyārthaḥ || bādarāyaṇaḥ bhagavān bādarāyaṇastu| anuṣṭheyaṃ svecchayā śrutyādyuktānuṣṭhānayogyakiṃcitkarmācaraṇābhyanujñānameva yena syāditi śruterarthaḥ| natu sarvakarmakaraṇāya yatheṣṭhācāravidhireveti manyate| kutaḥ| sāmyuteḥ| kenāpi prakāreṇa pravṛttāvapi īdṛśa eveti jñāninaḥ sāmyokteḥ ||
analyzed: anuṣṭheyam bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmya śruteḥ iti asya arthaḥ bādarāyaṇaḥ bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ tu anuṣṭheyam sva icchayā śruti ādi ukta anuṣṭhāna yogya kiṃcid karma ācaraṇa abhyanujñānam eva yena syāt iti śruteḥ arthaḥ na tu sarva karma karaṇāya yatheṣṭha ācāra vidhiḥ eva iti manyate kutas sāmyuteḥ kena api prakāreṇa pravṛttau api īdṛśaḥ eva iti jñāninaḥ sāmya ukteḥ

original: evaṃcānuṣṭheyānāṃ madhye kāmacāro yasminkaravāṇīti kāmastasyānucaraṇaṃ yasminna karavāṇīti kāmastasyānācaraṇamityevānuṣṭheye kāmacārānumatereva na tu sarveṣāṃ kāmacārasya yena syāditi śrutāvuktatvāt| jñāninaḥ karaṇākaraṇayoryena syāditi sāmyaśruteḥ | iti bādarāyaṇo manyate| ato jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca anuṣṭheyānām madhye kāmacāraḥ yasmin karavāṇi iti kāmaḥ tasya anucaraṇam yasmin na karavāṇi iti kāmaḥ tasya anācaraṇam iti eva anuṣṭheye kāmacāra anumateḥ eva na tu sarveṣām kāmacārasya yena syāt iti śrutau ukta tvāt jñāninaḥ karaṇa akaraṇayoḥ yena syāt iti sāmya śruteḥ iti bādarāyaṇaḥ manyate atas jñāninaḥ sat asat pravṛttibhyām viśeṣaḥ iti siddham

original: || vidhirvā dhāraṇavat ||
analyzed: vidhiḥ vā dhāraṇa vat

original: evaṃ kena syāditi vākyasya yatheṣṭhācāravidhitvābhāvamabhyupetya niyamena sarvadācāravidhitvamanuṣṭheyānāṃ madhye kāmacārābhyanujñānamityarthadvayaṃ stutyanumatirūpārthadvayaṃ coktaṃ| adhunā svecchācāraṇavidhirvā bhavatītyarthapratipādakaṃ sūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: evam kena syāt iti vākyasya yatheṣṭha ācāra vidhi tva abhāvam abhyupetya niyamena sarvadā ācāra vidhi tvam anuṣṭheyānām madhye kāmacāra abhyanujñānam iti artha dvayam stuti anumati rūpa artha dvayam ca uktam adhunā sva icchā ācāraṇa vidhiḥ vā bhavati iti artha pratipādakam sūtram upanyasyati

original: || vidhirvā dhāraṇavaditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā veda dhāraṇavidheḥ traivarṇikādhikārikatvameva na tu sarvādhikārikatvaṃ| tathā vidhiḥ jñānināmeva yena syāditi svecchācāravidhiḥ natvajñānināmityarthaḥ| vā śabdaḥ prāguktapakṣadvayāt asya pakṣāṃtarāvadyotakaḥ ||
analyzed: vidhiḥ vā dhāraṇa vat iti asya arthaḥ yathā veda dhāraṇa vidheḥ traivarṇika ādhikārika tvam eva na tu sarva ādhikārika tvam tathā vidhiḥ jñāninām eva yena syāt iti sva icchā ācāra vidhiḥ na tu ajñāninām iti arthaḥ vā śabdaḥ prāgukta pakṣa dvayāt asya pakṣa aṃtara avadyotakaḥ

original: evaṃca traivarṇikānāṃ vedavidhidhāraṇavadyena syāditi svecchācāravidherjñānināmeva sadbhāvāt| tataścoktaṃ yuktameveti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca traivarṇikānām veda vidhi dhāraṇa vat yena syāt iti svecchā ācāra vidheḥ jñāninām eva sadbhāvāt tatas ca uktam yuktam evā iti siddham

original: || stutimātramupādānāditi cennāpūrvatvāt ||
analyzed: stuti mātram upādānāt iti ced na apūrva tvāt

original: uktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||

original: nanu muktau yatibhyo gṛhastha evottamaḥ| tasya jyotiṣṭomādisarvakarmādhikāritvāt| sarvakarmānuṣṭhānaṃ ca cirakālasādhyaṃ| cirakālasādhya eva hi mokṣa uttamaḥ| kiṃca chaṃdoga ācāryakulādvedamadhītyeti gṛhasthasya mokṣamuktvopasaṃhāraḥ kriyate| na ca gṛhasthāduttamasadbhāve tadanuktopasaṃhāro yujyate|
analyzed: nanu muktau yatibhyaḥ gṛhasthaḥ eva uttamaḥ tasya jyotiṣṭoma ādi sarva karma adhikāri tvāt sarva karma anuṣṭhānam ca cira kāla sādhyam cira kāla sādhyaḥ eva hi mokṣaḥ uttamaḥ kiṃca chaṃdogaḥ ācārya kulāt vedam adhītya iti gṛhasthasya mokṣam uktvā upasaṃhāraḥ kriyate na ca gṛhasthāt uttama sadbhāve tad anukta upasaṃhāraḥ yujyate

original: ataḥ karmiṇāmevottatvena na jñānamatiśayamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: atas karmiṇām eva utta tvena na jñānam atiśayam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || kṛtsnabhāvāttu gṛhiṇopasaṃhāra iti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ kuṭuṃba iti śrutau gṛhīṇo gṛhasthasyaiva mokṣaphaloktyā paryavasyati| kṛtsnabhāvāt saṃpūrṇagṛhasthadharmavato devānapekṣyaiva| ataḥ śrutyavirodhācca yatereva sarvāśramiṣūttamatvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: kṛtsna bhāvāt tu gṛhiṇā upasaṃhāraḥ iti asya arthaḥ yatas kuṭuṃbaḥ iti śrutau gṛhīṇaḥ gṛhasthasya eva mokṣa phala uktyā paryavasyati kṛtsna bhāvāt saṃpūrṇa gṛhastha dharmavataḥ devān apekṣya eva atas śruti avirodhāt ca yateḥ eva sarva āśramiṣu uttama tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca manuṣyeṣu yatereva sarvāpekṣayottamatvaṃ na gṛhiṇaḥ| gṛhimokṣādyatimokṣasya cirakālasādhyatvāt| gṛhiṇāṃ bahukarmādhikārabhāvo'pi taiḥ sarveṣāmananuṣṭhānena katipayānuṣṭhānenaiva tadaparokṣajñānasiddheḥ| na caivaṃ gṛhiṇopasaṃhāravirodhaḥ| tasya devatāviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca manuṣyeṣu yateḥ eva sarva apekṣayā uttama tvam na gṛhiṇaḥ gṛhi mokṣa ādi atimokṣasya cira kāla sādhya tvāt gṛhiṇām bahu karma adhikāra bhāvaḥ api taiḥ sarveṣām ananuṣṭhānena katipaya anuṣṭhānena eva tad aparokṣa jñāna siddheḥ na ca evam gṛhiṇā upasaṃhāra virodhaḥ tasya devatā viṣaya tvāt

original: ato dharmādhikāriṣu jñānapracurāṇāṃ yatīnāmevottamatvena yuktaṃ jñānasyātiśayitatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas dharma adhikāriṣu jñāna pracurāṇām yatīnām eva uttama tvena yuktam jñānasya atiśayita tvam iti siddham

original: || maunavaditareṣāmapyupadeśāt ||
analyzed: mauna vat itareṣām api upadeśāt

original: yuktyaṃtareṇa mānuṣayatibhyo devānāmuttamattvaṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: yukti aṃtareṇa mānuṣa yatibhyaḥ devānām uttama tvam samarthayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || maunavāditareṣāmapyupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || maunavat yatitvasyeva| itareṣāṃ anyāśramadharmāṇāmapi| upadeśāt devā eva brahmacāriṇa iti śratāvuktatvāt| sarvāśramibhyo devānāmuttamatvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: maunavād itareṣām api upadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ mauna vat yati tvasya iva itareṣām anya āśrama dharmāṇām api upadeśāt devāḥ eva brahmacāriṇaḥ iti sarva āśramibhyaḥ devānām uttama tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca deveṣu saṃpūrṇa yatidharmasya sadbhāvena teṣāṃ yatyuttamatvāt| na ca devānāṃ yatitvābhāvaḥ| kṛtsnā hyeta iti śrutyā devānāṃ yatitvasadbhāvasya pratipāditatvāt| api ca yathā hyete munaya iti śruteryatitvadṛṣṭāṃteva sarvavarṇāśramitvābhidhānāt| ato jñānapracurāṇāṃ yatīnāmevottamatvādyuktaṃ jñānasyātiśayattvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca deveṣu saṃpūrṇa yati dharmasya sadbhāvena teṣām yati uttama tvāt na ca devānām yati tva abhāvaḥ kṛtsnāḥ hi ete iti śrutyā devānām yati tva sadbhāvasya pratipādita tvāt api ca yathā hi ete munayaḥ iti śruteḥ yati tva dṛṣṭāṃtā iva sarva varṇa āśrami tva abhidhānāt atas jñāna pracurāṇām yatīnām eva uttama tva ādi uktam jñānasya atiśaya tvam iti siddham

original: || iti kṛtsnabhāvādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti kṛtsna bhāva adhikaraṇam

original: atrāparokṣajñānasaṃgataparokṣajñānasyātigopyatvamahimā varṇyate ||
analyzed: atra aparokṣa jñāna saṃgata parokṣa jñānasya ati gopya tva mahimā varṇyate

original: || anāviṣkurvannatvayāt ||
analyzed: an āviṣkurvan a tvayāt

original: aparokṣa jñānahetuparokṣajñānasiddhaye āviṣkāreṇaiva vedavidyopadeṣṭavyā| sabhācatvarādāvupaviśyavidyopadeśe'pyaśeṣajñānayogyānāṃ jñānalābhasiddheḥ| āvaśyakaśca bahūpadeśaḥ| yathā yatheti śruteḥ| ata āviṣkāreṇaivopadeṣṭavyatvāttasya rahasyatvātiśayo na sidhyediti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: aparokṣa jñāna hetu parokṣa jñāna siddhaye āviṣkāreṇa eva veda vidyā upadeṣṭavyā sabhā catvara ādau upaviśya vidyā upadeśa ipi aśeṣa jñāna yogyānām jñāna lābha siddheḥ āvaśyakaḥ ca bahu upadeśaḥ yathā yathā iti śruteḥ atas āviṣkāreṇa eva upadeṣṭavya tvāt tasya rahasya tva atiśayaḥ na sidhyet iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || anāviṣkurvannanvayāditi || asyārthaḥ || guruḥ anāviṣkurvansabhādiṣu āviṣkāramakurvanneva| śiṣyebhyo vidyāmupadiśet| kutaḥ| anvayāt ayogyānāmapi jñānaprāptiprasaṃgarūpayukterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anāviṣkurvan anvayāt iti asya arthaḥ guruḥ anāviṣkurvan sabhā ādiṣu āviṣkāram akurvan eva śiṣyebhyaḥ vidyām upadiśet kutas anvayāt ayogyānām api jñāna prāpti prasaṃga rūpa yukteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcānāviṣkāreṇa svavidyopadeśaḥ kāryaḥ| āviṣkāreṇopadeśe'yogyānāmapi jñānaprasaṃgāt| na ca tadiṣṭaṃ| vidyā havai brāhmaṇamājagāmeti tanniṣedhāt| ato'lpāviṣkāreṇa jñānasyopadeṣṭavyatvena yuktastasyātiśaya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca anāviṣkāreṇa sva vidyā upadeśaḥ kāryaḥ āviṣkāreṇa upadeśeyogyānām api jñāna prasaṃgāt na ca tat iṣṭam vidyā brāhmaṇam ājagāma iti tad niṣedhāt atas ulpa āviṣkāreṇa jñānasya upadeṣṭavya tvena yuktaḥ tasya atiśayaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti anvayādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti anvaya adhikaraṇam

original: atrāparokṣajñānasya pratibaṃdhabhāve sādhanasaṃpattijanmanyevotpattiḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra aparokṣa jñānasya pratibaṃdha bhāve sādhana saṃpatti janmani eva utpattiḥ samarthyate

original: || aihikamaprastutapratibaṃdhe taddarśanāt ||
analyzed: aihikam aprastuta pratibaṃdhe tad darśanāt

original: nanu jñānasādhanaṃ kṛṣyādivadaihikaphalasyaiva hetuḥ| tataḥ sādhanasaṃpūrtijanmanyevāparokṣajñānaṃ| kasyacitpratibaṃdhakavaśātsādhane duṣṭe naikadāpi phalodayaḥ| ṣaṃḍabījāvāpinā kadāpi phalānudayadarśanāt| na hi duṣṭaṃ bījaṃ kālāṃtare phalaheturiti dṛṣṭaṃ| na ca yāgādivadupapattiḥ| tasyaihikaphalahetutvābhāvena vaiṣamyāt|
analyzed: nanu jñāna sādhanam kṛṣi ādi vat aihika phalasya eva hetuḥ tatas sādhana saṃpūrti janmani eva aparokṣa jñānam kasyacid pratibaṃdhaka vaśāt sādhane duṣṭe na ekadā api phala udayaḥ ṣaṃḍa bīja āvāpinā kadāpi phala anudaya darśanāt na hi duṣṭam bījam kāla antare phala hetuḥ iti dṛṣṭam na ca yāga ādi vat upapattiḥ tasya aihika phala hetu tva abhāvena vaiṣamyāt

original: ato jñānasyaivaihikatvena prāptatvātkasyacitpratibaṃdhakena tadanudayejanmāṃtarepyanudaya eveti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: atas jñānasya eva aihika tvena prāptatvāt kasyacid pratibaṃdhakena tad anudaye janmāṃtare pi anudayaḥ eva iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || aihikamaprastutamapratibaṃdhe taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || aprastutapratibaṃdhe prastutapratibaṃdhaśabdoktaprārabdhakarmābhāve| aparokṣajñānamaihikaṃ śravaṇādīnāṃ saṃpūrtijanmanyeva bhavati| pratibaṃdhe tu janmāṃtare bhavati| kutaḥ| taddarśanāt| śrutveti śratau tathā pratipādanādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: aihikam aprastutam apratibaṃdhe tad darśanāt iti asya arthaḥ aprastuta pratibaṃdhe prastuta pratibaṃdha śabda ukta prārabdha karma abhāve aparokṣa jñānam aihikam śravaṇa ādīnām saṃpūrti janmani eva bhavati pratibaṃdhe tu janmāṃtare bhavati kutas tad darśanāt śrutvā iti śratau tathā pratipādanāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca śravaṇādikamaihikaheturiti satyaṃ| tathā'pi śravaṇādisaṃpūrtijanmanyeva bhavatīti na niyamaḥ| kiṃtu pratibaṃdhakasadbhāve janmāṃtare'pi bhavati| ataḥ pratibaṃdhakābhāve jñānasyaihikatvānnoktānupapattiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca śravaṇa ādikam aihika hetuḥ iti satyam tathā api śravaṇa ādi saṃpūrti janmani eva bhavati iti na niyamaḥ kiṃtu pratibaṃdhaka sadbhāve janmāṃtare api bhavati atas pratibaṃdhaka abhāve jñānasya aihika tvāt na ukta anupapattiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti aihikādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti aihika adhikaraṇam

original: atra brahmajñānasya svotpattijanmānaṃtarameva pratibaṃdhakābhāve muktisādhanatvamahimā varṇyate|
analyzed: atra brahma jñānasya sva utpatti janma anantaram eva pratibaṃdhaka abhāve mukti sādhanatva mahimā varṇyate

original: || evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthāvadhṛtestadavasthāvadhṛteḥ ||
analyzed: evam mukti phala aniyamaḥ tad avasthā avadhṛteḥ tad avasthā avadhṛteḥ

original: nanvaparokṣajñānodaye dehapātānaṃtarameva mokṣo bhavatītyaṃgīkāro yuktaḥ| na tu vilaṃbāṃgīkāraḥ| vilaṃbe kāraṇābhāvāt| evameva kasyacinmokṣavilaṃbāṃgīkāre tasya kadā'pi mokṣo na syāt| tatsādhanānāṃ gatavīryatvāt| na hi jīrṇānāṃ dhānyānāmaṃkurakāryakāritā| tataścāniyama ityuktavyāghāta iti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu aparokṣa jñāna udaye dehapāta anantaram eva mokṣaḥ bhavati iti aṃgīkāraḥ yuktaḥ na tu vilaṃba aṃgīkāraḥ vilaṃbe kāraṇa abhāvāt evam eva kasyacid mokṣa vilaṃba aṃgīkāre tasya kadāpi mokṣaḥ na syāt tad sādhanānām gata vīrya tvāt na hi jīrṇānām dhānyānām aṃkura kārya kāri tā tatas ca aniyamaḥ iti ukta vyāghātaḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthāvadhṛtestadavasthāvadhṛteriti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ yathā jñāne'niyamaḥ tathā muktiphalāniyamaḥ| mokṣākhyaphale'pi jñāninaḥ taccharīrapātānaṃtarameva mokṣa iti niyamo nāsti| kiṃtu asati prārabdhe taddehapātānaṃtarameva| sati tu taddehāṃtarāvasāne mokṣo bhavati| nanu kuta evaṃ kalpyate|
analyzed: evam mukti phala aniyamaḥ tad avasthā avadhṛteḥ tad avasthā avadhṛteḥ iti asya arthaḥ evam yathā tathā mukti phala aniyamaḥ mokṣa ākhya phale api jñāninaḥ tad śarīra pāta anaṃtaram eva mokṣaḥ iti niyamaḥ na asti kiṃtu asati prārabdhe tad dehapāta anaṃtaram eva sati tu tad deha aṃtara avasāne mokṣaḥ bhavati nanu kutas evam kalpyate

original: jñānajanmānaṃtaraṃ muktyabhāve kadā'pi muktirnetyevaṃ kuto na kalpyata ityata uktaṃ| taditi| tasyāṃ brahmasaṃsthita iti śratau tasminbrahmaṇi avasthitasya tatjñānina iti yāvat| avadhṛteḥ amṛtatvametītyeveti mokṣaphalāvadhāraṇādityarthaḥ| ataḥ pratibaṃdhakakalpaneti bhāvaḥ| uktasya sarvasyaitadyāyārthasya prasiddhatvasūcanārthā dviruktiḥ ||
analyzed: jñāna janma anantaram mukti abhāve kadāpi muktiḥ na iti evam kutas na kalpyate iti atas uktam tat iti tasyām brahma saṃsthitaḥ iti śratau tasmin brahmaṇi avasthitasya tad jñāninaḥ iti yāvat avadhṛteḥ amṛta tvam eti iti eva iti mokṣa phala avadhāraṇāt iti arthaḥ atas pratibaṃdhaka kalpanā iti bhāvaḥ uktasya sarvasya etad yāya arthasya prasiddha tva sūcana arthā dviruktiḥ

original: evaṃca jñānodaye dehapātānaṃtarameva mokṣa iti na niyamaḥ| kiṃtu pratibaṃdhakābhāve taddehapātānaṃtaraṃ| anyatha tu janmāṃtaraṃ prāpyetyaniyamaḥ| dharmo svargamiti śruteḥ| vidvānamamṛtamiti smṛteśca| ato jñānināṃ pratibaṃdhakābhāve mokṣasyādūratvenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jñāna udaye dehapāta anaṃtaram eva mokṣaḥ iti na niyamaḥ kiṃtu pratibaṃdhaka abhāve tad dehapāta anaṃtaram anyathā tu janmāṃtaram prāpya iti aniyamaḥ svargam iti śruteḥ vidvānam amṛtam iti smṛteḥ ca atas jñāninām pratibaṃdhaka abhāve mokṣasya adūra tvena uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti muktaphalādhikaraṇaṃ ||

analyzed: āvṛttiḥ asakṛt upadeśāt

analyzed: nanu sakṛt eva śravaṇa ādikam anuṣṭheyam tāvatā eva vidhi paryavasānāt anyathā sakṛt eva jyotiṣṭoma ādikam anuṣṭhāya kṛtī na syāt evam ca vihita śravaṇa ādi anuṣṭhānena jñāna darśanāt vidheḥ aprāmāṇyāt pramāṇa aṃtarasya api abhāvāt na śravaṇa ādi jñāna sādhanam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || āvṛttisakṛdupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || jñānārthaṃ śravaṇādīnāmāvṛttiḥ kāryāḥ| kutaḥ| asakṛdupadeśāt| bahuvāraṃ śvetaketuṃ prati uddālakena paratattvasyepadiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃcāvṛttereva śravaṇādīnāṃ phalahetutvāt| aparokṣajñānasiddhaye'sakṛdanuṣṭhānasyoddālakenopadeśāt tataśca śravaṇādyāvartau niyamena phalopalaṃbhena tadvidheḥ prāmāṇyācchravaṇādikaṃ jñānasādhanamiti siddhaṃ ||

analyzed: liṃgāt ca iti asya arthaḥ bhṛguṇā śrutasya punar ālocanena aparokṣita tva rūpa liṃga darśanāt ca āvṛttiḥ kartavyā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca sa tapo tapyatetyādyāvartanaliṃgaśravaṇāt | tataśca śravaṇādyāvṛttiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ ||

original: evaṃcoktavidhīnāṃ pratīke brahmadṛṣṭyabhidhāyakatvāt| pratīkasyābrahmatvena mithyopāsāprasaṃgācca| na hi mithyopāsā phalahetuḥ| mithyopāsāyā anarthahetutvena pramāṇasiddhatvāt| kathaṃ tarhyupāsanā kāryeti cet| tatsthatveneti grahaṇād‌dvitīyāśravaṇāt| mahāvyākaraṇamūlakasupāṃ supo bhavatīti kātyāyanavacanena dvitīyāyāḥ saptamyarthatvāt|

original: tataśca pratīkasthatvenaiva brahmopāsanaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: evaṃca kāryameva sadā sarvathā brahmatvopāsanaṃ| bhagavata utkṛṣṭatvāt| tathopāstestatprasādajanakatvāt| brahmatvopāsakātiriktacaturguṇopāsakairapyātmatvādiviśeṣaṇatayā brahmatvopāsanasyātmetyeveti vacanātkāryatvāt| tathā ca brahmaṇo viśiṣyopāsyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || iti brahmādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: || ādityādimatayaścāṃga upapatteḥ ||

original: nanu na sarvadā sarvathā tathopāsanaṃ devaiḥ kāryaṃ| sūryādibhiritastataḥ saṃcaraṇena sadā bhagavadaṃgāśritatvābhāvāt| tathāpyupāsane'nyathopāsanatvenānarthaprasaṃgāt| satsvapi guṇāṃtareṣu svāśrayatvena bhagavadupāsane viśeṣakāraṇābhāvāt|

original: ata āśrayāśrayibhāvasyāsadātanatvena sarvopāsyatvābhāvāttadvatsadātanatvābhāvena nātmatvopāsanamāvaśyakamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||

original: || ādityādimatayaścāṃga upapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || aṃge bhagavadaṃge| ādityādibhirdevaiḥ ādityādimatayaḥ ādityādyāśrayāṃgakatvopāsanā kāryā| kutaḥ| upapatteḥ teṣāṃ tatpraveśāpekṣitatvena tathopāsanasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃca cakṣoḥ sūryo'jāyatetyādinoktaṃ svāśrayatvena bhagavadaṃgopāsanamādityādidevaiḥ sarvathā kāryameva| muktau tatra layasyāpekṣitatvāt| rūpāṃtareṇāṃgānāṃ svāśrayatvena mithyopāsanāprasaṃgābhāvāt| atastadupāsanasyāvaśyakatvāduktamātmatvopāsanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || iti ādityādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: atrāsanādiniyamaḥ sādhyate ||

original: || dhyānācca ||

original: || dhyānācceti || asyārthaḥ || avicchinnasmṛtirūpopāsanasyaiva dhyānatvāttadapekṣayaivāsananiyamābhyupagamānna smaraṇopāsanamādāya vyabhicāra ityarthaḥ ||

analyzed: evam ca smaraṇa ātmaka tvam dhyāna ātmaka tvam ca iti upāsanasya dvaividhyāt ādyasya sārvakālika tvena āsana niyama abhāve pi dvitīyasya yogya vijñeya dhyāna tvena āsanasya āvaśyaka tvam iti siddham

original: evaṃca cittavikṣepaparihārasyāsanasādhyaśarīrācalatvamapekṣyaiva pratyāhārādinā sādhyatvāt| acalaṃ ceccharīramiti smṛteḥ| tathā cāsanasyāvaśyakatvamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || smaraṃti ca ||

original: || yatraikāgratā tatrāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || yatra yasmindeśe kāle| āsane ca ekāgratā dhyānasyaikaniṣṭhatā bhavati| tatraiva tasmindeśe kāle āsana eva dhyānaṃ kuryāt| kutaḥ| aviśeṣāt| deśakālādinā dhyānajñānayorviśeṣābhāvādityarthaḥ ||

original: || iti āsānīdhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: atra dhyānasya prāyaṇāṃtatvaṃ samarthyate ||

original: || itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tviti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'nutthānavācī| itarasya bhagavatjñānītaradveṣiṇaḥ| pāte tu anutthānatamaḥpāte pratyāsanne| tadarthamitarasya pāpetara puṇyasyāpi| evaṃ jñānipāpavat| asaṃśleṣaḥ uttarasyāsaṃśleṣaḥ pūrvasya vināśaśca bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃcaivaṃ sukarmaṇaścāpi patatastamasi dhruvamiti dveṣikṛta pūrvottarapuṇyayordveṣeṇa vināśāśleṣau bhavata iti śravaṇāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||

original: || anārabdhakārye eva tu pūrve tadavadheriti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdaścārthaḥ| pūrve viṣṇudveṣajñānapūrvakālīne| anārabdhakārye eva puṇyapāpe vinaśyataḥ| kutaḥ| tadavadheḥ| tasya mokṣasya prārabdhakarmanivṛtyavadhitvaśruteḥ smṛteścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anārabdha kārye eva tu pūrve tad avadheḥ iti asya arthaḥ tu śabdaḥ ca arthaḥ pūrve viṣṇu dveṣa jñāna pūrva kālīne anārabdha kārye eva puṇya pāpe vinaśyataḥ kutas tad avadheḥ tasya mokṣasya prārabdha karma nivṛti avadhi tva śruteḥ smṛteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

analyzed: atas nyat api iti ekeṣām ubhayoḥ iti asya arthaḥ atas prārabdha karmāt anyat bhinnam jñānāt purva uttara kāmyam puṇyam aniṣṭam aprārabdham ca vināśa āśleṣau prāpnoti kutas yatas iti evam prakāreṇa ekeṣām śākhinām śākhāsu ubhayoḥ jñāna uttara pūrvayoḥ aprārabdha anabhīṣṭayoḥ kāmya puṇyayoḥ parityāgena pāṭhaḥ usti atas iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca muktāvanubhavakāraṇādanyadaprārabdhamanabhīṣṭaṃ kāmyaṃ puṇyaṃ yattasya vināśatvādalepaśca jñānottaraṃ kriyamāṇasyeti tasya putrā dāyamupayaṃtīti vacanāduktaṃ yogyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca muktau anubhava kāraṇāt anyat aprārabdham anabhīṣṭam kāmyam puṇyam yat tasya vināśa tvāt alepaḥ ca jñāna uttaram kriyamāṇasya iti tasya putrāḥ dāyam upayanti iti vacanāt uktam yogyam iti siddham

analyzed: vāc manasi darśanāt śabdāt ca iti asya arthaḥ vāc vāc abhimāninī umāṣada gṛhītā vāruṇī sauparṇī ca manasi manaḥ abhimāni rudra śabdita śeṣa garuḍe ca vilīyate kutas vācaḥ manaḥ adhīna tvāt iti śeṣaḥ tat katham darśanāt tasya pratyakṣa siddha tvāt kiṃca śabdāt ca tathā śruteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca tasyeti śabdāt| pratyakṣata eva vāco manovaśatvadarśanena tatra tallayasya saṃbhāvitatvāt| atra pūrvottaravarṇadevatātvaviṣaye guṇapradhānabhāve ca munimatavivāda evocyate na svayaṃ kiṃcidabhidīyata iti vāṅmanasayoḥ sāmyābhāvenobhayorgrāhyatvāt| viśeṣānukteḥ prādhānyaviṣaye tu ṛṣiputramatasyaiva grāhyatvāt|
analyzed: evam ca tasya iti śabdāt pratyakṣatas eva vācaḥ manaḥ vaśa tva darśanena tatra tad layasya saṃbhāvita tvāt atra pūrva uttara varṇa devatā tva viṣaye guṇa pradhāna bhāve ca muni mata vivādaḥ eva ucyate na svayam kiṃcid abhidīyate iti vāc manasayoḥ sāmya abhāvena ubhayoḥ grāhya tvāt viśeṣa anukteḥ prādhānya viṣaye tu ṛṣiputra matasya eva grāhya tvāt

original: manaseti yuktyā manaḥpūrvakasya viśeṣaśravaṇāt| pratyakṣānusāritvācca| ata eva jñānināṃ mokṣaniyamo yukta iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: manasā iti yuktyā manaḥ pūrvakasya viśeṣa śravaṇāt pratyakṣa anusāri tvāt ca atas eva jñāninām mokṣa niyamaḥ yuktaḥ iti siddham

original: || ata eva ca sarvāṇyanu ||
analyzed: atas eva ca sarvāṇi anu

analyzed: nanu vācaḥ laya nirṇaye api na sarva devānām mokṣaḥ laya aniścayāt iti āśaṃkām samādadhat sūtram āha

original: || ata eva ca sarvāṇyanviti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo'pyarthaḥ || ca sarvāṇi sarvāṇi daivatānyapi| anu yathā'nukūlaṃ| svasvayogyeṣu deveṣu līyaṃte| kutaḥ| ata eva agniviti śruterevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atas eva ca sarvāṇi anu iti asya arthaḥ ca śabdaḥ upi arthaḥ ca sarvāṇi sarvāṇi daivatāni api anu yathānukūlam sva sva yogyeṣu deveṣu līyaṃte kutas atas eva śruteḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā yathā'nukūlaṃ sarvadevānāṃ layanirṇayena yukta eva jñānināṃ mokṣaniyama iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śrutyā yathā anukūlam sarva devānām laya nirṇayena yuktaḥ eva jñāninām mokṣa niyamaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti vāṅmanodhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vāc manaḥ adhikaraṇam

original: atra manasaḥ prāṇe layaḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra manasaḥ prāṇe layaḥ samarthyate

original: || tanmanaḥ prāma uttarāt ||
analyzed: tat manaḥ prāmaḥ uttarāt

original: nanu na prāṇe mano līyate| tatsamatvāt| dṛśyate hi prāṇa iva manaso'pi pravartakatvaṃ| na ca tadanupapannatvānna tatra layaḥ| tasya bhagavadutpannatvaśravaṇāt| tataśca bhagavati layasya prativādinā'naṃgīkārāt| aṃgīkṛtasya prāṇe layasyānupapannatvāt iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu na prāṇe manaḥ līyate tad samatvāt dṛśyate hi prāṇe iva manasaḥ api pravartaka tvam na ca tad anupapanna tvāt na tatra layaḥ tasya bhagavat utpanna tva śravaṇāt tatas ca bhagavati layasya prativādinā anaṃgīkārāt aṃgīkṛtasya prāṇe layasya anupapanna tvāt iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || tanmanaḥ prāṇa uttarāditi || asyārtha || pūrvoktamanobhimāni śeṣaḥ suparṇaśca| prāṇe tacchabditacaturmukhe| līyate| kutaḥ| uttarāt manaḥ prāṇa ityuttaravākyādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tat manaḥ prāṇaḥ uttarāt iti asya artha śeṣaḥ suparṇaḥ ca prāṇe tad śabdita caturmukhe līyate kutas uttarāt manaḥ prāṇaḥ iti uttara vākyāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca manaḥ prāṇa iti śravaṇāt| na ca samatvācattatra layo'nupapannaḥ| mana utkrāmadityādinā nīcoccabhāvaśravaṇāt| na ca tadanutpannatvāttatra layāsaṃbhavaḥ| vāyoriti rudrasya tasmādutpattiśravaṇena manaḥ prāṇayoḥ sāmyābhāvāt| prāṇadvārā bhagavadutpannatvārthakatvena bhagavata utpannatvoktivirodhābhāvāt| tataśca manaḥ prāṇe līyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca manaḥ prāṇaḥ iti śravaṇāt na ca manaḥ utkrāmat ityādinā nīca ucca bhāva śravaṇāt na ca tad anutpanna tvāt tatra laya asaṃbhavaḥ vāyoḥ iti rudrasya tasmāt utpatti śravaṇena manaḥ prāṇayoḥ sāmya abhāvāt prāṇa dvārā bhagavat utpannatva arthaka tvena bhagavataḥ utpannatva ukti virodha abhāvāt tatas ca manaḥ prāṇe līyate iti siddham

original: || iti manaḥ prāṇādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti manaḥ prāṇa adhikaraṇam

original: atra prāṇaśabdoktacaturmukhasyeśvare layaḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra prāṇa śabda ukta caturmukhasya īśvare layaḥ samarthyate

original: || so'dhyakṣe tadupagamādibhyaḥ ||
analyzed: sa adhyakṣe tad upagama ādibhyaḥ

original: nanu na prāṇo paramātmani līyate| tasyātadadhīnatvāt| tasyānanyādhīnatve bahuśrutisadbhāvena cakṣurādivadityādau tadadhīnatvamuktamiti samādhānāyogāt| bahubādhaviruddhatvena vaiparītyasyaivocitatvāt| mahāṃtamiti tasya layābhāvokteśca| ataḥ prāṇasya layābhāvānna kasyāpi mokṣa iti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu na prāṇo paramātmani līyate tasya a tad adhīna tvāt tasya ananya adhīna tve bahu śruti sadbhāvena cakṣuḥ ādi vat ityādau tad adhīna tvam uktam iti samādhāna ayogāt bahu bādha viruddha tvena vaiparītyasya eva ucitatvāt mahāṃtam iti tasya laya abhāva ukteḥ ca atas prāṇasya laya abhāvāt na kasya api mokṣaḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || so'dhyakṣe tadupagamādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || saḥ caturmukhaḥ| adhyakṣe adhipatau paramātmani līyate| kutaḥ tadupagamādibhyaḥ paramātmaprāptyādipratipādaka sarva iti śrutyādibhya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tad upagama ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ saḥ caturmukhaḥ adhyakṣe adhipatau paramātmani līyate kutas tad upagama ādibhyaḥ paramātma prāpti ādi pratipādaka sarvaḥ iti śruti ādibhyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca hiraṇyagarbhasya bhagavadadhīnatvāt| niravakāśabahuśrutisadbhāvena tadanirṇayābhāvāt| anadhīnatvaśrutīnāṃtvīśvarānyādhīnatvābhāvaparatvena sāvakāśatvāt| prāṇasya tejasītismṛtestejaso dvāramātraparatvena tatra layaparatvābhāvāt| ato viriṃcasya layasadbhāvāduktaḥ sarvajñānināṃ mokṣa iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca hiraṇyagarbhasya bhagavat adhīna tvāt niravakāśa bahu śruti sadbhāvena tad anirṇaya abhāvāt anadhīna tva śrutīnām tu īśvara anya adhīna tva abhāva paratvena sa avakāśa tvāt prāṇasya tejasi iti smṛteḥ tejasaḥ dvāra mātra paratvena tatra laya paratva abhāvāt atas viriṃcasya laya sadbhāvāt uktaḥ sarvajñāninām mokṣaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti adhyakṣādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti adhyakṣa adhikaraṇam

original: atra prāgviśiṣyoktebhyo'nyeṣāṃ devānāṃ pṛthivyādisamastabhūteṣu layaḥ samarthyate ||
analyzed: atra prāk viśiṣya uktebhyaḥ nyeṣām devānām pṛthivī ādi samasta bhūteṣu layaḥ samarthyate

original: nanvagnāveva sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ layo'stu| na tu siddhāṃtyabhimato vibhāgena bhūteṣu layaḥ| agnau sarva iti śruteḥ| viparyaye ca pramāṇābhāvāt| ato'śeṣadevānāmagnau layāduktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu agnau eva sarveṣām devānām layaḥ tu na tu siddhāṃti abhimataḥ vibhāgena bhūteṣu layaḥ agnau sarve iti śruteḥ viparyaye ca pramāṇa abhāvāt atas śeṣa devānām agnau layāt uktam ayuktam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || bhūteṣu tacchruteriti || asyārthaḥ || viśiṣyoktebhyo'nyebhyo devāḥ| bhūteṣu paṃcabhūteṣu| līyaṃte| kutaḥ| tachruteḥ| bhūteṣu devā iti śrateścetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: bhūteṣu tad śruteḥ iti asya arthaḥ viśiṣya uktebhyaḥ nyebhyaḥ devāḥ bhūteṣu paṃcabhūteṣu līyaṃte kutas tad śruteḥ bhūteṣu devāḥ iti śrateḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca viśiṣyoktebhyo'nyeṣāṃ yogyatānusāreṇa tattadbhūteṣu layasya bhūteṣviti śrutāvuktatvāt| bhūteṣviti niravakāśabahuvacanaśravaṇābalenāgnāviti śruteḥ saṃkocanīyatvena tadavirodhāt| tataśca sarveṣāmagnau layābhāvena paṃcabhūteṣu devānāṃ laya iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca viśiṣya uktebhyaḥ nyeṣām yogyatā anusāreṇa tad tad bhūteṣu layasya bhūteṣu iti śrutau ukta tvāt bhūteṣu iti niravakāśa bahuvacana śravaṇa abalena agnau iti śruteḥ saṃkocanīya tvena tad avirodhāt tatas ca sarveṣām agnau laya abhāvena paṃcabhūteṣu devānām layaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti bhūtādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti bhūta adhikaraṇam

original: atra devānāṃ sarvabhūteṣu layaḥ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra devānām sarva bhūteṣu layaḥ samarthyate

original: || naikasmin darśayato hi ||
analyzed: na ekasmin darśayataḥ hi

original: nanvagnāveva sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ layo bhavet| agnāviti śruteḥ| sarveṣāṃ devānāmnāvagnervāyāviti layāṃgīkāreṇa bhūteṣu layasyāṃgīkṛtatvāt| ato'dhamānāmuttameṣu layābhidhānādityuktavyavasthā'nupapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu agnau eva sarveṣām devānām layaḥ bhavet agnau iti śruteḥ sarveṣām devānām naau agneḥ vāyau iti laya aṃgīkāreṇa bhūteṣu layasya aṃgīkṛta tvāt atas dhamānām uttameṣu laya abhidhānāt iti ukta vyavasthā anupapattiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || naikasmin darśa,yota hīti || asyārthaḥ || naikasmin agnāveva sarve devāḥ na līyaṃte| kiṃtu yathāyogaṃ sarvabhūteṣu| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| darśayataḥ pṛthivyāmṛbhava iti ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivyāmiti mohapaniṣaccaturvedaśikhe ca tathā pratipādayataḥ| tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na ekasmin darśaya uta hi iti asya arthaḥ na ekasmin agnau eva sarve devāḥ na līyaṃte kiṃtu yathāyogam sarva bhūteṣu kutas hi yasmāt darśayataḥ pṛthivyām ṛbhavaḥ iti ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivyām iti moha paniṣad caturveda śikhe ca tathā pratipādayataḥ tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutibhyāṃ paṃcasvapi layābhidhānāt| kā tarhyagnāviti śrutergatiriti cet| etacchrutibalenāgnāviti śrutau sarvaśabdaṃ saṃkucyāgnau sarvadevānāṃ layayogyānāmeva vaktumucitatvāt| ato'gnāveva sarveṣāṃ layābhāvāduktavyavasthā yukteti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śrutibhyām paṃcasu api laya abhidhānāt kā tarhi agnau iti śruteḥ gatiḥ iti ced etad śruti balena agnau iti śrutau sarva śabdam saṃkucya agnau sarva devānām laya yogyānām eva vaktum ucita tvāt atas gnau eva sarveṣām laya abhāvāt ukta vyavasthā yuktā iti siddham

original: || iti ekasminnadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti ekasmin adhikaraṇam

original: atra prakṛterviṣṇau layābhāvaḥ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra prakṛteḥ viṣṇau laya abhāvaḥ sādhyate

original: || samanā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtatvaṃ cānupoṣya ||
analyzed: samanā ca asṛti upakramāt amṛta tvam ca an upoṣya

original: nanu prakṛtiḥ paramātmani līyate| tejaḥ parasyāṃ devatāyāmiti śruteḥ| uttānā vai iti śrutyā devagavānāmuttānānāṃ vahanāsiddhivatprakṛterlayaśravaṇe'pi tadadhīnatve'saṃbhāvitatvāttadasiddhiḥ || tataśca bhagavati layasadbhāvādadhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvoktirayukteti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu prakṛtiḥ paramātmani līyate tejaḥ parasyām devatāyām iti śruteḥ uttānāḥ vai iti śrutyā devagavānām uttānānām vahana asiddhi vat prakṛteḥ laya śravaṇe api tad adhīnatve saṃbhāvita tvāt tad asiddhiḥ tatas ca bhagavati laya sadbhāvāt adhikāriṇām prāṇa avasāna tva uktiḥ ayuktā iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || samanā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtvaṃ cānupoṣya || asyārthaḥ || ādyaśco nabhaḥ samākarṣaṇārthaḥ| dvāveti śrutisamuccayo dvitīyaḥ| tathā ca lakṣmīrna līyate| kutaḥ| yatastasyāḥ anupoṣya paramātmānamanupāsyaivāmṛtatvaṃ| nityamuktatvaṃ tatkutaḥ| asṛtyupakramāt kadā'pi saṃsāropakramābhāvāt| so'pi kutaḥ|
analyzed: samanā ca asṛti upakramāt amṛtvam ca an upoṣya asya arthaḥ ādyaḥ caḥ nabhaḥ samākarṣaṇa arthaḥ dvau ā iti śruti samuccayaḥ dvitīyaḥ tathā ca lakṣmīḥ na līyate kutas yatas tasyāḥ an upoṣya paramātmānam an upāsya eva amṛta tvam nitya mukta tvam tat kutas asṛti upakramāt kadāpi saṃsāra upakrama abhāvāt saḥ api kutas

original: yataḥsamānā deśataḥ kālataḥsamo nā parama puruṣo yasyāḥsā samanā tasmādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yatas samānā deśataḥ kālataḥ samaḥ nā parama puruṣaḥ yasyāḥ sā samanā tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nityamuktatvāt| saṃsārasaṃbaṃdhābhāvāt| vibhutvātparamātmavat| sītārukmiṇyādirūpeṇāpi nityatvāt| dvau vā veti śruteḥ| tataśca prakṛtirna paramātmani līyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nitya mukta tvāt saṃsāra saṃbaṃdha abhāvāt vibhu tvāt paramātma vat sītā rukmiṇī ādi rūpeṇa api nitya tvāt dvau vā vā iti śruteḥ tatas ca prakṛtiḥ na paramātmani līyate iti siddham

original: || tadapīteḥ saṃsāravyapedaśāt ||
analyzed: tad apīteḥ saṃsāra vyapedaśāt

original: naitāvatā sāmyamityuktasādhye hetutayā sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: na etāvatā sāmyam iti ukta sādhye hetutayā sūtram paṭhati

original: || tadapīteḥ saṃsāravyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || tasyāṃ prakṛtau| apīteḥ layasya| saṃsāravyapadeśāt| vilīna iti saṃsārahetutvaśruterna mocakeśvara sāmyaṃ prakṛterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tad apīteḥ saṃsāra vyapadeśāt iti asya arthaḥ tasyām prakṛtau apīteḥ layasya saṃsāra vyapadeśāt vilīnaḥ iti saṃsāra hetutva śruteḥ na mocaka īśvara sāmyam prakṛteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca mūlarūpavatsītādyavatārāṇāmapi nityatvena garbhavāsādirūpasaṃsārasaṃbaṃdhasyāsaṃbhavāt| na caitāvatāsāmyaṃ| prakṛtau līnasya saṃsārābhidhānāt| paramātmani līnasya muktatvābhidhānāt| tathā ca prakṛtirbhagavati na līyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca mūla rūpavat sītā ādi avatārāṇām api nitya tvena garbha vāsa ādi rūpa saṃsāra saṃbaṃdhasya asaṃbhavāt na ca etāvatā asāmyam prakṛtau līnasya saṃsāra abhidhānāt paramātmani līnasya mukta tva abhidhānāt tathā ca prakṛtiḥ bhagavati na līyate iti siddham

original: || sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tathopalabdhe ||
analyzed: sūkṣmam pramāṇataḥ ca tathā upalabdhe

original: hetvaṃtareṇa prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ sarvasāmamyaṃ pratiṣedhatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: hetu aṃtareṇa prakṛti puruṣayoḥ sarva sāmamyam pratiṣedhat sūtram vyācaṣṭe

original: || sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tathopalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || prakṛterapi sūkṣmaṃ brahma| pramāṇataḥ jñānānaṃdādiguṇaparimāṇataścādhikaṃ| kutaḥ| tathopalabdheḥ|| sarveta iti tathāśruteḥ| ato'pi prakṛterna brahmasarvasāmyomatyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: sūkṣmam pramāṇataḥ ca tathā upalabdheḥ iti asya arthaḥ prakṛteḥ api sūkṣmam brahma pramāṇataḥ jñāna ānaṃda ādi guṇa parimāṇataḥ ca adhikam kutas tathā upalabdheḥ sarva itas iti tathā śruteḥ atas api prakṛteḥ na brahma sarva sāmyaḥ arthaḥ

original: evaṃca prakṛterapi paramātmanaḥ sūkṣmatvasya jñānānaṃdādiguṇaparimāṇādhikasya cābhidhānāt| tathā ca prakṛterna brahmasarvasāmyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca prakṛteḥ api paramātmanaḥ sūkṣma tvasya jñāna ānaṃda ādi guṇa parimāṇa adhikasya ca abhidhānāt tathā ca prakṛteḥ na brahma sarva sāmyam iti siddham

original: || nopamardenātaḥ ||

analyzed: niśi na iti ced na saṃbaṃdhāt iti asya arthaḥ nanu niśi āditya raśmīnām abhāvāt jñāninaḥ utkramaṇam na iti ced na nasyāt iti ced na kutas saṃbaṃdhāt sūrya raśmīnām sarvadā saṃbaṃdāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca rātrau bāhyādityābhāve'pi aṃtarādityasya sattvāt| tadraśmisaṃbaṃdhasya sarvadā nāḍīṣu sadbhāvena rātrāveva maraṇopapatteḥ| tathā ca jñānināṃ rātrau maraṇaṃ bhavatīti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca rātrau bāhya āditya abhāve pi aṃtara ādityasya sattvāt tad raśmi saṃbaṃdhasya sarvadā nāḍīṣu sadbhāvena rātrau eva maraṇa upapatteḥ tathā ca jñāninām rātrau maraṇam bhavati iti siddham

original: || yāvaddehabhāvitvāddarśayati ca ||
analyzed: yāvat deha bhāvi tvāt darśayati ca

original: nanu nāḍīraśmisaṃbaṃdhaḥ sarvadā'stīti nāma kiṃ| sadātana uta dehapātapūrvakālīnaḥ| āhosvidyāvaddehabhāvī| pakṣatrayasyāpyasaṃbhavaḥ| sadā nāḍīnāmabhāvāt| kadācitjñānino'pi tamasotkrāṃtiprasaṃgāt| tanniyame pramāṇābhāvāt| iti prāpte samāgadadhatsūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu nāḍī raśmi saṃbaṃdhaḥ sarvadā asti iti nāma kim sadātanaḥ uta dehapāta pūrva kālīnaḥ āhosvit yāvat deha bhāvī pakṣa trayasya api asaṃbhavaḥ sadā nāḍīnām abhāvāt kadācid jñāninaḥ api tamasā utkrāṃti prasaṃgāt tad niyame pramāṇa abhāvāt iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || yāvaddehabhāvitvāddarśayati ceti || asyārthaḥ || yāvaddehabhāvitvāt raśmisaṃbaṃdhasya yāvaccharīrabhāvitvāt| rātrāvapi jñāninaḥ utkramaṇaṃ yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| ca yataḥ| darśayati saṃsṛṣṭa iti śrutiḥ tathā pratipādayati ata ītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yāvat deha bhāvi tvāt darśayati ca iti asya arthaḥ yāvat deha bhāvi tvāt raśmi saṃbaṃdhasya yāvat śarīra bhāvi tvāt rātrau api jñāninaḥ utkramaṇam yuktam kutas ca yatas darśayati saṃsṛṣṭaḥ iti śrutiḥ tathā pratipādayati atas īti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭuśrutyā jñānino rātrau maraṇamastīti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭu śrutyā jñāninaḥ rātrau maraṇam asti iti siddham

original: || ataścāyane'pi hi dakṣiṇe ||
analyzed: atas ca ayane ipi hi dakṣiṇe

original: nanu vyartho'yaṃ jñānino rātrāvutkramaṇasaṃbhavapratipādanāyāsaḥ| dakṣiṇe maraṇāditi vacanāt| mokṣārthaṃ teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāyanotkrāṃtyayogāt| tadvadrātrāvapyutkrāṃtyabhāvopapatteriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu vyarthaḥ yam jñāninaḥ rātrau utkramaṇa saṃbhava pratipādana āyāsaḥ dakṣiṇe maraṇāt iti vacanāt mokṣa artham teṣām dakṣiṇāyana utkrāṃti ayogāt tadvat rātrau api utkrāṃti abhāva upapatteḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || ataścāyane'pi hi dakṣiṇa iti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdaḥ pratijñādvayasamuccaye| api dakṣiṇe maraṇāditi smṛtisatve'pi| dakṣiṇe ayane| dakṣiṇāyanakāle| jñāninaḥ utkrāṃtiryuktā| kutaḥ| ataḥ sauraraśmisahasranāḍīsaṃbaṃdhasya tadā'pi sattvāt| hi yataḥ| evaṃ ataḥ dakṣiṇāyana dṛṣṭāṃtena rātrāvutkrāṃtyabhāvo na vācya ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: atas ca ayane api hi dakṣiṇaḥ iti asya arthaḥ ca śabdaḥ pratijñā dvaya samuccaye api dakṣiṇe maraṇāt iti smṛti sattve api dakṣiṇe ayane dakṣiṇāyana kāle jñāninaḥ utkrāṃtiḥ yuktā kutas atas saura raśmi sahasranāḍī saṃbaṃdhasya tadā api sattvāt hi yatas evam atas dakṣiṇāyana dṛṣṭāṃtena rātrau utkrāṃti abhāvaḥ na vācyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dakṣiṇe maraṇāditi smṛterdakṣiṇāyanasaṃjñikanāḍīmaraṇasya| svargahetutvaṃ| uttarāyaṇasaṃjñikanāḍīmaraṇasya janolokādihetutvamityarthatvāt| śataṃ paṃcaiveti vacanāt| ye sādyo viṣṇulokaṃ gacchaṃti te suṣumnayā niṣkrāmaṃti| ta uttarāyaṇaraśmibhirnirgacchaṃtīti vivekasadbhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca dakṣiṇe maraṇāt iti smṛteḥ dakṣiṇāyana saṃjñika nāḍī maraṇasya svarga hetu tvam uttarāyaṇa saṃjñika nāḍī maraṇasya janaḥ loka ādi hetu tvam iti arthatvāt śatam paṃca eva iti vacanāt ye sādyaḥ viṣṇu lokam gacchaṃti te suṣumnayā niṣkrāmaṃti te uttarāyaṇa raśmibhiḥ nirgacchaṃti iti viveka sadbhāvāt

original: ato jñānināmutkramaṇasyājñamaraṇavailakṣaṇyātjñānamāhātmyaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas jñāninām utkramaṇasya ajña maraṇa vailakṣaṇyāt jñāna māhātmyam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti tadoko'dhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti tad oka udhi karaṇam

original: atra gatyanusmaraṇāderāvaśyakatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra gati anusmaraṇa ādeḥ āvaśyaka tvam samarthyate

original: || yoginaḥ prati smaryeti smārte caite ||
analyzed: yoginaḥ prati smaryā iti smārte ca ete

original: nanu na gatyarthaṃ vidyāgatyanusmṛtī apekṣite| agnirjyotiriti smṛtau kevalakālamaraṇādyadhīnatvasyoktatvāt| loke phalānusmaraṇābhāve'pi phaladarśanena tathaivātrāpi kalpyatvācca| tataśca na jñānaṃ saṃpurṇamokṣasādhanamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu na gati artham vidyā gati anusmṛtī apekṣite agniḥ jyotiḥ iti smṛtau kevala kāla maraṇa ādi adhīna tvasya ukta tvāt loke phala anusmaraṇa abhāve api phala darśanena tathā eva atra api kalpya tvāt ca tatas ca na jñānam saṃpurṇa mokṣa sādhanam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || yoginaḥ prati smaryeti smārte caita iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| ete brahmacaṃdragatī| yoginaḥ prati jñānakarmayoginaḥ prati smaryete smṛtyā ucyete| smārte ca svānusmṛtisādhye ca| gatītyādinā smaryete| atastayorna kevalaṃ kālādikṛtatvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: yoginaḥ prati smarya iti smārte ca ete iti asya arthaḥ caḥ yatas ete brahmacaṃdra gatī yoginaḥ prati jñāna karma yoginaḥ prati smaryete smṛtyai ucyete smārte ca sva anusmṛti sādhye ca gati ityādinā smaryete atas tayoḥ na kevalam kāla ādi kṛta tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca smṛtyukte ete gatī jñānakarmayogābhyāmeva smaryete| na kālasmaraṇāt| agnirjyoṃtiriti śloke brahmavida iti viśeṣaṇāt| dhūmo rātririti śloke yogīti viśeṣaṇāt| na ca lokānusāritā| sarvathā lokānusāritvasya chidādāvapyabhāvenādoṣatvāt| kathaṃcitsāmyasyehāpi bhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca smṛti ukte ete gatī jñāna karma yogābhyām eva smaryete na kāla smaraṇāt agniḥ jyoṃtiḥ iti śloke brahma vidaḥ iti viśeṣaṇāt dhūmaḥ rātriḥ iti śloke yogī iti viśeṣaṇāt na ca loka anusāri tā sarvathā loka anusāri tvasya chid ādau api abhāvena adoṣa tvāt kathaṃcid sāmyasya iha api bhāvāt

original: ato viśiṣṭotkramaṇasya vidyādisāpekṣatvādyuktaṃ jñānasya saṃpūrṇamokṣasādhanatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas viśiṣṭa utkramaṇasya vidyā ādi sāpekṣa tvāt yuktam jñānasya saṃpūrṇa mokṣa sādhanatvam iti siddham

original: || iti yogyadhikaraṇa ||
analyzed: iti yogi adhikaraṇa

original: || iti caturthādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: iti caturtha adhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

original: || śrīḥ ||
analyzed: śrīḥ

original: || hariḥ ||
analyzed: hariḥ

original: || atha tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: atha tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ

original: mārgo gamyaṃ cāsminpāda ucyate|
analyzed: mārgaḥ gamyam ca asmin pāde ucyate

original: atra jñāniprāpyamārgaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra jñāni prāpya mārgam sādhyate

original: || arcirādinā tatprathiteḥ ||
analyzed: arciḥ ādinā tad prathiteḥ

original: nanu dvāveva mārgāviti| tatraikasmin mārge'rciṣo lokaḥ prathamaḥ| mārgāṃtare tu vāyulokaḥ| te'rciṣamabhisaṃbhavaṃti sa vāyumāgacchatītyubhayavidhaśrutivirodhaḥ| tataśca gurūpadeśātprāk nirṇayābhāvātsmaraṇānupapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu dvau eva mārgau iti tatra ekasmin mārga īrciṣaḥ lokaḥ prathamaḥ mārga aṃtare tu vāyu lokaḥ ta īrciṣam abhisaṃbhavaṃti sa vāyum āgacchati iti ubhayavidha śruti virodhaḥ tatas ca guru upadeśāt prāk nirṇaya abhāvāt smaraṇa anupapattiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || arcirādinā tatprathiteriti || asyārthaḥ || utkrāṃto jñāni arcirādinā mārgeṇa gacchati| kutaḥ| tatprathiteḥ| tasya te'rciṣamabhisaṃbhavaṃtīti śrutau tasyārthasya prasiddhatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: arciḥ ādinā tad prathiteḥ iti asya arthaḥ utkrāṃtaḥ jñāni arciḥ ādinā mārgeṇa gacchati kutas tad prathiteḥ tasya tā ṛciṣam abhisaṃbhavaṃti iti śrutau tasya arthasya prasiddha tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca dvāveva mārgau prathitāvarcirādirvipaścitāṃ| dhūmādiḥ karmiṇāṃ caiveti smṛteḥ| tatra dvāvagneḥ sutau ekasminpure saṃsthitau| tatraiko'gnināmako'paro jyotirnāmakaḥ| tadubhayādhiṣṭhitasya lokasya prathamaprāptiḥ| prabalaitacchrutivirodhena sa vāyumiti śruterarciranaṃtarārthatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca dvau eva mārgau prathitau arcirādiḥ vipaścitām dhūma ādiḥ karmiṇām ca eva iti smṛteḥ tatra dvau agneḥ sutau ekasmin pure saṃsthitau tatra ekaḥ agni nāmaka uparaḥ jyotiḥ nāmakaḥ tad ubhaya dhiṣṭhitasya lokasya prathama prāptiḥ prabalā etad śruti virodhena sa vāyum iti śruteḥ arciḥ anaṃtara artha tva upapatteḥ

original: ata eka eva vipaścito mārga iti vinirṇayādanusmṛtisaṃbhava iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas ekaḥ eva vipaścitaḥ mārgaḥ iti vinirṇayāt anusmṛti saṃbhavaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti arcirādyadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti arciḥ ādi adhikaraṇam

original: atra vāyordvitīyaprāpyatvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra vāyoḥ dvitīya prāpya tvam sādhyate

original: || vāyuśabdādaviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāṃ ||
analyzed: vāyu śabdāt aviśeṣa viśeṣābhyām

original: nanvadhikārivibhedena mārgabhedāt| vāyulokasyevāharlokasyāpi dvitīyaprāpyatvaṃ| sa vāyumāgacchati arciṣo'hariti cobhayatrāpi śrutisadbhāvāt| na caikasya pūrvatvaṃ parasyānaṃtaryamiti vyavasthā| viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāt| ato mārganirṇayābhāvādanusmṛtyayoga iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu adhikāri vibhedena mārga bhedāt vāyu lokasya iva ahar lokasya api dvitīya prāpya tvam sa vāyum āgacchati ca ubhayatra api śruti sadbhāvāt na ca ekasya pūrva tvam parasya ānaṃtaryam iti vyavasthā viśeṣa pramāṇa abhāvāt atas mārga nirṇaya abhāvāt anusmṛtya yogaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || vāyuśabdādaviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || aviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāṃ vāyoḥ prāpyatvaśruteḥ ubhayaparyālocanayā vāyoḥ dvitīya prāpyatvamevetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: vāyu śabdāt aviśeṣa viśeṣābhyām iti asya arthaḥ aviśeṣa viśeṣābhyām vāyoḥ prāpya tva śruteḥ ubhaya paryālocanayā vāyoḥ dvitīya prāpya tvam eva iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃcārciṣa iti vāyoḥ prathama prāpyatvaśruteḥ sāmānyaśruteśca mukhyaprāthamyabādhe'mukhyaprāthamyaparatvāt| tadyathā na hiṃsyāditi niṣedhasya yāgīyapaśuhiṃsāniṣedhaparatvāsaṃbhavena bāhyahiṃsāniṣedhapagtvaṃ| tathā sa ito gata iti viśeṣaśruteśca| ato mārgānirṇayena yuktā tadanusmṛtiriti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca arciṣaḥ iti vāyoḥ prathama prāpya tva śruteḥ sāmānya śruteḥ ca mukhya prāthamya bādhe mukhya prāthamya paratvāt tat yathā na hiṃsyāt iti niṣedhasya yāgīya paśu hiṃsā niṣedha paratva asaṃbhavena tathā saḥ itas gataḥ iti viśeṣa śruteḥ ca atas mārga anirṇayena yuktā tad anusmṛtiḥ iti siddham

original: || iti vāyuśabdādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti vāyu śabda adhikaraṇam

original: atra taṭidabhimānilokasya saṃvatsarābhimānilokānaṃtaraprāpyatvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra taṭit abhimāni lokasya saṃvatsara abhimāni loka anaṃtara prāpya tvam sādhyate

original: || taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbaṃdhāt ||
analyzed: varuṇaḥ saṃbaṃdhāt

original: nanu varuṇataṭitorubhayorapi saṃvatsarānaṃtaryaṃ| māsebhyaḥ saṃvatsaramiti tathā saṃvatsarāttaṭitamityubhayathāśrutermārgabhedenobhayorapi saṃvatsarānaṃtaryopapattau anyatarasvīkāre kāraṇābhāvāt| ato mārganirṇayābhāvāttadanusmaraṇānupapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu varuṇa taṭitoḥ ubhayoḥ api saṃvatsara ānaṃtaryam māsebhyaḥ saṃvatsaram iti tathā saṃvatsarāt taṭitam iti ubhayathā śruteḥ mārga bhedena ubhayoḥ api saṃvatsara ānaṃtarya upapattau anyatara svīkāre kāraṇa abhāvāt atas mārga nirṇaya abhāvāt tad anusmaraṇa anupapattiḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbaṃdhāditi || asyārthaḥ || taṭito'dhi taṭitprāptyanaṃtaraṃ varuṇaḥ prāpyaḥ| kutaḥ| saṃbaṃdhāt varuṇasya taṭita upari saṃbaṃdhādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: taṭitaḥ dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbaṃdhāt iti asya arthaḥ taṭitaḥ dhi taṭit prāpti anaṃtaram varuṇaḥ prāpyaḥ kutas saṃbaṃdhāt varuṇasya taṭitaḥ upari saṃbaṃdhāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca varuṇataṭitorubhayorapi saṃvatsarānaṃtaryaṃ na grāhyaṃ| kiṃtveka eva mārgaḥ| tatra saṃvatsarānaṃtaraṃ taṭitameva gacchati| na ca śrutyaṃtaravirodhaḥ| taṭito'naṃtaraṃ varuṇasya prāpyatvena tadarthatvopapatteḥ| tatra taṭita ityuparisaṃbaṃdhaśruteḥ| ato mārgaikyenānusmaraṇamupapadyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca varuṇa taṭitoḥ ubhayoḥ api saṃvatsara ānaṃtaryam na grāhyam kiṃtu ekaḥ eva mārgaḥ tatra saṃvatsara anaṃtaram taṭitam eva gacchati na ca śruti aṃtara virodhaḥ taṭitaḥ unaṃtaram varuṇasya prāpya tvena tad artha tva upapatteḥ tatra taṭitaḥ iti upari saṃbaṃdha śruteḥ atas mārga aikyena anusmaraṇam upapadyate iti siddham

original: || iti taṭidadhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti taṭit adhikaraṇam

original: atrārciranaṃtaraprāpyasya vāyorātivāhikatvaṃ samarthyate|
analyzed: atra arciḥ anaṃtara prāpyasya vāyoḥ ātivāhika tvam samarthyate

original: || ātivāhikastalliṃgāt ||
analyzed: ātivāhikaḥ tad liṃgāt

original: nanu sa vāyumāgacchatīti prathamaprāptatayokto vāyurmukhyaḥ| vāyuśabdasya tatraiva mukhyatvāt| bādhakaṃ vinā mukhyārthatyāgāyogāt| mukhyatve'pi prāpyatvāt| ato vāyorarciṣānaṃtaraṃ prāpyatvānna tasyādhikyamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: nanu sa vāyum āgacchati iti prathama prāptatayā uktaḥ vāyuḥ mukhyaḥ vāyu śabdasya tatra eva mukhya tvāt bādhakam vinā mukhya artha tyāga ayogāt mukhya tve pi prāpya tvāt atas vāyoḥ arciṣā anantaram prāpya tvāt na tasya ādhikyam iti prāpte sūtram paṭhati

original: || ātivāhikastalliṃgāditi || asyārthaḥ || pūrvaṃ dvitīyaprāpyatvenokto vāyurātivāhika eva na mukhyaḥ| kutaḥ| talliṃgāt pūrvaprāpyatvavāyuśabdāt| arciṣaḥ sa iti rūpataddharmāderityarthaḥ ||

original: evaṃca jñānināṃ kārya eva pratipattyabhisaṃdhyorabhāvāt| paraviṣaye tu tayorabhāvābhāvāt| yadupāste pumāniti smṛteḥ| tataśca vāyuḥ parameva tān gamayati na kāryamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca jñāninām kārye eva pratipatti abhisaṃdhyoḥ abhāvāt para viṣaye tu tayoḥ abhāva abhāvāt yat upāste pumān iti smṛteḥ tatas ca vāyuḥ param eva tān gamayati na kāryam iti siddham

original: || apratīkālaṃbanānnayatīti bādarāyaṇa ubhayathā ca doṣāttatkratuśca ||
analyzed: a pratīka ālaṃbanāt nayati iti bādarāyaṇaḥ ubhayathā ca doṣāt tad kratuḥ ca

original: adhikāribhedenobhayaprāptiriti siddhāṃtayatsūtramupanyasyati ||
analyzed: adhikāri bhedena ubhaya prāptiḥ iti siddhāṃtayat sūtram upanyasyati

original: || apratīkālaṃbanānnayatīti bādarāyaṇa ubhayathā ca doṣāttatkratuśceti ||asyārthaḥ || vāyurapratīkālaṃbanān vyāptopāsakānadhikāriṇaḥ nayati paraṃ brahma gamayati| anyān pratīkālaṃbanān pratikaśabditadehāṃta upāsakān kāryabrahma nayatīti| sa enān iti śrutyartha iti bādarāyaṇācāryo manyate| kutaḥ| ubhayathā ca doṣāt|
analyzed: apratīka ālaṃbanān nayati iti bādarāyaṇaḥ ubhayathā ca doṣāt tad kratuḥ ca iti asya arthaḥ vāyuḥ apratīka ālaṃbanān vyāpta upāsaka anadhikāriṇaḥ nayati param brahma gamayati anyān pratīka ālaṃbanān pratika śabdita dehāṃte upāsakān kārya brahma nayati iti saḥ enān iti śruti arthaḥ iti bādarāyaṇa ācāryaḥ manyate kutas ubhayathā ca doṣāt

original: enāṃ vyavasthāmanaṃgīkṛtya sarveṣāṃ ekaikaprāptyaṃgīkāre kāryabrahmaparabrahmapāptyaṃgīkāre kāryaparabrahmaprāptipakṣadvayoktadoṣatvaprāpteḥ| nanu yatprāptumabhivāṃchaṃti tatprāpnotīti vacanāttattadicchāmātreṇa tattatprāptisaṃbhavānnoktavyavasthāṃgīkāryetyata āha| tatkratuśceti| anena sa yathā kāmo bhavati tatkraturbhavatītyādi śrutirgṛhyate|
analyzed: enām vyavasthām an aṃgīkṛtya sarveṣām ekaika prāpti aṃgīkāre kārya brahma para brahma pāpti aṃgīkāre kārya para brahma prāpti pakṣa dvaya ukta doṣatva prāpteḥ nanu yat prāptum abhivāṃchaṃti tat prāpnoti iti vacanāt tad tad icchā mātreṇa tad tad prāpti saṃbhavāt na ukta vyavasthā aṃgīkāryā iti atas āha tad kratuḥ ca iti anena sa yathā kāmaḥ bhavati tad kratuḥ bhavati ityādi śrutiḥ gṛhyate

original: ca śabdo yata ityarthe| yataḥ sa yatheti śrutistattatprāptīcchāmātreṇa tattatprāptiṃ pratiṣidhya tatjñānopāsanāparokṣaireva tatprāptiṃ vakti| atastattadicchāmātreṇaiva na tatprāptiryujyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ca śabdaḥ yatas iti arthe yatas sa yathā iti śrutiḥ tad tad prāpti icchā mātreṇa tad tad prāptim pratiṣidhya tad jñāna upāsana parokṣaiḥ eva tad prāptim vakti atas tad tad icchā mātreṇa eva na tad prāptiḥ yujyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca vāyuḥ pratīkālaṃbanānmanuṣyāṃśca kāryaṃ nayati| apratīkālaṃbaneṣu ṛṣīṇāṃ śataṃ rājñāṃ śataṃ ca paraṃ nyatīti śrutyarthatvāt| sarvānkāryaṃ nayatītyarthatve sarvānparameva nayatītyarthatve ca doṣasadbhāvāt| na cecchāvaśenaiva kāryaparaprāptyorasaṃbhavenāpratīkālaṃbanatvādiviśeṣāṃgīkāro vyartha iti vācyaṃ|
analyzed: evam ca vāyuḥ pratīka ālaṃbanān manuṣyān ca kāryam nayati apratīka ālaṃbaneṣu ṛṣīṇām śatam rājñām śatam ca param śruti artha tvāt sarvān kāryam nayati iti artha tve sarvān param eva nayati iti artha tve ca doṣa sadbhāvāt na ca icchā vaśena eva kārya para prāptyoḥ asaṃbhavena apratīka ālaṃbana tva ādi viśeṣa aṃgīkāraḥ vyarthaḥ iti vācyam

original: sa yathā kāma iti śrutau tatprāptīcchūnāmicchānusāreṇa tatprāptipratiṣedhāt| pratīkālaṃbanatvādivibhāge pratīkamiti smṛteḥ pramāṇatvena sadbhāvāt| ato jñānināmadhikāribhedenobhayaprāptiriti bhagavānbādarāyaṇo manyata iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: sa yathā kāmaḥ iti śrutau tad prāpti icchūnām icchā anusāreṇa tad prāpti pratiṣedhāt pratīka ālaṃbana tva ādi vibhāge pratīkam iti smṛteḥ pramāṇa tvena sadbhāvāt atas jñāninām adhikāri bhedena ubhaya prāptiḥ iti bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ manyate iti siddham

original: || viśeṣaṃ ca darśayati ||
analyzed: viśeṣam ca darśayati

original: yaduktaṃ necchānusāreṇa prāptirapi tu pratīkālaṃbanādikrameṇaiveti na tadyuktaṃ| kecidapratīkālaṃbanāḥ kecitpratīkālaṃbanā iti niyame pramāṇābhāvena yatheṣṭamapratīkālaṃbanatvāpādanasyāpi saṃbhavādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati ||
analyzed: yat uktam na icchā anusāreṇa prāptiḥ api tu pratīka ālaṃbana ādi krameṇa eva iti na tat yuktam kecid apratīka ālaṃbanāḥ kecid pratīka ālaṃbanāḥ iti niyame pramāṇa abhāvena yatheṣṭam apratīka ālaṃbana tva āpādanasya api saṃbhavāt iti āśaṃkām pariharat sūtram paṭhati

original: || viśeṣaṃ ca darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| aṃtaḥ prakāśā iti śrutiḥ kecanāpratīkālaṃbanāḥ kecanapratīkālaṃbanāḥ iti viśeṣaṃ bhedaṃ darśayati pratipādayati| tasmāccoktaṃ yuktamirtyathaḥ ||
analyzed: viśeṣam ca darśayati iti asya arthaḥ caḥ yatas aṃtar prakāśāḥ iti śrutiḥ kecana a pratīka ālaṃbanāḥ kecana pratīka ālaṃbanāḥ iti viśeṣam bhedam darśayati pratipādayati tasmāt ca uktam yuktam irti atha

original: evaṃcāṃtaḥ prakāśā iti śrutyā pratīkāpratīkalaṃbanayorviśeṣabhedasya pratipāditvāt| ato'pratīkālaṃbanānityādyuktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evaṃca aṃtar prakāśāḥ iti śrutyā pratīka apratīka laṃbanayoḥ viśeṣa bhedasya pratipādi tvāt atas pratīka ālaṃbana anitya ādi uktam yuktam iti siddham

original: || iti kāryādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: || hariḥ ||

original: || saṃpadyāvihāya svena śabdāt ||

original: nanu mukto brahmātikramya muktau bhogānbhuṃkte| etaṃ setuṃ tīrtveti brahmātikramānaṃtaraṃ rūpāvirbhāvasyoktatvenānatikramya sthitasya svarūpānubhavāyogāt| ato muktasya brah‌mātikramaniyamānna tadgamyamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu muktaḥ brahma atikramya muktau bhogān bhuṃkte etam setum tīrtvā iti brahma atikrama anaṃtaram rūpa āvirbhāvasya ukta tvena an atikramya sthitasya svarūpa anubhava ayogāt atas muktasya brahma atikrama niyamāt na tat gamyam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || saṃpādyāvihāya svena śabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || jñānī saṃpadya brahma prāpya| avihāya brahmānatikramya| svena āvirbhūtasvarūpeṇāvasthitaḥ san bhogānbhuṃkte| kutaḥ| śabdāt sa evaṃ viditi śruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃpādya a vihāya svena śabdāt iti asya arthaḥ jñānī saṃpadya brahma prāpya a vihāya brahma an atikramya svena āvirbhūta svarūpeṇa avasthitaḥ san bhogān bhuṃkte kutas śabdāt saḥ evam vid iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca brahma saṃpadyāvihāyaiva bhogānbhuṃkte| sa evamiti śruteḥ| paraṃjyotiriti śruteśca| etamiti śruterbrahmaprāptayenyataraṇasyaiva tadarthatvanāvirodhāt| ato muktasya brahmādikramābhāvāttadeva gamyamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca brahma saṃpadya a vihāya eva bhogān bhuṃkte saḥ evam iti śruteḥ paraṃjyotiḥ iti śruteḥ ca etam iti śruteḥ brahma prāptaye nya taraṇasya eva atas muktasya brahma ādi krama abhāvāt tat eva gamyam iti siddham

original: || iti saṃpadyādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: atra brahma prāpya tadavihāyaiva bhogabhokturmuktatvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra brahma prāpya tat a vihāya eva bhoga bhoktuḥ mukta tvam sādhyate

original: || muktaḥ pratijñānāt ||
analyzed: muktaḥ pratijñānāt

original: nanu sa tatra paryetīti śrutyukto na muktaḥ| paryetīti kriyāpratīteḥ| muktasya kṛtakṛtyārthatvena kriyā'saṃbhavāt| na cāmuktasyaivaṃ vidhabhogāsaṃbhavaḥ| prāgasaṃbhave'pi gavatprāptyanaṃtaraṃ saṃbhavāt| na ca śrutyuktasyāmukttve svena rūpeṇeti vākyavirodhaḥ| tatra nirguṇopāsakasya svarūpāvirbhāvābhidhānāt|
analyzed: nanu sa tatra paryeti iti śruti uktaḥ na muktaḥ paryeti iti kriyā pratīteḥ muktasya kṛtakṛtya artha tvena kriyā saṃbhavāt na ca amuktasya evam vidha bhoga asaṃbhavaḥ prāk asaṃbhave api gavat prāpti anaṃtaram saṃbhavāt na ca śruti uktasya amukt tve svena rūpeṇa iti vākya virodhaḥ tatra nirguṇa upāsakasya svarūpa āvirbhāva abhidhānāt

original: sa tatreti daharavidyopāsasyāmuktasyaiva bhogābhidhānāt| ataḥ śrutyuktasyāmuktatvānna muktasya bhoga iti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: sa tatra iti dahara vidyā upāsasya amuktasya eva bhoga abhidhānāt atas śruti uktasya amukta tvāt na muktasya bhogaḥ iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || muktaḥ pratijñānāditi || asyārthaḥ || sa tatra paryetīti śrutau mukta evocyate| kutaḥ| pratijñānāt muktādanyasya divyabhogaṃ pratiṣidhyāharaha iti śrutau muktasyaiva brahmaprāptyā divyabhogokterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: muktaḥ pratijñānāt iti asya arthaḥ sa tatra paryeti iti śrutau muktaḥ eva ucyate kutas pratijñānāt muktāt anyasya divya bhogam pratiṣidhya aharahar iti śrutau muktasya eva brahma prāptyāḥ divya bhoga ukteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutau muktasyaivoktatvāt| muktatvaṃ vinaitadbhogāsaṃbhavāt| svarūpāvirbhāvokteśca| ekaprakaraṇatvasaṃbhave bhinnaprakāraṇatvakalpanā'yogāt| anyathā'tiprasaṃgāt| ato yukta eva muktasya bhoga iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca nirdiṣṭa śrutau muktasya eva ukta tvāt mukta tvam vinā etad bhoga asaṃbhavāt svarūpa āvirbhāva ukteḥ ca eka prakaraṇa tva saṃbhave bhinna prakāraṇa tva kalpanā yogāt anyathā atiprasaṃgāt atas yuktaḥ eva muktasya bhogaḥ iti siddham

original: || iti muktādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti muktā adhikaraṇam

original: atra muktaprāpyasya jyotiṣo brahmatvaṃ sādhyate|
analyzed: atra mukta prāpyasya jyotiṣaḥ brahmatvam sādhyate

original: || ātmā prakaraṇāt ||
analyzed: ātmā prakaraṇāt

original: nanu paraṃjyoti śabdokto na viṣṇuḥ| kiṃtvādityo bhavet| sa tejasīti śrutyā samākhyānāt| evaṃca na muktasya brahmasamīpe bhoga iti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu paraṃjyoti śabda uktaḥ na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu ādityaḥ bhavet sa tejasi iti śrutyā samākhyānāt evaṃca na muktasya brahma samīpe bhogaḥ iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || ātmā prakaraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || paraṃjyotiḥ śabdena ātmā paramātmaivocyate na sūryaḥ| kutaḥ| prakaraṇāt asya vākyasya paramātmaprakaraṇatvādityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: ātmā prakaraṇāt iti asya arthaḥ paraṃjyotiḥ śabdena ātmā paramātmā eva ucyate na sūryaḥ kutas prakaraṇāt asya vākyasya paramātma prakaraṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca ya ātmeti bhagavata evārabhyādhītatvenāsya tatprakaraṇātvāt| prakaraṇasya samākhyāto balavattvāt| sūryamaṃḍalaprāptyanaṃtaraṃ pāpakarmavināśāṃgīkāreṇa sa tejasīti vākyasya kiṃstudhnaprāptipūrvakālikasūryaprāptiparatvena sāvakāśatvāt| paraṃjyotiḥśabdasyānyatrābhāvācca|
analyzed: evam ca yaḥ ātmā iti bhagavataḥ eva ārabhya adhīta tvena asya tad prakaraṇa atvāt prakaraṇasya samākhyātaḥ balavat tvāt sūrya maṃḍala prāpti anaṃtaram pāpa karma vināśa aṃgīkāreṇa sa tejasi iti vākyasya sāvakāśa tvāt paraṃjyotiḥ śabdasya anyatra abhāvāt ca

original: ataḥ paraṃ jyotirbrahmaiveti tatprāptyāvihāyaiva mukto bhogānbhuṃkta iti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: atas param jyotiḥ brahma eva iti tad prāptyā vihāya eva muktaḥ bhogān bhuṃkte iti siddham

original: || iti ātmādhikaraṇaṃ ||
analyzed: iti ātma adhikaraṇam

original: atra sāyujyabhājāṃ bhagavadbhuktabhogabhoktṛtvaṃ samarthyate |
analyzed: atra sāyujya bhājām bhagavat bhukta bhoga bhoktṛ tvam samarthyate

original: || avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvāt ||
analyzed: avibhāgena dṛṣṭa tvāt

original: nanu muktāḥ paramātmanā'bhuktabhogān bhuṃjate| avāptamahāpuruṣārthatvāt| anyathā kadācinmuktānāṃ bhogecchāyāmapyavāptakāmatvena paramātmanastadanicchāyāṃ muktānāṃ bhogo na syāt| paramātmabhogaṃ vinā teṣāṃ bhogāyogāt| tataśca bhagavadabhuktabhogabhoktṛtvānna tasya sarvabhoktṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha ||
analyzed: nanu muktāḥ paramātmanā abhukta bhogān bhuṃjate avāpta mahāpuruṣa artha tvāt anyathā kadācid muktānām bhoga icchāyām api avāpta kāmatvena paramātmanaḥ tad anicchāyām muktānām bhogaḥ na syāt paramātma bhogam vinā teṣām bhoga ayogāt tatas ca bhagavat abhukta bhoga bhoktṛ tvāt na tasya sarva bhoktṛ tvam iti prāpte sūtram āha

original: || avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvāditi| asyārthaḥ || avibhāgena paramātmabhuktāḥ krameṇaiva muktaiḥ bhogāḥ bhujyaṃte| kutaḥ| dṛṣṭatvāt yānevāhamiti śruterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: avibhāgena dṛṣṭa tvāt iti asya arthaḥ avibhāgena paramātma bhuktāḥ krameṇa eva muktaiḥ bhogāḥ bhujyaṃte kutas dṛṣṭa tvāt yān eva aham iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca bhuktāneva bhogānbhuṃjaṃte muktāḥ| yānevāhaṃ śṛṇomīti śruteḥ| muktāḥ prāpyeti smṛteśca| ato muktānāṃ bhagavadbhuktabhogabhoktṛtvādyuktaṃ tasya sarvabhoktṛtvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca bhuktān eva bhogān bhuṃjaṃte muktāḥ yān eva aham śṛṇomi iti śruteḥ muktāḥ prāpya iti smṛteḥ ca atas muktānām bhagavat bhukta bhoga bhoktṛ tvāt yuktam tasya sarva bhoktṛ tvam iti siddham

original: || iti avibhāgādhikaraṇaṃ ||

original: atra brahmaprāptasya sāyujyamuktasya bhogaḥ samarthyate|

original: || brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhyaḥ ||
analyzed: brāhmeṇa jaiminiḥ upanyāsa ādibhyaḥ

original: nanu na muktānāṃ bhogo yuktaḥ| śarīrābhāvāt| teṣāṃ dehasadbhāvāṃgīkāre muktatvavyāghātāt| ato muktau bhogāsaṃbhavādapuruṣārthatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ ||
analyzed: nanu na muktānām bhogaḥ yuktaḥ śarīra abhāvāt teṣām deha sadbhāva aṃgīkāre mukta tva vyāghātāt atas muktau bhoga asaṃbhavāt apuruṣa artha tvam iti prāpte sūtritam

original: || brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || brāhmeṇa brahmasaṃbaṃdhidehenaiva| mukto bhogānbhuṃkte| kutaḥ| upanyāsādibhyaḥ brahmaṇeti śruteḥ| ādi padoktādatta iti smṛteryukteśceti jaiminyācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: brāhmeṇa jaiminiḥ upanyāsa ādibhyaḥ iti asya arthaḥ brāhmeṇa brahma saṃbaṃdhi dehena eva muktaḥ bhogān bhuṃkte kutas upanyāsa ādibhyaḥ brahmaṇā iti śruteḥ ādi pada ukta ādatte iti smṛteḥ yukteḥ ca iti jaimini ācāryaḥ manyate iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃca muktānāṃ dehābhāve'pi brāhmeṇa dehena bhogasya yuktatvāt| nirdiṣṭaśrutismṛtyośca| jaiminyuktasyāpi prāmāṇikatvena bādarāyaṇokteravirodhāt| ato muktau bhogasaṃbhavādyuktaṃ mukteḥ puruṣārthatvamiti siddhaṃ ||
analyzed: evam ca muktānām deha abhāve pi brāhmeṇa dehena bhogasya yuktatvāt nirdiṣṭa śruti smṛtyoḥ ca jaimini uktasya api prāmāṇika tvena bādarāyaṇa ukteḥ avirodhāt atas muktau bhoga saṃbhavāt yuktam mukteḥ puruṣa artha tvam iti siddham
